# ==== Part 2 of 6: Shared blocks (3): each is written back into the files that name it
$shared = @{}
$shared['rade-signin-50c4c3e9'] = @'
# >>> rade-signin: generated from the pinned RADE sign-in block by scripts/build_task_scripts.py (do not edit)
# ---- RADE sign-in window size (start; engine/ps/07-checks.ps1 $signInSize; E3, the Owner, 2026-11-21)
# engine-v44 (the PFM, 2026-11-26): RADE never touches the CAC sign-in window of Connect-PnPOnline -UseWebLogin; it opens
# at its own size. The size watch of engine-v35 to engine-v43 (Start-SignInSize) is gone: it froze the sign-in
# (90-161.Z R44 r2, one host: watch on, 2 windows not responding at 9 s; watch off, signed in after 5 s).
# The block holds the read-only window report (Start-SignInReport, Stop-SignInReport), the DPI setting of engine-v46
# (Set-SignInDpiAware) and the one sign-in (Connect-RadeSite).
# Copy this block unchanged between its start and end lines (an app's task scripts may hold the same copy).
# Windows PowerShell 5.1, no module. When the report helper cannot be compiled (Constrained Language Mode), the sign-in
# goes on without it.
# engine-v43 S2 (the PFM, 2026-11-26: R44 r1 froze at the sign-in with no data): while Connect-PnPOnline runs, a
# background timer reads the windows of THIS process only, about every second, and prints one line at each change:
# "SIGNIN-WIN t=<seconds> windows=<visible> owned=<visible with an owner> min=<minimized> size=<largest WxH>
# hung=<not responding> front=<1 when the foreground window is one of them>". No title, no text, no other process.
# The parent reads the lines while the child runs (Invoke-ChildScript -StageSeconds), so a frozen sign-in still reports.
function Start-SignInReport {
  [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess, ConfirmImpact = 'None')]
  param()
  if (-not $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess('the windows of this process', 'Report their state')) { return }   # -WhatIf: no timer
  if ($env:OS -ne 'Windows_NT' -and $env:RADE_SIGNIN_TEST -ne '1') { return }   # Windows only (the cloud test compiles it)
  try {
    if (-not ('RadeSignIn.Report1' -as [type])) {
      Add-Type -Namespace RadeSignIn -Name Report1 -ErrorAction Stop -MemberDefinition @"
public delegate bool WinProc(System.IntPtr h, System.IntPtr l);
[System.Runtime.InteropServices.DllImport("user32.dll")] static extern bool EnumThreadWindows(uint tid, WinProc f, System.IntPtr l);
[System.Runtime.InteropServices.DllImport("user32.dll")] static extern bool IsWindowVisible(System.IntPtr h);
[System.Runtime.InteropServices.DllImport("user32.dll")] static extern bool IsIconic(System.IntPtr h);
[System.Runtime.InteropServices.DllImport("user32.dll")] static extern bool IsHungAppWindow(System.IntPtr h);
[System.Runtime.InteropServices.DllImport("user32.dll")] static extern System.IntPtr GetWindow(System.IntPtr h, uint cmd);
[System.Runtime.InteropServices.DllImport("user32.dll")] static extern System.IntPtr GetForegroundWindow();
[System.Runtime.InteropServices.DllImport("user32.dll")] static extern bool GetWindowRect(System.IntPtr h, out Rect r);
[System.Runtime.InteropServices.StructLayout(System.Runtime.InteropServices.LayoutKind.Sequential)]
public struct Rect { public int L, T, R, B; }
static System.Threading.Timer timer; static object gate = new object(); static System.DateTime t0; static string last = "";
static int n, owned, mins, hung, front, bw, bh; static long fg; static WinProc each = Each;
// Starts the report: one look now, then one every tickMs, until End. The timer starts outside the lock, so the first look runs.
public static void Begin(int tickMs) { End(false); lock (gate) { t0 = System.DateTime.Now; last = ""; }
  System.Threading.Timer tm = new System.Threading.Timer(Tick, null, System.Threading.Timeout.Infinite, System.Threading.Timeout.Infinite);
  lock (gate) { timer = tm; } tm.Change(0, tickMs); }
// Ends the report: waits until no tick runs, then, with final, prints one last line (the state at the end).
public static void End(bool final) {
  System.Threading.Timer tm; lock (gate) { tm = timer; timer = null; }
  // The event is closed only when the last tick has ended: a tick that runs past 2 s signals it later, and a closed event
  // would then end this process (review of PR 201). In that rare case the event is closed later by the garbage collector.
  if (tm != null) { System.Threading.ManualResetEvent done = new System.Threading.ManualResetEvent(false); if (!tm.Dispose(done) || done.WaitOne(2000)) { done.Dispose(); } }
  if (final) { lock (gate) { Look(true); } } }
// One timer tick: a tick that starts while another look runs is skipped; a tick after End prints nothing.
static void Tick(object state) {
  if (!System.Threading.Monitor.TryEnter(gate)) { return; }
  try { if (timer != null) { Look(false); } } finally { System.Threading.Monitor.Exit(gate); } }
// Reads the windows of this process and prints a line when the state changed since the last line, or when force is set.
// The caller holds gate.
static void Look(bool force) {
  try { n = 0; owned = 0; mins = 0; hung = 0; front = 0; bw = 0; bh = 0; fg = GetForegroundWindow().ToInt64();
    using (System.Diagnostics.Process me = System.Diagnostics.Process.GetCurrentProcess()) {
      foreach (System.Diagnostics.ProcessThread t in me.Threads) { EnumThreadWindows((uint)t.Id, each, System.IntPtr.Zero); } }
    string s = "windows=" + n + " owned=" + owned + " min=" + mins + " size=" + bw + "x" + bh + " hung=" + hung + " front=" + front;
    if (s != last || force) { last = s; System.Console.Out.WriteLine("SIGNIN-WIN t=" + (int)(System.DateTime.Now - t0).TotalSeconds + " " + s); System.Console.Out.Flush(); } }
  catch { } }
static bool Each(System.IntPtr hw, System.IntPtr l) {
  if (!IsWindowVisible(hw)) { return true; }
  n++; if (GetWindow(hw, 4) != System.IntPtr.Zero) { owned++; } if (IsIconic(hw)) { mins++; } if (IsHungAppWindow(hw)) { hung++; } if (hw.ToInt64() == fg) { front = 1; }
  Rect r; if (GetWindowRect(hw, out r) && (r.R - r.L) * (r.B - r.T) > bw * bh) { bw = r.R - r.L; bh = r.B - r.T; }
  return true; }
"@
    }
    [RadeSignIn.Report1]::Begin(1000)
  } catch { $null = $_ }   # no helper: the sign-in goes on without the report
}
function Stop-SignInReport {
  [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess, ConfirmImpact = 'None')]
  param()
  if (-not $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess('the window report of this process', 'Stop')) { return }
  try { if ('RadeSignIn.Report1' -as [type]) { [RadeSignIn.Report1]::End($true) } } catch { $null = $_ }   # no report: nothing to stop
}
# engine-v47 (the PFM, 2026-11-26, from the R46 run: "SIGNIN-DPI aware=yes", then the sign-in window opened only after
# about 90 s and 100 s; "dpiaware is clearly the culprit"): the DPI setting of engine-v46 is OFF unless
# $env:RADE_SIGNIN_DPI = '1'. The RADE window sets '0' for its children (part 09), so an app's older copy of this block,
# which turns it off only on '0', is off too. With it on, the child becomes DPI-aware (SetProcessDPIAware) before the
# sign-in, so Windows draws the PnP window at its own pixels, not stretched (90-161.Z R45 finding 2); RADE does not move,
# size or watch the window (engine-v44). Prints "SIGNIN-DPI aware=<yes|was|no|off>": yes (now aware), was (already
# aware), no (Windows did not take it, or not Windows), off (not turned on). Takes nothing.
function Set-SignInDpiAware {
  [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess, ConfirmImpact = 'None')]
  param()
  if ($env:RADE_SIGNIN_DPI -ne '1') { return 'SIGNIN-DPI aware=off' }   # engine-v47: off unless turned on
  if (-not $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess('this process', 'Make DPI-aware')) { return 'SIGNIN-DPI aware=no' }
  if ($env:OS -ne 'Windows_NT') { return 'SIGNIN-DPI aware=no' }
  try {
    if (-not ('RadeSignIn.Dpi1' -as [type])) {
      Add-Type -Namespace RadeSignIn -Name Dpi1 -ErrorAction Stop -MemberDefinition @"
[System.Runtime.InteropServices.DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool SetProcessDPIAware();
[System.Runtime.InteropServices.DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool IsProcessDPIAware();
"@
    }
    if ([RadeSignIn.Dpi1]::IsProcessDPIAware()) { return 'SIGNIN-DPI aware=was' }
    if ([RadeSignIn.Dpi1]::SetProcessDPIAware()) { return 'SIGNIN-DPI aware=yes' }
  } catch { $null = $_ }   # no helper (Constrained Language Mode): the sign-in goes on at Windows' size
  return 'SIGNIN-DPI aware=no'
}
# engine-v43 S1: the one sign-in of a child script. Prints "STAGE signin" (the parent stops a stage that runs too long),
# signs in with the CAC (PnP web login), prints "SIGNIN seconds=<n>" and "STAGE none" (no stage runs).
# Throws when the sign-in fails, as Connect-PnPOnline does. Takes the site address.
function Connect-RadeSite([string]$Site) {
  'STAGE signin'
  Set-SignInDpiAware   # engine-v47: prints aware=off unless RADE_SIGNIN_DPI=1 (the DPI sign-in of engine-v46 opened its window after about 90 s)
  $t0 = Get-Date; Start-SignInReport   # engine-v44: no size watch
  try { $null = & { Connect-PnPOnline -Url $Site -UseWebLogin -ErrorAction Stop } *>&1 }
  finally { Stop-SignInReport }   # no report after the sign-in
  'SIGNIN seconds=' + [int]((Get-Date) - $t0).TotalSeconds
  'STAGE none'
}

# >>> site-common: generated from scripts/gov/src/site-common.ps1 by scripts/build_task_scripts.py (do not edit)
function Get-SiteAddress([string]$ConfigDir) {
  # One entry (PFM 15 Nov 26): the address RADE holds (RADE_SITE, from its "Site address" box) is used with no question;
  # outside RADE the one saved in Config\90161Z-site.txt is used. Only when neither exists does a question open (once).
  # To change the site, use "Change the site address" in RADE. Kept only on this computer (the repo is public).
  $ok = '^https://[^/\s]+/sites/[^/\s]+'
  $v = ([string]$env:RADE_SITE).Trim()
  if ($v -match $ok) { return $v }
  $f = Join-Path $ConfigDir '90161Z-site.txt'
  if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f -PathType Leaf) { $v = ([string](Get-Content -LiteralPath $f -TotalCount 1)).Trim(); if ($v -match $ok) { return $v } }
  # RADE runs a step with no window, so a question there would wait unseen: stop with the fix instead.
  if ($env:RADE_CONTRACT) { throw 'SITE ADDRESS not set. Complete the "Site address" box in RADE, then run this step again.' }
  $v = ([string](Read-Host 'Site address (it starts with https://; it is kept only on this computer), then press Enter')).Trim()
  if ($v -notmatch $ok) { throw 'SITE ADDRESS not given or not a site address (https://<host>/sites/<name>). Run again.' }
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $ConfigDir -PathType Container)) { [void](New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $ConfigDir -Force) }
  Set-Content -LiteralPath $f -Value $v -Encoding UTF8
  return $v
}

function Hide-Site([string]$Text, [string]$Site) {
  <#
  .SYNOPSIS
  Masks e-mail addresses, the site, its host, path, name and tenant, other URLs, cloud and .mil hosts and GUIDs in a
  result text. Not masked: display names, office symbols, phone numbers, user ids, computer names.
  .PARAMETER Text
  The text to clean (a result line or an error message).
  .PARAMETER Site
  The site address (https://<host>/sites/<name>), or an empty text for the generic rules only.
  .OUTPUTS
  System.String. The text with each match replaced by a placeholder such as <EMAIL>, <SITE> or <GUID>.
  #>
  # The address only (name, @ or %40, host; encoded characters and an apostrophe inside the name count as part of it),
  # first: the host rules below would
  # keep its name part.
  $Text = $Text -replace '(?:[\w.+=-]|%[0-9A-Fa-f]{2}|(?<=\w)[''\u2019](?=\w))+(?:@|%40)[A-Za-z0-9-]+(?:\.[A-Za-z0-9-]+)*(?:%[0-9A-Fa-f]{2})*', '<EMAIL>'
  if ($Site) {
    $Text = $Text -replace [regex]::Escape($Site.TrimEnd('/')), '<SITE>'
    try {
      $u = [uri]$Site; $p = $u.AbsolutePath.TrimEnd('/'); $leaf = ($p -split '/')[-1]   # $p is /sites/<name>: also in URL-encoded form
      $set = @(, @($u.Host, '<SITE-HOST>', ''))   # literal text, placeholder, word boundary (tenant and site name only, 3+ letters)
      if ($p.Length -gt 1) { $set += @($p, '<SITE-PATH>', ''), @([uri]::EscapeDataString($p), '<SITE-PATH>', ''), @($leaf, '<SITE-NAME>', '\b') }
      $set += , @(($u.Host -split '\.')[0], '<TENANT>', '\b')
      foreach ($s in $set) { if ($s[2] -eq '' -or $s[0].Length -ge 3) { $Text = $Text -replace ($s[2] + [regex]::Escape($s[0]) + $s[2]), $s[1] } }
    } catch { $null = $_ }
  }
  # Pattern and mask pairs. The GUID has no \b: guid%27<id> must be masked too.
  $g = @('https?://\S+', '<URL>', '\b[\w.-]+\.(sharepoint|onmicrosoft|microsoftonline|windows)\.(com|us|net|mil)\b', '<TENANT-HOST>',
    '\b[\w.-]+\.mil\b', '<HOST>', '[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}', '<GUID>')
  for ($i = 0; $i -lt $g.Count; $i += 2) { $Text = $Text -replace $g[$i], $g[$i + 1] }
  return $Text
}

# >>> task-common: generated from scripts/gov/src/task-common.ps1 by scripts/build_task_scripts.py (do not edit)
function ConvertTo-Masked([string]$Text, [string[]]$Secret) {
  foreach ($x in $Secret) { $Text = $Text -replace [regex]::Escape($x), '<DODID>' }
  return $Text
}

function Get-TaskId([string]$Id) {
  # Returns @{ Id; Leaf (profile folder name); Secret (longest first, so a longer name is masked before a shorter one inside it) }.
  $leaf = ''
  if ($env:USERPROFILE) { $leaf = Split-Path -Leaf $env:USERPROFILE }
  $value = ([string]$Id).Trim()
  # No DODID question (PFM 13 Nov 26): the Windows profile folder name is used when -Id is not given.
  if (-not $value) { $value = $leaf }
  if ($value -notmatch '^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{4,}$') { throw 'DODID not valid: use the folder name under C:\Users (4 or more letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore).' }
  $secret = @(@($value, $leaf, $env:USERNAME) |
    Where-Object { $_ -and $_.Length -ge 4 } | Sort-Object -Unique | Sort-Object Length -Descending)
  return @{ Id = $value; Leaf = $leaf; Secret = $secret }
}

function Get-TaskDir([string]$Id, [string]$Task, [string]$Label, [switch]$Create) {
  # The task folder C:\Users\<DODID>\<OneDrive>\RADE\90-161.Z\<Task>: <OneDrive> is the folder name of $env:OneDriveCommercial,
  # else 'OneDrive - United States Air Force' (fleet v2). Until RADE moves the old ...\90-161.Z, that one is used. -Create makes it.
  $odName = if ($env:OneDriveCommercial) { Split-Path -Leaf $env:OneDriveCommercial } else { 'OneDrive - United States Air Force' }; $od = Join-Path (Join-Path 'C:\Users' $Id) $odName
  $app = 'RADE\90-161.Z'
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $od $app) -PathType Container) -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $od '90-161.Z') -PathType Container)) { $app = '90-161.Z' }
  $tail = $odName + '\' + $app + '\' + $Task
  $dir = Join-Path (Join-Path 'C:\Users' $Id) $tail
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir -PathType Container)) {
    if ($Create) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir | Out-Null }
    else { throw ('FOLDER not found: C:\Users\<DODID>\' + $tail + '. Create it, save the ' + $Label + ' files into it, then run again.') }
  }
  return $dir
}

function Assert-TaskFile([string]$Dir, [string[]]$Name, [string]$Message) {
  # Throws $Message + the missing names when a file in $Name is not in $Dir.
  $missing = @($Name | Where-Object { -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $Dir $_) -PathType Leaf) })
  if ($missing.Count -gt 0) { throw ($Message + ($missing -join ', ')) }
}

function Unblock-TaskScript([string]$Dir) {
  # Files pasted into Notepad and saved locally need no unblock; a failed unblock is not an error here.
  Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $Dir -Filter *.ps1 | ForEach-Object { Unblock-File -LiteralPath $_.FullName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
}

function Invoke-TaskStep([hashtable]$Step, [string]$ScriptDir, [string[]]$Secret, $Lines, [string]$Log) {
  # Runs $Step.File from $ScriptDir in a child powershell.exe with $Step.Args, masks and records its output and exit
  # code in $Lines, and saves $Lines to $Log after the step.
  Write-Host ('STEP ' + $Step.Name + ' running (Word steps can take a few minutes; do not close this window)...')
  $Lines.Add('STEP ' + $Step.Name)
  $stepArgs = $Step.Args
  $global:LASTEXITCODE = $null
  # PS 5.1: with Stop, a stderr line from the step (2>&1) would end the runner. Record it instead.
  $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
  $out = & powershell.exe -NoProfile -File (Join-Path $ScriptDir $Step.File) @stepArgs 2>&1
  $code = $LASTEXITCODE
  $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
  foreach ($o in @($out | Where-Object { $null -ne $_ })) {
    $masked = ConvertTo-Masked ([string]$o) $Secret
    $Lines.Add($masked)
    Write-Host $masked
  }
  $Lines.Add('STEP ' + $Step.Name + ' exit=' + $code)
  Write-Host ('STEP ' + $Step.Name + ' exit=' + $code)
  Set-Content -LiteralPath $Log -Value $Lines -Encoding UTF8
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  90-161.Z Task 30 r1 (round R47; the PFM, 26 Nov 26: fewer CAC sign-ins): runs several parts of the task scripts T21, T26 and T27
  in this one process, in the order given, so the parts share one CAC sign-in. Windows PowerShell 5.1 (also 7), the installed

.DESCRIPTION
  Why: RADE runs each step in its own powershell.exe, and each step that reads the site signed in again (about 18 sign-ins in R46).
  A batch step runs its parts with the call operator in this process: the first part that needs the site signs in, and each later
  part finds that connection (Get-PnPConnection in its own connect function) and prints "SIGNIN reused" instead of a second sign-in.
  The batch sets KANON_KEEP_SIGNIN=1 while the parts run, so no part signs out; the batch signs out once at its end.
  -Run: the parts, separated by ";", each "<task>:<part>" or "<task>:<part>:<label>", for example
  T21:Clean:first;T21:Make;T21:Person. Only the parts of the table $BatchParts below can run; a task, part or label that is not
  in the table, or a script that is not in its folder, stops the batch before any part runs (no path comes from -Run).
  Each part prints its own lines (the RADE step contract: PASS, FAIL, SKIP, NOW, MADE) and writes its own result file. A part
  that ends with an exit code other than 0 does not stop the parts after it (a clean-up part must still run); the batch then
  ends with exit code 1. In RADE's Uninstall the batch runs with RADE_MODE and RADE_MADE, which the parts read as before.
  Lines of the batch itself: TASK T30 batch r1, <N> parts, <time>; NOW Part <n> of <N>: <task> <part> [<label>]; BATCH part <n> of <N>: <task> <part> [<label>], exit
  code <c>; BATCH done: parts=<N> exit-not-zero=<n>; or STOPPED: <why>. The words of the step contract are not in them.
  Network: the one SharePoint site of the parts (RADE_SITE or Config\90161Z-site.txt), only through the parts it runs.

  Run: by RADE (powershell.exe -NoProfile -File T30\90161Z-T30-batch-r1.ps1 -Id <DODID> -NoPause -Run <parts>); the part

.PARAMETER Id

param([string]$Id, [switch]$NoPause, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Run, [string]$ScriptRoot, [string]$TestRoot)
$task = 'T30'
$Rev = 'r1'
# The parts a batch may run: the task, its folder, its script (the revision of this round's bundle) and the parts of that script
# that sign in to the site. tests/ps/Test-T30.ps1 checks that each script is in scripts/gov and in the R47 bundle.
$BatchParts = @{
  T21 = @{ Dir = 'T21'; File = '90161Z-T21-probe-r14.ps1'; Parts = @('Clean', 'Make', 'Person'); Labels = @('first', 'last'); NoLaunch = $true }

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Reads -Run into the list of parts, and finds each part's script. Throws (before any part runs) on a part that is not in
  $BatchParts or a script that is not there.
.PARAMETER Text
  The value of -Run.
.PARAMETER AppDir
  The app folder that holds the task folders.
.PARAMETER FlatDir
  Test runs only: the value of -ScriptRoot (one folder with every part script), or ''.
.OUTPUTS
  An array of @{ Task; Part; Label; Name (for the lines); File (the full path); Entry (the $BatchParts row) }.
#>
function Get-BatchPlan([string]$Text, [string]$AppDir, [string]$FlatDir) {
  $plan = @()
  foreach ($one in @(([string]$Text).Split(';') | Where-Object { $_.Trim() })) {
    $bits = @($one.Trim().Split(':'))
    if ($bits.Count -lt 2 -or $bits.Count -gt 3) { throw ('PART not valid: "' + $one.Trim() + '" (use <task>:<part> or <task>:<part>:<label>)') }
    $entry = $BatchParts[$bits[0]]
    if (-not $entry -or $entry.Parts -cnotcontains $bits[1]) { throw ('PART not in the batch table: ' + $bits[0] + ':' + $bits[1]) }
    $label = $(if ($bits.Count -eq 3) { $bits[2] } else { '' })
    if ($label -and $entry.Labels -cnotcontains $label) { throw ('LABEL not in the batch table: ' + $one.Trim()) }
    $file = $(if ($FlatDir) { Join-Path $FlatDir $entry.File } else { Join-Path (Join-Path $AppDir $entry.Dir) $entry.File })
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $file -PathType Leaf)) { throw ('SCRIPT missing: ' + $entry.Dir + '\' + $entry.File + ' is not there. Run the round again.') }
    $plan += @{ Task = $bits[0]; Part = $bits[1]; Label = $label; Name = ($bits[0] + ' ' + $bits[1] + $(if ($label) { ' ' + $label } else { '' })); File = $file; Entry = $entry }
  }
  if (-not $plan.Count) { throw 'PART not given: -Run names no part.' }
  return $plan
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Runs one part of the plan in this process and gives back its exit code. An error that ends the part's script is shown
  (masked) and counts as exit code 1; the next part still runs.
.PARAMETER Step
  One entry of Get-BatchPlan.
.PARAMETER Who
  The Get-TaskId table (the DODID and its masks).
.PARAMETER PartTestRoot
  Test runs only: the value of -TestRoot, or ''.
.OUTPUTS
  The exit code of the part (0 when it ran to its end with no failure).
#>
function Invoke-BatchPart($Step, $Who, [string]$PartTestRoot) {
  $partArgs = @{ Id = $Who.Id; Part = $Step.Part; NoPause = $true }
  if ($Step.Label) { $partArgs.Label = $Step.Label }
  if ($PartTestRoot) { $partArgs.TestDir = Join-Path $PartTestRoot $Step.Entry.Dir; if ($Step.Entry.NoLaunch) { $partArgs.NoLaunch = $true } }
  $global:LASTEXITCODE = 0
  # A line that a part leaves on the output stream goes to the screen too, so this function gives back only the exit code.
  try { & $Step.File @partArgs | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ([string]$_) }; return [int]$LASTEXITCODE }
  catch {
    $why = ConvertTo-Masked (Hide-Site ([string]$_) ([string]$env:RADE_SITE)) $Who.Secret
    Write-Host ('STOPPED: the part ' + $Step.Name + ' did not run to its end: ' + $why.Substring(0, [Math]::Min(300, $why.Length)))
    return 1
  }
}

$batchFatal = $false; $batchBad = 0; $batchPlan = @()
try {
  $batchWho = Get-TaskId $Id
  $batchPlan = @(Get-BatchPlan $Run (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) $ScriptRoot)
  Write-Host ('TASK ' + $task + ' batch ' + $Rev + ', ' + $batchPlan.Count + ' parts, ' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'))
  Set-Item -Path ('Env:' + $BatchKeepVar) -Value '1'
  for ($batchAt = 0; $batchAt -lt $batchPlan.Count; $batchAt++) {
    $batchStep = $batchPlan[$batchAt]; $batchOf = [string]($batchAt + 1) + ' of ' + $batchPlan.Count
    Write-Host ('NOW Part ' + $batchOf + ': ' + $batchStep.Name)
    $batchCode = Invoke-BatchPart $batchStep $batchWho $TestRoot
    if ($batchCode -ne 0) { $batchBad++ }
    Write-Host ('BATCH part ' + $batchOf + ': ' + $batchStep.Name + ', exit code ' + $batchCode)
  }
} catch {
  $batchFatal = $true
  $batchWhy = ConvertTo-Masked (Hide-Site ([string]$_) ([string]$env:RADE_SITE)) $(if ($batchWho) { $batchWho.Secret } else { @() })
  Write-Host ('STOPPED: ' + $batchWhy.Substring(0, [Math]::Min(300, $batchWhy.Length)) + ' (no part ran after this)')
} finally {
  Remove-Item -Path ('Env:' + $BatchKeepVar) -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  # The one sign-out of the batch (the parts kept the sign-in); no PnP module loaded means no part signed in.
  if (Get-Command Disconnect-PnPOnline -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { try { $null = & { Disconnect-PnPOnline -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } *>&1 } catch { $null = $_ } }
  Write-Host ('BATCH done: parts=' + $batchPlan.Count + ' exit-not-zero=' + $batchBad)
  if (-not $NoPause -and -not $env:RADE_CONTRACT) { [void](Read-Host 'Press Enter to close') }
}
if ($batchFatal -or $batchBad) { exit 1 }
exit 0
'@ }

# @@SHARED task-common-2b522804@@ (RADE writes the shared block "task-common" here; its text is in the bundle part "Shared blocks")

# The guard of this step: every line goes to the result file as soon as it is written (a copy of the console output), and a
# timer ends this process when the sign-in runs past its limit, after it writes why. Windows PowerShell 5.1, no module.
if (-not ('T29Guard.Tee' -as [type])) {
  Add-Type -Namespace T29Guard -Name Tee -MemberDefinition @"
static System.IO.TextWriter was; static System.IO.StreamWriter file; static System.Threading.Timer timer; static object gate = new object();
// Starts the copy: each line written to the console also goes to the file at once (the file is made new).
public static void Begin(string path) { lock (gate) { was = System.Console.Out; file = new System.IO.StreamWriter(path, false, new System.Text.UTF8Encoding(true)); file.AutoFlush = true;
  System.Console.SetOut(new Both()); } }
// Writes one line to the console and to the file.
public static void Line(string s) { System.Console.Out.WriteLine(s); }
// Ends the copy and gives the console back; safe to call twice.
public static void End() { lock (gate) { if (timer != null) { timer.Dispose(); timer = null; } 
  if (file != null) { if (part.Length > 0) { FileLine(part.ToString()); part.Clear(); }
    System.Console.SetOut(was); file.Dispose(); file = null; } } }
// Starts the time limit: after seconds, the line why goes out, then this process ends with exit code 1.
public static void Limit(int seconds, string why) { timer = new System.Threading.Timer(delegate(object o) {
  lock (gate) { try { if (file != null) { file.WriteLine(why); was.WriteLine(why); was.Flush(); } } catch { } }
  System.Environment.Exit(1); }, null, seconds * 1000, System.Threading.Timeout.Infinite); }
// Stops the time limit (the sign-in ended in time).
public static void Unlimit() { lock (gate) { if (timer != null) { timer.Dispose(); timer = null; } } }
// The masks of the file copy (text, placeholder): each line is masked before it reaches the file, so a stop by the time
// limit (no finally block runs) leaves no site address or DODID in the file.
static System.Collections.Generic.List<string[]> masks = new System.Collections.Generic.List<string[]>(); static System.Text.StringBuilder part = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
// Adds one mask: each later line that holds the text gets the placeholder in the file (text of 4 characters or more only).
public static void Mask(string text, string placeholder) { lock (gate) { if (text != null && text.Length >= 4) { masks.Add(new string[] { text, placeholder }); } } }
static void FileLine(string s) { foreach (string[] m in masks) { s = s.Replace(m[0], m[1]); } file.WriteLine(s); }
static void FileText(string s) { foreach (char c in s) { if (c == '\n') { FileLine(part.ToString().TrimEnd('\r')); part.Clear(); } else { part.Append(c); } } }
class Both : System.IO.TextWriter {
  public override System.Text.Encoding Encoding { get { return was.Encoding; } }
  public override void Write(char c) { lock (gate) { was.Write(c); if (file != null) { FileText(c.ToString()); } } }
  public override void Write(string s) { lock (gate) { was.Write(s); if (file != null && s != null) { FileText(s); } } }
  public override void WriteLine(string s) { lock (gate) { was.WriteLine(s); was.Flush(); if (file != null) { FileText((s ?? "") + "\n"); } } } }
"@
}

$fatal = $false; $site = ''; $secret = @(); $dir = ''; $out = ''
try {
  $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
  $who = Get-TaskId $Id; $secret = $who.Secret
  foreach ($s in $secret) { [T29Guard.Tee]::Mask($s, '<DODID>') }   # the file copy never holds the DODID (also on a stop by the time limit)
  if ($TestDir) { $dir = $TestDir } else { $dir = Get-TaskDir $who.Id $task 'Task 29' -Create }
  Set-Location -LiteralPath $dir
  $out = Join-Path $dir ('90161Z-T29-signin-' + $Rev + '.txt')
  [T29Guard.Tee]::Begin($out)
  [T29Guard.Tee]::Line('TASK T29 signin ' + $Rev + ', ' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'))
  [T29Guard.Tee]::Line('HOST rade=' + $(if ($env:RADE_HOST) { $env:RADE_HOST } else { 'unknown' }) + ' ps=' + $PSVersionTable.PSEdition + ' ' + $PSVersionTable.PSVersion)
  $script:site = Get-SiteAddress (Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $dir) 'Config')
  [T29Guard.Tee]::Mask($script:site.TrimEnd('/'), '<SITE>'); try { [T29Guard.Tee]::Mask(([uri]$script:site).Host, '<SITE-HOST>') } catch { $null = $_ }   # no host: the site mask stays
  $mod = @(Get-Module -ListAvailable -Name PnP.PowerShell | Sort-Object Version -Descending)
  if (-not $mod.Count) { throw 'PNP not installed: PnP.PowerShell is not on this computer.' }
  $pin = @($mod | Where-Object { [string]$_.Version -eq '1.12.0' }); if ($pin.Count) { $mod = $pin }   # the tested version first
  $null = & { Import-Module PnP.PowerShell -RequiredVersion $mod[0].Version -DisableNameChecking } *>&1
  [T29Guard.Tee]::Line('NOW Signing in to the site (if a sign-in window opens, sign in with your CAC)')
  [T29Guard.Tee]::Limit($Limit, ('STOPPED: the sign-in did not finish in ' + $Limit + ' seconds (the step can be run again)'))
  Connect-RadeSite $script:site | ForEach-Object { [T29Guard.Tee]::Line([string]$_) }
  [T29Guard.Tee]::Unlimit()
  [T29Guard.Tee]::Line('RESULT SIGNIN PASS')
  try { $null = & { Disconnect-PnPOnline -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } *>&1 } catch { $null = $_ }   # a sign-out that fails changes nothing here
} catch {
  $fatal = $true
  try { [T29Guard.Tee]::Unlimit() } catch { $null = $_ }   # no guard: nothing to stop
  if ($script:site) { $site = $script:site }
  $m = ConvertTo-Masked (Hide-Site ([string]$_) $site) $secret
  $line = 'STOPPED: ' + $m.Substring(0, [Math]::Min(300, $m.Length)) + ' (the step can be run again)'
  try { [T29Guard.Tee]::Line($line) } catch { Write-Host $line }
} finally {
  try { [T29Guard.Tee]::End() } catch { $null = $_ }   # no guard: the file was not opened
  if ($script:site) { $site = $script:site }
  # Every line is masked once more (the site, the DODID) in the file that goes back.
  if ($out -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $out -PathType Leaf)) {
    try { $masked = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $out | ForEach-Object { ConvertTo-Masked (Hide-Site $_ $site) $secret })
      Set-Content -LiteralPath $out -Value $masked -Encoding UTF8 } catch { $null = $_ } }   # the file keeps its own lines
  if (-not $NoPause -and -not $env:RADE_CONTRACT) { [void](Read-Host 'Press Enter to close') }
}
if ($fatal) { exit 1 }
exit 0
'@ }

# R12 (R39): the Sofia Sans font files next to this script (the round puts them in the T22 folder with it), as the
# RADE UI file wants them: file name -> base64. Takes the folder; returns an empty table when there are none.
function Get-FontTtf([string]$Folder) {
  $out = @{}
  try { foreach ($f in @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $Folder -Filter '*SofiaSans*.ttf' -File -ErrorAction Stop)) {
      $out[$f.Name] = [Convert]::ToBase64String([IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($f.FullName)) } } catch { $null = $_ }
  return $out
}
$OpenedHours = 3   # a result file older than this is from an earlier round (review R30): -Opened does not trust it
# The -Opened line for the result file in $Dir: PASS when it was written in the last $OpenedHours hours, its last
# "CARDS opened" line counts more than 0 cards and no line starts with STOPPED:, else FAIL (also when it is missing).
function Get-OpenedLine([string]$Dir) {
  $f = Join-Path $Dir ('90161Z-T22-window-' + $Rev + '.txt')
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f -PathType Leaf)) { return 'FAIL the window did not open' }
  if ((Get-Item -LiteralPath $f).LastWriteTime -lt (Get-Date).AddHours(-$OpenedHours)) { return 'FAIL the window did not open (no result from this round)' }
  $text = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $f)
  $m = @($text | Where-Object { $_ -match '^CARDS opened: .*\((\d+) of (\d+)\)$' }) | Select-Object -Last 1
  $stopped = @($text | Where-Object { $_ -match '^STOPPED:' }).Count
  if ($m -and -not $stopped -and $m -match '\((\d+) of (\d+)\)$' -and [int]$Matches[1] -gt 0) { return ('PASS the window opened (' + $Matches[1] + ' of ' + $Matches[2] + ' cards)') }
  return 'FAIL the window did not open'
}

  $lines.Add('LAYOUT self-check: ' + $defects.Count + ' defects in ' + $ui.LayCards.Count + ' card views')

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  90-161.Z Task 22 r21, Maintenance (round R39; the PFM, 20 Nov 26): the test install of 90-161.Z 0.1, and the read-back
  of what RADE's Maintenance tools Diagnose and Back up made. Windows PowerShell 5.1 (also 7); no module.
.DESCRIPTION
  RADE shows its Maintenance screen (Diagnose, Back up) only for an app that a RADE deploy installed (RADE engine-v30,
  engine/ps/window/06-open.ps1). R39 therefore deploys 90-161.Z version 0.1.0 first.
  -Part Install: the one step of that deploy. It writes 90161Z-T22-install-r21.txt and passes; RADE keeps the install
  record (RADE\Config\installed). It installs nothing else and changes nothing on the site.
  -Part Read: reads, on this computer only, (1) the install record of 90-161.Z (version and last run state), (2) the
  newest Diagnose report (RADE\90-161.Z\Diagnose\diagnose-*.txt): its PASS, FINDING and NOTE counts and each FINDING
  line, masked, and (3) the newest Back up folder (RADE\90-161.Z\Backups\<time>): for each list, its JSON and CSV file
  and its row count. Never a row value: the backup files hold site data and stay in OneDrive (Project rule "Data
  boundary"); only counts and list titles go into the result.
  -Part Backup (round R41, the Restore test; the PFM, 21 Nov 26): reads only (3), the newest Back up folder, so the round
  knows that the Back up before the Restore test saved every list (12 from R41: the 12th is "PFM Recommendations (DAF Form
  847)", a title with parentheses that RADE engine-v31 can back up). It also needs a backup made after the T26 part
  Rows made the fake rows (RowsAt in T26\90161Z-T26-endorse-state-r4.txt): an older backup, or no Rows time, is a FAIL.
  Result lines: RESULT INSTALL, RESULT DIAGNOSE and RESULT BACKUP, each PASS or FAIL. Exit 1 when one is FAIL.
  A report or backup older than $FreshHours hours is from an earlier day and counts as missing.
  Run: by RADE (powershell.exe -File 90161Z-T22-maint-r21.ps1 -Part Install, Read or Backup -NoPause), or by hand in T22.
  Parameters: -Id (the DODID; the profile folder name when not given), -Part, -NoPause, -TestDir (the T22 folder of a
  test; its parent is the app folder and the parent of that the RADE folder).
  Network: none.
  Writes: Install: 90161Z-T22-install-r21.txt; Read: 90161Z-T22-maint-r21.txt; Backup: 90161Z-T22-backup-r21.txt, all in
          the T22 folder (or -TestDir).
  Credentials: none.
#>
param([string]$Id, [ValidateSet('Install', 'Read', 'Backup')][string]$Part = 'Read', [switch]$NoPause, [string]$TestDir)
$task = 'T22'
$Rev = 'r21'
$FreshHours = 6   # a Diagnose report or a backup older than this is not from this round
$BackupLists = 12   # the lists the R41 manifest names in "backup" (scripts/paste_bundles.json; tests/ps/Test-T22Maint.ps1 checks they match): fewer is a FAIL
# @@SHARED task-common-2b522804@@ (RADE writes the shared block "task-common" here; its text is in the bundle part "Shared blocks")
# @@SHARED site-common-cc1bf548@@ (RADE writes the shared block "site-common" here; its text is in the bundle part "Shared blocks")

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  The install record of 90-161.Z in RADE\Config\installed (schema rade-installed/2: key, installed, lastRun).
.PARAMETER Rade
  The RADE folder.
.OUTPUTS
  The record (a PSCustomObject) whose key is "90-161.Z/90-161.Z" (the app folder and the app name; RADE adds "@<hash>"
  only for an app with a site marker, which 90-161.Z has not), or $null.
#>
function Get-InstallRecord([string]$Rade) {
  $d = Join-Path (Join-Path $Rade 'Config') 'installed'
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $d -PathType Container)) { return $null }
  foreach ($f in @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $d -Filter '*.json' -File)) {
    try { $j = Get-Content -LiteralPath $f.FullName -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { continue }   # a record of another app that is being written
    if ([string]$j.key -eq '90-161.Z/90-161.Z') { return $j } }
  return $null
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  The result lines of the newest Diagnose report: counts, each FINDING line (masked), and RESULT DIAGNOSE.
.PARAMETER App
  The app folder (RADE\90-161.Z).
.OUTPUTS
  The lines (strings).
#>
function Get-DiagnoseResult([string]$App) {
  $d = Join-Path $App 'Diagnose'
  $f = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $d -Filter 'diagnose-*.txt' -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending) | Select-Object -First 1
  if (-not $f -or $f.LastWriteTime -lt (Get-Date).AddHours(-$FreshHours)) { return @('DIAGNOSE no report from this round in the Diagnose folder', 'RESULT DIAGNOSE FAIL') }
  $text = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $f.FullName)
  $n = @{}; foreach ($k in 'PASS', 'FINDING', 'NOTE') { $n[$k] = @($text | Where-Object { $_ -like ($k + ': *') }).Count }
  $out = @('DIAGNOSE report made ' + $f.LastWriteTime.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm') + ': pass=' + $n.PASS + ' findings=' + $n.FINDING + ' notes=' + $n.NOTE)
  $site = [string]$env:RADE_SITE   # the site RADE holds (no question here); empty outside RADE: the generic masks still apply
  foreach ($l in @($text | Where-Object { $_ -like 'FINDING: *' } | Select-Object -First 20)) { $out += ('DIAGNOSE ' + (Hide-Site ([string]$l) $site)) }
  return $out + @('RESULT DIAGNOSE PASS')   # the report exists: what it found is for the PFM to judge (the answers)
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  The result lines of the newest Back up folder: for each list, its files and row count, and RESULT BACKUP.
.PARAMETER App
  The app folder (RADE\90-161.Z).
.PARAMETER Since
  Only for -Part Backup: the newest folder must be made after this time (the T26 Rows time); $null = no such rule.
.OUTPUTS
  The lines (strings). PASS when the newest folder is from this round (and made after Since), has at least one list, and every JSON file has its
  CSV copy and can be read. The row values are never read into the result.
#>
function Get-BackupResult([string]$App, $Since = $null) {
  $root = Join-Path $App 'Backups'
  $all = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $root -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending)
  $new = $all | Select-Object -First 1
  if (-not $new -or $new.LastWriteTime -lt (Get-Date).AddHours(-$FreshHours)) { return @('BACKUP no backup folder from this round (folders: ' + $all.Count + ')', 'RESULT BACKUP FAIL') }
  if ($null -ne $Since -and $new.CreationTime -le $Since) { return @('BACKUP the newest backup folder is older than the fake rows of the Restore test (run Back up again)', 'RESULT BACKUP FAIL') }
  $all2 = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $new.FullName -Filter '*.json' -File | Sort-Object Name)
  $json = @($all2 | Where-Object { -not $_.Name.StartsWith('~') })   # '~<n>.json': a file RADE could not give its list name
  $tilde = $all2.Count - $json.Count
  $out = @('BACKUP folders=' + $all.Count + '; the newest holds ' + $json.Count + ' lists'); $bad = $tilde
  if ($tilde) { $out += ('BACKUP ' + $tilde + ' list files without their list name (RADE did not finish naming them)') }
  foreach ($j in $json) {
    $name = [IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($j.Name); $csv = Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $new.FullName ($name + '.csv')) -PathType Leaf
    $rows = 'unreadable'   # RADE writes one JSON array of rows (engine-v30, 13-maintenance.ps1)
    try { $rows = [string](Get-JsonRowCount $j.FullName) } catch { $bad++ }
    if (-not $csv) { $bad++ }
    $out += ('BACKUP list "' + $name + '": rows=' + $rows + ' csv=' + $(if ($csv) { 'yes' } else { 'no' })) }
  if ($json.Count -lt $BackupLists) { $out += ('BACKUP ' + $json.Count + ' of ' + $BackupLists + ' lists saved') }
  return $out + @('RESULT BACKUP ' + $(if ($json.Count -ge $BackupLists -and -not $bad) { 'PASS' } else { 'FAIL' }))
}

# The time the T26 part Rows made the fake rows of the Restore test (RowsAt in the T26 state file), or $null. Takes the app folder.
function Get-RowsTime([string]$App) {
  $f = Join-Path (Join-Path $App 'T26') '90161Z-T26-endorse-state-r4.txt'
  $l = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $f -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { ([string]$_).StartsWith('RowsAt=') }) | Select-Object -First 1
  if (-not $l) { return $null }
  try { return [datetime]::ParseExact(([string]$l).Substring(7), 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss', [Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture) } catch { return $null }
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  The number of rows in one backup JSON file (one array of rows; RADE engine-v30). Reads no value into the result.
.DESCRIPTION
  Windows PowerShell 5.1 ConvertFrom-Json stops on a long text (its JSON length limit); then the .NET reader with no
  length limit counts it.
.PARAMETER Path
  The JSON file.
.OUTPUTS
  The row count.
#>
function Get-JsonRowCount([string]$Path) {
  $raw = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($Path)
  try { $v = $raw | ConvertFrom-Json; return @($v).Count } catch {   # a variable: 5.1 writes the array as one object
    Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Web.Extensions
    $s = New-Object System.Web.Script.Serialization.JavaScriptSerializer; $s.MaxJsonLength = [int]::MaxValue
    return @($s.DeserializeObject($raw)).Count }
}

$lines = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
$lines.Add('TASK T22 maintenance ' + $Rev + ', part ' + $Part + ', ' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'))
$code = 0; $dir = ''; $who = $null
try {
  $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
  if ($TestDir) { $dir = $TestDir } else { $who = Get-TaskId $Id; $dir = Get-TaskDir $who.Id $task 'Task 22' -Create }
  $app = Split-Path -Parent $dir; $rade = Split-Path -Parent $app
  if ($Part -eq 'Install') {
    $lines.Add('INSTALL the deploy of 90-161.Z 0.1.0 reached its step; RADE keeps the install record. Nothing else was installed; nothing on the site changed.')
    $lines.Add('RESULT INSTALL PASS') }
  elseif ($Part -eq 'Backup') {
    $since = Get-RowsTime $app
    if ($null -eq $since) { $lines.Add('BACKUP no time of the fake rows on file (run the step that makes the Restore test rows first)'); $lines.Add('RESULT BACKUP FAIL') }
    else { foreach ($l in @(Get-BackupResult $app $since)) { $lines.Add($l) } } }
  else {
    $rec = Get-InstallRecord $rade
    if ($rec -and $rec.installed) { $lines.Add('INSTALL record: version=' + [string]$rec.installed.version + ' last run=' + [string]$rec.lastRun.state); $lines.Add('RESULT INSTALL PASS') }
    else { $lines.Add('INSTALL no install record of 90-161.Z (run the deploy "90-161.Z" first)'); $lines.Add('RESULT INSTALL FAIL') }
    foreach ($l in @(Get-DiagnoseResult $app) + @(Get-BackupResult $app)) { $lines.Add($l) } }
  if (@($lines | Where-Object { $_ -match '^RESULT \S+ FAIL$' }).Count) { $code = 1 }
} catch {
  $code = 1; $lines.Add('STOPPED: ' + ([string]$_.Exception.Message))
} finally {
  $masked = @($lines | ForEach-Object { $t = [string]$_; if ($who) { $t = ConvertTo-Masked $t $who.Secret }; $t })
  $out = $(switch ($Part) { 'Install' { '90161Z-T22-install-' } 'Backup' { '90161Z-T22-backup-' } default { '90161Z-T22-maint-' } }) + $Rev + '.txt'
  if ($dir) { try { Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir $out) -Value $masked -Encoding UTF8 } catch { $null = $_ } }
  $masked | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_ }
  if (-not $NoPause -and -not $env:RADE_CONTRACT) { [void](Read-Host 'Press Enter to close') }
}
exit $code

# Turns the "|" lines of the Your Work grid into row tables (Publication keeps "number|title" for the two-part cell).
function ConvertTo-HomeRow([string[]]$Lines) {
  foreach ($l in $Lines) {
    if ($l.Trim()) {
      $f = $l.Split('|')
      @{ Publication = ($f[0] + '|' + $f[1]); Action = $f[2]; Step = $f[3]; With = $f[4]; Since = $f[5]; Age = $f[6]; Due = $f[7]
        Status = $f[8]; Kind = $f[9]; Go = $f[10] }
    }
  }
}
# Turns the "|" lines of the All Actions grid into row tables; Me is true for a row that needs you.
function ConvertTo-QueueRow([string[]]$Lines) {
  foreach ($l in $Lines) {
    if ($l.Trim()) {
      $f = $l.Split('|')
      @{ Publication = ($f[0] + '|' + $f[1]); Action = $f[2]; Step = $f[3]; Weekdays = $f[4]; With = $f[5]; Status = $f[6]
        Kind = $f[7]; Go = $f[8]; Me = ($f[9] -eq '1') }
    }
  }
}

# Grid columns: N = name, W = width at 100 % (0 = takes the rest; at most: R11 a short column is as wide as its values), K = how the cell is
# drawn, H = header text when not N, HW = the head may wrap to 2 lines (R11), Drop = leaves when the heads do not fit (R11; PFM 20 Nov 26).
$ColsNarrow = @(@{ N = 'Publication'; W = 0; K = 'pub' }, @{ N = 'Step'; W = 128; K = 'plain' }, @{ N = 'With'; W = 170; K = 'with' },
  @{ N = 'Since'; W = 64; K = 'since'; Drop = $true }, @{ N = 'Due'; W = 72; K = 'plain' }, @{ N = 'Status'; W = 104; K = 'chip' })
$ColsWide = @(@{ N = 'Publication'; W = 0; K = 'pub' }, @{ N = 'Action'; W = 136; K = 'plain' }, @{ N = 'Step'; W = 136; K = 'plain' },
  @{ N = 'With'; W = 184; K = 'with' }, @{ N = 'Since'; W = 120; K = 'since' }, @{ N = 'Due'; W = 72; K = 'plain' },
  @{ N = 'Status'; W = 104; K = 'chip' })
$ColsQueue = @(@{ N = 'Publication'; W = 0; K = 'pub' }, @{ N = 'Action'; W = 130; K = 'plain' }, @{ N = 'Step'; W = 150; K = 'plain' },
  @{ N = 'Weekdays'; W = 86; K = 'plain'; H = 'Weekdays in step'; HW = $true }, @{ N = 'With'; W = 140; K = 'with' }, @{ N = 'Status'; W = 124; K = 'chip' })
# The Action Status card at the right of a step card. Takes one table: Title, Sub, Note (a gray box; may be empty),
# Rows (label, value, chip kind) and Buttons. Stretch: its bottom lines up with the main card's bottom (R30 V4).
function Get-SideStatus($S) {
  $b = @(@{ T = 'head'; Text = $S.Title; Small = $true }, @{ T = 'p'; Text = $S.Sub; Style = 'note' })
  if ($S.Note) { $b += @{ T = 'p'; Text = $S.Note; Style = 'box' } }
  if ($S.Rows) { $b += @{ T = 'rows'; Rows = $S.Rows } }
  if ($S.Buttons) { $b += @{ T = 'buttons'; Items = $S.Buttons } }
  return @{ Cap = 'Action Status'; Pad = 22; Stretch = $true; Blocks = $b }
}
# True when a check or box block shows its link. A format check with 0 findings has nothing to open, so no link (R30 V3).
function Test-CheckLink($Block) {
  return [bool]($Block.Link -and -not ($null -ne $Block.Findings -and [int]$Block.Findings -eq 0))
}

# fonts (docs/phases.md R39), the text box height (R38 finding 2, B1) and the speed of the cards (R38 finding 3). The

<#
.SYNOPSIS
Gives the -PlanOnly lines of one block of a card.
.DESCRIPTION
One or more lines per block type, the same words the window shows: chips, headline, text, steps, checks and boxes with
their links, rows, list items with their buttons, grid rows that open a card, boxes, choices, error, progress, buttons.
.PARAMETER Block
The block table (T = its type).
.OUTPUTS
The lines, not yet made plain (ConvertTo-PlanText runs on each).
#>
function Get-BlockPlan($Block) {
  $b = $Block
  switch ($b.T) {
    'chips' { '    CHIPS ' + (@($b.Items | ForEach-Object { $_[1] }) -join ', ') + $(if ($b.Cap) { ' | ' + $b.Cap } else { '' }) }
    'head' { '    HEAD ' + $b.Text }
    'p' { '    P ' + $b.Text }
    'steps' { '    STEPS ' + $b.N + ' of 12 (12 dots) | ' + $StepNames[$b.N - 1] }
    'check' { '    CHECK ' + $b.Text; if (Test-CheckLink $b) { '    LINK ' + $b.Link.Text + $(if ($b.Link.Go) { ' -> ' + $b.Link.Go } else { ' -> @note' }) } }
    'ck' { '    BOX ' + $b.Text; if (Test-CheckLink $b) { '    LINK ' + $b.Link.Text + ' -> @note' } }
    'rows' { foreach ($r in @($b.Rows)) { '    ROW ' + $r[0] + ': ' + $r[1] } }
    'list' { foreach ($r in @($b.Rows)) { '    ITEM ' + $r.Title + ' | ' + $r.Sub; if ($r.Btn) { Get-ButtonPlan @{ Text = $r.Btn.Text; Kind = $r.Btn.Kind; Go = $r.Btn.Go } } } }
    'grid' {
      '    GRID ' + $b.Name + ': ' + @($b.Cols).Count + ' columns, ' + @($b.Rows).Count + ' rows'
      foreach ($r in @($b.Rows)) { if ($r.Go) { '    CHOICE ' + $(if ($r.Publication) { $r.Publication } else { $r.Office }) + ' -> ' + $r.Go } } }
    'filter' { '    FILTER search and show list' }
    'input' { '    INPUT ' + $b.Label + ' (' + $b.Id + ')' }
    'radio' { '    CHOICES ' + $b.Label + ': ' + (@($b.Items) -join ' / ') }
    'err' { '    ERROR ' + $b.Text }
    'progress' { '    PROGRESS ' + $b.Text }
    'buttons' { foreach ($x in @($b.Items)) { Get-ButtonPlan $x } }
  }
}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
Gives the cards, their sections and blocks, and the rail as plain text lines (-PlanOnly; tests/run.sh reads them).
.DESCRIPTION
A CARD line per card (key, rail item, title or crumb), then SUB and CRUMB, a SECTION line per section and the block lines
of Get-BlockPlan, and at the end one RAIL line per rail item. Reads $Cards and $RailItems; changes nothing.
.OUTPUTS
An array of ASCII lines.
#>
function Get-CardPlan {
  $out = @()
  foreach ($k in $Cards.Keys) {
    $c = $Cards[$k]
    $head = $(if ($c.Title) { $c.Title } else { $c.Crumb })
    $out += (ConvertTo-PlanText ('CARD ' + $k + ' | ' + $c.Rail + ' | ' + $head))
    if ($c.Sub) { $out += (ConvertTo-PlanText ('  SUB ' + $c.Sub)) }
    if ($c.Crumb -and $c.Title) { $out += (ConvertTo-PlanText ('  CRUMB ' + $c.Crumb)) }
    foreach ($col in @($c.Cols)) {
      foreach ($s in @($col)) {
        $wide = $(if ($s.WideOnly) { ' [wide only]' } else { '' })   # R15: the click-through check skips these sections
        $out += (ConvertTo-PlanText ('  SECTION ' + $(if ($s.Cap) { $s.Cap } else { '-' }) + $wide))
        foreach ($b in @($s.Blocks)) { foreach ($l in @(Get-BlockPlan $b)) { $out += (ConvertTo-PlanText ([string]$l)) } }
      }
    }
  }
  foreach ($r in $RailItems) { $out += ('RAIL ' + $r.Text + ' -> ' + $r.Go) }
  return $out
}

}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
R16 (R42 finding 3: WALK 13 step12 was answered "not opened"): the name of card $Key for a click-through step; the name of the
card, and, when another card has the same name, its step line before the dot ("step 12 of 12") so that a card that shows now
is not taken for the card of the step.
#>
function Get-WalkName([string]$Key) {
  $name = Get-CardName $Key
  $same = @($Cards.Keys | Where-Object { [string]$_ -ne $Key -and (Get-CardName ([string]$_)) -eq $name })
  if (-not $same.Count) { return $name }
  $cap = ''; foreach ($col in @($Cards[$Key].Cols)) { foreach ($sec in @($col)) { foreach ($b in @($sec.Blocks)) { if (-not $cap -and $b.T -eq 'chips' -and $b.Cap) { $cap = [string]$b.Cap } } } }
  if (-not $cap) { return $name }
  return ($name + ', ' + ([string]@($cap -split [regex]::Escape($mid))[0]).Trim().ToLowerInvariant()) }
<#
.SYNOPSIS
R14 (R41 plan row 3): how a person opens card $To from card $From with one selection that only opens a screen.
.DESCRIPTION
In this order: a rail item that opens $To (the rail shows on every card); a button of $From that goes to $To with
no need (R15, R41 finding 4: also a button with a FAKE note, such as "Start Endorsement" on Confirm: it is the real way to
the endorsement screen; a button that needs a reason or a box needs a second action); the crumb link of $From. Sections shown only in a wide window are left out, so the
opener is there at every window size. No opener: $null (the click-through then shows its own link "Open this screen").
.PARAMETER From
The card key the person is on ('' at the start: only the rail counts).
.PARAMETER To
The card key to open.
.OUTPUTS
@{ Via = 'rail', 'button' or 'link'; Text = what to select; Beside = the list row the button sits in, or '' }, or $null.
#>
function Get-WalkOpener([string]$From, [string]$To) {
  foreach ($r in $RailItems) { if ($r.Go -eq $To) { return @{ Via = 'rail'; Text = [string]$r.Text; Beside = '' } } }
  $c = $Cards[$From]; if (-not $c) { return $null }
  foreach ($col in @($c.Cols)) { foreach ($sec in @($col)) {
      if ($sec.WideOnly) { continue }
      foreach ($b in @($sec.Blocks)) {
        $btns = @(); if ($b.T -eq 'buttons') { $btns = @($b.Items | ForEach-Object { @{ B = $_; Beside = '' } }) }
        if ($b.T -eq 'list') { $btns = @($b.Rows | Where-Object { $_.Btn } | ForEach-Object { @{ B = $_.Btn; Beside = [string]$_.Title } }) }
        foreach ($x in $btns) { if ($x.B.Go -eq $To -and -not $x.B.Need) { return @{ Via = 'button'; Text = [string]$x.B.Text; Beside = $x.Beside } } } } } }
  if ($c.CrumbGo -eq $To) { return @{ Via = 'link'; Text = [string]@(([string]$c.Crumb) -split [regex]::Escape(' ' + $gt + ' '))[0]; Beside = '' } }
  return $null
}
# R17: the head line of the waves card, the first line of text above its grid. Takes nothing; returns the line.
function Get-WaveHead {
  foreach ($col in @($Cards.waves.Cols)) { foreach ($sec in @($col)) { foreach ($b in @($sec.Blocks)) { if ($b.T -eq 'head') { return [string]$b.Text } } } }
  return ''
}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
R14 (R41 plan row 3; PFM 20 Nov 26): the click-through, one step per card, every card once.
.DESCRIPTION
The order (the cards in the order the window builds them, $Cards): from the card the person is on, the next step is the
first card not yet walked that one rail item, button or crumb link opens (Get-WalkOpener); when no card has one, the
first card not yet walked, opened with the link "Open this screen" of the check bar. Each step is one action and one
Pass or Fail, in the words of the 4 checks. Pure data: no window.
.OUTPUTS
An array of @{ Key; Via (rail, button, link, open or, R16, look); Opener (what to select); Text (the bar text); From (R15: the card it starts on);
R18: Target, only on a step that names one part of the screen (the accessible name of its control; the bar frames it) }.
R16: Via look is the step after the waves card: it asks about the grid on the card the person is on.
R17 (R43 finding 3): the grid is named by the head line above it (Get-WaveHead), not by its accessible name.
.PARAMETER Only
r19: the card keys to walk (the round's walk, Get-RoundWalk); empty = every card.
#>
function Get-WalkPlan([string[]]$Only = @()) {
  # r19: with $Only, only those cards are walked (in the order of $Cards), from the card the window opens on.
  $left = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]; foreach ($k in $Cards.Keys) { if (-not $Only.Count -or $Only -contains [string]$k) { $left.Add([string]$k) } }
  $out = @(); $cur = ''; $n = $left.Count + $(if ($left.Contains('waves')) { 1 } else { 0 })   # R16: the waves card has one more step
  while ($left.Count) {
    $key = ''; $op = $null
    foreach ($k in $left) { $o = Get-WalkOpener $cur $k; if ($o) { $key = $k; $op = $o; break } }
    if (-not $key) { $key = $left[0]; $op = @{ Via = 'open'; Text = 'Open this screen'; Beside = '' } }
    [void]$left.Remove($key)
    $what = $(if ($op.Via -eq 'rail') { $op.Text + ' in the list on the left' } elseif ($op.Via -eq 'link') { 'the link "' + $op.Text + '" at the top' }
      elseif ($op.Beside) { '"' + $op.Text + '" beside "' + $op.Beside + '"' } elseif ($op.Via -eq 'open') { '"Open this screen" in this bar' } else { '"' + $op.Text + '"' })
    $text = 'Screen ' + ($out.Count + 1) + ' of ' + $n + ': select ' + $what + '. Pass if ' + (Get-WalkName $key) + ' opens and looks right.'
    $out += @{ Key = $key; Via = $op.Via; Opener = $op.Text; Text = $text; From = $cur }; $cur = $key
    # R16 (R42 finding 4; R43 T3): the step after the waves card asks about its grid, with its own Pass and Fail
    # R17 (R43 finding 3: the card shows no grid named "Wave 1 answers"): the step names the grid by the head line above it
    # R18 (the PFM, 26 Nov 26, R45 comment 6b): a step that names one part of the screen has Target, the accessible name of that
    # control; the bar draws a 2 px frame around it while the step shows (the bar part, $wn.FrameSet).
    if ($key -eq 'waves') { $head = Get-WaveHead; $out += @{ Key = $key; Via = 'look'; Opener = $head; From = 'waves'; Target = 'Wave 1 answers'
        Text = 'Screen ' + ($out.Count + 1) + ' of ' + $n + ': look at the grid under the line "' + $head + '" Pass if the grid shows the second person, or if no one helped.' } } }
  return $out
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
