$files += @{ Dir = 'T22'; Name = '90161Z-T22-site-r21.ps1'; Kind = 'text'; Sha = '9c51d0148e9a'; Data = @'
<#
.SYNOPSIS
  90-161.Z Task 22 r21, part "site": the PFM window reads the PFM lists of the test site, read-only, and fills its cards
  from them (round R41; PFM 20 Nov 26, docs/reviews/2026-11-21-r41-plan.md row 1).
.DESCRIPTION
  What it reads: the rows of 2 PFM lists, PFM Publications (the grids Who Has It Now of Your Work and of the "nothing
  needs you" card, and All Actions) and PFM Endorsements (the grid of answers on the endorsement card, so an endorser's
  answer shows here read-only, plan row 2). Only the columns a card shows: the title, the publication number, the
  action, the step, the status and the dates. No person column is read, so no name can show (Data boundary rule).
  How: PnP.PowerShell 1.12.0, your own CAC sign-in in the PnP web login window (Connect-PnPOnline -UseWebLogin), the
  one site RADE holds (the main script reads it with its site-common block and gives it here), then Get-PnPListItem on each list. Nothing on the site is
  written: this part calls no command that adds, changes or removes anything (tests/run.sh checks the text).
  Empty: a grid whose list has no rows shows its empty state, one line that the list has no rows.
  Fake-data markers (the test site holds fake rows only; PFM 20 Nov 26): a fake row's title starts with "90161Z TEST"
  (every row the round scripts T18 and T24 made) or "XXX XXX " (the window's own fake names). Each row shown on a card
  is checked before a picture of that card is saved (Get-SiteUnmarked; the measure and feedback parts ask it): a card
  with a row that has no marker gets no picture, so its data stops at the boundary.
  Offline: when the site cannot be read (no PnP.PowerShell, no site address, the sign-in or a read failed), the window
  keeps its FAKE cards; -Measure and -PlanOnly never read the site (the cards part's FAKE data is their source).
  Lines: SOURCE site or SOURCE fake (why); READ <list> rows=<n> for each list read; WRITES=0; MARKER rows checked=<n>
  without a marker=<n>. Counts only: no row text, no address.
  Inputs: $Cards, $GridQueue, $lines, $dir (the cards part and the main script). Outputs: the functions below and
  $script:SiteSource, $script:SiteShown (card key -> the titles of the site rows it shows).
  Run: not alone; 90161Z-T22-pfm-window-r21.ps1 dot-sources it from its own folder inside its try block.
  Network: the one SharePoint site given in RADE (RADE_SITE) or in Config\90161Z-site.txt, through PnP.PowerShell; read only.
  Writes: none on the site; on this computer only, once, Config\90161Z-site.txt when the site address is typed outside RADE.
  Credentials: your own CAC sign-in through the PnP web login window; nothing is stored.
#>
$script:SiteSource = 'fake'; $script:SiteShown = @{}
$script:FakeMarks = @('90161Z TEST', 'XXX XXX ')   # the repo's fake-data markers (see the header)
# The lists this window reads and the columns it reads from each (internal names, schemas/lists).
$script:SiteLists = [ordered]@{
  'PFM Publications' = @('Title', 'PublicationNumber', 'ActionType', 'ProcessStep', 'ActionStatus', 'CoordinationSuspense', 'Modified')
  'PFM Endorsements' = @('Title', 'EndorsementStatus', 'ResponseDate', 'Modified') }
# True when title $Title starts with one of the fake-data markers.
function Test-FakeRow([string]$Title) {
  foreach ($m in $script:FakeMarks) { if (([string]$Title).StartsWith($m)) { return $true } }
  return $false
}
# The number of site rows card $Key shows that have no fake-data marker (0 for a card with no site rows).
function Get-SiteUnmarked([string]$Key) { return @(@($script:SiteShown[$Key]) | Where-Object { $null -ne $_ -and -not (Test-FakeRow $_) }).Count }
# The text of field value $V: a lookup gives its shown value, a date its day as d MMM yy, $null an empty text.
function Get-SiteText($V) {
  if ($null -eq $V) { return '' }
  if ($V -is [datetime]) { return $V.ToLocalTime().ToString('d MMM yy', [Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture) }
  if ($V.PSObject.Properties['LookupValue']) { return [string]$V.LookupValue }
  return [string]$V
}
# The weekdays from date $V to today (0 when there is no date): the age of a row on its step.
function Get-SiteAge($V) {
  if (-not ($V -is [datetime])) { return 0 }
  $d = $V.ToLocalTime().Date; $n = 0
  while ($d -lt (Get-Date).Date) { $d = $d.AddDays(1); if ($d.DayOfWeek -ne 'Saturday' -and $d.DayOfWeek -ne 'Sunday') { $n++ } }
  return $n
}
# The chip kind of an Action Status (schemas/lists/PFMPublications.json): On Track ok, On Hold soon, Stalled late, else neutral.
function Get-SiteKind([string]$Status) {
  switch ($Status) { 'On Track' { return 'ok' } 'On Hold' { return 'soon' } 'Stalled' { return 'late' } default { return 'neu' } }
}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Turns the PFM Publications rows into the row tables of the Your Work grid and of the All Actions grid.
.DESCRIPTION
  The same keys as the cards part's FAKE rows (ConvertTo-HomeRow, ConvertTo-QueueRow): Publication is "number|title"
  (a dash for a row with no number), With is a dash (no person column is read), the row opens the Publications card.
.PARAMETER Items
  The list items (Get-PnPListItem).
.OUTPUTS
  @{ Home = the Your Work rows; Queue = the All Actions rows; Titles = the row titles }.
#>
function ConvertTo-SitePubRow($Items) {
  $hrows = @(); $queue = @(); $titles = @()
  foreach ($it in @($Items)) {
    $t = Get-SiteText $it['Title']; $num = Get-SiteText $it['PublicationNumber']; if (-not $num) { $num = '-' }
    $st = Get-SiteText $it['ActionStatus']; $kind = Get-SiteKind $st; $age = Get-SiteAge $it['Modified']
    $due = Get-SiteText $it['CoordinationSuspense']; if (-not $due) { $due = '-' }
    $act = Get-SiteText $it['ActionType']; $step = Get-SiteText $it['ProcessStep']
    $hrows += @{ Publication = ($num + '|' + $t); Action = $act; Step = $step; With = '-'; Since = (Get-SiteText $it['Modified']); Age = ([string]$age + ' d')
      Due = $due; Status = $st; Kind = $kind; Go = 'pub' }
    $queue += @{ Publication = ($num + '|' + $t); Action = $act; Step = $step; Weekdays = [string]$age; With = '-'; Status = $st; Kind = $kind; Go = 'pub'; Me = $false }
    $titles += $t }
  return @{ Home = $hrows; Queue = $queue; Titles = $titles }
}
# Turns the PFM Endorsements rows into the rows of the answers grid (Office is the row title; no person column is read).
function ConvertTo-SiteAnswerRow($Items) {
  foreach ($it in @($Items)) {
    $a = Get-SiteText $it['EndorsementStatus']; if (-not $a) { $a = 'Not Started' }
    $sig = Get-SiteText $it['ResponseDate']; if (-not $sig) { $sig = '-' }
    $done = ($a -ne 'Not Started')
    @{ Office = (Get-SiteText $it['Title']); Answer = $a; Comments = '-'; Signature = $sig; Status = $(if ($done) { 'Answered' } else { 'Waiting' })
      Kind = $(if ($done) { 'ok' } else { 'neu' }); Go = '' } }
}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Puts site rows into one grid block of a card, or the empty state when there are none.
.PARAMETER Card
  The card key in $Cards.
.PARAMETER Name
  The grid's Name (its accessible name).
.PARAMETER Rows
  The row tables.
.PARAMETER List
  The list title, for the empty-state line.
.PARAMETER Titles
  The titles of the rows, kept for the marker check of the card's picture.
#>
function Merge-SiteGrid([string]$Card, [string]$Name, $Rows, [string]$List, $Titles) {
  foreach ($col in @($Cards[$Card].Cols)) { foreach ($sec in @($col)) {
      $bl = @($sec.Blocks)
      for ($i = 0; $i -lt $bl.Count; $i++) {
        if ($bl[$i].T -ne 'grid' -or $bl[$i].Name -ne $Name) { continue }
        if (@($Rows).Count) { $bl[$i].Rows = @($Rows) }
        else { $bl[$i] = @{ T = 'p'; Style = 'note'; Text = ('Nothing to show yet: the list ' + $List + ' on your site has no rows.') } }
        if ($sec.Cap -and $sec.Cap -match '^Who Has It Now') { $sec.Cap = 'Who Has It Now ' + $mid + ' ' + @($Rows).Count + ' open actions' } }
      $sec.Blocks = $bl } }
  $script:SiteShown[$Card] = @(@($script:SiteShown[$Card]) + @($Titles) | Where-Object { $null -ne $_ })
}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Makes the waves card say what its grid shows: the head line, the chip over it and the "Wave 1" pill are counted from the same rows.
.DESCRIPTION
  R18 (the PFM, 26 Nov 26, R45 comment 4b: the head line said "two of three offices have answered" over a grid of 1 row). Called after the
  site rows are in the grid. Counts the rows with Status "Answered" and all rows, then sets the first chips block, the first head block
  and the "Wave 1: ..." pill row of the Action Status card. The FAKE sentences of the card are the 3-row design (2 of 3); the site rows
  win. Candidate B (keep 3 FAKE rows in the grid and mark them) was not built: it would mix FAKE rows into site data.
.PARAMETER Rows
  The answer rows of the grid (Status "Answered" or "Waiting").
#>
function Sync-WaveSummary($Rows) {
  $all = @($Rows); $t = $all.Count; $n = @($all | Where-Object { $_.Status -eq 'Answered' }).Count; $w = $t - $n
  if (-not $t) {   # no rows: the grid is the empty-state note; the head line says so (R46 build, worker question 2b)
    foreach ($col in @($Cards.waves.Cols)) { foreach ($sec in @($col)) { foreach ($bl in @($sec.Blocks)) {
          if ($bl.T -eq 'chips' -and $bl.Cap -match '^STEPS 9 AND 10') { $bl.Items = @(, @('late', 'No answers yet')) }
          elseif ($bl.T -eq 'head' -and -not $bl.Small) { $bl.Text = 'Wave 1: no office has answered yet.' }
          elseif ($bl.T -eq 'rows') { $bl.Rows = @($bl.Rows | ForEach-Object { if ([string]$_[0] -like 'Wave 1:*') { , @('Wave 1: offices the AO added', '0 of 0', 'soon') } else { , $_ } }) } } } }
    return }
  $hd = 'Wave 1: ' + $n + ' of ' + $t + $(if ($t -eq 1) { ' office has' } else { ' offices have' }) + ' answered.'
  $chip = $(if ($w) { @('late', ($w.ToString() + $(if ($w -eq 1) { ' office has' } else { ' offices have' }) + ' not answered')) } else { @('ok', 'Every office has answered') })
  $pill = @('Wave 1: offices the AO added', ($n.ToString() + ' of ' + $t), $(if ($w) { 'soon' } else { 'ok' }))
  foreach ($col in @($Cards.waves.Cols)) { foreach ($sec in @($col)) { foreach ($bl in @($sec.Blocks)) {
        if ($bl.T -eq 'chips' -and $bl.Cap -match '^STEPS 9 AND 10') { $bl.Items = @(, $chip) }
        elseif ($bl.T -eq 'head' -and -not $bl.Small) { $bl.Text = $hd }
        elseif ($bl.T -eq 'rows') { $bl.Rows = @($bl.Rows | ForEach-Object { if ([string]$_[0] -like 'Wave 1:*') { , $pill } else { , $_ } }) } } } }
}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Reads the PFM lists of the site and fills the cards (the window's source is then "site"); on any failure the cards
  keep their FAKE data (source "fake") and the reason is one SOURCE line.
.DESCRIPTION
  Steps: load PnP.PowerShell, sign in (web login, CAC), read each list of $script:SiteLists, then put the rows into the
  grids of Your Work, the "nothing needs you" card (rows On Track), All Actions and the endorsement answers. Adds the
  SOURCE, READ, WRITES=0 and MARKER lines. Writes nothing on the site.
.PARAMETER Site
  The site address (https://<host>/sites/<name>), or '' when none is set (then the cards keep their FAKE data).
#>
function Invoke-SiteRead([string]$Site) {
  $read = [ordered]@{}
  try {
    if (-not $Site) { throw 'no site address is set in RADE' }
    $mod = @(Get-Module -ListAvailable -Name PnP.PowerShell | Sort-Object Version -Descending)
    if (-not $mod.Count) { throw 'PnP.PowerShell is not on this computer' }
    Write-Host 'NOW Signing in to the site to read the PFM lists (if a sign-in window opens, sign in with your CAC)'
    $null = & { Import-Module PnP.PowerShell -RequiredVersion $mod[0].Version -DisableNameChecking } *>&1
    $null = & { Connect-PnPOnline -Url $Site -UseWebLogin -ErrorAction Stop } *>&1
    foreach ($l in $script:SiteLists.Keys) {
      Write-Host ('NOW Reading the list ' + $l)
      $read[$l] = @(Get-PnPListItem -List $l -Fields $script:SiteLists[$l] -PageSize 500 -ErrorAction Stop) }
    try { $null = & { Disconnect-PnPOnline -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } *>&1 } catch { $null = $_ }
  } catch {
    $why = Hide-Site ([string]$_.Exception.Message) $Site; if ($who) { $why = ConvertTo-Masked $why $who.Secret }
    $lines.Add('SOURCE fake (the site was not read: ' + $why.Substring(0, [Math]::Min(160, $why.Length)) + ')')
    foreach ($l in $read.Keys) { $lines.Add('READ ' + $l + ' rows=' + @($read[$l]).Count) }
    $lines.Add('WRITES=0'); return }
  $pub = ConvertTo-SitePubRow $read['PFM Publications']; $ans = @(ConvertTo-SiteAnswerRow $read['PFM Endorsements'])
  $ok = @($pub.Home | Where-Object { $_.Kind -eq 'ok' })
  Merge-SiteGrid 'home' 'Who has it now' $pub.Home 'PFM Publications' $pub.Titles
  Merge-SiteGrid 'empty' 'Who has it now' $ok 'PFM Publications' @($ok | ForEach-Object { ([string]$_.Publication -split '\|', 2)[1] })
  Merge-SiteGrid 'queue' 'All actions' $pub.Queue 'PFM Publications' $pub.Titles
  Merge-SiteGrid 'waves' 'Wave 1 answers' $ans 'PFM Endorsements' @($ans | ForEach-Object { $_.Office })
  Sync-WaveSummary $ans   # R18: the head line, chip and pill are counted from the rows the grid shows
  if ($Walk.Count) { $script:Walk = @(Get-RoundWalk) }   # R18: the look step names the head line, which the site rows may have changed (r19: this round's walk)
  $script:GridQueue = @($pub.Queue)   # the All Actions filter ($wn.Refilter) reads it
  foreach ($b in @($Cards.queue.Cols[0][0].Blocks)) { if ($b.T -eq 'grid') { $b.Count = 'Showing {0} of ' + @($pub.Queue).Count + ' actions, as the site lists them' } }
  $script:SiteSource = 'site'
  $lines.Add('SOURCE site (the PFM lists of your site, read-only; ' + $read.Count + ' lists read)')
  foreach ($l in $read.Keys) { $lines.Add('READ ' + $l + ' rows=' + @($read[$l]).Count) }
  $lines.Add('WRITES=0')
  $all = @($script:SiteShown.Values | ForEach-Object { @($_) }); $bad = @($all | Where-Object { -not (Test-FakeRow $_) })
  $lines.Add('MARKER rows checked=' + $all.Count + ' without a marker=' + $bad.Count + ' (a card with one gets no picture)')
}
'@ }

PREAMBLE
The goals of the Open Font License (OFL) are to stimulate worldwide
development of collaborative font projects, to support the font creation
efforts of academic and linguistic communities, and to provide a free and
open framework in which fonts may be shared and improved in partnership
with others.

The OFL allows the licensed fonts to be used, studied, modified and
redistributed freely as long as they are not sold by themselves. The
fonts, including any derivative works, can be bundled, embedded, 
redistributed and/or sold with any software provided that any reserved
names are not used by derivative works. The fonts and derivatives,
however, cannot be released under any other type of license. The
requirement for fonts to remain under this license does not apply
to any document created using the fonts or their derivatives.

Holder(s) under this license and clearly marked as such. This may
include source files, build scripts and documentation.

"Reserved Font Name" refers to any names specified as such after the
copyright statement(s).

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  90-161.Z Task 21 probe r14, module "common": the helpers every part of the probe uses.

  Inputs: the values the main file sets in its own scope ($site, $dir, $lines, $passed, $failed, $WaitMinutes, $pollEvery,
  $StateName). Outputs: functions for the SharePoint REST calls, the result lines, the NOW lines, the wait loop, the
  second person's saved numbers and the sign-in.

  Writes: none on the site by itself (Invoke-Rest sends what a part asks for); the result lines in memory.
  Credentials: your own CAC sign-in through the PnP web login window (Connect-ProbeSite); nothing is stored.
  Run: not alone; powershell.exe -File 90161Z-T21-probe-r14.ps1 -Part <part> loads it.

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Sends one SharePoint REST request through the signed-in PnP connection (the same call T20 uses).
.PARAMETER Method
  Get, Post or Merge.
.PARAMETER Uri
  The address after the site, for example _api/web/lists.
.PARAMETER Body
  The JSON body for Post and Merge (verbose form); empty for Get.
.OUTPUTS
  System.String. The raw answer text.
#>
function Invoke-Rest([string]$Method, [string]$Uri, [string]$Body) {
  $url = $script:site.TrimEnd('/') + '/' + $Uri
  if ($Method -eq 'Get') { return [string](Invoke-PnPSPRestMethod -Method Get -Url $url -Raw -ErrorAction Stop) }
  return [string](Invoke-PnPSPRestMethod -Method $Method -Url $url -Content $Body -ContentType 'application/json;odata=verbose' -Raw -ErrorAction Stop)
}
# Reads a REST collection and returns its "value" items as an array.
function Get-RestValue([string]$Uri) { return @(((Invoke-Rest 'Get' $Uri '') | ConvertFrom-Json).value) }
function Get-SiteList {
  # Every list on the site that is not hidden, with the folder name it was made under (the folder name never changes).
  $select = '$select=Id,Title,ItemCount,BaseTemplate,Hidden,EnableAttachments,HasUniqueRoleAssignments,RootFolder/Name'
  return @(Get-RestValue ('_api/web/lists?' + $select + '&$expand=RootFolder&$top=1000') | Where-Object { -not $_.Hidden })
}
# Finds a list or library by the folder name it was made under; returns it, or $null.
function Find-ByFolder([string]$Folder) {
  foreach ($l in (Get-SiteList)) { if ([string]$l.RootFolder.Name -eq $Folder) { return $l } }
  return $null
}
# Prints one "NOW <text>" line before an action that takes time (the RADE window shows it as it happens). It goes to the
# screen only: it is not a result line, so it is not added to the result lines or the result file and is not counted.
function Write-Now([string]$Text) { Write-Host ('NOW ' + $Text) }
# Adds one "ITEM <name> <status> <text>" line and counts a PASS or a FAIL.
function Add-Item([string]$Name, [string]$Status, [string]$Text) {
  $script:lines.Add('ITEM ' + $Name + ' ' + $Status + $(if ($Text) { ' ' + $Text } else { '' }))
  if ($Status -eq 'PASS') { $script:passed++ } elseif ($Status -eq 'FAIL') { $script:failed++ }
}
function Add-Test([string]$Name, [string[]]$Piece, [bool]$Pass) {
  # One summary line per test: "T4 PASSED: a ...; next ...".
  $script:lines.Add($Name + ' ' + $(if ($Pass) { 'PASSED' } else { 'FAILED' }) + ': ' + ($Piece -join '; '))
  # The runner counts a line as passed or failed only by the separate word PASS or FAIL (R28 finding 7: this part read PASSED
  # while its 3 tests failed), so each test also gets one RESULT line.
  $script:lines.Add('RESULT ' + $Name + ' ' + $(if ($Pass) { 'PASS' } else { 'FAIL' }))
  if ($Pass) { $script:passed++ } else { $script:failed++ }
}
function Format-Detail([string]$Text) {
  # The flow's ProbeDetail (or an error text) for a line: one line, anything that looks like an address or a link masked, cut to 160.
  $t = ($Text -replace '\s+', ' ').Trim()
  $t = $t -replace '[^\s"<>|,;()\[\]]+@[^\s"<>|,;()\[\]]+', '<MASKED>'
  $t = $t -replace '[^\s"<>|,;()\[\]]+%40[^\s"<>|,;()\[\]]+', '<MASKED>'
  $t = $t -replace 'https?://\S+', '<MASKED>'
  if ($t.Length -gt 160) { $t = $t.Substring(0, 160) }
  return $t
}
function Get-ListRow([string]$Title, [string[]]$Fields) {
  # Plain rows (Id and the named fields as text); only counts and flags are written from them.
  $rows = @(Get-PnPListItem -List $Title -Fields $Fields -PageSize 500 -ErrorAction Stop)
  return @($rows | ForEach-Object {
    $o = @{ Id = [int]$_.Id; Item = $_ }
    foreach ($f in $Fields) { $o[$f] = [string]$_[$f] }
    $o
  })
}
function Find-Result($Rows, [string]$Test, [string]$Way) {
  # The newest RESULT row for a test and way, or $null.
  $hit = @($Rows | Where-Object { $_.Title -eq 'RESULT' -and $_.ProbeTest -eq $Test -and $_.ProbeWay -eq $Way } | Sort-Object { $_.Id } -Descending)
  if ($hit.Count) { return $hit[0] }
  return $null
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Checks every $pollEvery seconds for up to $WaitMinutes (both set by the main file); a NOW line a minute.
.DESCRIPTION
  A failed check is retried; 3 failures in a row stop the part (the error goes to the caller). This one differs from the
  shared Wait-Until of T18 and T24 (scripts/gov/src/wait-common.ps1): it takes its poll time from -PollSeconds, so the tests
  can wait 1 second, and it prints one NOW line a minute.
.PARAMETER Done
  The check: a script block that returns $true when the wait is over.
.PARAMETER What
  What is waited for, for the progress line.
.OUTPUTS
  System.Boolean. $true when the check passed in time, $false when the time ran out.
#>
function Wait-Until([scriptblock]$Done, [string]$What) {
  $start = Get-Date
  $end = $start.AddMinutes($WaitMinutes)
  $misses = 0; $nextNote = $start.AddMinutes(1)
  while ($true) {
    $isDone = $false
    try { $isDone = [bool](& $Done); $misses = 0 }
    catch {
      $misses++
      if ($misses -ge 3) { throw }
      Write-Now ('Checking again (a check failed, ' + $misses + ' of 3 allowed in a row)')
    }
    if ($isDone) { return $true }
    $now = Get-Date
    if ($now -ge $end) { return $false }
    if ($now -ge $nextNote) {
      Write-Now ('Waiting for ' + $What + ' (' + [int]($now - $start).TotalMinutes + ' of ' + $WaitMinutes + ' minutes)')
      $nextNote = $nextNote.AddMinutes(1)
    }
    Start-Sleep -Seconds $pollEvery
  }
}
# The site user number of the author of a row, or 0 when the row has none.
function Get-AuthorId($Row) { $a = $Row.Item['Author']; if ($a -and $a.LookupId) { return [int]$a.LookupId }; return 0 }
# The site user number of the person who saved a row last (Modified By), or 0 when the row has none.
function Get-EditorId($Row) { $a = $Row.Item['Editor']; if ($a -and $a.LookupId) { return [int]$a.LookupId }; return 0 }
# The site user numbers of the members of one site group.
function Get-GroupMemberId([int]$GroupId) {
  return @(Get-RestValue ('_api/web/sitegroups/getbyid(' + $GroupId + ')/users?$select=Id&$top=5000') | ForEach-Object { [int]$_.Id })
}
# The Id of the site's associated Visitors group, or 0 when the site has none or it cannot be read.
function Get-VisitorGroupId {
  try { return [int]((Invoke-Rest 'Get' '_api/web/associatedvisitorgroup?$select=Id' '') | ConvertFrom-Json).Id } catch { return 0 }
}
function Read-State([string]$Dir) {
  # The saved numbers of the second person (site user Id, group Id, whether the person was a member before): no address, no name.
  $f = Join-Path $Dir $StateName
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f -PathType Leaf)) { return $null }
  $h = @{}
  foreach ($l in @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $f)) { if ([string]$l -match '^(\w+)=(.*)$') { $h[$Matches[1]] = $Matches[2].Trim() } }
  if ($h['UserId'] -notmatch '^\d+$') { return $null }
  return $h
}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Loads PnP.PowerShell, signs in to the site with the web login (CAC) and reads the lists once, so the REST route is
  proved by a read before anything is written. Adds the lines ROUTE and ITEM a-rest-read.
#>
function Connect-ProbeSite {
  Write-Now 'Loading PnP.PowerShell'
  $mod = @(Get-Module -ListAvailable -Name PnP.PowerShell | Sort-Object Version -Descending)
  if (-not $mod.Count) { throw 'PNP not installed: PnP.PowerShell is not on this computer.' }
  $null = & { Import-Module PnP.PowerShell -RequiredVersion $mod[0].Version -DisableNameChecking } *>&1
  # r14 (R47 plan; R46 finding 1): no DPI call here any more (RADE engine-v47 turns the DPI sign-in off).
  # r14 (R47: fewer CAC sign-ins): in a T30 batch an earlier part of this process signed in to this site; that sign-in is
  # used again (Get-PnPConnection), with no second sign-in window. Outside a batch no connection is there, so it signs in.
  $now = $null; try { $now = Get-PnPConnection -ErrorAction Stop } catch { $now = $null }   # no connection: sign in below
  if ($now -and ([string]$now.Url).TrimEnd('/') -eq ([string]$script:site).TrimEnd('/')) { $script:lines.Add('SIGNIN reused: this process is signed in to the site already') }
  else {
    Write-Now 'Signing in to the site (if a sign-in window opens, sign in with your CAC)'
    $null = & { Connect-PnPOnline -Url $script:site -UseWebLogin -ErrorAction Stop } *>&1
  }
  $script:lines.Add('ROUTE web-login PASS')
  Write-Now 'Reading the lists of the site'
  $siteLists = Get-SiteList
  $script:lines.Add('ITEM a-rest-read INFO lists read from the site=' + $siteLists.Count)
}
'@ }

# Encodes a text for HTML (the test page).
function Get-HtmlText([string]$Text) { return [System.Net.WebUtility]::HtmlEncode($Text) }

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Writes the test page: one big link per thing to open. Colors and font as the RADE window.
.DESCRIPTION
  The page holds the site address, so it stays in the T21 folder on this computer; it is never a result file.
.PARAMETER Dir
  The T21 folder.
.PARAMETER Site
  The site address.
.OUTPUTS
  System.Int32. The number of links on the page.
#>
function Write-LinksPage([string]$Dir, [string]$Site) {
  $s = $Site.TrimEnd('/')
  $links = @(
    @('Open the new row form', ($s + '/Lists/' + $ListFolder + '/NewForm.aspx'), 'Tests T4 and the list form look: the form other people use.'),
    @('Open the probe list', ($s + '/Lists/' + $ListFolder + '/AllItems.aspx'), 'The rows the tests wrote.'),
    @('Open the list with the button', ($s + '/Lists/' + $ListFolder + '/' + $ViewTitle + '.aspx'), 'The view look: a button that starts a flow.'),
    @('Open the fake workbook', ($s + '/' + $LibFolder + '/' + $BookName + '?web=1'), 'The Excel look: a workbook in Excel for the web.'))
  $body = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder
  [void]$body.Append('<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>90-161.Z test page r6</title><style>')
  [void]$body.Append('body{font-family:"Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif;color:#1b2430;background:#fff;margin:0}.light{height:6px;background:#ffd520}')
  [void]$body.Append('main{max-width:760px;padding:24px 32px}h1{font-family:"Segoe UI Semibold","Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif;font-weight:600;')
  [void]$body.Append('font-size:29px;color:#0b2545;margin:8px 0 4px}')
  [void]$body.Append('p{font-size:15px;color:#5a6573;margin:0 0 24px}a.go{display:block;border:1px solid #00539f;background:#00539f;color:#fff;')
  [void]$body.Append('text-decoration:none;font-size:17px;font-weight:700;padding:14px 18px;margin:0 0 4px}')
  [void]$body.Append('a.go:focus{outline:2px solid #0b2545;outline-offset:2px}span.why{display:block;font-size:14px;color:#5a6573;margin:0 0 20px}')
  [void]$body.Append('</style></head><body><div class="light"></div><main>')
  [void]$body.Append('<h1>90-161.Z test page</h1><p>Round R30. Fake data only. Open each link when the RADE window says so.</p>')
  foreach ($l in $links) {
    [void]$body.Append('<a class="go" href="' + (Get-HtmlText $l[1]) + '">' + (Get-HtmlText $l[0]) + '</a><span class="why">' + (Get-HtmlText $l[2]) + '</span>')
  }
  [void]$body.Append('</main></body></html>')
  Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $Dir $LinksName) -Value $body.ToString() -Encoding UTF8
  return $links.Count
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Make, step m3: the 4 text columns of the probe list (internal name = display name). Adds an ITEM line.
.PARAMETER List
  The probe list (from Find-ByFolder).
.PARAMETER Made
  The counts of what was made (columns is raised here).
.PARAMETER Skip
  The counts of what was there already (columns is raised here).
#>
function Add-ProbeColumn($List, [hashtable]$Made, [hashtable]$Skip) {
  $want = @(@{ Name = 'ProbeTest'; Type = 'Text' }, @{ Name = 'ProbeWay'; Type = 'Text' }, @{ Name = 'ProbeResult'; Type = 'Text' },
    @{ Name = 'ProbeDetail'; Type = 'Note' })
  $have = @(Get-RestValue ("_api/web/lists(guid'" + $List.Id + "')/fields?" + '$select=InternalName&$top=2000') | ForEach-Object { [string]$_.InternalName })
  $bad = 0
  foreach ($c in $want) {
    if ($have -contains $c.Name) { $Skip.columns++; continue }
    $extra = $(if ($c.Type -eq 'Note') { ' RichText="FALSE" NumLines="6"' } else { '' })
    $xml = '<Field Name="' + $c.Name + '" StaticName="' + $c.Name + '" DisplayName="' + $c.Name + '" Required="FALSE" Type="' + $c.Type + '"' + $extra + '></Field>'
    $body = @{ parameters = @{ __metadata = @{ type = 'SP.XmlSchemaFieldCreationInformation' }; SchemaXml = $xml; Options = 24 } } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20 -Compress
    try { $null = Invoke-Rest 'Post' ("_api/web/lists(guid'" + $List.Id + "')/fields/createfieldasxml") $body; $Made.columns++ } catch { $bad++ }
  }
  Add-Item 'm3-columns' $(if ($bad -eq 0) { 'PASS' } else { 'FAIL' }) ('columns made=' + $Made.columns + ' already there=' + $Skip.columns + ' refused=' + $bad)
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Make, step m4: the list's own permissions: the site's copied, then Contribute for the associated Visitors group on this
  list only. Adds an ITEM line (and a NOTE when the site has no Visitors group).
.PARAMETER Made
  The counts of what was made (permissions is raised for each change).
#>
function Grant-ProbePermission([hashtable]$Made) {
  $lst = Find-ByFolder $ListFolder
  $lbase = "_api/web/lists(guid'" + $lst.Id + "')"
  if (-not $lst.HasUniqueRoleAssignments) {
    $null = Invoke-Rest 'Post' ($lbase + '/breakroleinheritance(copyRoleAssignments=true,clearSubscopes=true)') '{}'
    $Made.permissions++
  }
  $visitorId = Get-VisitorGroupId
  if ($visitorId -le 0) {
    $script:lines.Add('NOTE m4: no associated Visitors group on this site, so Contribute was not added; the T4 test needs a Visitors group')
    Add-Item 'm4-permissions' 'PASS' ('own permissions on the list (copied now=' + $Made.permissions + '); Visitors group not found')
    return
  }
  $contribute = 0
  try { $contribute = [int](Get-RestValue '_api/web/roledefinitions?$filter=RoleTypeKind%20eq%203&$select=Id')[0].Id } catch { $contribute = 0 }
  if ($contribute -le 0) { throw 'ROLE Contribute not found on the site.' }
  $has = $false
  $bindings = $lbase + '/roleassignments/getbyprincipalid(' + $visitorId + ')/roledefinitionbindings?$select=Id'
  try { $has = @(Get-RestValue $bindings | Where-Object { [int]$_.Id -eq $contribute }).Count -gt 0 } catch { $has = $false }
  if (-not $has) {
    $null = Invoke-Rest 'Post' ($lbase + '/roleassignments/addroleassignment(principalid=' + $visitorId + ',roledefid=' + $contribute + ')') '{}'
    $Made.permissions++
  }
  Add-Item 'm4-permissions' 'PASS' ('own permissions on the list, Visitors group has Contribute (changes now=' + $Made.permissions + ')')
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Make, step m5: saves the fake workbook from the text block in this module (the repo holds no .xlsx: the personal-data
  scan cannot read a binary file), then uploads it. No macro workbook (PFM 17 Nov 26: endpoint security risk).
.PARAMETER Library
  The probe library (from Find-ByFolder).
.PARAMETER Made
  The counts of what was made (files is raised for an upload).
.PARAMETER Skip
  The counts of what was there already (files is raised when the workbook is in the library).
#>
function Send-FakeWorkbook($Library, [hashtable]$Made, [hashtable]$Skip) {
  $wrote = 0
  foreach ($w in @(, @($BookName, $FakeBookBase64))) {
    $bytes = [Convert]::FromBase64String((([string]$w[1] -split '\s+') -join ''))
    $path = Join-Path $script:dir $w[0]
    $same = $false
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path -PathType Leaf) {
      $cur = [IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($path)
      $same = ($cur.Length -eq $bytes.Length) -and ([Convert]::ToBase64String($cur) -eq [Convert]::ToBase64String($bytes))
    }
    if (-not $same) { [IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($path, $bytes); $wrote++ }
  }
  $script:lines.Add('ITEM m5a-workbooks INFO fake workbook saved to the T21 folder now=' + $wrote)
  $filesUri = "_api/web/lists(guid'" + $Library.Id + "')/rootfolder/files?" + '$select=Name&$top=500'
  $inLib = @(Get-RestValue $filesUri | ForEach-Object { [string]$_.Name })
  foreach ($n in @($BookName)) {
    if ($inLib -contains $n) { $Skip.files++; continue }
    $null = Add-PnPFile -Path (Join-Path $script:dir $n) -Folder $LibFolder -ErrorAction Stop
    $Made.files++
  }
  $inLib = @(Get-RestValue $filesUri | ForEach-Object { [string]$_.Name })
  $ok = ($inLib -contains $BookName)
  Add-Item 'm5-files' $(if ($ok) { 'PASS' } else { 'FAIL' }) ('files in the library: the workbook there=' + $(if ($ok) { 'yes' } else { 'no' }) + ' (uploaded now=' + $Made.files + ')')
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  The part Make: the library and the list (m1, m2; the same cmdlet T16 uses for its library), the columns, the
  permissions, the workbook and the test page (m3 to m6), then the MADE and SKIPPED count lines. A second run changes
  nothing on the site.
#>
function Invoke-MakePart {
  $made = @{ library = 0; list = 0; columns = 0; permissions = 0; files = 0 }
  $skip = @{ library = 0; list = 0; columns = 0; permissions = 0; files = 0 }
  Write-Now 'Looking for the library and the list'
  $lib = Find-ByFolder $LibFolder
  if ($lib) { $skip.library++ } else {
    Write-Now ('Making the library ' + $LibTitle)
    $null = New-PnPList -Title $LibTitle -Template DocumentLibrary -Url $LibFolder -ErrorAction Stop
    $made.library++; $lib = Find-ByFolder $LibFolder
  }
  Add-Item 'm1-library' $(if ($lib) { 'PASS' } else { 'FAIL' }) $(if ($lib) { 'library there (made=' + $made.library + ')' } else { 'library not on the site after the create step' })
  $lst = Find-ByFolder $ListFolder
  if ($lst) { $skip.list++ } else {
    Write-Now ('Making the list ' + $ListTitle)
    $null = New-PnPList -Title $ListTitle -Template GenericList -Url ('Lists/' + $ListFolder) -ErrorAction Stop
    $made.list++; $lst = Find-ByFolder $ListFolder
  }
  Add-Item 'm2-list' $(if ($lst) { 'PASS' } else { 'FAIL' }) $(if ($lst) { 'list there (made=' + $made.list + ')' } else { 'list not on the site after the create step' })
  if (-not $lib -or -not $lst) { throw 'LIST or library missing after the create step; nothing more was done.' }
  Write-Now 'Adding the 4 columns of the list'
  Add-ProbeColumn $lst $made $skip
  Write-Now 'Setting the permissions of the list'
  Grant-ProbePermission $made
  Write-Now 'Saving and uploading the fake workbook'
  Send-FakeWorkbook $lib $made $skip
  # m6: the test page (it holds the site address: it stays in the T21 folder).
  $n = Write-LinksPage $script:dir $script:site
  Add-Item 'm6-page' 'PASS' ('test page in the T21 folder, links=' + $n)
  $script:lines.Add('MADE library=' + $made.library + ' list=' + $made.list + ' columns=' + $made.columns + ' permission changes=' + $made.permissions + ' files=' + $made.files)
  $script:lines.Add('SKIPPED (already there) library=' + $skip.library + ' list=' + $skip.list + ' columns=' + $skip.columns + ' files=' + $skip.files)
}

# The part Open (no sign-in): writes the test page again and opens it in the browser.
function Invoke-OpenPart {
  Write-Now 'Writing the test page'
  $n = Write-LinksPage $script:dir $script:site
  Add-Item 'o1-page' 'PASS' ('test page written, links=' + $n)
  if (-not $NoLaunch) { Write-Now 'Opening the test page in the browser'; Start-Process -FilePath (Join-Path $script:dir $LinksName) }
  Add-Item 'o2-open' 'PASS' ('test page opened in the browser=' + $(if ($NoLaunch) { 'no (test run)' } else { 'yes' }))
}
'@ }

$files += @{ Dir = 'T21'; Name = '90161Z-T21-person-r14.ps1'; Kind = 'text'; Sha = '50de66b00512'; Data = @'
<#
.SYNOPSIS
  90-161.Z Task 21 probe r14, module "person": the parts Person (the second person for test T4), Ask (the round asks that
  person for a new row, R36) and Clean (removes the person, the list and the library again).
.DESCRIPTION
  Loaded by 90161Z-T21-probe-r14.ps1 (dot-sourced from the same folder); it does nothing when it is run alone.
  Inputs: the values the main file sets ($site, $dir, $StateName, $ListTitle, $ListFolder, $LibTitle, $LibFolder,
  $TestDir, $NoLaunch) and the helpers of the module "common". Outputs: result lines through Add-Item.
  The second person's e-mail address is read in a small window and used in memory only: it is never written to a file,
  a result line or an output stream (tests/ps/Test-T21.ps1 checks this text).
  Network: the one SharePoint site of the main file, through the PnP.PowerShell connection.
  Writes: Person: adds one person to the site's Visitors group; on this computer the state file (3 numbers or flags) and
          the clipboard (the new row form link). Ask: the line T4Asked=yes in that state file and the clipboard (the new
          row form link); nothing on the site. Clean: removes that person from Visitors and PFM Office again, moves the probe list
          and library to the site Recycle Bin, deletes the state file.
  Credentials: none of its own (the main file signs in); no password is asked for.
  Run: not alone; powershell.exe -File 90161Z-T21-probe-r14.ps1 -Part Person (or Ask, or Clean) loads it.
#>

function Read-PersonAddress {
  # The second person's address, typed by the PFM in a small window. It is returned to the caller and used in memory only; this
  # function writes nothing. In a test run (-TestDir) a fake address may come from the test.
  # r13 (the PFM, 26 Nov 26, R45: "maybe i should have the option to say skip"): the window has OK and Skip. Skip, an
  # empty box or closing the window gives '' (the caller then gives SKIP, not FAIL). The window scales itself
  # (AutoScaleMode Dpi), so it draws right in a DPI-aware process too.
  # r14 (R46 finding 4: the box cut the prompt at "stays on this comput"): a prompt of 2 short lines, at most 120 characters
  # (tests/ps/Test-T30.ps1 checks it). The RADE step card says that the address stays on this computer.
  if ($TestDir -and $null -ne $env:T21_TEST_ADDRESS) { return ([string]$env:T21_TEST_ADDRESS).Trim() }
  $prompt = 'Type the e-mail address of the second person (not you), then select OK. If nobody can help today, select Skip.'
  try {
    Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms -ErrorAction Stop; Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Drawing -ErrorAction Stop
    $f = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Form
    $f.Text = '90-161.Z test T4'; $f.FormBorderStyle = 'FixedDialog'; $f.MaximizeBox = $false; $f.MinimizeBox = $false
    $f.StartPosition = 'CenterScreen'; $f.TopMost = $true; $f.Font = New-Object System.Drawing.Font('Segoe UI', 9)
    $f.AutoScaleDimensions = New-Object System.Drawing.SizeF(96, 96); $f.AutoScaleMode = 'Dpi'; $f.ClientSize = New-Object System.Drawing.Size(420, 170)
    $l = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Label; $l.Text = $prompt; $l.SetBounds(12, 12, 396, 70)
    $t = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.TextBox; $t.SetBounds(12, 88, 396, 24)
    $ok = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Button; $ok.Text = 'OK'; $ok.SetBounds(232, 128, 84, 30); $ok.DialogResult = 'OK'
    $sk = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Button; $sk.Text = 'Skip'; $sk.SetBounds(324, 128, 84, 30); $sk.DialogResult = 'Cancel'
    $f.Controls.AddRange(@($l, $t, $ok, $sk)); $f.AcceptButton = $ok; $f.CancelButton = $sk
    $r = $f.ShowDialog(); $v = [string]$t.Text; $f.Dispose()
    if ($r -ne 'OK') { return '' }   # Skip or the window's X: nobody can help today
    return $v.Trim()
  } catch {
    if ($env:RADE_CONTRACT) { throw 'ADDRESS window not available: the window for the second person could not open on this computer.' }
    return ([string](Read-Host 'E-mail address of the second person (it is not saved; press Enter with no text to skip)')).Trim()
  }
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Person, step p3: puts the found person into the Visitors group, unless the person is a member already. The numbers are
  saved in the state file before the change, so Clean can find the person even if this part stops half way.
.DESCRIPTION
  A state file from an earlier run of this part that added a person is kept (review, 17 Nov 26): a second run must not
  turn "added by this test" into "was a member before", or Clean would leave the person in Visitors.
.PARAMETER VisitorId
  The Id of the site's Visitors group.
.PARAMETER UserId
  The site user number of the person.
.PARAMETER LoginName
  The person's login name for Add-PnPGroupMember (used in memory only).
.OUTPUTS
  System.Collections.Hashtable. State ('yes', 'was', 'no' or 'other') and Why (the status text, no identity).
#>
function Add-VisitorMember([int]$VisitorId, [int]$UserId, [string]$LoginName) {
  $state = 'no'; $why = ''
  $was = (Get-GroupMemberId $VisitorId) -contains $UserId
  $old = Read-State $script:dir
  $keep = ($old -and $old['WasMember'] -eq 'no')
  if ($keep -and [int]$old['UserId'] -ne $UserId) {
    $state = 'other'; $why = 'a person added by an earlier run is still on file: run the Clean part first, then this part again'
  } else {
    if ($keep) { $was = $false }
    else {
      $stateLines = @(('UserId=' + $UserId), ('GroupId=' + $VisitorId), ('WasMember=' + $(if ($was) { 'yes' } else { 'no' })))
      Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $script:dir $StateName) -Value $stateLines -Encoding ASCII
    }
  }
  if ($state -eq 'other') { $null = $state }
  elseif ($was) { $state = 'was'; $why = 'the person was already a member and stays one' }
  elseif ($keep -and ((Get-GroupMemberId $VisitorId) -contains $UserId)) { $state = 'yes'; $why = 'added by an earlier run of this part; Clean removes the person' }
  else {
    try {
      $null = Add-PnPGroupMember -LoginName $LoginName -Group $VisitorId -ErrorAction Stop
      if ((Get-GroupMemberId $VisitorId) -contains $UserId) { $state = 'yes' } else { $why = 'the group does not list the person after the add' }
    } catch { $why = 'the add was refused: ' + (Format-Detail ([string]$_.Exception.Message)) }
  }
  return @{ State = $state; Why = $why }
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Person, steps p2 and p3: asks for the address, finds the person on the site and adds the person to Visitors. The
  address is read into one variable, used in the next calls and cleared; it is never written, printed or saved.
.PARAMETER VisitorId
  The Id of the site's Visitors group.
.OUTPUTS
  System.Collections.Hashtable. State ('yes', 'was', 'no' or 'other') and Why (the status text, no identity).
#>
function Add-SecondPerson([int]$VisitorId) {
  $result = @{ State = 'no'; Why = '' }
  Write-Now 'Asking for the address of the second person in a small window'
  $personAddr = Read-PersonAddress
  $addrOk = ($personAddr -match '^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$'); $addrNone = -not ($personAddr -match '\S')   # r13: nothing typed (Skip)
  if ($addrNone) { Add-Item 'p2-person' 'SKIP' 'nobody could help today (Skip, or no address)'; $result.Why = 'skipped: nobody could help today' }   # r13: Skip is not a failure
  elseif (-not $addrOk) { Add-Item 'p2-person' 'FAIL' 'the text in the window is not an e-mail address'; $result.Why = 'the text is not an e-mail address' }
  else {
    $userId = 0; $loginName = ''
    Write-Now 'Looking for the second person on the site'
    try {
      $raw = Invoke-Rest 'Post' '_api/web/ensureuser' (@{ logonName = ('i:0#.f|membership|' + $personAddr) } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress)
      if ($raw -match '"Id"\s*:\s*(\d+)') { $userId = [int]$Matches[1] }
      if ($raw -match '"LoginName"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"') { $loginName = $Matches[1] }
    } catch { $userId = 0 }
    if ($userId -le 0) {
      try {
        $raw = Invoke-Rest 'Get' ("_api/web/siteusers/getbyemail('" + [uri]::EscapeDataString($personAddr) + "')?" + '$select=Id,LoginName') ''
        if ($raw -match '"Id"\s*:\s*(\d+)') { $userId = [int]$Matches[1] }
        if ($raw -match '"LoginName"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"') { $loginName = $Matches[1] }
      } catch { $userId = 0 }
    }
    if (-not $loginName) { $loginName = 'i:0#.f|membership|' + $personAddr }
    if ($userId -le 0) { Add-Item 'p2-person' 'FAIL' 'the person was not found on this site'; $result.Why = 'the person was not found on this site' }
    else {
      Add-Item 'p2-person' 'PASS' 'the person was found on this site (the site user number is saved in the state file, no address and no name)'
      Write-Now 'Adding the second person to the Visitors group'
      $result = Add-VisitorMember $VisitorId $userId $loginName
      $isIn = ($result.State -eq 'yes' -or $result.State -eq 'was')
      $inText = $(if ($result.State -eq 'no' -or $result.State -eq 'other') { 'no' } else { 'yes' })
      Add-Item 'p3-visitors' $(if ($isIn) { 'PASS' } else { 'FAIL' }) ('person in the Visitors group=' + $inText + $(if ($result.Why) { ' (' + $result.Why + ')' } else { '' }))
    }
  }
  $personAddr = $null; $loginName = $null; $raw = $null
  return $result
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  The part Person (T4 retry, PFM 17 Nov 26): the second person is added to the Visitors group with your sign-in, and
  removed again by Clean. Prints "added to Visitors: yes" or "no" and a status, never who; puts the form link on the
  clipboard.
#>
function Invoke-PersonPart {
  Write-Now 'Looking for the probe list and the Visitors group'
  $lst = Find-ByFolder $ListFolder
  if (-not $lst) { throw 'LIST not found: run -Part Make first.' }
  $visitorId = Get-VisitorGroupId
  $result = @{ State = 'no'; Why = '' }
  if ($visitorId -le 0) { Add-Item 'p1-group' 'FAIL' 'the site has no Visitors group'; $result.Why = 'the site has no Visitors group' }
  else {
    Add-Item 'p1-group' 'PASS' 'the site has a Visitors group'
    $result = Add-SecondPerson $visitorId
  }
  $state = $result.State
  $status = $(if ($state -eq 'yes') { 'added and listed in the group' } elseif ($state -eq 'was') { 'already a member (Clean leaves the person in the group)' } else { $result.Why })
  $script:lines.Add('VISITORS added to Visitors: ' + $(if ($state -eq 'yes') { 'yes' } else { 'no' }) + '; status: ' + $status)
  $clip = 'no'
  if ($NoLaunch) { $clip = 'no (test run)' } else {
    try { Set-Clipboard -Value ($script:site.TrimEnd('/') + '/Lists/' + $ListFolder + '/NewForm.aspx'); $clip = 'yes' } catch { $clip = 'no' }
  }
  $script:lines.Add('ITEM p4-link INFO the link of the new row form is on the clipboard=' + $clip)
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  The part Ask (R36; on this computer only, no sign-in): the round asks the second person to add one new row titled T4a
  through the new row form. Writes T4Asked=yes into the state file of Person (the other lines stay), so Read counts T4
  even when no row came (R35: T4 read FAIL when no step had asked), and puts the link of the new row form on the
  clipboard. With no second person on file it writes nothing and fails.
#>
function Invoke-AskPart {
  Write-Now 'Reading the state file of the second person'
  $st = Read-State $script:dir
  if (-not $st) { Add-Item 'k1-asked' 'FAIL' 'no second person on file: run the part Person first'; return }
  $f = Join-Path $script:dir $StateName
  $keep = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $f | Where-Object { [string]$_ -notmatch '^T4Asked=' })
  Set-Content -LiteralPath $f -Value (@($keep) + 'T4Asked=yes') -Encoding ASCII
  $ok = ((Read-State $script:dir)['T4Asked'] -eq 'yes')
  Add-Item 'k1-asked' $(if ($ok) { 'PASS' } else { 'FAIL' }) ('T4Asked=yes in the state file (Read now counts T4)=' + $(if ($ok) { 'yes' } else { 'no' }))
  $clip = 'no'
  if ($NoLaunch) { $clip = 'no (test run)' } else {
    try { Set-Clipboard -Value ($script:site.TrimEnd('/') + '/Lists/' + $ListFolder + '/NewForm.aspx'); $clip = 'yes' } catch { $clip = 'no' }
  }
  $script:lines.Add('ITEM k2-link INFO the link of the new row form is on the clipboard=' + $clip)
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Clean, step c1: removes the second person from the Visitors group again (found by the saved numbers in the state file),
  then deletes the state file. A person who was a member before the test stays. Adds one ITEM line.
#>
function Clear-SecondPerson {
  $state = Read-State $script:dir
  if (-not $state) { Add-Item 'c1-person' 'PASS' 'no second person on file (nothing to remove)'; return }
  if ($state['WasMember'] -eq 'yes') {
    Add-Item 'c1-person' 'PASS' 'the second person was a Visitors member before the test, so the person stays (state file deleted)'
    try { Remove-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $script:dir $StateName) -ErrorAction Stop } catch { $null = $_ }
    return
  }
  Write-Now 'Removing the second person from the Visitors group'
  try {
    $uid = [int]$state['UserId']; $gid = 0
    if ($state['GroupId'] -match '^\d+$') { $gid = [int]$state['GroupId'] }
    if ($gid -le 0) { $gid = [int]((Invoke-Rest 'Get' '_api/web/associatedvisitorgroup?$select=Id' '') | ConvertFrom-Json).Id }
    $members = Get-GroupMemberId $gid
    if ($members -contains $uid) {
      $null = Invoke-Rest 'Post' ('_api/web/sitegroups/getbyid(' + $gid + ')/users/removebyid(' + $uid + ')') '{}'
      $members = Get-GroupMemberId $gid
    }
    $still = $members -contains $uid
    $text = $(if (-not $still) { 'the second person is not in the Visitors group (state file deleted)' } else { 'the second person is still in the Visitors group (state file kept; run Clean again)' })
    Add-Item 'c1-person' $(if (-not $still) { 'PASS' } else { 'FAIL' }) $text
    if (-not $still) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $script:dir $StateName) -ErrorAction Stop }
  } catch { Add-Item 'c1-person' 'FAIL' ('the second person could not be removed: ' + (Format-Detail ([string]$_.Exception.Message)) + ' (state file kept; run Clean again)') }
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  The part Clean: runs each step on its own, even if an earlier one failed. First the person (Visitors, then PFM Office:
  module "office"), then the two objects (found
  by their folder name), to the site Recycle Bin (restorable for 93 days). The probe flows stay in the solution.
#>
function Invoke-CleanPart {
  Write-Now 'Looking for a second person on file'
  Clear-SecondPerson
  Clear-OfficeMember
  foreach ($o in @(@('c2-list', $ListTitle, $ListFolder), @('c3-library', $LibTitle, $LibFolder))) {
    try {
      $x = Find-ByFolder $o[2]
      if (-not $x) { Add-Item $o[0] 'PASS' ('"' + $o[1] + '" was not on the site (nothing to remove)'); continue }
      Write-Now ('Moving ' + $o[1] + ' to the site Recycle Bin')
      # R29a finding 7: the command returns the Recycle Bin item ID; it is not shown (it reached the log as a raw table).
      $null = Remove-PnPList -Identity ([string]$x.Id) -Recycle -Force -ErrorAction Stop
      $still = Find-ByFolder $o[2]
      $text = $(if (-not $still) { 'moved to the site Recycle Bin (restorable for 93 days)' } else { 'is still on the site' })
      Add-Item $o[0] $(if (-not $still) { 'PASS' } else { 'FAIL' }) ('"' + $o[1] + '" ' + $text)
    } catch { Add-Item $o[0] 'FAIL' ('"' + $o[1] + '" could not be removed: ' + (Format-Detail ([string]$_.Exception.Message)) + ' (run Clean again)') }
  }
  $flows = '"90161Z T21 Probe Health r6" and "90161Z T21 Probe Button r6"'
  $script:lines.Add('NOTE the probe flows ' + $flows + ' are flows of the solution "90-161.Z flows"; this script does not touch flows or solutions')
}
'@ }

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  90-161.Z Task 21 probe r14, module "look": the parts Form (a header on the list form) and View (a list view with a
  button that starts the button flow "90161Z T21 Probe Button r6" of the solution "90-161.Z flows"). The part Look runs
  both.
.DESCRIPTION
  Loaded by 90161Z-T21-probe-r14.ps1 (dot-sourced from the same folder); it does nothing when it is run alone.
  Inputs: the values the main file sets ($ListTitle, $ListFolder, $ViewTitle, $HeaderText) and the helpers of the module
  "common"; View takes the button flow's ID from the button-flow-id block below, which scripts/build_flow_solution.py
  writes at build time (the flow's workflow ID in the solution, the same on every build; R34: no export file). Outputs:
  result lines through Add-Item and Add-Test (FORM, VIEW).
  R29a finding 6: the round skipped the look at the form because one step held both tests and the view failed. With Form
  and View as separate parts, the round can run the look at the form after Form alone.
  Network: the one SharePoint site of the main file, through the PnP.PowerShell connection (CSOM, then REST).
  Writes: Form: the form formatting (ClientFormCustomFormatter) of the probe list's content type. View: the view
          "ProbeButton" on the probe list and its formatting (CustomFormatter). Nothing on this computer.

# >>> button-flow-id: generated from flow/solution/defs/90161Z-T21-probe-button-r6.json by scripts/build_flow_solution.py (do not edit)
$ButtonFlowId = 'ce93ba66-4985-5431-bec3-5f371af52372'

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Sets a formatting JSON on a content type (form header) or a view. Easy path first: the CSOM property; then the REST
  merge.
.PARAMETER Kind
  'form' (content type) or 'view'.
.PARAMETER Json
  The formatting JSON text.
.PARAMETER ListId
  The probe list's Id.
.PARAMETER TargetId
  The content type Id (form) or the view Id (view).
.OUTPUTS
  System.String. 'csom', 'rest' or 'none'; the last error text is kept in $script:fmtError.
#>
function Send-Formatter([string]$Kind, [string]$Json, [string]$ListId, [string]$TargetId) {
  $script:fmtError = ''
  try {
    $ctx = Get-PnPContext
    $list = $ctx.Web.Lists.GetById([guid]$ListId)
    if ($Kind -eq 'form') { $t = $list.ContentTypes.GetById($TargetId); $t.ClientFormCustomFormatter = $Json; $t.Update($false) }
    else { $t = $list.Views.GetById([guid]$TargetId); $t.CustomFormatter = $Json; $t.Update() }
    $ctx.ExecuteQuery()
    return 'csom'
  } catch { $script:fmtError = [string]$_.Exception.Message }
  try {
    $lbase = "_api/web/lists(guid'" + $ListId + "')"
    if ($Kind -eq 'form') {
      $body = @{ __metadata = @{ type = 'SP.ContentType' }; ClientFormCustomFormatter = $Json } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress
      $null = Invoke-Rest 'Merge' ($lbase + "/contenttypes('" + $TargetId + "')") $body
    } else {
      $body = @{ __metadata = @{ type = 'SP.View' }; CustomFormatter = $Json } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress
      $null = Invoke-Rest 'Merge' ($lbase + "/views(guid'" + $TargetId + "')") $body
    }
    return 'rest'
  } catch { $script:fmtError = [string]$_.Exception.Message }
  return 'none'
}

# Finds the probe list or stops the part (Form and View need it).
function Get-ProbeListOrStop {
  Write-Now 'Looking for the probe list'
  $lst = Find-ByFolder $ListFolder
  if (-not $lst) { throw 'LIST not found: run -Part Make first.' }
  return $lst
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  The part Form (a): the header of the list form (the form formatting of the content type), read back from the content
  type. Adds the ITEM line l1-form and the test FORM.
#>
function Invoke-FormPart {
  $lst = Get-ProbeListOrStop
  $lbase = "_api/web/lists(guid'" + $lst.Id + "')"
  $ctId = ''
  try { $cts = @(Get-RestValue ($lbase + '/contenttypes?$select=Id,Name')); if ($cts.Count) { $ctId = [string]$cts[0].Id.StringValue } } catch { $ctId = '' }
  $formPass = $false; $route = 'none'; $readBack = 'no'
  if (-not $ctId) { Add-Item 'l1-form' 'FAIL' 'no content type found on the list' }
  else {
    $hdr = [ordered]@{ headerJSONFormatter = [ordered]@{ elmType = 'div'; style = [ordered]@{ padding = '12px'; 'font-size' = '18px'; 'font-weight' = '600' }; txtContent = $HeaderText } }
    Write-Now 'Setting the header on the list form and reading it back'
    $route = Send-Formatter 'form' ($hdr | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 -Compress) ([string]$lst.Id) $ctId
    try {
      $raw = Invoke-Rest 'Get' ($lbase + "/contenttypes('" + $ctId + "')?" + '$select=ClientFormCustomFormatter') ''
      if ($raw.Contains($HeaderText)) { $readBack = 'yes' }
    } catch { $readBack = 'not read' }
    $formPass = ($readBack -eq 'yes')
    $why = $(if ($route -eq 'none') { '; ' + (Format-Detail $script:fmtError) } else { '' })
    Add-Item 'l1-form' $(if ($formPass) { 'PASS' } else { 'FAIL' }) ('header formatting set (route=' + $route + ') and read back from the content type=' + $readBack + $why)
  }
  $summary = 'a header on the list form (form formatting set by script)=' + $(if ($formPass) { 'PASS' } else { 'FAIL' }) + ' (route=' + $route + '; read back=' + $readBack + ')'
  Add-Test 'FORM' @($summary + '; what the form shows is left to your answers') $formPass
}

# The button flow's ID from the button-flow-id block (lower case), or '' when the block holds no ID.
function Get-ButtonFlowId {
  $bt = ([string]$ButtonFlowId).Trim()
  if ($bt -match '^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$') { return $bt.ToLowerInvariant() }
  return ''
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Makes the view "ProbeButton" when it is missing and returns its Id ('' when it is not there after the create step).
.PARAMETER ListBase
  The REST address of the probe list (_api/web/lists(guid'...')).
.OUTPUTS
  System.Collections.Hashtable. Id (the view Id or '') and Made (1 when the view was made now, else 0).
#>
function Get-ButtonView([string]$ListBase) {
  $viewId = ''
  try { $vs = @(Get-RestValue ($ListBase + '/views?$select=Id,Title') | Where-Object { [string]$_.Title -eq $ViewTitle }); if ($vs.Count) { $viewId = [string]$vs[0].Id } } catch { $viewId = '' }
  $viewMade = 0
  if (-not $viewId) {
    Write-Now ('Making the view ' + $ViewTitle)
    $null = Add-PnPView -List $ListTitle -Title $ViewTitle -Fields @('Title', 'ProbeTest', 'ProbeResult') -ErrorAction Stop
    $viewMade++
    $vs = @(Get-RestValue ($ListBase + '/views?$select=Id,Title') | Where-Object { [string]$_.Title -eq $ViewTitle }); if ($vs.Count) { $viewId = [string]$vs[0].Id }
  }
  return @{ Id = $viewId; Made = $viewMade }
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  The part View (b): a view with a button that starts the button flow (customRowAction executeFlow with the ID of the
  flow "90161Z T21 Probe Button r6" from the button-flow-id block), read back from the view. Adds the ITEM line l2-view and
  the test VIEW.
#>
function Invoke-ViewPart {
  $lst = Get-ProbeListOrStop
  $lbase = "_api/web/lists(guid'" + $lst.Id + "')"
  $btnId = Get-ButtonFlowId
  if (-not $btnId) {
    Add-Item 'l2-view' 'FAIL' 'no button flow ID in the look module (its button-flow-id block is empty), so the view was not made'
    Add-Test 'VIEW' @('b a view formatted by script with a button that starts a flow=FAIL (flow ID known to the script=no; the build left no ID)') $false
    return
  }
  $view = Get-ButtonView $lbase
  $viewPass = $false; $vroute = 'none'; $vback = 'no'
  if (-not $view.Id) { Add-Item 'l2-view' 'FAIL' 'the view is not on the list after the create step' }
  else {
    $params = '{"id":"' + $btnId + '","headerText":"Run the test flow","runFlowButtonText":"Run"}'
    $fmt = [ordered]@{ '$schema' = 'https://developer.microsoft.com/json-schemas/sp/view-formatting.schema.json'
      rowFormatter = [ordered]@{ elmType = 'div'; style = [ordered]@{ display = 'flex'; 'align-items' = 'center'; padding = '4px' }
        children = @([ordered]@{ elmType = 'span'; style = [ordered]@{ flex = '1' }; txtContent = '[$Title]' },
          [ordered]@{ elmType = 'button'; txtContent = 'Run the test flow'; customRowAction = [ordered]@{ action = 'executeFlow'; actionParams = $params } }) } }
    Write-Now 'Setting the button on the view and reading it back'
    $vroute = Send-Formatter 'view' ($fmt | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 -Compress) ([string]$lst.Id) $view.Id
    try {
      $raw = Invoke-Rest 'Get' ($lbase + "/views(guid'" + $view.Id + "')?" + '$select=CustomFormatter') ''
      if ($raw.Contains('executeFlow') -and $raw.Contains($btnId)) { $vback = 'yes' }
    } catch { $vback = 'not read' }
    $viewPass = ($vback -eq 'yes')
    $why = $(if ($vroute -eq 'none') { '; ' + (Format-Detail $script:fmtError) } else { '' })
    Add-Item 'l2-view' $(if ($viewPass) { 'PASS' } else { 'FAIL' }) ('view made now=' + $view.Made + '; formatting set (route=' + $vroute + ') and read back from the view=' + $vback + $why)
  }
  $summary = 'b a view formatted by script with a button that starts a flow=' + $(if ($viewPass) { 'PASS' } else { 'FAIL' })
  Add-Test 'VIEW' @($summary + ' (route=' + $vroute + '; read back=' + $vback + '; flow ID known to the script=yes); whether the button runs is read by the Read part') $viewPass
}
'@ }

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Read, test HEALTH: the flow "90161Z T21 Probe Health r6" of the solution "90-161.Z flows" ran on the solution's
  SharePoint connection: it writes one RESULT row after the newest command row (r7: it no longer lists flows, because the
  Power Automate Management connector is not in the solution).
.PARAMETER Rows
  The probe list rows (from Get-ListRow).
.PARAMETER HealthFloor
  The Id of the newest RUN-HEALTH command row (0 when there is none).
#>
function Add-HealthTest($Rows, [int]$HealthFloor) {
  $name = 'a health flow on the SharePoint connection of the solution='
  $h = $null
  if ($HealthFloor -gt 0) { $h = Find-Result @($Rows | Where-Object { $_.Id -gt $HealthFloor }) 'HEALTH' 'a' }
  # R11 (R38; PFM 20 Nov 26: rounds drop steps that passed): no command row means this round did not start the health
  # flow, so one NOT RUN line, no RESULT line, not counted (HEALTH passed in R36 and R37).
  if (-not $HealthFloor) { $script:lines.Add('HEALTH NOT RUN: this round did not start the health flow (HEALTH passed in R36 and R37)'); return }
  if (-not $h) {
    $why = 'no result row after the wait: the flow did not run; check that "90161Z T21 Probe Health r6" reads On in the solution "90-161.Z flows"'
    Add-Test 'HEALTH' @($name + 'FAIL (' + $why + ')') $false
  } else {
    $d = Format-Detail $h.ProbeDetail
    Add-Test 'HEALTH' @($name + $h.ProbeResult + $(if ($d) { ' (' + $d + ')' } else { '' })) ($h.ProbeResult -eq 'PASS')
  }
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Read, test T4: a person who is a Visitors member writes a row through the list form (list-level Contribute on this list only; the site stays Read).
  Rows by anyone but you count; RESULT rows do not. With no state file and no row by another person the round had no
  second person (R30a: T4 passed in R29a): one NOT RUN line, no RESULT line, not counted.
.PARAMETER Rows
  The probe list rows (from Get-ListRow).
.PARAMETER MeId
  Your own site user number (0 when it cannot be read).
#>
function Add-T4Test($Rows, [int]$MeId) {
  $others = @($Rows | Where-Object { $_.Title -ne 'RESULT' -and $MeId -gt 0 -and (Get-AuthorId $_) -gt 0 -and (Get-AuthorId $_) -ne $MeId })
  $t4a = @($Rows | Where-Object { ([string]$_.Title).Trim() -eq 'T4a' -and $MeId -gt 0 -and (Get-AuthorId $_) -gt 0 -and (Get-AuthorId $_) -ne $MeId })
  $st = Read-State $script:dir
  if (-not $st -and $others.Count -eq 0) { $script:lines.Add('T4 NOT RUN: no second person in this round (T4 passed in R29a)'); return }
  # R35 (19 Nov 26): a second person was added for EDITALL only, and no step asked for a new row, so T4 read FAIL. T4 counts only
  # when the round asked (T4Asked=yes in the state file) or a row by another person is there.
  if ($others.Count -eq 0 -and -not ($st -and $st['T4Asked'] -eq 'yes')) { $script:lines.Add('T4 NOT RUN: this round did not ask the second person to add a row (T4 passed in R29a)'); return }
  $addedText = $(if (-not $st) { 'not tried (no state file)' } elseif ($st['WasMember'] -eq 'yes') { 'already a member' } else { 'yes' })
  $t4pass = ($others.Count -ge 1)
  $counts = '(rows=' + $others.Count + '; T4a rows=' + $t4a.Count + '; person in the Visitors group=' + $addedText + ')'
  $t4 = @('a list form by a second person (Visitors member)=' + $(if ($t4pass) { 'PASS' } else { 'FAIL' }) + ' ' + $counts)
  if (-not $t4pass) {
    $t4 += ('next: the second person opens the new row form link and saves one row; a form that says no permission means the Visitors group' +
      ' does not hold Contribute on this list (the Make part gives it; for the app lists, run T20 r4 and read ITEM W01 to W03)') }
  Add-Test 'T4' $t4 $t4pass
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Read, test EDITALL (F2 B, PFM 19 Nov 26): the second person, as a PFM Office member, saved the EDITALL row that you wrote
  on the probe list, which is set to "edit own rows". With no office state file and no EDITALL row the round had no
  Office part: one NOT RUN line, no RESULT line, not counted.
.PARAMETER Rows
  The probe list rows (from Get-ListRow, with Author and Editor).
.PARAMETER MeId
  Your own site user number (0 when it cannot be read).
#>
function Add-EditAllTest($Rows, [int]$MeId) {
  $mine = @($Rows | Where-Object { ([string]$_.Title) -like 'EDITALL *' -and $MeId -gt 0 -and (Get-AuthorId $_) -eq $MeId })
  $st = Read-OfficeState; $ids = @(); if ($st) { $ids = @($st.UserIds) }   # the people the part Office added (module office)
  if (-not $ids.Count -and -not $mine.Count) { $script:lines.Add('EDITALL NOT RUN: no PFM Office test in this round'); return }
  $byOther = @($mine | Where-Object { $e = Get-EditorId $_; $e -gt 0 -and $e -ne $MeId -and (-not $ids.Count -or $ids -contains $e) })
  $pass = ($byOther.Count -ge 1)
  $counts = ' (EDITALL rows by you=' + $mine.Count + '; saved by the second person=' + $byOther.Count + ')'
  $piece = @('a PFM Office member who is not the author edits the row=' + $(if ($pass) { 'PASS' } else { 'FAIL' }) + $counts)
  if (-not $pass) { $piece += 'next: the second person opens the edit form link, changes the row and saves it; a form that will not save means the level did not give the right' }
  Add-Test 'EDITALL' $piece $pass
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  The part Read: waits for the health flow's row (only when there is a command row), then one test line each for
  HEALTH, T4, EDITALL and BUTTON (counts only).
#>
function Invoke-ReadPart {
  Write-Now 'Reading the rows of the probe list'
  $lst = Find-ByFolder $ListFolder
  if (-not $lst) { throw 'LIST not found: run -Part Make first.' }
  $rf = @('Title', 'ProbeTest', 'ProbeWay', 'ProbeResult', 'ProbeDetail', 'Author', 'Editor')
  $rows = @(Get-ListRow $ListTitle $rf)
  # The health flow answers a minute or more after its command row. Wait for it (default 4 minutes) only when there is one.
  $healthFloor = [int](@($rows | Where-Object { $_.Title -like 'RUN-HEALTH *' } | ForEach-Object { $_.Id }) + 0 | Measure-Object -Maximum).Maximum
  if ($healthFloor -gt 0) {
    Write-Now ('Waiting for the health flow''s result row (up to ' + $WaitMinutes + ' minutes)')
    $ok = Wait-Until {
      $rows = @(Get-ListRow $ListTitle $rf)
      [bool](Find-Result @($rows | Where-Object { $_.Id -gt $healthFloor }) 'HEALTH' 'a') } 'the health flow''s result row'
    $rows = @(Get-ListRow $ListTitle $rf)
    $script:lines.Add('WAIT health row ' + $(if ($ok) { 'there' } else { 'not there (time ran out)' }))
  } else { $script:lines.Add('WAIT none: no RUN-HEALTH row on the list') }
  $meId = 0
  try { $meId = [int]((Invoke-Rest 'Get' '_api/web/currentuser?$select=Id' '') | ConvertFrom-Json).Id } catch { $meId = 0 }
  Add-HealthTest $rows $healthFloor
  Add-T4Test $rows $meId
  Add-EditAllTest $rows $meId
  # BUTTON: the button flow "90161Z T21 Probe Button r6", started by the view button, wrote one row titled BTN-FLOW.
  $btn = @($rows | Where-Object { ([string]$_.Title).Trim() -like 'BTN-FLOW*' })
  # R11 (R38): with no BTN-FLOW row and no RUN-HEALTH row the round ran no flow step, so BUTTON did not run (one NOT RUN
  # line, not counted; BUTTON passed in R36 and R37). A round with flow steps still reports BUTTON FAIL when the row is missing.
  if (-not $btn.Count -and -not $healthFloor) { $script:lines.Add('BUTTON NOT RUN: this round ran no flow step (BUTTON passed in R36 and R37)') }
  else { Add-Test 'BUTTON' @('b a view button starts a flow=' + $(if ($btn.Count) { 'PASS' } else { 'FAIL' }) + ' (rows titled BTN-FLOW=' + $btn.Count + ')') ($btn.Count -ge 1) }
  $script:lines.Add('NOTE FORM and VIEW: what the screen showed is left to the answers you give in the RADE window (this script does not read them)')
}
'@ }

<#

# SharePoint permission bits (SP.BasePermissions, low word): EditListItems 0x4; CancelCheckout 0x100 ("Override List Behaviors").
$EditItemsBit = 0x4
$OverrideBit = 0x100

# True when a permission answer ({High, Low}) holds Edit Items and Override List Behaviors: the right to edit every row.
function Test-EditAll($Bits) { $low = [long]$Bits.Low; return (($low -band $EditItemsBit) -ne 0 -and ($low -band $OverrideBit) -ne 0) }

# Finds a site group by its name (one request for that group, its name encoded); returns its Id, or 0 when it is missing.
function Get-GroupIdByName([string]$Name) {
  try { return [int]((Invoke-Rest 'Get' ("_api/web/sitegroups/getbyname('" + [uri]::EscapeDataString($Name) + "')?" + '$select=Id') '') | ConvertFrom-Json).Id }
  catch { return 0 }
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Office, steps o1 to o3: finds the group and the level (made by T20 r2), sets "edit own rows" on the probe list and gives
  the group the level on that list. Each change is made only when it is missing and is read back.
.PARAMETER List
  The probe list (from Find-ByFolder).
.OUTPUTS
  System.Int32. The Id of the group PFM Office, or 0 when the group or the level is missing (the part stops there).
#>
function Grant-OfficeOnProbe($List) {
  $gid = Get-GroupIdByName $OfficeGroup
  if (-not $gid) { Add-Item 'o1-group' 'FAIL' ('the site has no group ' + $OfficeGroup + ': run T20 r2 first'); return 0 }
  $level = @(Get-RestValue ('_api/web/roledefinitions?$select=Id,Name,BasePermissions&$top=500') | Where-Object { [string]$_.Name -eq $OfficeLevel })
  if (-not $level.Count -or -not (Test-EditAll $level[0].BasePermissions)) {
    Add-Item 'o1-group' 'FAIL' ('the level ' + $OfficeLevel + ' is missing or lacks Override List Behaviors: run T20 r2 first'); return 0
  }
  Add-Item 'o1-group' 'PASS' ('the group ' + $OfficeGroup + ' and the level ' + $OfficeLevel + ' (Edit plus Override List Behaviors) are on the site')
  $lbase = "_api/web/lists(guid'" + $List.Id + "')"
  Write-Now 'Setting "edit own rows" on the probe list'
  $ctx = Get-PnPContext; $l = $ctx.Web.Lists.GetById([guid]$List.Id); $l.WriteSecurity = 2; $l.Update(); $ctx.ExecuteQuery()
  $ws = [int]((Invoke-Rest 'Get' ($lbase + '?$select=WriteSecurity') '') | ConvertFrom-Json).WriteSecurity
  Add-Item 'o2-edit-own' $(if ($ws -eq 2) { 'PASS' } else { 'FAIL' }) ('the probe list lets a person edit only own rows=' + $(if ($ws -eq 2) { 'yes' } else { 'no' }))
  $has = $false
  $bindings = $lbase + '/roleassignments/getbyprincipalid(' + $gid + ')/roledefinitionbindings?$select=Id'
  try { $has = @(Get-RestValue $bindings | Where-Object { [int]$_.Id -eq [int]$level[0].Id }).Count -gt 0 } catch { $has = $false }
  if (-not $has) {
    Write-Now ('Giving the level ' + $OfficeLevel + ' to the group on the probe list')
    $null = Invoke-Rest 'Post' ($lbase + '/roleassignments/addroleassignment(principalid=' + $gid + ',roledefid=' + [int]$level[0].Id + ')') '{}'
  }
  Add-Item 'o3-level' 'PASS' ('the group holds the level on the probe list (given now=' + $(if ($has) { 'no' } else { 'yes' }) + ')')
  return $gid
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Office, step o4: one row titled EDITALL that you write (so you are its author); a row from an earlier run is used again.
.OUTPUTS
  System.Int32. The row's Id.
#>
function Add-OfficeRow {
  $rows = @(Get-ListRow $ListTitle @('Title', 'Author') | Where-Object { ([string]$_.Title) -like 'EDITALL *' } | Sort-Object { $_.Id } -Descending)
  if ($rows.Count) { $id = [int]$rows[0].Id; $made = 'no' }
  else {
    Write-Now 'Adding the row the second person edits'
    $tag = 'R35' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N').Substring(0, 8)
    $id = [int](Add-PnPListItem -List $ListTitle -Values @{ Title = ('EDITALL ' + $tag); ProbeTest = 'EDITALL' } -ErrorAction Stop).Id
    $made = 'yes'
  }
  Add-Item 'o4-row' 'PASS' ('the row titled EDITALL is on the probe list, you are its author (made now=' + $made + ')')
  return $id
}

# The office state file: GroupId=<n> and UserIds=<n>,<n> (each person this part added to PFM Office that Clean has not
# removed yet). Returns @{ GroupId; UserIds } or $null when there is no file. Numbers only, never an address or a name.
function Read-OfficeState {
  $f = Join-Path $script:dir $OfficeStateName
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f -PathType Leaf)) { return $null }
  $h = @{ GroupId = 0; UserIds = @() }
  foreach ($l in @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $f)) {
    if ([string]$l -match '^GroupId=(\d+)$') { $h.GroupId = [int]$Matches[1] }
    if ([string]$l -match '^UserIds=([\d,]*)$') { $h.UserIds = @($Matches[1] -split ',' | Where-Object { $_ } | ForEach-Object { [int]$_ }) }
  }
  return $h
}
# Writes the office state file (the group Id and the user Ids still to remove); deletes it when no Id is left.
function Write-OfficeState([int]$GroupId, [int[]]$UserIds) {
  $f = Join-Path $script:dir $OfficeStateName
  if (-not @($UserIds).Count) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $f -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; return }
  Set-Content -LiteralPath $f -Value @(('GroupId=' + $GroupId), ('UserIds=' + (@($UserIds) -join ','))) -Encoding ASCII
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Office, step o5: puts the second person of the part Person into the group PFM Office and reads back that the person
  can now edit every row of the probe list. A person who could do that before is not used: the test would prove nothing.
  The person's Id is added to the office state file before the change, so Clean can remove the person even if this
  stops. Every person this part adds is recorded: a person from an earlier run that Clean has not removed yet stays on
  file next to the new one, and Clean removes both (review of 19 Nov 26). A person who was a member before is not recorded.
.PARAMETER GroupId
  The Id of the group PFM Office.
.PARAMETER List
  The probe list (from Find-ByFolder).
.OUTPUTS
  System.String. The status text for the OFFICE line (no identity).
#>
function Add-OfficeMember([int]$GroupId, $List) {
  $person = Read-State $script:dir
  if (-not $person) { Add-Item 'o5-person' 'FAIL' 'no second person on file: run the part Person first'; return 'no second person on file' }
  $uid = [int]$person['UserId']
  $loginName = ''
  $raw = Invoke-Rest 'Get' ('_api/web/getuserbyid(' + $uid + ')?$select=LoginName') ''
  if ($raw -match '"LoginName"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"') { $loginName = $Matches[1] }
  $permUri = "_api/web/lists(guid'" + $List.Id + "')/getusereffectivepermissions(@u)?@u='" + [uri]::EscapeDataString($loginName) + "'"
  $was = (Get-GroupMemberId $GroupId) -contains $uid
  if (-not $was -and (Test-EditAll ((Invoke-Rest 'Get' $permUri '') | ConvertFrom-Json))) {
    $loginName = $null
    Add-Item 'o5-person' 'FAIL' 'the second person can edit every row already, without PFM Office: use a person who is only a Visitor'
    return 'the person can edit every row already'
  }
  $st = Read-OfficeState
  $ids = @(); if ($st) { $ids = @($st.UserIds) }
  if (@($ids | Where-Object { $_ -ne $uid }).Count) { $script:lines.Add('NOTE o5: a person from an earlier run is still on file for PFM Office; Clean removes both') }
  if (-not $was -and $ids -notcontains $uid) { $ids += $uid }
  $mine = $ids -contains $uid
  if ($ids.Count) { Write-OfficeState $GroupId $ids }
  if (-not $was) {
    Write-Now ('Adding the second person to the group ' + $OfficeGroup)
    try { $null = Add-PnPGroupMember -LoginName $loginName -Group $GroupId -ErrorAction Stop } catch { $null = $_ }
  }
  $in = (Get-GroupMemberId $GroupId) -contains $uid
  $can = $in -and (Test-EditAll ((Invoke-Rest 'Get' $permUri '') | ConvertFrom-Json))
  $loginName = $null
  $text = 'person in PFM Office=' + $(if ($in) { 'yes' } else { 'no' }) + '; can edit every row of the probe list now=' + $(if ($can) { 'yes' } else { 'no' })
  Add-Item 'o5-person' $(if ($can) { 'PASS' } else { 'FAIL' }) $text
  return $(if (-not $mine) { 'already a member (Clean leaves the person in the group)' } elseif ($in) { 'added and listed in the group' } else { 'the add was refused' })
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  The part Office (F2 B, PFM 19 Nov 26): the group PFM Office gets the level on the probe list, you write one EDITALL row,
  the second person joins the group, and the row's edit form link goes on the clipboard for that person. Read checks that
  the person saved the row (test EDITALL); Clean removes the person from the group.
#>
function Invoke-OfficePart {
  Write-Now 'Looking for the probe list, the group PFM Office and its level'
  $lst = Find-ByFolder $ListFolder
  if (-not $lst) { throw 'LIST not found: run -Part Make first.' }
  $status = 'the group or the level is missing'
  $rowId = 0
  $gid = Grant-OfficeOnProbe $lst
  if ($gid) {
    $rowId = Add-OfficeRow
    $status = Add-OfficeMember $gid $lst
  }
  $script:lines.Add('OFFICE second person in ' + $OfficeGroup + ': ' + $(if ($status -like 'added*' -or $status -like 'already*') { 'yes' } else { 'no' }) + '; status: ' + $status)
  $clip = 'no'
  if ($NoLaunch) { $clip = 'no (test run)' } elseif ($rowId) {
    try { Set-Clipboard -Value ($script:site.TrimEnd('/') + '/Lists/' + $ListFolder + '/EditForm.aspx?ID=' + $rowId); $clip = 'yes' } catch { $clip = 'no' }
  }
  $script:lines.Add('ITEM o6-link INFO the link of the edit form of the EDITALL row is on the clipboard=' + $clip)
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Clean, step c1b: removes every person on the office state file from the group PFM Office again, then deletes the file
  (it keeps the Ids that are still in the group). A failure is its own FAIL line and never stops the later Clean steps.
  R35 (W8): with -Label first (the check before the test) a recorded person who is still in PFM Office is a leftover of an
  earlier test: it is a FAIL line that says what to do, and nobody is removed (the Clean at the end, -Label last, removes
  the person). The group PFM Office and its level stay: they are app setup (T20), not leftovers.
.OUTPUTS
  None.
#>
function Clear-OfficeMember {
  $st = Read-OfficeState
  if (-not $st -or -not @($st.UserIds).Count) { Add-Item 'c1b-office' 'INFO' 'no PFM Office test on file (nothing to remove)'; Write-OfficeState 0 @(); return }
  try {
    $members = Get-GroupMemberId $st.GroupId
    if ($Label -eq 'first') {
      $left = @($st.UserIds | Where-Object { $members -contains $_ })
      if ($left.Count) {
        $todo = 'What to do: go on to the last Clean step of this round, which removes them, or remove them from the group ' + $OfficeGroup + ' by hand and run this step again'
        Add-Item 'c1b-office' 'FAIL' ('leftover: ' + $left.Count + ' test person(s) from an earlier test still in the group ' + $OfficeGroup + ' (state file kept). ' + $todo)
      } else {
        Write-OfficeState $st.GroupId @()
        Add-Item 'c1b-office' 'PASS' ('no test person is left in ' + $OfficeGroup + ' (state file deleted)')
      }
      return
