$lines = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
$script:passed = 0; $script:failed = 0
# Adds one "ITEM <name> <status> <text>" line and counts a PASS or a FAIL.
function Add-Item([string]$Name, [string]$Status, [string]$Text) {
  $lines.Add('ITEM ' + $Name + ' ' + $Status + ' ' + $Text)
  if ($Status -eq 'PASS') { $script:passed++ } elseif ($Status -eq 'FAIL') { $script:failed++ }
}
# The state file as a hashtable (key=value lines); empty when the file is missing.
function Read-State([string]$Path) {
  $h = @{}
  if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path -PathType Leaf) {
    foreach ($l in (Get-Content -LiteralPath $Path)) { $i = ([string]$l).IndexOf('='); if ($i -gt 0) { $h[([string]$l).Substring(0, $i)] = ([string]$l).Substring($i + 1) } } }
  return $h
}
# Writes the state hashtable to the state file as sorted key=value lines (row numbers and flags only).
function Save-State([string]$Path, $State) { Set-Content -LiteralPath $Path -Value @($State.Keys | Sort-Object | ForEach-Object { $_ + '=' + $State[$_] }) -Encoding ASCII }
# The answer value of a row in ASCII (an unknown value is "other", so no free text from the site reaches a line).
function Get-AnswerText($V) {
  $t = ([string]$V).Replace([string][char]0x2014, '-').Trim()
  if ($Answers -contains $t) { return $t }
  return 'other'
}
# The site user number of the author of a row, or 0 when the row has none.
function Get-AuthorId($Row) { $a = $Row['Author']; if ($a -and $a.LookupId) { return [int]$a.LookupId }; return 0 }
# The rows of list $List whose lookup column $Field points at row $Id (all rows read, then filtered here).
function Get-RowsFor([string]$List, [string]$Field, [int]$Id) {
  return @(Get-PnPListItem -List $List -PageSize 500 -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { $v = $_[$Field]; $v -and [int]$v.LookupId -eq $Id })
}
# The fake publication rows (exact title), oldest first.
function Find-FakePub {
  $all = @(Get-PnPListItem -List 'PFM Publications' -Fields 'Title' -PageSize 500 -ErrorAction Stop)
  return @($all | Where-Object { ([string]$_['Title']) -eq $PubTitle } | Sort-Object { $_.Id })
}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Loads PnP.PowerShell and signs in to the one site with the web login (CAC), or (R47, a T30 batch) reuses the sign-in of
  this process to the same site. Adds the line ROUTE web-login PASS (and SIGNIN reused when it reuses).
.OUTPUTS
  None.
#>
function Connect-EndorseSite {
  $mod = @(Get-Module -ListAvailable -Name PnP.PowerShell | Sort-Object Version -Descending)
  if (-not $mod.Count) { throw 'PNP not installed: PnP.PowerShell is not on this computer.' }
  $null = & { Import-Module PnP.PowerShell -RequiredVersion $mod[0].Version -DisableNameChecking } *>&1
  # R47 (R46 finding 1): no DPI call here any more (RADE engine-v47 turns the DPI sign-in off).
  # R47 (fewer CAC sign-ins): in a T30 batch an earlier part of this process signed in to this site; that sign-in is used
  # again (Get-PnPConnection), with no second sign-in window. Outside a batch no connection is there, so it signs in.
  $now = $null; try { $now = Get-PnPConnection -ErrorAction Stop } catch { $now = $null }   # no connection: sign in below
  if ($now -and ([string]$now.Url).TrimEnd('/') -eq ([string]$script:site).TrimEnd('/')) { $lines.Add('SIGNIN reused: this process is signed in to the site already') }
  else {
    Write-Host 'NOW Signing in to the site (if a sign-in window opens, sign in with your CAC)'
    $null = & { Connect-PnPOnline -Url $script:site -UseWebLogin -ErrorAction Stop } *>&1
  }
  $lines.Add('ROUTE web-login PASS')
}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
  The columns of the fake publication (PFM 25 Nov 26): the step-1 columns, and the 4 that the exit of step 1 needs (OPR, Applies to
  Level, Publication Type, the master DAF Form 673 link), so the T27 part Step can move it to step 2.
.DESCRIPTION
  The two choices are choices of schemas/lists/PFMPublications.json (tests/ps/Test-T26.ps1 checks that). The link is an address on
  the reserved domain example.test, a comma, and a description that holds the fake-data marker (the form PnP.PowerShell takes).
.PARAMETER StepId
  The row number of the process step with step number 1.
.PARAMETER OfficeId
  The row number of the PFM Offices row used as OPR.
.OUTPUTS
  System.Collections.Hashtable. The values for Add-PnPListItem.
#>
function Get-FakePubValue([int]$StepId, [int]$OfficeId) {
  return @{ Title = $PubTitle; ActionType = 'New'; ProductType = 'Publication'; ProcessStep = $StepId; ActionStatus = 'On Track'
    OPR = $OfficeId; AppliesToLevel = 'Wing and Units Below'; PublicationType = 'Instruction'
    MasterForm673Link = 'https://example.test/90161Z-TEST-673, 90161Z TEST R43 form 673 (delete me)' }
}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
  The part Make: the fake publication (found or made once) and, on the clipboard, the new row form link and the steps
  for the second person.
#>
function Invoke-MakePart {
  $st = Read-State $script:stateFile
  Write-Host 'NOW Looking for the fake publication'
  $pub = @(Find-FakePub)
  if ($pub.Count) { $pubId = [int]$pub[0].Id; Add-Item 'm1-publication' 'PASS' 'the fake publication is there (made by an earlier run; it is used again)' }
  else {
    $step = @(Get-PnPListItem -List 'PFM Process Steps' -Fields 'Title', 'StepNumber' -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { [int]$_['StepNumber'] -eq 1 })
    if (-not $step.Count) { throw 'STEP not found: PFM Process Steps has no row with step number 1 (run T20 first).' }
    # The OPR is a lookup to PFM Offices: the first seeded office row (lowest row number) is used; no row is made there.
    # This is the worker's pick for the PFM's fake-value decision of 25 Nov 26; it is a seed row, with no fake-data marker.
    $office = @(Get-PnPListItem -List 'PFM Offices' -Fields 'Title' -PageSize 500 -ErrorAction Stop | Sort-Object { $_.Id })
    if (-not $office.Count) { throw 'OFFICE not found: PFM Offices has no row (run T20 first).' }
    Write-Host 'NOW Making the fake publication'
    $pubId = [int](Add-PnPListItem -List 'PFM Publications' -Values (Get-FakePubValue $step[0].Id $office[0].Id) -ErrorAction Stop).Id
    $st['Made'] = 'yes'; Add-Item 'm1-publication' 'PASS' 'the fake publication was made (step 1, On Track, with OPR, level, publication type and 673 link)' }
  $st['PubId'] = [string]$pubId; if (-not $st['Made']) { $st['Made'] = 'no' }
  Save-State $script:stateFile $st   # saved before the edit row: if that write fails, Clean still finds the publication it made
  $editId = Add-EditRow $pubId; $st['EditId'] = [string]$editId
  Save-State $script:stateFile $st
  $list = $script:site.TrimEnd('/') + '/Lists/' + $EndorseFolder
  $steps = @(($list + '/NewForm.aspx'), '1. Open the link above.', ('2. In Title, type: ' + $AnswerTitle), ('3. In Publication, pick: ' + $PubTitle),
    '4. In Endorsement Status, pick your answer, for example Concur.', '5. Select Save, then tell me if it saved.',
    ($list + '/EditForm.aspx?ID=' + $editId), '6. Open this second link.', '7. In Endorsement Status, pick your answer, for example Concur.',
    '8. Select Save, then tell me if it saved or said that you have no permission.')
  $clip = 'no'
  if ($script:noLaunch) { $clip = 'no (test run)' } else { try { Set-Clipboard -Value $steps; $clip = 'yes' } catch { $clip = 'no' } }
  $lines.Add('ITEM m3-link INFO the 2 form links of PFM Endorsements (new row, edit your row) and the 8 steps for the second person are on the clipboard=' + $clip)
}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Make, step m2 (PFM 20 Nov 26): the fake endorsement row that you make on the fake publication ("Not Started"), which the
  second person then tries to edit in its edit form. A row with that title on the publication is used again.
.PARAMETER PubId
  The row number of the fake publication.
.OUTPUTS
  System.Int32. The row number of the endorsement row.
#>
function Add-EditRow([int]$PubId) {
  $have = @(Get-RowsFor 'PFM Endorsements' 'Publication' $PubId | Where-Object { ([string]$_['Title']) -eq $EditTitle } | Sort-Object { $_.Id })
  if ($have.Count) { Add-Item 'm2-edit-row' 'PASS' 'the fake endorsement row to edit is there (made by an earlier run)'; return [int]$have[0].Id }
  Write-Host 'NOW Making the fake endorsement row that the second person tries to edit'
  $id = [int](Add-PnPListItem -List 'PFM Endorsements' -Values @{ Title = $EditTitle; Publication = $PubId; CoordinationStage = 'Formal Coordination'
      EndorsementStatus = 'Not Started' } -ErrorAction Stop).Id
  Add-Item 'm2-edit-row' 'PASS' 'the fake endorsement row to edit was made (Not Started, you are its author)'
  return $id
}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
  The part Read (reads only): the rows of PFM Endorsements on the fake publication that another person saved; one
  RESULT line with the answer on the newest one and the row count.
#>
function Invoke-ReadPart {
  $st = Read-State $script:stateFile
  Write-Host 'NOW Looking for the fake publication'
  $pubId = $(if ($st['PubId'] -match '^\d+$') { [int]$st['PubId'] } else { $p = @(Find-FakePub); if ($p.Count) { [int]$p[0].Id } else { 0 } })
  if (-not $pubId) { Add-Item 'r1-publication' 'FAIL' 'no fake publication: run the part Make first'; $lines.Add('RESULT ENDORSE FAIL'); return }
  $meId = 0
  try { $meId = [int]((Invoke-PnPSPRestMethod -Method Get -Url ($script:site.TrimEnd('/') + '/_api/web/currentuser?$select=Id') -Raw -ErrorAction Stop) | ConvertFrom-Json).Id } catch { $meId = 0 }
  Write-Host 'NOW Reading the answers on PFM Endorsements'
  $rows = @(Get-RowsFor 'PFM Endorsements' 'Publication' $pubId)
  $other = @($rows | Where-Object { $meId -gt 0 -and (Get-AuthorId $_) -gt 0 -and (Get-AuthorId $_) -ne $meId -and ([string]$_['Title']) -ne $EditTitle } |
      Sort-Object { $_.Id } -Descending)
  $answered = @($other | Where-Object { (Get-AnswerText $_['EndorsementStatus']) -ne 'Not Started' })
  $marked = @($other | Where-Object { ([string]$_['Title']).StartsWith('90161Z TEST') }).Count
  $answer = $(if ($answered.Count) { Get-AnswerText $answered[0]['EndorsementStatus'] } else { 'none' })
  $pass = ($answered.Count -ge 1)
  $lines.Add('ENDORSE rows on the fake publication=' + $rows.Count + '; by another person=' + $other.Count + '; with an answer=' + $answered.Count +
    '; with the fake-data title=' + $marked + $(if ($meId -le 0) { ' (your own user number could not be read)' } else { '' }))
  $lines.Add('RESULT ENDORSE ' + $(if ($pass) { 'PASS' } else { 'FAIL' }) + ' answer=' + $answer + ' rows=' + $answered.Count)
  if ($pass) { $script:passed++ } else {
    $script:failed++
    $lines.Add('next: the second person opens the new row form link, types the title, picks the fake publication and an answer, and selects Save;' +
      ' a form that says no permission means the Visitors group does not hold Contribute on PFM Endorsements (run T20 r4)') }
  Add-EditResult $rows $meId ([string]$st['EditId'])
}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Read, the edit (PFM 20 Nov 26): did the second person change the endorsement row that you made? PFM Endorsements is
  "edit own rows" (PFM 10A), so a refusal is the expected outcome: RESULT ENDORSE-EDIT REFUSED is recorded and is not
  counted as a failure (it holds neither PASS nor FAIL). A saved change by another person: RESULT ENDORSE-EDIT PASS
  answer=<choice>.
.PARAMETER Rows
  The endorsement rows of the fake publication.
.PARAMETER MeId
  Your own site user number (0 when it cannot be read).
.PARAMETER EditId
  The row number Make saved in the state file ('' when none).
#>
function Add-EditResult($Rows, [int]$MeId, [string]$EditId) {
  $row = @($Rows | Where-Object { ($EditId -match '^\d+$' -and [int]$_.Id -eq [int]$EditId) -or ([string]$_['Title']) -eq $EditTitle } | Sort-Object { $_.Id }) | Select-Object -First 1
  if (-not $row) { $lines.Add('ENDORSE-EDIT the row to edit is not on the site (run the part Make first)'); $lines.Add('RESULT ENDORSE-EDIT REFUSED (no row to edit)'); return }
  $ed = 0; $e = $row['Editor']; if ($e -and $e.LookupId) { $ed = [int]$e.LookupId }
  $ans = Get-AnswerText $row['EndorsementStatus']
  $changed = ($MeId -gt 0 -and $ed -gt 0 -and $ed -ne $MeId -and $ans -ne 'Not Started')
  $lines.Add('ENDORSE-EDIT the row you made: last saved by another person=' + $(if ($ed -gt 0 -and $MeId -gt 0 -and $ed -ne $MeId) { 'yes' } else { 'no' }) + '; answer=' + $ans)
  if ($changed) { $script:passed++; $lines.Add('RESULT ENDORSE-EDIT PASS answer=' + $ans) }
  else { $lines.Add('RESULT ENDORSE-EDIT REFUSED (expected under edit own rows: recorded; it does not count against the round)') }
}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
  The part Clean: recycles the endorsement and log rows of the fake publication, then the publication when Make made
  it, and deletes the state file. Each step runs even when one fails.
#>
function Invoke-CleanPart {
  $st = Read-State $script:stateFile
  $script:pauseBad = $false; Restore-PauseRow $st
  $pubId = $(if ($st['PubId'] -match '^\d+$') { [int]$st['PubId'] } else { 0 })
  if (-not $pubId) { Add-Item 'c1-rows' 'PASS' 'no fake publication on file (nothing to remove)'; return }
  $n = 0; $bad = 0
  foreach ($l in 'PFM Endorsements', 'PFM Activity Log') {
    try { foreach ($r in (Get-RowsFor $l 'Publication' $pubId)) { $null = Remove-PnPListItem -List $l -Identity $r.Id -Recycle -Force -ErrorAction Stop; $n++ } }
    catch { $bad++; $lines.Add('NOTE rows of ' + $l + ' not all removed: ' + ([string]$_.Exception.Message).Substring(0, [Math]::Min(120, ([string]$_.Exception.Message).Length))) } }
  Add-Item 'c1-rows' $(if ($bad) { 'FAIL' } else { 'PASS' }) ('rows moved to the site Recycle Bin=' + $n + $(if ($bad) { ' (run Clean again)' } else { '' }))
  if ($st['Made'] -eq 'yes') {
    try { $null = Remove-PnPListItem -List 'PFM Publications' -Identity $pubId -Recycle -Force -ErrorAction Stop
      Add-Item 'c2-publication' 'PASS' 'the fake publication moved to the site Recycle Bin' }
    catch { $bad++; Add-Item 'c2-publication' 'FAIL' 'the fake publication could not be removed (run Clean again)' } }
  else { Add-Item 'c2-publication' 'PASS' 'the fake publication was not made by this task, so it stays' }
  if (-not $bad -and -not $script:pauseBad) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $script:stateFile -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Clean, the pause-switch row (the PFM, 21 Nov 26): back to its value from before the round, only when it differs.
.DESCRIPTION
  The value before the round is the word the first Rows run saved (PauseBefore). Yes, No and empty are written back as
  they were; a row that was missing or held other text gets the off value (No). With no Rows on file nothing is
  done. Logs RESULT PAUSEROW PASS value=<word>, or FAIL (then the state file stays, so Clean can run again).
.PARAMETER State
  The state hashtable of this task.
#>
function Restore-PauseRow($State) {
  $want = [string]$State['PauseBefore']
  if (-not $want) { return }   # Rows did not run: the round did not touch the row
  if ($want -notin 'Yes', 'No', 'empty') { $want = Get-ValueWord $Pause.Off }   # missing or other text: the off value, never a read-back
  $value = $(if ($want -eq 'empty') { '' } else { $want })
  try {
    $rows = @(Get-PauseRow)
    if ($rows.Count -ne 1) { $script:pauseBad = $true; Add-Result 'PAUSEROW' $false ('rows named ' + $Pause.Title + '=' + $rows.Count + ': set it by hand'); return }
    if (([string]$rows[0][$Pause.Field]).Trim() -cne $value) { $null = Set-PnPListItem -List $Pause.List -Identity $rows[0].Id -Values @{ $Pause.Field = $value } -ErrorAction Stop }
    $now = Get-ValueWord (@(Get-PauseRow))[0][$Pause.Field]
    if ($now -ne $want) { $script:pauseBad = $true }
    Add-Result 'PAUSEROW' ($now -eq $want) ('value=' + $now)
  } catch { $script:pauseBad = $true; Add-Result 'PAUSEROW' $false 'the pause-switch row could not be set back (run Clean again)' }
}

$fatal = $false; $site = ''; $secret = @(); $dir = ''
try {
  $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
  # The Restore test parts are dot-sourced here, in this script's scope, so they see the values and helpers above.
  $restoreFile = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '90161Z-T26-restore-r4.ps1'
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $restoreFile -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'MODULE missing: 90161Z-T26-restore-r4.ps1 is not in the folder of this script. Run the round again.' }

  if (-not $Part) { throw 'PART not given: use -Part Make, Read, Clean, Rows, Change or Check.' }

  Set-Location -LiteralPath $dir
  $script:stateFile = Join-Path $dir $StateName
  $script:site = Get-SiteAddress (Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $dir) 'Config')
  $lines.Add('TASK T26 endorse ' + $Rev + ', part ' + $Part + ', ' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'))
  Connect-EndorseSite
  switch ($Part) { 'Make' { Invoke-MakePart } 'Read' { Invoke-ReadPart } 'Clean' { Invoke-CleanPart } 'Rows' { Invoke-RowsPart } 'Change' { Invoke-ChangePart }
    default { Invoke-CheckPart (Split-Path -Parent $dir) } }
  # R47: a T30 batch sets KANON_KEEP_SIGNIN=1, so the next part of the batch uses this sign-in again; the batch signs out at its end.
  if ($env:KANON_KEEP_SIGNIN -ne '1') { try { $null = & { Disconnect-PnPOnline -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } *>&1 } catch { $null = $_ } }
} catch {

  $m = ConvertTo-Masked (Hide-Site ([string]$_) $site) $secret
  $lines.Add('STOPPED: ' + $m.Substring(0, [Math]::Min(300, $m.Length)) + ' (the part can be run again)')
} finally {

  $masked = @($lines | ForEach-Object { ConvertTo-Masked (Hide-Site $_ $site) $secret })
  $resultName = $(if ($Part) { '90161Z-T26-endorse-' + $Part.ToLowerInvariant() + $(if ($Label) { '-' + $Label } else { '' }) + '-' + $Rev + '.txt' } else { '' })
  if ($dir -and $resultName) { try { Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir $resultName) -Value $masked -Encoding UTF8 } catch { $null = $_ } }
  $masked | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_ }
  if (-not $NoPause -and -not $env:RADE_CONTRACT) { [void](Read-Host 'Press Enter to close') }
}
if ($fatal) { exit 1 }

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  90-161.Z Task 26 r3, module "restore": the parts Rows, Change and Check of the RADE Restore test (R41). Moved here from
  90161Z-T26-endorse-r4.ps1 (code standard file size cap, C4); the code is unchanged.
.DESCRIPTION
  Loaded by 90161Z-T26-endorse-r4.ps1 (dot-sourced from the same folder, in its scope); it does nothing when it is run alone.
  Inputs: the values and helpers of the main file ($lines, $Pause, $script:stateFile, Add-Item,
  Read-State, Save-State, Get-RowsFor, Find-FakePub). Outputs: RESULT lines in $lines; the part functions Invoke-RowsPart,
  Invoke-ChangePart and Invoke-CheckPart.
  Network: the one SharePoint site of the main file, through the PnP.PowerShell connection of the main file.

  Credentials: none of its own (the main file signs in).

# The Restore test (R41): the fake rows on the fake publication (moved here with the parts that use them).
$BinTitle = '90161Z TEST R41 restore {0} (delete me)'   # the 3 endorsement rows that go to the Recycle Bin ({0} = 1 to 3)
$LogTitle = '90161Z TEST R41 restore log (delete me)'   # the log row that is deleted for good
$NewTitle = '90161Z TEST R41 restore new (delete me)'   # the row made after the backup: Restore must leave it
# ---- The RADE Restore test (R41): the parts Rows, Change and Check ----
# Adds one "RESULT <name> PASS|FAIL <text>" line and counts it.
function Add-Result([string]$Name, [bool]$Ok, [string]$Text) {
  $lines.Add('RESULT ' + $Name + ' ' + $(if ($Ok) { 'PASS' } else { 'FAIL' }) + $(if ($Text) { ' ' + $Text } else { '' }))
  if ($Ok) { $script:passed++ } else { $script:failed++ }
}
# A value of the pause-switch row as a word for a result line: Yes, No, empty or other (no free text from the site).
function Get-ValueWord($V) { $t = ([string]$V).Trim(); if ($t -in 'Yes', 'No') { return $t }; if (-not $t) { return 'empty' }; return 'other' }
# The rows of PFM Settings whose title is the pause-switch row.
function Get-PauseRow {
  return @(Get-PnPListItem -List $Pause.List -Fields 'Title', $Pause.Field -PageSize 500 -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { ([string]$_['Title']).Trim() -eq $Pause.Title })
}
# The rows of list $List with title $Title on the fake publication $PubId, oldest first.
function Get-TitledRow([string]$List, [string]$Title, [int]$PubId) { return @(Get-RowsFor $List 'Publication' $PubId | Where-Object { ([string]$_['Title']) -eq $Title } | Sort-Object { $_.Id }) }
<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Rows, the pause-switch row: there once, with the off value; then read back (RESULT PAUSEROW).
.DESCRIPTION
  A missing row is made with the off value; a row with another value is set to it; two or more rows with that title
  are a FAIL (RADE reads one row) and are not changed. The value before goes into the state file as a word.
.PARAMETER State
  The state hashtable (gets PauseBefore and PauseAfter).
#>
function Initialize-PauseRow($State) {
  $rows = @(Get-PauseRow)
  if ($rows.Count -gt 1) { Add-Result 'PAUSEROW' $false ('rows named ' + $Pause.Title + '=' + $rows.Count + ': keep one, delete the others, then run again'); return }
  if (-not $rows.Count) {
    Write-Host 'NOW Making the pause-switch row in PFM Settings'
    $null = Add-PnPListItem -List $Pause.List -Values @{ Title = $Pause.Title; $Pause.Field = $Pause.Off } -ErrorAction Stop; $did = 'made'
    if (-not $State['PauseBefore']) { $State['PauseBefore'] = 'missing' } }
  else {
    # Only the first Rows run of a round saves the value before it: a rerun would save the round's own off value (review MAJOR)
    if (-not $State['PauseBefore']) { $State['PauseBefore'] = Get-ValueWord $rows[0][$Pause.Field] }
    if (([string]$rows[0][$Pause.Field]).Trim() -ceq $Pause.Off) { $did = 'kept' }
    else { $null = Set-PnPListItem -List $Pause.List -Identity $rows[0].Id -Values @{ $Pause.Field = $Pause.Off } -ErrorAction Stop; $did = 'set' } }
  $now = @(Get-PauseRow); $val = $(if ($now.Count -eq 1) { ([string]$now[0][$Pause.Field]).Trim() } else { '' })
  $State['PauseAfter'] = Get-ValueWord $val
  $text = 'row=' + $did + ' before=' + $State['PauseBefore'] + ' now=' + $State['PauseAfter'] + ' (RADE turns it to ' + $Pause.On + ' while Restore writes)'
  Add-Result 'PAUSEROW' ($now.Count -eq 1 -and $val -ceq $Pause.Off) $text
}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
  The part Rows: the pause-switch row, then the 3 endorsement rows and the log row on the fake publication.
.DESCRIPTION
  A row with the same title on the fake publication is used again, so a second run makes no second row. The row
  numbers go into the state file for the parts Change and Check.
#>
function Invoke-RowsPart {
  $st = Read-State $script:stateFile
  Initialize-PauseRow $st; Save-State $script:stateFile $st
  Write-Host 'NOW Looking for the fake publication'
  $pubId = $(if ($st['PubId'] -match '^\d+$') { [int]$st['PubId'] } else { $p = @(Find-FakePub); if ($p.Count) { [int]$p[0].Id } else { 0 } })
  if (-not $pubId) { Add-Result 'ROWS' $false 'no fake publication: run the part Make first'; return }
  $st['PubId'] = [string]$pubId; $made = 0; $found = 0
  $old = @((@(1, 2, 3) | ForEach-Object { $st['Bin' + $_] }) + $st['LogId']) -join ','
  for ($i = 1; $i -le 3; $i++) {
    $title = $BinTitle -f $i; $have = @(Get-TitledRow 'PFM Endorsements' $title $pubId)
    if ($have.Count) { $st['Bin' + $i] = [string]$have[0].Id; $found++; continue }
    $st['Bin' + $i] = [string](Add-PnPListItem -List 'PFM Endorsements' -Values @{ Title = $title; Publication = $pubId; CoordinationStage = 'Formal Coordination'
        EndorsementStatus = 'Not Started' } -ErrorAction Stop).Id; $made++
    Save-State $script:stateFile $st }
  $have = @(Get-TitledRow 'PFM Activity Log' $LogTitle $pubId)
  if ($have.Count) { $st['LogId'] = [string]$have[0].Id; $found++ }
  else { $st['LogId'] = [string](Add-PnPListItem -List 'PFM Activity Log' -Values @{ Title = $LogTitle; Publication = $pubId; EventType = 'Other' } -ErrorAction Stop).Id; $made++ }
  # Other row numbers than on file (rows made new): the marks of an earlier Change are for the old rows, so they go.
  if ((@((@(1, 2, 3) | ForEach-Object { $st['Bin' + $_] }) + $st['LogId']) -join ',') -ne $old) { foreach ($k in 'Gone1', 'Gone2', 'Gone3', 'Purged', 'NewId', 'ChangedAt') { $st.Remove($k) } }
  $st['RowsAt'] = (Get-Date).ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss')
  Save-State $script:stateFile $st
  $lines.Add('ROWS endorsement rows=' + ((@(1, 2, 3) | ForEach-Object { $st['Bin' + $_] }) -join ',') + '; log row=' + $st['LogId'])
  Add-Result 'ROWS' $true ('made=' + $made + ' found=' + $found + ' (3 on PFM Endorsements, 1 on PFM Activity Log, all on the fake publication)')
}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
  The part Change (after the Back up): 3 rows to the Recycle Bin, 1 row deleted for good, 1 new row.
.DESCRIPTION
  Each write is marked in the state file when it is done, so a second run does only what is left. Remove-PnPListItem
  without -Recycle deletes the row for good: it never reaches the Recycle Bin, so Restore must make it again as a new row.
#>
function Invoke-ChangePart {
  $st = Read-State $script:stateFile
  if (-not ($st['LogId'] -match '^\d+$' -and $st['PubId'] -match '^\d+$')) { Add-Result 'CHANGE' $false 'no rows on file: run the part Rows first'; return }
  $pubId = [int]$st['PubId']; $gone = 0; $purged = 0; $added = 0; $skip = 0
  for ($i = 1; $i -le 3; $i++) {
    if ($st['Gone' + $i] -eq 'yes') { continue }
    # Only a row with its fake-data title on the fake publication is deleted.
    if (-not @(Get-TitledRow 'PFM Endorsements' ($BinTitle -f $i) $pubId | Where-Object { [int]$_.Id -eq [int]$st['Bin' + $i] }).Count) { $skip++; continue }
    $null = Remove-PnPListItem -List 'PFM Endorsements' -Identity ([int]$st['Bin' + $i]) -Recycle -Force -ErrorAction Stop
    $st['Gone' + $i] = 'yes'; $gone++; Save-State $script:stateFile $st }
  if ($st['Purged'] -ne 'yes') {
    # Deleted for good only when the row on file still has the fake-data title ("90161Z TEST ...") on the fake publication.
    if (@(Get-TitledRow 'PFM Activity Log' $LogTitle $pubId | Where-Object { [int]$_.Id -eq [int]$st['LogId'] -and ([string]$_['Title']).StartsWith('90161Z TEST') }).Count) {
      $null = Remove-PnPListItem -List 'PFM Activity Log' -Identity ([int]$st['LogId']) -Force -ErrorAction Stop
      $st['Purged'] = 'yes'; $purged++; Save-State $script:stateFile $st }
    else { $skip++ } }
  if ($st['NewId'] -notmatch '^\d+$') {
    $st['NewId'] = [string](Add-PnPListItem -List 'PFM Endorsements' -Values @{ Title = $NewTitle; Publication = $pubId; CoordinationStage = 'Formal Coordination'
        EndorsementStatus = 'Not Started' } -ErrorAction Stop).Id; $added++ }
  if (-not $st['ChangedAt']) { $st['ChangedAt'] = (Get-Date).ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss') }
  Save-State $script:stateFile $st
  $text = 'to the Recycle Bin=' + $gone + ' deleted for good=' + $purged + ' new row=' + $added + ' (new row number ' + $st['NewId'] + ')'
  if ($skip) { $text += '; rows on file not found with the fake-data title=' + $skip + ' (not deleted: run the part Rows again)' }
  Add-Result 'CHANGE' (-not $skip) $text
}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
  The part Check (after Restore; reads only): the rows Restore put back, the new row, the pause switch, the fresh backup.
.PARAMETER App
  The app folder (RADE\90-161.Z), which holds the Backups folder.
#>
function Invoke-CheckPart([string]$App) {
  $st = Read-State $script:stateFile
  if ($st['NewId'] -notmatch '^\d+$' -or $st['PubId'] -notmatch '^\d+$') { Add-Result 'RESTORE-BIN' $false 'no change on file: run the parts Rows and Change first'; return }
  $pubId = [int]$st['PubId']; $back = 0; $twice = 0
  for ($i = 1; $i -le 3; $i++) { $rows = @(Get-TitledRow 'PFM Endorsements' ($BinTitle -f $i) $pubId)
    if (@($rows | Where-Object { [int]$_.Id -eq [int]$st['Bin' + $i] }).Count) { $back++ }; if ($rows.Count -gt 1) { $twice++ } }
  Add-Result 'RESTORE-BIN' ($back -eq 3 -and -not $twice) ('back with the old row number=' + $back + ' of 3; made twice=' + $twice)
  $logs = @(Get-TitledRow 'PFM Activity Log' $LogTitle $pubId); $old = @($logs | Where-Object { [int]$_.Id -eq [int]$st['LogId'] }).Count
  $newNo = $(if ($logs.Count) { [string]$logs[0].Id } else { 'none' })
  Add-Result 'RESTORE-NEW' ($logs.Count -eq 1 -and -not $old) ('log rows=' + $logs.Count + '; with the old row number=' + $old + '; new row number=' + $newNo)
  $keep = @(Get-TitledRow 'PFM Endorsements' $NewTitle $pubId | Where-Object { [int]$_.Id -eq [int]$st['NewId'] }).Count
  Add-Result 'RESTORE-KEEP' ($keep -eq 1) ('the row made after the backup is there=' + $(if ($keep -eq 1) { 'yes' } else { 'no' }))
  $p = @(Get-PauseRow); $word = $(if ($p.Count -eq 1) { Get-ValueWord $p[0][$Pause.Field] } else { 'rows=' + $p.Count })
  Add-Result 'PAUSEROW' ($p.Count -eq 1 -and $word -eq $st['PauseAfter']) ('now=' + $word + ' before Restore=' + $st['PauseAfter'])
  $since = [datetime]::ParseExact($st['ChangedAt'], 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss', [Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture)
  $fresh = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $App 'Backups') -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.CreationTime -gt $since -and -not $_.Name.StartsWith('~') })
  Add-Result 'FRESH-BACKUP' ($fresh.Count -ge 1) ('Backups folders made after the change=' + $fresh.Count)
}
'@ }

# ---- Step 6: the PFM Office level (PFM 19 Nov 26, F2 A; docs/reviews/2026-11-13-sweep-decisions.md, F2) ----
# The group the app shows the PFM screens to (PFM 12 Nov 26, 3.7B and 7A). tests/ps/Test-T21.ps1 checks that T21 uses both names.
$OfficeGroup = 'PFM Office'
# The texts, the level name and the bits of step 6 are in the module 90161Z-T20-access-r4.ps1 (R36).
# Step 6 (Grant-OfficeLevel) and step 7 (Grant-WingContribute, Test-WingContribute) live in the module 90161Z-T20-access-r4.ps1.

# The MADE lines of this run, each one exactly as Add-MadeLine printed it (the helpers module). Only these lines pass the final mask as they are.
$script:MadeLines = @{}
# The final form of one output line: a MADE line printed by Add-MadeLine stays as it is (it holds a fixed name of the app, never site data:
# a site named "office" must not turn "PFM Office" into "PFM <SITE-NAME>"); every other line is masked (site, DODID). This function is in
# the main file, before the first step, so the final lines are written even when a module is missing.
function ConvertTo-FinalLine([string]$Line, [string]$Site, [string[]]$Secret) {
  if ($script:MadeLines.ContainsKey($Line)) { return $Line }
  return (ConvertTo-Masked (Hide-Site $Line $Site) $Secret)
}

$secret = @()
$site = ''
$lines = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
$dir = ''
$Rev = 'r4'
$resultName = '90161Z-T20-provision-lists-' + $Rev + '.txt'
if ($Check) { $resultName = '90161Z-T20-clean-check-' + $Rev + '.txt' }

  if (-not $PayloadPath) { $PayloadPath = Join-Path $dir 'provisioning-payload.json' }
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $PayloadPath -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'PAYLOAD not found: provisioning-payload.json is not in the T20 folder. Run the round again so RADE saves it.' }

  $plan = Get-Plan $p
  $mod = @(Get-Module -ListAvailable -Name PnP.PowerShell | Sort-Object Version -Descending)

  $null = & { Import-Module PnP.PowerShell -RequiredVersion $mod[0].Version -DisableNameChecking } *>&1

  $null = & { Connect-PnPOnline -Url $site -UseWebLogin -ErrorAction Stop } *>&1
  $lines.Add('ROUTE web-login PASS')

  $siteLists = Get-SiteList
  $lines.Add('ITEM a-rest-read PASS lists read from the site=' + $siteLists.Count)
  $found = @{}
  foreach ($k in $plan.Keys) { $l = Find-OurList $siteLists $k; if ($l) { $found[$k] = $l } }

  if ($Check) {
    $internal = @($plan.Keys); $display = @($plan.Keys | ForEach-Object { $plan[$_].Display })
    # A list that 90-161.Z made (by its folder name), or one the rights probe made.
    $isOurs = { param($l) ($internal -contains [string]$l.RootFolder.Name) -or ([string]$l.RootFolder.Name -like 'PFMRightsProbe*') -or ([string]$l.Title -like 'PFMRightsProbe*') }
    # A list that 90-161.Z did not make but that has a title the install needs: SharePoint allows one list per title,

    $isClash = { param($l) -not (& $isOurs $l) -and (($display -contains [string]$l.Title) -or ($internal -contains [string]$l.Title)) }

    else { $lines.Add('ITEM b-lists PASS no 90-161.Z list on the site (other lists whose title starts with PFM: ' + $other + ', not made by 90-161.Z, not touched)') }
    if ($clash.Count) {

        '. The install cannot use that title. Rename that list or delete it: your decision; this script does not change it')
    }
    else { $lines.Add('ITEM b2-title-in-use PASS no other list has a title the install needs') }
    $lib = @($siteLists | Where-Object { [string]$_.Title -eq '90-161.Z' -or [string]$_.RootFolder.Name -eq '90-161.Z' })
    if ($lib.Count) { $lines.Add('ITEM c-library FAIL the library 90-161.Z is still on the site. Delete it (step 5)') }
    else { $lines.Add('ITEM c-library PASS no 90-161.Z library') }

    if ($docs.Count) {

      $files = @(Get-RestValue $filesUri | ForEach-Object { [string]$_.Name } | Where-Object { $_ -like '90161Z-*' } | Sort-Object)
      if ($files.Count) { $lines.Add('ITEM d-files FAIL result files still in Documents (' + $files.Count + '): ' + ($files -join ', ') + '. Delete them (step 6)') }

    else {
      # r2: the group PFM Office is made by 90-161.Z (step 6) and kept: it is named, not counted with the other PFM groups.
      $otherPfm = @($groups | Where-Object { $_ -like 'PFM*' -and $_ -ne $OfficeGroup }).Count
      $isThere = $(if ($groups -contains $OfficeGroup) { 'yes, kept' } else { 'no' })
      $lines.Add('ITEM e-groups PASS no probe test group (other groups whose name starts with PFM: ' + $otherPfm + ', not made by 90-161.Z; the group ' +
        $OfficeGroup + ' is there=' + $isThere + ')')
    }
    $nf = @($lines | Where-Object { $_ -cmatch '^ITEM \S+ FAIL\b' }).Count
    $lines.Add('CLEAN check done, items with problems=' + $nf)
  } else {
    $write = -not $DryRun
    # Before any write: this PowerShell must write a list inside a request body as a JSON list ("results":[...]).
    $probe = @($p.rows | Where-Object { @($_.body.PSObject.Properties | Where-Object { $_.Value -and $_.Value.PSObject.Properties['results'] }).Count } | Select-Object -First 1)
    if ($probe.Count) {
      $pj = $probe[0].body | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20 -Compress
      if ($pj -notmatch '"results":\[' -or $pj -match '"Count":') { throw 'JSON not written as expected by this PowerShell (a list in a request body). Nothing was changed. Send this line.' }
      $lines.Add('ITEM a2-json PASS request bodies are written as expected')
    }
    $made = @{ lists = 0; fields = 0; views = 0; viewops = 0; rows = 0; updates = 0; permissions = 0 }
    $skip = @{ lists = 0; fields = 0; views = 0; rows = 0 }
    $lines.Add('BEFORE lists on the site=' + $found.Count + ' of ' + $plan.Count)

    # 1. Lists (created under the internal name; the display title is set in step 4, as the flow does).
    foreach ($l in $p.lists) {
      $name = [string]$l.body.Title
      if ($found.ContainsKey($name)) { $skip.lists++; continue }
      if ($write) { Write-Host ('  Creating the list ' + $name + ' ...'); $null = Invoke-Rest 'Post' ([string]$l.uri) ($l.body | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20 -Compress) }
      if ($write) { Add-MadeLine 'list' $plan[$name].Display }   # RADE engine-v41: one MADE line for each list this run made
      $made.lists++
    }
    if ($write) {
      $siteLists = Get-SiteList
      foreach ($k in $plan.Keys) { $l = Find-OurList $siteLists $k; if ($l) { $found[$k] = $l } }
      $missing = @($plan.Keys | Where-Object { -not $found.ContainsKey($_) })
      if ($missing.Count) { throw ('LISTS not on the site after the create step: ' + ($missing -join ', ')) }
    }

    # 2. Columns and views, in payload order. A lookup column gets the real id of the list it points to.
    $haveFields = @{}; $haveViews = @{}
    foreach ($k in $plan.Keys) {
      $haveFields[$k] = @(); $haveViews[$k] = @()
      if ($found.ContainsKey($k)) {
        $base = "_api/web/lists(guid'" + $found[$k].Id + "')"
        $haveFields[$k] = @(Get-RestValue ($base + '/fields?$select=InternalName&$top=2000') | ForEach-Object { [string]$_.InternalName })
        $haveViews[$k] = @(Get-RestValue ($base + '/views?$select=Title&$top=500') | ForEach-Object { [string]$_.Title })
      }
    }
    $lastList = ''; $listNo = 0
    foreach ($op in $p.fields) {
      $uri = [string]$op.uri
      if ($uri -notmatch "^_api/web/lists/getbytitle\('([^']+)'\)/(.+)$") { throw 'PAYLOAD column or view request not understood' }
      $k = $Matches[1]; $rest = $Matches[2]
      # R48 (R47 finding 1): one NOW line before the columns and views of each list (the long part of the step); RADE shows "Making list N of 12: <title>".
      if ($write -and $k -ne $lastList) { $listNo++; Write-Host ('NOW Making list ' + $listNo + ' of ' + $plan.Count + ': ' + $plan[$k].Display); $lastList = $k }
      $target = ''
      if ($found.ContainsKey($k)) { $target = "_api/web/lists(guid'" + $found[$k].Id + "')/" + $rest }
      if ($rest -eq 'fields/createfieldasxml') {
        $null = ([string]$op.body.parameters.SchemaXml) -match '\bName="([^"]+)"'
        if ($haveFields[$k] -contains $Matches[1]) { $skip.fields++; continue }
        $body = $op.body | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20 -Compress
        foreach ($ref in $p.lookupPlaceholders) {
          $token = '{__' + [string]$ref + '_ID__}'
          if ($body.Contains($token)) {
            if ($write) { $body = $body.Replace($token, '{' + [string]$found[[string]$ref].Id + '}') }
          }
        }
        if ($write) { $null = Invoke-Rest 'Post' $target $body }
        $made.fields++
      } elseif ($rest -eq 'views') {
        $title = [string]$op.body.Title
        if ($haveViews[$k] -contains $title) { $skip.views++; continue }
        if ($write) { $null = Invoke-Rest 'Post' $target ($op.body | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20 -Compress) }
        $made.views++
      } elseif ($rest -match "^views/getbytitle\('([^']+)'\)/viewfields/") {
        # Always sent, also for a view that was there: clear the columns, then add each one. A run that stopped between
        # the view and its columns is repaired this way; for a complete view it changes nothing.
        if ($write) { $null = Invoke-Rest 'Post' $target '{}' }
        $made.viewops++
      } else { throw ('PAYLOAD request not understood for ' + $k) }
    }

    # 3. Seed rows: each row whose Title is not in the list yet (so a run that stopped part way is repaired, and a
    # second run adds nothing).
    $lastList = ''
    $haveRows = @{}
    foreach ($r in $p.rows) {
      if ([string]$r.uri -notmatch "^_api/web/lists/getbytitle\('([^']+)'\)/items$") { throw 'PAYLOAD row request not understood' }
      $k = $Matches[1]
      if (-not $haveRows.ContainsKey($k)) {
        $haveRows[$k] = @()
        if ($found.ContainsKey($k) -and [int]$found[$k].ItemCount -gt 0) {
          $haveRows[$k] = @(Get-RestValue ("_api/web/lists(guid'" + $found[$k].Id + "')/items?" + '$select=Title&$top=5000') | ForEach-Object { [string]$_.Title })
        }
      }
      if ($haveRows[$k] -contains [string]$r.body.Title) { $skip.rows++; continue }
      if ($write) {
        if ($k -ne $lastList) { Write-Host ('  Seed rows of ' + $k + ' ...'); $lastList = $k }
        $null = Invoke-Rest 'Post' ("_api/web/lists(guid'" + $found[$k].Id + "')/items") ($r.body | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20 -Compress)
      }
      $made.rows++

    foreach ($u in $p.updates) {
      if ([string]$u.uri -notmatch "^_api/web/lists/getbytitle\('([^']+)'\)(?:/fields/getbyinternalnameortitle\('([^']+)'\))?$") { throw 'PAYLOAD update request not understood' }
      if ($write) { Write-CsomMerge ([string]$found[$Matches[1]].Id) ([string]$Matches[2]) $u.body }
      $made.updates++
    }
    foreach ($x in $p.permissions) {
      $null = ([string]$x.uri) -match "getbytitle\('([^']+)'\)$"
      $title = [uri]::UnescapeDataString($Matches[1])
      $k = @($plan.Keys | Where-Object { $plan[$_].Display -eq $title })[0]
      if ($write) { Write-CsomMerge ([string]$found[$k].Id) '' $x.body }
      $made.permissions++
    }
    # 6. The PFM Office level (F2 A), after the lists, so it never stops the list steps above.
    $office = Grant-OfficeLevel $write
    # 7. Contribute for Visitors on the intake lists (r4), after step 6 so the copied role assignments include PFM Office.
    $wing = Grant-WingContribute $write (Get-SiteList)
    $word = 'CREATED'; if (-not $write) { $word = 'DRYRUN would create' }
    $lines.Add($word + ' lists=' + $made.lists + ' fields=' + $made.fields + ' views=' + $made.views + ' view-column requests=' + $made.viewops +
      ' rows=' + $made.rows + '; set: updates=' + $made.updates + ' permissions=' + $made.permissions)
    $lines.Add($word + ' for ' + $OfficeGroup + ': group=' + $office.group + ' level=' + $office.level + ' level given to the group=' + $office.binding)
    $lines.Add($word + ' for the intake lists: own permissions=' + $wing.own + ' Visitors given Contribute=' + $wing.granted)
    $lines.Add('SKIPPED (already there) lists=' + $skip.lists + ' fields=' + $skip.fields + ' views=' + $skip.views + ' rows=' + $skip.rows)

    if ($write) {
      # 8. Check every list against the payload, then the PFM Office level.
      $siteLists = Get-SiteList
      $n = 0
      foreach ($k in $plan.Keys) {
        $n++
        $e = $plan[$k]
        $l = Find-OurList $siteLists $k
        $tag = 'ITEM L' + $n.ToString('00') + '-' + $k
        if (-not $l) { $lines.Add($tag + ' FAIL the list is not on the site'); continue }
        $base = "_api/web/lists(guid'" + $l.Id + "')"
        $sf = @(Get-RestValue ($base + '/fields?$select=InternalName,Indexed&$top=2000'))
        $names = @($sf | ForEach-Object { [string]$_.InternalName })
        $idx = @($sf | Where-Object { $_.Indexed } | ForEach-Object { [string]$_.InternalName })
        $views = @(Get-RestValue ($base + '/views?$select=Title&$top=500') | ForEach-Object { [string]$_.Title })
        $bad = @()
        if ([string]$l.Title -ne $e.Display) { $bad += 'title is not "' + $e.Display + '"' }
        $m = @($e.Fields | Where-Object { $names -notcontains $_ }); if ($m.Count) { $bad += 'columns missing: ' + ($m -join ', ') }
        $m = @($e.Indexed | Where-Object { $idx -notcontains $_ }); if ($m.Count) { $bad += 'not indexed: ' + ($m -join ', ') }
        $m = @($e.Views | Where-Object { $views -notcontains $_ }); if ($m.Count) { $bad += 'views missing: ' + ($m -join ', ') }
        if ($e.Versioning -and -not $l.EnableVersioning) { $bad += 'versioning is off' }
        if ([int]$l.ItemCount -lt $e.Rows) { $bad += 'rows ' + [int]$l.ItemCount + ', expected ' + $e.Rows + ' or more' }
        if ($e.Secure) {
          $sec = Get-PnPList -Identity $e.Display -Includes ReadSecurity, WriteSecurity -ErrorAction Stop
          if ([int]$sec.ReadSecurity -ne 1 -or [int]$sec.WriteSecurity -ne 2) { $bad += 'edit own rows not set (read ' + [int]$sec.ReadSecurity + ', write ' + [int]$sec.WriteSecurity + ')' }
        }
        if ($bad.Count) { $lines.Add($tag + ' FAIL ' + ($bad -join '; ')) }
        else {
          $lines.Add($tag + ' PASS "' + $e.Display + '": columns ' + $e.Fields.Count + ', indexed ' + $e.Indexed.Count + ', views ' + $e.Views.Count +
            ', rows ' + [int]$l.ItemCount + $(if ($e.Secure) { ', edit own rows set' } else { '' }))
        }
      }
      $lines.Add((Test-OfficeLevel))
      $lines.Add((Test-ListAccess $plan $siteLists))
      foreach ($w in @(Test-WingContribute $siteLists)) { $lines.Add($w) }
      $lines.Add('AFTER lists on the site=' + @($plan.Keys | Where-Object { Find-OurList $siteLists $_ }).Count + ' of ' + $plan.Count)
    }
    $nf = @($lines | Where-Object { $_ -cmatch '^ITEM \S+ FAIL\b' }).Count
    $lines.Add('PROVISION done, items with problems=' + $nf)
  }
  try { $null = & { Disconnect-PnPOnline -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } *>&1 } catch { $null = $_ }
} catch {
  if ($PlanOnly) { Write-Host ('PLAN FAILED: ' + [string]$_); exit 2 }
  $m = ConvertTo-Masked (Hide-Site ([string]$_) $site) $secret
  $lines.Add('STOPPED: ' + $m.Substring(0, [Math]::Min(400, $m.Length)) + ' (a run that stopped can be run again: it skips what is there)')
} finally {
  if (-not $PlanOnly) {
    $masked = @($lines | ForEach-Object { ConvertTo-FinalLine $_ $site $secret })
    if ($dir) { try { Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir $resultName) -Value $masked -Encoding UTF8 } catch { $null = $_ } }
    $masked | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_ }
    if (-not $NoPause) { [void](Read-Host 'Press Enter to close') }
    if (@($masked | Where-Object { $_ -cmatch '^STOPPED|^ITEM \S+ FAIL\b' }).Count) { exit 1 }
  }
}
'@ }

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  90-161.Z Task 20 list provisioning r4, module "helpers": the plan of the payload and the SharePoint helpers (REST, CSOM
  merge, groups, permission levels). Moved here from 90161Z-T20-provision-lists-r4.ps1 (code standard file size cap, C4); the code is unchanged.
.DESCRIPTION
  Loaded by 90161Z-T20-provision-lists-r4.ps1 (dot-sourced from the same folder, in its scope); it does nothing when it is run alone.
  Inputs: $site and the PnP.PowerShell connection of the main file ($script:site). Outputs: the functions Get-Plan, Invoke-Rest,
  Get-RestValue, Get-SiteList, Find-OurList, Add-MadeLine, Write-CsomMerge, Get-GroupId, Get-RoleLevel, Get-WebBinding, ConvertTo-PermissionWord, Test-LevelPermission.
  Network: the one SharePoint site of the main file, through the PnP.PowerShell connection of the main file (none in Get-Plan).
  Writes: Write-CsomMerge and Invoke-Rest (Post) change the site when the main file calls them in create mode; nothing on this computer.
  Credentials: none of its own (the main file signs in).
  Run: not alone; powershell.exe -File 90161Z-T20-provision-lists-r4.ps1 loads it.
#>

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  What the payload asks for, per list (internal name): display title, columns, indexed columns, views, rows, versioning
  and whether "edit own rows" is set.
.PARAMETER P
  The payload (provisioning-payload.json, read with ConvertFrom-Json).
.OUTPUTS
  System.Collections.Specialized.OrderedDictionary. One entry per list, in payload order.
#>
function Get-Plan($P) {
  $plan = [ordered]@{}
  foreach ($l in $P.lists) {
    $plan[[string]$l.body.Title] = @{ Display = [string]$l.body.Title; Fields = @(); Indexed = @(); Views = @(); Rows = 0; Versioning = [bool]$l.body.EnableVersioning; Secure = $false }
  }
  foreach ($op in $P.fields) {
    if ([string]$op.uri -notmatch "getbytitle\('([^']+)'\)/(fields/createfieldasxml|views)$") { continue }
    $e = $plan[$Matches[1]]
    if ($Matches[2] -eq 'views') { $e.Views += [string]$op.body.Title; continue }
    $xml = [string]$op.body.parameters.SchemaXml
    if ($xml -notmatch '\bName="([^"]+)"') { throw ('PAYLOAD column without a name in ' + $Matches[1]) }
    $name = $Matches[1]
    $e.Fields += $name
    if ($xml -match '\bIndexed="TRUE"') { $e.Indexed += $name }
  }
  foreach ($r in $P.rows) { if ([string]$r.uri -match "getbytitle\('([^']+)'\)/items$") { $plan[$Matches[1]].Rows++ } }
  foreach ($u in $P.updates) {
    if ([string]$u.uri -match "getbytitle\('([^']+)'\)$") { $plan[$Matches[1]].Display = [string]$u.body.Title }
    elseif ([string]$u.uri -match "getbytitle\('([^']+)'\)/fields/getbyinternalnameortitle\('([^']+)'\)$" -and $u.body.Indexed) { $plan[$Matches[1]].Indexed += $Matches[2] }
  }
  foreach ($x in $P.permissions) {
    if ([string]$x.uri -notmatch "getbytitle\('([^']+)'\)$") { throw 'PAYLOAD permission request not understood' }
    $title = [uri]::UnescapeDataString($Matches[1])
    $hit = @($plan.Keys | Where-Object { $plan[$_].Display -eq $title })
    if ($hit.Count -ne 1) { throw ('PAYLOAD permission for a list that is not in the payload: ' + $title) }
    $plan[$hit[0]].Secure = $true
  }
  return $plan
}

function Invoke-Rest([string]$Method, [string]$Uri, [string]$Body) {
  # One SharePoint REST request through the signed-in PnP connection (sign-in cookies and the request digest come from PnP).
  $url = $script:site.TrimEnd('/') + '/' + $Uri
  # No -Accept: the cmdlet's own default (application/json;odata=nometadata) is what the script reads.
  if ($Method -eq 'Get') { return [string](Invoke-PnPSPRestMethod -Method Get -Url $url -Raw -ErrorAction Stop) }
  return [string](Invoke-PnPSPRestMethod -Method Post -Url $url -Content $Body -ContentType 'application/json;odata=verbose' -Raw -ErrorAction Stop)
}

# Reads a REST collection and returns its "value" items as an array.
function Get-RestValue([string]$Uri) {
  $j = (Invoke-Rest 'Get' $Uri '') | ConvertFrom-Json
  return @($j.value)
}

function Get-SiteList {
  # Every list on the site that is not hidden, with the folder name it was created under (that name does not change when
  # the title does, so it finds a list before and after its rename).
  $q = '_api/web/lists?$select=Id,Title,ItemCount,EnableVersioning,BaseTemplate,Hidden,HasUniqueRoleAssignments,RootFolder/Name&$expand=RootFolder&$top=1000'
  return @(Get-RestValue $q | Where-Object { -not $_.Hidden })
}

function Find-OurList($SiteLists, [string]$Internal) {
  # Ours = created under the internal name, so its folder has that name (case sensitive). A list that a person made and titled
  # "PFM Settings" has another folder name: it is never matched, so nothing is added to it.
  foreach ($l in $SiteLists) { if ([string]$l.RootFolder.Name -ceq $Internal) { return $l } }
  return $null
}

# True when a name is one of the fixed names of 90-161.Z for its kind: a list title of the plan (the payload), the group $OfficeGroup or the
# level $OfficeLevel (both from the main file and the access module, read from the scope that loaded this file). Case sensitive.
function Test-MadeName([string]$Kind, [string]$Name) {
  switch ($Kind) {
    'list' { return (@($plan.Values | ForEach-Object { [string]$_.Display }) -ccontains $Name) }
    'group' { return ($Name -ceq $OfficeGroup) }
    'level' { return ($Name -ceq $OfficeLevel) }
    default { return $false }
  }
}

# Adds the line "MADE <kind>: <name>" to the output lines for one item that THIS run created (RADE engine-v41 reads it, and the Uninstall
# of 90-161.Z gets it back in RADE_MADE). Kind is a lowercase word (list, group, level). Call it only after the item is made, never in a
# dry run and never for an item that was already there. A MADE line is printed only for a fixed name of the app (Test-MadeName), never for
# site data, so the final mask of the main file leaves it as it is (ConvertTo-FinalLine, which reads $script:MadeLines):
# a site named "office" must not turn "PFM Office" into "PFM <SITE-NAME>".
function Add-MadeLine([string]$Kind, [string]$Name) {
  if (-not (Test-MadeName $Kind $Name)) { $lines.Add('NOTE no MADE line: a name of the kind ' + $Kind + ' is not a fixed name of 90-161.Z'); return }
  $line = 'MADE ' + $Kind + ': ' + $Name
  if (-not $script:MadeLines) { $script:MadeLines = @{} }
  $lines.Add($line); $script:MadeLines[$line] = 1
}

# A MERGE of the payload, written through CSOM: every property of the body except __metadata is set, then Update.
function Write-CsomMerge([string]$ListId, [string]$FieldName, $Body) {
  $ctx = Get-PnPContext
  $target = $ctx.Web.Lists.GetById([guid]$ListId)
  if ($FieldName) { $target = $target.Fields.GetByInternalNameOrTitle($FieldName) }
  foreach ($prop in $Body.PSObject.Properties) { if ($prop.Name -ne '__metadata') { $target.($prop.Name) = $prop.Value } }
  $target.Update()
  $ctx.ExecuteQuery()
}


# Finds a site group by its name; returns its Id, or 0 when the site has no group with that name.
function Get-GroupId([string]$Name) {
  $hit = @(Get-RestValue ('_api/web/sitegroups?$select=Id,Title&$top=5000') | Where-Object { [string]$_.Title -eq $Name })
  if ($hit.Count) { return [int]$hit[0].Id }
  return 0
}

# Finds a permission level of the site by its name, or by its kind when the name is empty; returns it, or $null.
function Get-RoleLevel([string]$Name, [int]$Kind) {
  $all = @(Get-RestValue ('_api/web/roledefinitions?$select=Id,Name,RoleTypeKind,BasePermissions&$top=500'))
  $hit = @($all | Where-Object { ($Name -and [string]$_.Name -eq $Name) -or (-not $Name -and [int]$_.RoleTypeKind -eq $Kind) })
  if ($hit.Count) { return $hit[0] }
  return $null
}

# The Ids of the permission levels a group holds on the site itself; none when it holds no level there.
function Get-WebBinding([int]$PrincipalId) {
  $uri = '_api/web/roleassignments/getbyprincipalid(' + $PrincipalId + ')/roledefinitionbindings?$select=Id'
  try { return @(Get-RestValue $uri | ForEach-Object { [int]$_.Id }) } catch { return @() }
}

# One word (High or Low) of SP.BasePermissions as a number, whatever JSON type it came in: SharePoint writes a string, and on
# Windows PowerShell 5.1 ConvertFrom-Json makes a JSON number an Int32 or an Int64 by its size. Parsed from its invariant text.
function ConvertTo-PermissionWord($Value) { return [long]::Parse(([string]$Value).Trim(), [Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture) }

# True when a level holds every permission of another level (both from Get-RoleLevel) plus the extra bits given, checked bit
# by bit in both 32-bit words.
function Test-LevelPermission($Level, $Base, [long]$Extra) {
  $have = @((ConvertTo-PermissionWord $Level.BasePermissions.Low), (ConvertTo-PermissionWord $Level.BasePermissions.High))
  $want = @(((ConvertTo-PermissionWord $Base.BasePermissions.Low) -bor $Extra), (ConvertTo-PermissionWord $Base.BasePermissions.High))
  for ($w = 0; $w -lt 2; $w++) { for ($i = 0; $i -lt 32; $i++) { $bit = [long]1 -shl $i; if (($want[$w] -band $bit) -and -not ($have[$w] -band $bit)) { return $false } } }
  return $true
}
'@ }

$files += @{ Dir = 'T20'; Name = '90161Z-T20-access-r4.ps1'; Kind = 'text'; Sha = '710d63b70c31'; Data = @'
<#
.SYNOPSIS
  90-161.Z Task 20 list provisioning r4, module "access": step 6 (the PFM Office level), step 7 (Contribute for the Visitors
  group on the intake lists, r4) and the read-backs of the level and of the access to the 12 lists (PFM 19 Nov 26: R34 plan,
  open point 12). r4 (R36): steps 6 and 7 moved here from the main file (code standard file size cap); the code is unchanged.
.DESCRIPTION
  Loaded by 90161Z-T20-provision-lists-r4.ps1 (dot-sourced from the same folder); it does nothing when it is run alone.
  Inputs: the values and helpers of the main file ($OfficeGroup, Invoke-Rest, Get-SiteList, Write-CsomMerge,
  Get-GroupId, Get-RoleLevel, Get-WebBinding, Test-LevelPermission, Get-RestValue, Find-OurList). Outputs: one ITEM line
  from each read-back; the step functions return their counts.
  Network: the one SharePoint site of the main file, through the PnP.PowerShell connection of the main file.
  Writes: step 6: the group PFM Office, its level and that level on the site, when missing; step 7: Contribute for the
          Visitors group on the 3 intake lists (own permissions), when missing. The read-backs write nothing.
  Credentials: none of its own (the main file signs in).
  Run: not alone; powershell.exe -File 90161Z-T20-provision-lists-r4.ps1 loads it.
#>

# Step 6 (moved from the main file in R36): the texts of the group PFM Office (its name $OfficeGroup stays in the main file).
$OfficeGroupText = 'Publications and Forms Manager (PFM) office: the people who work the PFM organization box (90-161.Z).'
# The site's Edit level plus Override List Behaviors: Edit lacks it, and only it lets a person edit every row of a list set to
# "edit own rows" (PFM Publications and PFM Endorsements, PFM 10A), so the Alternate and the Acting PFM need it (sweep F2).
$OfficeLevel = 'PFM Office Edit All Items'
$OfficeLevelText = 'Edit, plus Override List Behaviors: edits every row, also on lists set to edit own rows (90-161.Z, PFM 2026-11-19).'
# SharePoint permission bit (SP.BasePermissions, low word): CancelCheckout 0x100 ("Override List Behaviors"); EditListItems is below.
$OverrideBit = [long]0x100
# The RoleTypeKind of the site's Edit level (SP.RoleType Editor = 6): found by kind, so a site in another language works too.
$EditRoleKind = 6
# SharePoint permission bit (SP.BasePermissions, low word): EditListItems 0x4.
$EditItemsBit = [long]0x4

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Step 7, the read-back of step 6 (the level and the group on the site): PASS when the group holds the level on the site and the level holds Edit plus Edit Items and
  Override List Behaviors; else FAIL (typed list: PS 5.1).
.OUTPUTS
  System.String. One ITEM line.
#>
function Test-OfficeLevel {
  $gid = Get-GroupId $OfficeGroup; $level = Get-RoleLevel $OfficeLevel 0; $edit = Get-RoleLevel '' $EditRoleKind
  $bad = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]; $need = [long]($EditItemsBit -bor $OverrideBit); if ($level -and -not $edit) { $bad.Add('the site has no Edit level to compare') }
  if (-not $gid) { $bad.Add('the group ' + $OfficeGroup + ' is not on the site') }; if (-not $level) { $bad.Add('the level ' + $OfficeLevel + ' is not on the site') }
  if ($level -and $edit) { $ok = [bool](Test-LevelPermission $level $edit $need); if (-not $ok) { $bad.Add('the level lacks a permission of Edit or Override List Behaviors') } }
  if ($level -and $gid) { $held = @(Get-WebBinding $gid); if ($held -notcontains [int]$level.Id) { $bad.Add('the group does not hold the level on the site') } }
  if ($bad.Count -gt 0) { return ('ITEM P01-pfm-office FAIL ' + ($bad -join '; ') + ' (this script never changes a level that is there)') }
  return ('ITEM P01-pfm-office PASS the group "' + $OfficeGroup + '" holds the level "' + $OfficeLevel + '" on the site (Edit plus Override List Behaviors)')
}


<#
.SYNOPSIS
  The role bindings of a group on one list: the Ids of the permission levels it holds there; none when it holds none.
.PARAMETER ListId
  The list's id (the Id of a Get-SiteList entry).
.PARAMETER PrincipalId
  The group's Id.
.OUTPUTS
  System.Int32[]. The level Ids.
#>
function Get-ListBinding([string]$ListId, [int]$PrincipalId) {
  $uri = "_api/web/lists(guid'" + $ListId + "')/roleassignments/getbyprincipalid(" + $PrincipalId + ')/roledefinitionbindings?$select=Id'
  try { return @(Get-RestValue $uri | ForEach-Object { [int]$_.Id }) } catch { return @() }
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Step 7, the read-back of the access to the app lists (R34 plan, open point 12): each of the lists of the plan either
  inherits its role assignments from the site (HasUniqueRoleAssignments false), or has its own and the group PFM Office holds
  the level PFM Office Edit All Items on that list; else FAIL, naming the lists. The reasons go in a typed list (PS 5.1).
.PARAMETER Plan
  The plan of the payload (Get-Plan): internal name to display title and settings.
.PARAMETER SiteLists
  The lists of the site (Get-SiteList), with HasUniqueRoleAssignments.
.OUTPUTS
  System.String. One ITEM line, with the counts.
#>
function Test-ListAccess($Plan, $SiteLists) {
  $bad = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
  $gid = Get-GroupId $OfficeGroup; $level = Get-RoleLevel $OfficeLevel 0
  $inherit = 0; $own = 0
  foreach ($k in $Plan.Keys) {
    $name = [string]$Plan[$k].Display
    $l = Find-OurList $SiteLists $k
    if (-not $l) { $bad.Add($name + ' is not on the site'); continue }
    if (-not [bool]$l.HasUniqueRoleAssignments) { $inherit++; continue }
    $own++
    if (-not $gid -or -not $level) { $bad.Add($name + ' has its own permissions and the group or the level is not on the site'); continue }
    $held = @(Get-ListBinding ([string]$l.Id) $gid)
    if ($held -notcontains [int]$level.Id) { $bad.Add($name + ' has its own permissions and the group ' + $OfficeGroup + ' does not hold the level on it') }
  }
  if ($bad.Count -gt 0) { return ('ITEM P02-list-access FAIL lists that fail (' + $bad.Count + ' of ' + $Plan.Count + '): ' + ($bad -join '; ')) }
  $tail = ' have own permissions and the group "' + $OfficeGroup + '" holds the level "' + $OfficeLevel + '" on each'
  return ('ITEM P02-list-access PASS ' + $Plan.Count + ' lists: ' + $inherit + ' inherit from the site, ' + $own + $tail)
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Step 6: the group PFM Office, the level PFM Office Edit All Items (the bits of the site's Edit level plus Override List
  Behaviors) and that level for the group on the site, each made only when it is missing (a second run changes nothing).
  A level with that name that is there is not changed.
.PARAMETER Write
  $true: make what is missing; $false (-DryRun): only count it.
.OUTPUTS
  System.Collections.Hashtable. group, level, binding: 1 when it was made (or a dry run would make it), else 0.
#>
function Grant-OfficeLevel([bool]$Write) {
  $made = @{ group = 0; level = 0; binding = 0 }
  $gid = Get-GroupId $OfficeGroup
  if (-not $gid) {
    $made.group = 1
    if ($Write) {
      Write-Host ('  Making the group ' + $OfficeGroup + ' ...')
      $null = Invoke-Rest 'Post' '_api/web/sitegroups' (@{ __metadata = @{ type = 'SP.Group' }; Title = $OfficeGroup; Description = $OfficeGroupText } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress)
      $gid = Get-GroupId $OfficeGroup
      if (-not $gid) { throw ('GROUP ' + $OfficeGroup + ' not on the site after the create step.') }
      Add-MadeLine 'group' $OfficeGroup   # RADE engine-v41: this run made the group
    }
  }
  $level = Get-RoleLevel $OfficeLevel 0
  if (-not $level) {
    $made.level = 1
    $edit = Get-RoleLevel '' $EditRoleKind
    if (-not $edit) { throw ('LEVEL Edit not found on the site: the level ' + $OfficeLevel + ' is made from it. The lists are done.') }
    if ($Write) {
      Write-Host ('  Making the permission level ' + $OfficeLevel + ' ...')
      $low = (ConvertTo-PermissionWord $edit.BasePermissions.Low) -bor $OverrideBit
      $bits = @{ __metadata = @{ type = 'SP.BasePermissions' }; High = [string](ConvertTo-PermissionWord $edit.BasePermissions.High); Low = [string]$low }
      $body = @{ __metadata = @{ type = 'SP.RoleDefinition' }; Name = $OfficeLevel; Description = $OfficeLevelText; BasePermissions = $bits }
      $null = Invoke-Rest 'Post' '_api/web/roledefinitions' ($body | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress)
      $level = Get-RoleLevel $OfficeLevel 0
      if (-not $level) { throw ('LEVEL ' + $OfficeLevel + ' not on the site after the create step.') }
      Add-MadeLine 'level' $OfficeLevel   # RADE engine-v41: this run made the level
    }
  }
  if (-not $gid -or -not $level) { $made.binding = 1; return $made }
  if ((Get-WebBinding $gid) -notcontains [int]$level.Id) {
    $made.binding = 1
    if ($Write) {
      Write-Host ('  Giving the level ' + $OfficeLevel + ' to the group ' + $OfficeGroup + ' ...')
      $null = Invoke-Rest 'Post' ('_api/web/roleassignments/addroleassignment(principalid=' + $gid + ',roledefid=' + [int]$level.Id + ')') '{}'
    }
  }
  return $made
}

# ---- Step 7 (r4): Contribute for the site's Visitors group on the intake lists (PFM 19 Nov 26; docs/roles-and-permissions.md section 7) ----
# The intake lists are the ones wing users write to through the app: the request (PFM Publications), the endorser entry (PFM
# Endorsements) and the DAF Form 847 intake (PFM Recommendations); docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (Data and UI rows, and the risk row on edit own rows).
$IntakeLists = @('PFMPublications', 'PFMEndorsements', 'PFMRecommendations')
# SP.RoleType Contributor = 3: found by kind, so a site in another language works too.
$ContributeRoleKind = 3

# The Id of the site's associated Visitors group (the people the site gives Read), or 0 when the site has none or it cannot be read.
function Get-VisitorGroupId {
  try { return [int]((Invoke-Rest 'Get' '_api/web/associatedvisitorgroup?$select=Id' '') | ConvertFrom-Json).Id } catch { return 0 }
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Step 7: for each intake list that is on the site, makes the list's own permissions when it inherits (the site's role
  assignments are copied), then gives the Visitors group the level Contribute on that list when it does not hold it yet. Reads
  first and writes only what is missing, so a second run changes nothing. Never changes the site's own permissions.
.PARAMETER Write
  $true: make what is missing; $false (-DryRun): only count it.
.PARAMETER SiteLists
  The lists of the site (Get-SiteList). A list that is not there yet counts as one that would be made and given the role.
.OUTPUTS
  System.Collections.Hashtable. own (lists that got their own permissions) and granted (lists that got the role): counts; a dry run counts what it would do.
#>
function Grant-WingContribute([bool]$Write, $SiteLists) {
  $made = @{ own = 0; granted = 0 }
  $vid = Get-VisitorGroupId
  $level = Get-RoleLevel '' $ContributeRoleKind
  if ($Write -and ($vid -le 0 -or -not $level)) { return $made }   # the read-back names the cause
  foreach ($k in $IntakeLists) {
    $l = Find-OurList $SiteLists $k
    if (-not $l) { $made.own++; $made.granted++; continue }
    $base = "_api/web/lists(guid'" + $l.Id + "')"
    if (-not [bool]$l.HasUniqueRoleAssignments) {
      $made.own++
      # clearSubscopes=false: items that hold their own permissions keep them (R36 review).
      if ($Write) { $null = Invoke-Rest 'Post' ($base + '/breakroleinheritance(copyRoleAssignments=true,clearSubscopes=false)') '{}' }
    }
    $held = @()
    if ($vid -gt 0 -and [bool]$l.HasUniqueRoleAssignments) { $held = @(Get-ListBinding ([string]$l.Id) $vid) }
    if ($level -and $held -contains [int]$level.Id) { continue }
    $made.granted++
    if ($Write) {
      Write-Host ('  Giving Visitors Contribute on ' + $k + ' ...')
      $null = Invoke-Rest 'Post' ($base + '/roleassignments/addroleassignment(principalid=' + $vid + ',roledefid=' + [int]$level.Id + ')') '{}'
    }
  }
  return $made
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Step 7, the read-back: one ITEM line per intake list. PASS when the list has its own permissions and the Visitors group holds
  Contribute on it; else FAIL, with the reason (list missing, no Visitors group, no Contribute level, inherits, role missing).
.PARAMETER SiteLists
  The lists of the site (Get-SiteList), read after step 7.
.OUTPUTS
  System.String[]. The ITEM lines, W01 to W03.
#>
function Test-WingContribute($SiteLists) {
  $vid = Get-VisitorGroupId
  $level = Get-RoleLevel '' $ContributeRoleKind
  $out = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
  $n = 0
  foreach ($k in $IntakeLists) {
    $n++
    $tag = 'ITEM W' + $n.ToString('00') + '-' + $k
    $l = Find-OurList $SiteLists $k
    if (-not $l) { $out.Add($tag + ' FAIL the list is not on the site'); continue }
    if ($vid -le 0) { $out.Add($tag + ' FAIL the site has no associated Visitors group, so wing users cannot write to "' + $l.Title + '"'); continue }
    if (-not $level) { $out.Add($tag + ' FAIL the site has no Contribute level'); continue }
    if (-not [bool]$l.HasUniqueRoleAssignments) { $out.Add($tag + ' FAIL "' + $l.Title + '" still inherits its permissions from the site: Visitors only read'); continue }
    if (@(Get-ListBinding ([string]$l.Id) $vid) -notcontains [int]$level.Id) { $out.Add($tag + ' FAIL the Visitors group does not hold Contribute on "' + $l.Title + '"'); continue }
    $out.Add($tag + ' PASS "' + $l.Title + '": the Visitors group holds Contribute on the list (own permissions); the site stays Read')
  }
  return $out.ToArray()
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  90-161.Z Task 27 r1 (round R43; the PFM, 25 Nov 26: RADE Uninstall, install from zero, 1 fake publication through 1 process step
  (a move from step 1 to step 2; see the module check); test site only): the Uninstall steps of the app 90-161.Z, and the read-only checks and the process step that follow
  them. Windows PowerShell 5.1 (also 7), the installed PnP.PowerShell 1.12.0 (no other module).
.DESCRIPTION
  Parts (-Part). The first 3 run in RADE's Uninstall mode (RADE engine-v41: a Back up first, then these steps). The lists are removed
  BY THEIR FIXED TITLES (the PFM, 25 Nov 26: the 12 lists of the test site were made before RADE installs, so RADE has no record of them):
  the own-name table of the module 90161Z-T27-made-r2.ps1, whether or not RADE_MADE names them. The group and the level are different
  (the PFM, 25 Nov 26): a group cannot go to a Recycle Bin, so its removal cannot be undone; they go only when RADE_MADE names them.
  Never a list, group or level whose name is not in that table. The other gates stay: RADE_MODE=uninstall, a made list (RADE_MADE) of schema
  rade-made/1 for the app 90-161.Z, the app name and the own-name table. They print one ITEM line for each thing (PASS removed, SKIP
  nothing left, FAIL) and one RESULT line (PASS, SKIP or FAIL). A second run finds nothing left and prints SKIP. Without RADE_MODE=uninstall
  and a made list of schema rade-made/1 for 90-161.Z they remove nothing and print FAIL.
    Lists   Removes each of the 12 lists of 90-161.Z to the site Recycle Bin (restorable for 93 days). A list is removed only when its
            folder name is its internal name AND its title is its fixed title (or, for a list that a stopped install left, its internal
            name): a list that a person made and titled like ours, and a list of ours that a person retitled, stay and print SKIP. A list
            that other lists point to is removed after the lists that point to it.
    Access  Removes the group PFM Office and the permission level PFM Office Edit All Items, each one only when RADE_MADE names it (the
            install made it). A group or level that RADE_MADE does not name stays and prints SKIP "not made by the install" (T20 makes
            each one only when the site has none, so one that was there before the install is not ours to remove).
    Local   Removes the install note file of this computer (T22 folder), only when the made list names it (a file is not covered by
            the decision of 25 Nov 26). RADE keeps its own install record and marks it uninstalled; this script never touches that record.
  The read-only checks and the step (a round step; they need no made list). Module: 90161Z-T27-check-r2.ps1.
    Gone    After Uninstall: none of the 12 lists is on the site.
    Install After the install from zero: the 12 lists are on the site, and the process steps the next part needs are in PFM Process Steps.
    Step    1 fake publication (made by T26 Make) moves from step 1 (Request, DAFMAN 90-161 3.1) to step 2 (Drafting with SMEs, 3.2), and
