# @@SHARED task-common-2b522804@@ (RADE writes the shared block "task-common" here; its text is in the bundle part "Shared blocks")
# @@SHARED site-common-cc1bf548@@ (RADE writes the shared block "site-common" here; its text is in the bundle part "Shared blocks")
# R46 (the PFM, 26 Nov 26, R45 finding 2): the RADE sign-in block, for Set-SignInDpiAware (a smaller sign-in window).
# @@SHARED rade-signin-50c4c3e9@@ (RADE writes the shared block "rade-signin" here; its text is in the bundle part "Shared blocks")

$lines = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
$script:passed = 0; $script:failed = 0; $script:skipped = 0
# The number of things this run removed so far; the stop handler prints it when a part stops after a removal.
$script:removedSoFar = 0
# Adds one "ITEM <name> <status> <text>" line and counts a PASS, a SKIP or a FAIL.
function Add-Item([string]$Name, [string]$Status, [string]$Text) {
  $lines.Add('ITEM ' + $Name + ' ' + $Status + ' ' + $Text)
  if ($Status -eq 'PASS') { $script:passed++ } elseif ($Status -eq 'FAIL') { $script:failed++ } elseif ($Status -eq 'SKIP') { $script:skipped++ }
}
# Adds the one RESULT line of an Uninstall part: FAIL when an item failed, else PASS when something was removed, else SKIP.
function Add-UninstallResult([int]$Removed) {
  $word = $(if ($script:failed) { 'FAIL' } elseif ($Removed) { 'PASS' } else { 'SKIP' })
  $lines.Add('RESULT UNINSTALL ' + $Part.ToUpperInvariant() + ' ' + $word + ' removed=' + $Removed)
}
# Loads the newest installed PnP.PowerShell; stops with a plain message when it is not installed.
function Import-PnPNewest {
  $mod = @(Get-Module -ListAvailable -Name PnP.PowerShell | Sort-Object Version -Descending)
  if (-not $mod.Count) { throw 'PNP not installed: PnP.PowerShell is not on this computer.' }
  $null = & { Import-Module PnP.PowerShell -RequiredVersion $mod[0].Version -DisableNameChecking } *>&1
}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Signs in to the one site with the web login (CAC), after the module is loaded, or (R47, a T30 batch) reuses the sign-in
  of this process to the same site. Adds the line ROUTE web-login PASS (and SIGNIN reused when it reuses).
.OUTPUTS
  None.
#>
function Connect-LifecycleSite {
  Import-PnPNewest
  # R47 (R46 finding 1): no DPI call here any more (RADE engine-v47 turns the DPI sign-in off).
  # R47 (fewer CAC sign-ins): in a T30 batch an earlier part of this process signed in to this site; that sign-in is used
  # again (Get-PnPConnection), with no second sign-in window. Outside a batch no connection is there, so it signs in.
  $now = $null; try { $now = Get-PnPConnection -ErrorAction Stop } catch { $now = $null }   # no connection: sign in below
  if ($now -and ([string]$now.Url).TrimEnd('/') -eq ([string]$script:site).TrimEnd('/')) { $lines.Add('SIGNIN reused: this process is signed in to the site already') }
  else {
    Write-Host 'NOW Signing in to the site (if a sign-in window opens, sign in with your CAC)'
    $null = & { Connect-PnPOnline -Url $script:site -UseWebLogin -ErrorAction Stop } *>&1
  }
  $lines.Add('ROUTE web-login PASS')
}
# Cuts an error message to 120 characters, so no long site text reaches a line.
function Get-ShortError($ErrorRecord) { $m = [string]$ErrorRecord.Exception.Message; return $m.Substring(0, [Math]::Min(120, $m.Length)) }
<#
.SYNOPSIS
  The part Lists: removes each of the 12 lists of 90-161.Z by its fixed title (the own-name table), to the site Recycle Bin, whether or
  not the made list names it, and reads each back. A list is removed only when its folder name is its internal name AND its title is
  its fixed title; any other list stays.
.PARAMETER Made
  The result of Read-MadeFile (accepted). It only adds NOTE lines here: a list name in it that is not one of the 12 is refused.
#>
function Invoke-ListsPart($Made) {
  foreach ($n in (Get-MadeName $Made.Items 'list')) {
    if (-not (Resolve-OwnList $n)) { $lines.Add('NOTE refused: a list in the made list is not one of the 12 lists of 90-161.Z (not removed)') }
  }
  Connect-LifecycleSite
  Write-Host 'NOW Reading the lists of the site'
  $siteLists = Get-SiteList
  $removed = @(); $n = 0
  foreach ($k in $OwnLists.Keys) {
    $n++; $tag = 'l' + $n.ToString('00') + '-' + $k
    $l = Find-OwnListToRemove $siteLists $k
    if (-not $l) { Add-Item $tag 'SKIP' (Get-ListLeftReason $siteLists $k); continue }
    try {
      Write-Host ('NOW Removing the list ' + $OwnLists[$k])
      $null = Remove-PnPList -Identity ([string]$l.Id) -Recycle -Force -ErrorAction Stop
      $removed += $k; $script:removedSoFar++
    } catch { Add-Item $tag 'FAIL' ('the list could not be removed: ' + (Get-ShortError $_) + ' (run this step again)') }
  }
  $after = @(Get-SiteList)
  foreach ($k in $removed) {
    $tag = 'r-' + $k
    if (Find-OwnListToRemove $after $k) { Add-Item $tag 'FAIL' 'the list is still on the site after the remove (run this step again)' }
    else { Add-Item $tag 'PASS' ('the list is removed (moved to the site Recycle Bin): ' + $OwnLists[$k]) }
  }
  Add-UninstallResult $removed.Count
}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
  The part Access: removes the group PFM Office, then the permission level PFM Office Edit All Items, each only when the made list names
  it (the install made it; a group cannot go to a Recycle Bin). A name that is not named stays and prints SKIP. No other group and no
  other level is ever removed.
.PARAMETER Made
  The result of Read-MadeFile (accepted). A group or level name in it that is not ours is refused (NOTE) and never removed.
#>
function Invoke-AccessPart($Made) {
  foreach ($n in (Get-MadeName $Made.Items 'group')) {
    if (-not (Test-OwnName 'group' $n)) { $lines.Add('NOTE refused: a group in the made list is not the group of 90-161.Z (not removed)') }
  }
  foreach ($n in (Get-MadeName $Made.Items 'level')) {
    if (-not (Test-OwnName 'level' $n)) { $lines.Add('NOTE refused: a level in the made list is not the level of 90-161.Z (not removed)') }
  }
  $madeGroup = @(Get-MadeName $Made.Items 'group') -ccontains $OwnGroup
  $madeLevel = @(Get-MadeName $Made.Items 'level') -ccontains $OwnLevel
  Connect-LifecycleSite
  $removed = Invoke-OwnAccessRemoval 'a1-group' $OwnGroup $madeGroup { Get-GroupId $OwnGroup } { Remove-PnPGroup -Identity $OwnGroup -Force -ErrorAction Stop }
  $removed += Invoke-OwnAccessRemoval 'a2-level' $OwnLevel $madeLevel { Get-OwnLevelId } { Remove-PnPRoleDefinition -Identity $OwnLevel -Force -ErrorAction Stop }
  Add-UninstallResult $removed
}
# The number of the permission level PFM Office Edit All Items on the site, or 0 when it is not there.
function Get-OwnLevelId { $v = Get-RoleLevel $OwnLevel 0; if ($v) { return [int]$v.Id }; return 0 }
<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Removes one named thing of the site (the group or the level) when the made list names it and it is there, and reads it back.
.PARAMETER Tag
  The item name for the result line.
.PARAMETER Name
  The name of the thing (it is one of the 2 fixed names of the module; the caller checked it).
.PARAMETER Named
  Whether the made list names the thing (the install made it). When it does not, nothing is removed and the item is a SKIP.
.PARAMETER Find
  A script block that returns the number of the thing, or 0 when it is not on the site.
.PARAMETER Remove
  A script block that removes it.
.OUTPUTS
  System.Int32. 1 when it was removed and read back, else 0.
#>
function Invoke-OwnAccessRemoval([string]$Tag, [string]$Name, [bool]$Named, [scriptblock]$Find, [scriptblock]$Remove) {
  if (-not $Named) { Add-Item $Tag 'SKIP' ('not made by the install: ' + $Name + ' stays'); return 0 }
  if (-not (& $Find)) { Add-Item $Tag 'SKIP' ('not on the site: nothing left to remove: ' + $Name); return 0 }
  try { Write-Host ('NOW Removing ' + $Name); $null = & $Remove }
  catch { Add-Item $Tag 'FAIL' ('could not be removed: ' + (Get-ShortError $_) + ' (run this step again)'); return 0 }
  $script:removedSoFar++
  if (& $Find) { Add-Item $Tag 'FAIL' ('still on the site after the remove: ' + $Name + ' (run this step again)'); return 0 }
  Add-Item $Tag 'PASS' ('removed: ' + $Name)
  return 1
}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
  The part Local: removes the install note file (T22 folder) when the made list names it. Not the RADE install record.
.PARAMETER Made
  The result of Read-MadeFile (accepted).
.PARAMETER Dir
  The T27 folder; the T22 folder is its neighbor.
#>
function Invoke-LocalPart($Made, [string]$Dir) {
  $names = @(Get-MadeName $Made.Items 'file')
  if (-not $names.Count) { Add-Item 'f00-note' 'SKIP' 'no file is named in the made list: nothing to remove'; Add-UninstallResult 0; return }
  $removed = 0; $n = 0
  foreach ($name in $names) {
    $n++; $tag = 'f' + $n.ToString('00') + '-note'
    # Only the install note, only by its plain file name: a path, or any other file name, is refused.
    if (-not (Test-OwnName 'file' $name)) { $lines.Add('NOTE refused: a file in the made list is not the install note of 90-161.Z (not removed)'); continue }
    $path = Join-Path (Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $Dir) 'T22') $name
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path -PathType Leaf)) { Add-Item $tag 'SKIP' 'the install note is not on this computer: nothing left to remove'; continue }
    try { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $path -ErrorAction Stop } catch { Add-Item $tag 'FAIL' ('the install note could not be removed: ' + (Get-ShortError $_)); continue }
    $script:removedSoFar++
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path) { Add-Item $tag 'FAIL' 'the install note is still there after the remove'; continue }
    Add-Item $tag 'PASS' 'the install note is removed'; $removed++
  }
  Add-UninstallResult $removed
}

$fatal = $false; $site = ''; $secret = @(); $dir = ''; $uninstall = $false
try {
  $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
  # The modules are dot-sourced here, in this script's scope, so they see the values and helpers above (the T20 helpers give
  # Get-SiteList, Find-OurList, Get-GroupId and Get-RoleLevel; RADE saves them in this folder too).
  foreach ($m in '90161Z-T27-made-r2.ps1', '90161Z-T27-check-r2.ps1', '90161Z-T20-helpers-r4.ps1') {

    . (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $m)
  }
  $who = Get-TaskId $Id; $secret = $who.Secret
  if ($TestDir) { $dir = $TestDir } else { $dir = Get-TaskDir $who.Id $task 'Task 27' -Create }
  Set-Location -LiteralPath $dir
  $lines.Add('TASK T27 lifecycle ' + $Rev + ', part ' + $Part + ', ' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'))
  $uninstall = $Part -in 'Lists', 'Access', 'Local'
  if ($uninstall) {
    # The gate: nothing is removed unless RADE says Uninstall and its made list is accepted.
    $made = Read-MadeFile ([string]$env:RADE_MODE) ([string]$env:RADE_MADE)
    if (-not $made.Ok) { Add-Item 'g-made' 'FAIL' $made.Why; $lines.Add('RESULT UNINSTALL ' + $Part.ToUpperInvariant() + ' FAIL removed=0'); throw 'GATE not passed.' }
    $lines.Add('MADE entries=' + @($made.Items).Count + '; without step, kind or name=' + $made.Dropped)
  }

  switch ($Part) {
    'Lists' { Invoke-ListsPart $made } 'Access' { Invoke-AccessPart $made } 'Local' { Invoke-LocalPart $made $dir }
    'Gone' { Connect-LifecycleSite; Invoke-GonePart } 'Install' { Connect-LifecycleSite; Invoke-InstallPart }
    default { Connect-LifecycleSite; Invoke-StepPart $dir }
  }
  # R47: a T30 batch sets KANON_KEEP_SIGNIN=1, so the next part of the batch uses this sign-in again; the batch signs out at its end.
  if ($Part -notin 'Local' -and $env:KANON_KEEP_SIGNIN -ne '1') { try { $null = & { Disconnect-PnPOnline -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } *>&1 } catch { $null = $_ } }
} catch {
  $fatal = $true
  # A part that throws after a removal (a read-back, a lookup) still prints its FAIL item and its RESULT line, and counts as failed
  # (R43 review). A part that printed its RESULT line already (the gate, or a normal end) is not counted twice.
  if ($uninstall -and -not @($lines | Where-Object { $_ -cmatch '^RESULT UNINSTALL ' }).Count) {
    Add-Item 's-stopped' 'FAIL' 'the part stopped before it finished (see STOPPED); what was removed stays removed (run this step again)'
    Add-UninstallResult $script:removedSoFar
  }
  if ($script:site) { $site = $script:site }
  $m = ConvertTo-Masked (Hide-Site ([string]$_) $site) $secret
  $lines.Add('STOPPED: ' + $m.Substring(0, [Math]::Min(300, $m.Length)) + ' (the part can be run again)')
} finally {
  if ($script:site) { $site = $script:site }
  $lines.Add('LIFECYCLE ' + $Part + ' done: passed=' + $script:passed + ' skipped=' + $script:skipped + ' failed=' + $script:failed)
  # Every line is masked once more before it is shown or saved.

  $resultName = '90161Z-T27-' + $Part.ToLowerInvariant() + $(if ($Label) { '-' + $Label } else { '' }) + '-' + $Rev + '.txt'
  if ($dir) { try { Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir $resultName) -Value $masked -Encoding UTF8 } catch { $null = $_ } }
  $masked | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_ }
  if (-not $NoPause -and -not $env:RADE_CONTRACT) { [void](Read-Host 'Press Enter to close') }
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  90-161.Z Task 27 r1, module "made" (round R43; the PFM, 25 Nov 26: RADE Uninstall): the one table of what the 90-161.Z install
  can make, and the gate that reads RADE's list of what the install made (RADE_MADE).
.DESCRIPTION
  Loaded by 90161Z-T27-lifecycle-r2.ps1 (dot-sourced from the same folder, in its scope); it does nothing when it is run alone.
  The contract (RADE engine-v41; the R43 plan, "Engine facts"): RADE runs an uninstall step with RADE_MODE=uninstall and RADE_MADE = the
  path of a JSON file of schema rade-made/1: { schema, app, made: [ { step, kind, name } ] }. Each made entry comes from one line that an

  of the app 90-161.Z, and the thing is in the own-name table below. The PFM's decision of 25 Nov 26: the lists are removed by their fixed
  names whether or not the made list names them (the 12 lists of the test site were made before RADE installs); the group and the level

# The app that the made list must name.
$MadeApp = '90-161.Z'
$MadeSchema = 'rade-made/1'
# The 12 lists the install makes: internal name = display title (T20 creates each under its internal name, then sets the display
# title, and prints "MADE list: <display title>"). Order: the lists that
# other lists point to by a lookup column come LAST, so Uninstall removes a list before the lists it points to

$OwnLists = [ordered]@{

  PFMActivityLog = 'PFM Activity Log'; PFMWaivers = 'PFM Waivers'; PFMPublications = 'PFM Publications'

}

$OwnGroup = 'PFM Office'
$OwnLevel = 'PFM Office Edit All Items'
# The note file the install step writes on this computer (T22 maint -Part Install), in the T22 folder. The RADE install record is not here:
# RADE keeps it and marks it uninstalled (DECISIONS 2026-11-25), so no script of this task touches it.
$OwnNote = '^90161Z-T22-install-r\d+\.txt$'

# The answer of Read-MadeFile for a made list that is not accepted: not Ok, the reason, no entries.
function Get-MadeRefusal([string]$Why) { return @{ Ok = $false; Why = $Why; Items = @(); Dropped = 0 } }

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Reads RADE's made list and checks it before anything is removed.
.PARAMETER Mode
  The value of RADE_MODE. Only 'uninstall' passes.
.PARAMETER Path
  The value of RADE_MADE: the path of the JSON file.
.OUTPUTS
  System.Collections.Hashtable. Ok ($true or $false), Why (the reason when not Ok, no path and no site text), Items (the entries that
  have a step, a kind and a name, as text), Dropped (the count of entries that miss one of the three).
#>
function Read-MadeFile([string]$Mode, [string]$Path) {
  if ($Mode -cne 'uninstall') { return (Get-MadeRefusal 'RADE_MODE is not uninstall: nothing is removed') }
  if (-not $Path -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path -PathType Leaf)) { return (Get-MadeRefusal 'RADE_MADE is not a file: nothing is removed') }
  try { $j = Get-Content -LiteralPath $Path -Raw -Encoding UTF8 | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { return (Get-MadeRefusal 'RADE_MADE is not valid JSON: nothing is removed') }
  if ([string]$j.schema -cne $MadeSchema) { return (Get-MadeRefusal ('RADE_MADE schema is not ' + $MadeSchema + ': nothing is removed')) }
  if ([string]$j.app -cne $MadeApp) { return (Get-MadeRefusal ('RADE_MADE is not for the app ' + $MadeApp + ': nothing is removed')) }
  $items = @(); $dropped = 0
  foreach ($m in @($j.made)) {
    if ($m -and $m.step -and $m.kind -and $m.name) { $items += @{ Step = [string]$m.step; Kind = [string]$m.kind; Name = [string]$m.name } } else { $dropped++ }
  }
  return @{ Ok = $true; Why = ''; Items = $items; Dropped = $dropped }
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  The names of one kind in the made list, without repeats.
.PARAMETER Items
  The Items of Read-MadeFile.
.PARAMETER Kind
  'list', 'group', 'level' or 'file'.
.OUTPUTS
  System.String[]. The names, in file order.
#>
function Get-MadeName($Items, [string]$Kind) {
  $seen = @{}; $out = @()
  foreach ($i in @($Items)) { if ($i.Kind -ceq $Kind -and -not $seen.ContainsKey($i.Name)) { $seen[$i.Name] = 1; $out += $i.Name } }
  return $out
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  The internal name of an own list, from its display title as T20 prints it in "MADE list: <title>"; '' for any other name.
.PARAMETER Name
  The name in the made list.
.OUTPUTS
  System.String. The internal name (a key of $OwnLists), or ''. The match is case sensitive.
#>
function Resolve-OwnList([string]$Name) {
  foreach ($k in $OwnLists.Keys) { if ($Name -ceq $OwnLists[$k]) { return [string]$k } }
  return ''
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  The site list to remove for one own list: its folder name is the internal name AND its title is the fixed title (or the internal name,
  which a list has between T20 step 1 and step 4); $null for any other list.
.PARAMETER SiteLists
  The lists of the site (Get-SiteList).
.PARAMETER Key
  The internal name (a key of $OwnLists).
.OUTPUTS
  The site list, or $null. A list with an own title and another folder name, and a list with the own folder name and another title,
  are never returned.
#>
function Find-OwnListToRemove($SiteLists, [string]$Key) {
  $l = Find-OurList $SiteLists $Key
  if ($l -and ([string]$l.Title -ceq $OwnLists[$Key] -or [string]$l.Title -ceq $Key)) { return $l }
  return $null
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  The reason text for an own list that Find-OwnListToRemove did not return (nothing left, or a list that is not ours holds the title).
.PARAMETER SiteLists
  The lists of the site.
.PARAMETER Key
  The internal name.
.OUTPUTS
  System.String. The text for the SKIP line (no title of a list that is not ours).
#>
function Get-ListLeftReason($SiteLists, [string]$Key) {
  if (Find-OurList $SiteLists $Key) { return 'the list with this folder name has another title, so it is not removed' }
  if (@($SiteLists | Where-Object { [string]$_.Title -ceq $OwnLists[$Key] }).Count) { return 'a list with this title is on the site, but it is not ours (another folder name): not removed' }
  return 'the list is not on the site: nothing left to remove'
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Whether a name in the made list is the one fixed own name of its kind: the group, the level or the install note file.
.PARAMETER Kind
  'group', 'level' or 'file'.
.PARAMETER Name
  The name in the made list.
.OUTPUTS
  System.Boolean. $true only for the group PFM Office, the level PFM Office Edit All Items, or a plain install note file name
  (no path: a name with a folder part is refused).
#>
function Test-OwnName([string]$Kind, [string]$Name) {
  switch ($Kind) {
    'group' { return ($Name -ceq $OwnGroup) }
    'level' { return ($Name -ceq $OwnLevel) }
    'file' { return ([IO.Path]::GetFileName($Name) -ceq $Name -and $Name -cmatch $OwnNote) }
    default { return $false }
  }
}

# The step the fake publication goes to (PFM Process Steps, StepNumber), and the step it starts at (T26 Make: step 1).

# The columns of PFM Publications that the step reads, and those that are required (tests/ps/Test-T27.ps1 checks the second list against the schema).
$PubFields = @('Title', 'ProcessStep', 'ActionStatus', 'ActionType', 'ProductType', 'PublicationType', 'Product', 'OPR', 'AppliesToLevel', 'MasterForm673Link')
$PubRequired = @('Title', 'ActionType', 'ProductType', 'ProcessStep', 'ActionStatus')

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  The part Gone (reads only): none of the 12 lists of 90-161.Z is on the site. The group and the level are reported as information
  (they stay when the site had them before the install).
#>
function Invoke-GonePart {
  Write-Host 'NOW Reading the lists of the site'
  $siteLists = Get-SiteList
  $left = @($OwnLists.Keys | Where-Object { Find-OurList $siteLists $_ })
  if ($left.Count) { Add-Item 'g1-lists' 'FAIL' ('lists of 90-161.Z still on the site=' + $left.Count + ' of ' + $OwnLists.Count + ': ' + (($left | ForEach-Object { $OwnLists[$_] }) -join ', ')) }
  else { Add-Item 'g1-lists' 'PASS' ('none of the ' + $OwnLists.Count + ' lists of 90-161.Z is on the site') }
  $lines.Add('ITEM g2-access INFO group ' + $OwnGroup + ' on the site=' + $(if (Get-GroupId $OwnGroup) { 'yes' } else { 'no' }) +
    '; level ' + $OwnLevel + ' on the site=' + $(if (Get-RoleLevel $OwnLevel 0) { 'yes' } else { 'no' }) + ' (kept when the site had them before the install)')
}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
  The part Install (reads only): the 12 lists are on the site under their titles, and PFM Process Steps holds the steps that the
  part Step needs.
#>
function Invoke-InstallPart {
  Write-Host 'NOW Reading the lists of the site'
  $siteLists = Get-SiteList
  $bad = @()
  foreach ($k in $OwnLists.Keys) {
    $l = Find-OurList $siteLists $k
    if (-not $l) { $bad += $OwnLists[$k] + ' (missing)' } elseif ([string]$l.Title -cne $OwnLists[$k]) { $bad += $OwnLists[$k] + ' (other title)' }
  }
  if ($bad.Count) { Add-Item 'i1-lists' 'FAIL' ('lists with a problem=' + $bad.Count + ' of ' + $OwnLists.Count + ': ' + ($bad -join ', ')) }
  else { Add-Item 'i1-lists' 'PASS' ('all ' + $OwnLists.Count + ' lists of 90-161.Z are on the site under their titles') }
  if ($bad -match 'PFM Process Steps') { Add-Item 'i2-steps' 'FAIL' 'PFM Process Steps is not usable: the seed rows cannot be read'; return }
  $steps = @(Get-StepRow)
  $have = @($StepFrom, $StepTo | Where-Object { $n = $_; @($steps | Where-Object { [int]$_['StepNumber'] -eq $n }).Count -eq 1 })
  if ($have.Count -eq 2) { Add-Item 'i2-steps' 'PASS' ('PFM Process Steps holds step ' + $StepFrom + ' and step ' + $StepTo + ' (rows in all=' + $steps.Count + ')') }
  else { Add-Item 'i2-steps' 'FAIL' ('PFM Process Steps misses step ' + $StepFrom + ' or step ' + $StepTo + ' (rows in all=' + $steps.Count + ')') }
}
# The rows of PFM Process Steps (all read; the list has 13 rows).
function Get-StepRow { return @(Get-PnPListItem -List 'PFM Process Steps' -Fields 'Title', 'StepNumber', 'TargetBusinessDays' -PageSize 500 -ErrorAction Stop) }
# The number in a lookup value (a SharePoint lookup reads back as an object with LookupId; a plain number is taken as it is); 0 when none.
function Get-LookupNumber($Value) {
  if ($null -eq $Value) { return 0 }
  if ($Value.PSObject.Properties['LookupId']) { return [int]$Value.LookupId }
  if ([string]$Value -match '^\d+$') { return [int]$Value }
  return 0
}
# The row number of the fake publication: from the T26 state file (T26 folder, next to the T27 folder), else by its exact title. 0 when none.
function Find-FakePubId([string]$Dir) {
  $state = Join-Path (Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $Dir) 'T26') $T26State
  $rows = @(Get-PnPListItem -List 'PFM Publications' -Fields 'Title', 'ProcessStep' -PageSize 500 -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { ([string]$_['Title']) -ceq $PubTitle } | Sort-Object { $_.Id })
  if (-not $rows.Count) { return 0 }
  if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $state -PathType Leaf) {
    $hit = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $state | Where-Object { ([string]$_) -match '^PubId=(\d+)$' })
    if ($hit.Count) { $id = [int](([string]$hit[0]).Substring(6)); if (@($rows | Where-Object { [int]$_.Id -eq $id }).Count) { return $id } }
  }
  return [int]$rows[0].Id
}
# Whether a column value is filled: a lookup or a link counts when its number or address is there, text when it is not blank.
function Test-Filled($Value) {
  if ($null -eq $Value) { return $false }
  if ($Value.PSObject.Properties['LookupId']) { return ([int]$Value.LookupId -gt 0) }
  if ($Value.PSObject.Properties['Url']) { return ([string]$Value.Url).Trim().Length -gt 0 }
  return ([string]$Value).Trim().Length -gt 0
}
# The row of the fake publication, with the columns the step reads (a column not named in -Fields cannot be read from a real item).
function Get-PubRow([int]$PubId) {
  return @(Get-PnPListItem -List 'PFM Publications' -Fields $PubFields -PageSize 500 -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { [int]$_.Id -eq $PubId })[0]
}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Checks the exit conditions of step 1 that the lists can show (see the header: saved, product, opr, directive, level, form673) on one
  publication row, and adds one ITEM line for each.
.PARAMETER Row
  The row of PFM Publications (Get-PubRow).
.PARAMETER Phase
  'b' (before the move) or 'a' (after it): the first letter of each item name.
.OUTPUTS
  System.Int32. The number of conditions that failed.
#>
function Test-StepOneExit($Row, [string]$Phase) {
  $blank = @($PubRequired | Where-Object { -not (Test-Filled $Row[$_]) })
  $isNew = ([string]$Row['ActionType'] -ceq 'New')
  $cond = @(
    @('1-saved', ($blank.Count -eq 0), 'every required column is filled', ('required columns blank: ' + ($blank -join ', '))),
    @('2-product', ((Test-Filled $Row['ActionType']) -and ($isNew -or (Test-Filled $Row['Product']))),
      'action type set, and the product named (or the action is New)', 'the action type or the product is not set'),
    @('3-opr', (Test-Filled $Row['OPR']), 'the OPR is named', 'the OPR is blank'),
    @('4-directive', (([string]$Row['ProductType'] -cne 'Publication') -or (Test-Filled $Row['PublicationType'])),
      'the publication type is set (the directive decision)', 'the publication type is blank'),
    @('5-level', (Test-Filled $Row['AppliesToLevel']), 'the scope level (Applies to Level) is set', 'the scope level is blank'),
    @('6-form673', (Test-Filled $Row['MasterForm673Link']), 'DAF Form 673 is started (the master 673 link is set)', 'DAF Form 673 is not started (the master 673 link is blank)'))
  $failed = 0
  foreach ($c in $cond) {
    if ($c[1]) { Add-Item ($Phase + $c[0]) 'PASS' ('exit condition of step ' + $StepFrom + ': ' + $c[2]) }
    else { Add-Item ($Phase + $c[0]) 'FAIL' ('exit condition of step ' + $StepFrom + ' not met: ' + $c[3]); $failed++ }
  }
  return $failed
}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
  The part Step: the fake publication of T26 moves from step 1 (Request, DAFMAN 90-161 3.1) to step 2 (Drafting with SMEs, 3.2) only
  when the exit conditions of step 1 hold on it; the move is read back and the conditions are checked again.
.PARAMETER Dir
  The T27 folder (its neighbor T26 holds the T26 state file).
#>
function Invoke-StepPart([string]$Dir) {
  Write-Host 'NOW Looking for the fake publication'
  $pubId = Find-FakePubId $Dir
  if (-not $pubId) { Add-Item 's1-publication' 'FAIL' 'no fake publication on the site: run the step that makes it first'; $lines.Add('RESULT STEP FAIL no fake publication'); return }
  $steps = @(Get-StepRow)
  $to = @($steps | Where-Object { [int]$_['StepNumber'] -eq $StepTo })
  $from = @($steps | Where-Object { [int]$_['StepNumber'] -eq $StepFrom })
  if ($to.Count -ne 1 -or $from.Count -ne 1) {
    Add-Item 's1-publication' 'FAIL' ('PFM Process Steps has no single row for step ' + $StepFrom + ' or step ' + $StepTo + ' (the install did not seed it)')
    $lines.Add('RESULT STEP FAIL no step rows'); return
  }
  $row = Get-PubRow $pubId
  $now = Get-LookupNumber $row['ProcessStep']
  if ($now -ne [int]$from[0].Id -and $now -ne [int]$to[0].Id) {
    Add-Item 's1-publication' 'FAIL' ('the fake publication is at neither step ' + $StepFrom + ' nor step ' + $StepTo + ': no move'); $lines.Add('RESULT STEP FAIL not at step 1'); return
  }
  Add-Item 's1-publication' 'PASS' ('the fake publication is on the site and is at step ' + $(if ($now -eq [int]$from[0].Id) { $StepFrom } else { $StepTo }))
  $lines.Add('NOTE not shown by the lists, so not checked: "PFM confirms" (exit of step 1); and the actions of DAFMAN 3.1.2 to 3.1.8 that a person takes (research, record sets, PCM, notify the PFM)')
  if (Test-StepOneExit $row 'b') { $lines.Add('RESULT STEP FAIL exit conditions of step ' + $StepFrom + ' not met: no move'); return }
  if ($now -eq [int]$to[0].Id) { Add-Item 's2-move' 'SKIP' ('the fake publication is at step ' + $StepTo + ' already (an earlier run moved it)') }
  else {
    Write-Host ('NOW Moving the fake publication to step ' + $StepTo)
    try { $null = Set-PnPListItem -List 'PFM Publications' -Identity $pubId -Values @{ ProcessStep = [int]$to[0].Id } -ErrorAction Stop }
    catch { Add-Item 's2-move' 'FAIL' ('the move failed: ' + (Get-ShortError $_)); $lines.Add('RESULT STEP FAIL not moved'); return }
    $row = Get-PubRow $pubId
    if ((Get-LookupNumber $row['ProcessStep']) -ne [int]$to[0].Id) {
      Add-Item 's2-move' 'FAIL' ('read back: the publication is not at step ' + $StepTo); $lines.Add('RESULT STEP FAIL read back'); return
    }
    Add-Item 's2-move' 'PASS' ('moved from step ' + $StepFrom + ' to step ' + $StepTo + ' and read back from the site')
  }
  if (Test-StepOneExit $row 'a') { $lines.Add('RESULT STEP FAIL exit conditions of step ' + $StepFrom + ' no longer hold after the move'); return }
  $days = [string]$to[0]['TargetBusinessDays']
  $logs = @(Get-PnPListItem -List 'PFM Activity Log' -Fields 'Title', 'Publication' -PageSize 500 -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { (Get-LookupNumber $_['Publication']) -eq $pubId }).Count
  $lines.Add('ITEM s3-info INFO target business days of step ' + $StepTo + '=' + $days + '; activity log rows on the publication=' + $logs + ' (a flow writes them; 0 when no flow is imported)')
  $lines.Add('RESULT STEP PASS from=' + $StepFrom + ' to=' + $StepTo + ' target-days=' + $days)
}
'@ }

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  90-161.Z Task 20 list provisioning r4, module "helpers": the plan of the payload and the SharePoint helpers (REST, CSOM
  merge, groups, permission levels). Moved here from 90161Z-T20-provision-lists-r4.ps1 (code standard file size cap, C4); the code is unchanged.
.DESCRIPTION
  Loaded by 90161Z-T20-provision-lists-r4.ps1 (dot-sourced from the same folder, in its scope); it does nothing when it is run alone.
  Inputs: $site and the PnP.PowerShell connection of the main file ($script:site). Outputs: the functions Get-Plan, Invoke-Rest,
  Get-RestValue, Get-SiteList, Find-OurList, Add-MadeLine, Write-CsomMerge, Get-GroupId, Get-RoleLevel, Get-WebBinding, ConvertTo-PermissionWord, Test-LevelPermission.
  Network: the one SharePoint site of the main file, through the PnP.PowerShell connection of the main file (none in Get-Plan).
  Writes: Write-CsomMerge and Invoke-Rest (Post) change the site when the main file calls them in create mode; nothing on this computer.
  Credentials: none of its own (the main file signs in).
  Run: not alone; powershell.exe -File 90161Z-T20-provision-lists-r4.ps1 loads it.
#>

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  What the payload asks for, per list (internal name): display title, columns, indexed columns, views, rows, versioning
  and whether "edit own rows" is set.
.PARAMETER P
  The payload (provisioning-payload.json, read with ConvertFrom-Json).
.OUTPUTS
  System.Collections.Specialized.OrderedDictionary. One entry per list, in payload order.
#>
function Get-Plan($P) {
  $plan = [ordered]@{}
  foreach ($l in $P.lists) {
    $plan[[string]$l.body.Title] = @{ Display = [string]$l.body.Title; Fields = @(); Indexed = @(); Views = @(); Rows = 0; Versioning = [bool]$l.body.EnableVersioning; Secure = $false }
  }
  foreach ($op in $P.fields) {
    if ([string]$op.uri -notmatch "getbytitle\('([^']+)'\)/(fields/createfieldasxml|views)$") { continue }
    $e = $plan[$Matches[1]]
    if ($Matches[2] -eq 'views') { $e.Views += [string]$op.body.Title; continue }
    $xml = [string]$op.body.parameters.SchemaXml
    if ($xml -notmatch '\bName="([^"]+)"') { throw ('PAYLOAD column without a name in ' + $Matches[1]) }
    $name = $Matches[1]
    $e.Fields += $name
    if ($xml -match '\bIndexed="TRUE"') { $e.Indexed += $name }
  }
  foreach ($r in $P.rows) { if ([string]$r.uri -match "getbytitle\('([^']+)'\)/items$") { $plan[$Matches[1]].Rows++ } }
  foreach ($u in $P.updates) {
    if ([string]$u.uri -match "getbytitle\('([^']+)'\)$") { $plan[$Matches[1]].Display = [string]$u.body.Title }
    elseif ([string]$u.uri -match "getbytitle\('([^']+)'\)/fields/getbyinternalnameortitle\('([^']+)'\)$" -and $u.body.Indexed) { $plan[$Matches[1]].Indexed += $Matches[2] }
  }
  foreach ($x in $P.permissions) {
    if ([string]$x.uri -notmatch "getbytitle\('([^']+)'\)$") { throw 'PAYLOAD permission request not understood' }
    $title = [uri]::UnescapeDataString($Matches[1])
    $hit = @($plan.Keys | Where-Object { $plan[$_].Display -eq $title })
    if ($hit.Count -ne 1) { throw ('PAYLOAD permission for a list that is not in the payload: ' + $title) }
    $plan[$hit[0]].Secure = $true
  }
  return $plan
}

function Invoke-Rest([string]$Method, [string]$Uri, [string]$Body) {
  # One SharePoint REST request through the signed-in PnP connection (sign-in cookies and the request digest come from PnP).
  $url = $script:site.TrimEnd('/') + '/' + $Uri
  # No -Accept: the cmdlet's own default (application/json;odata=nometadata) is what the script reads.
  if ($Method -eq 'Get') { return [string](Invoke-PnPSPRestMethod -Method Get -Url $url -Raw -ErrorAction Stop) }
  return [string](Invoke-PnPSPRestMethod -Method Post -Url $url -Content $Body -ContentType 'application/json;odata=verbose' -Raw -ErrorAction Stop)
}

# Reads a REST collection and returns its "value" items as an array.
function Get-RestValue([string]$Uri) {
  $j = (Invoke-Rest 'Get' $Uri '') | ConvertFrom-Json
  return @($j.value)
}

function Get-SiteList {
  # Every list on the site that is not hidden, with the folder name it was created under (that name does not change when
  # the title does, so it finds a list before and after its rename).
  $q = '_api/web/lists?$select=Id,Title,ItemCount,EnableVersioning,BaseTemplate,Hidden,HasUniqueRoleAssignments,RootFolder/Name&$expand=RootFolder&$top=1000'
  return @(Get-RestValue $q | Where-Object { -not $_.Hidden })
}

function Find-OurList($SiteLists, [string]$Internal) {
  # Ours = created under the internal name, so its folder has that name (case sensitive). A list that a person made and titled
  # "PFM Settings" has another folder name: it is never matched, so nothing is added to it.
  foreach ($l in $SiteLists) { if ([string]$l.RootFolder.Name -ceq $Internal) { return $l } }
  return $null
}

# True when a name is one of the fixed names of 90-161.Z for its kind: a list title of the plan (the payload), the group $OfficeGroup or the
# level $OfficeLevel (both from the main file and the access module, read from the scope that loaded this file). Case sensitive.
function Test-MadeName([string]$Kind, [string]$Name) {
  switch ($Kind) {
    'list' { return (@($plan.Values | ForEach-Object { [string]$_.Display }) -ccontains $Name) }
    'group' { return ($Name -ceq $OfficeGroup) }
    'level' { return ($Name -ceq $OfficeLevel) }
    default { return $false }
  }
}

# Adds the line "MADE <kind>: <name>" to the output lines for one item that THIS run created (RADE engine-v41 reads it, and the Uninstall
# of 90-161.Z gets it back in RADE_MADE). Kind is a lowercase word (list, group, level). Call it only after the item is made, never in a
# dry run and never for an item that was already there. A MADE line is printed only for a fixed name of the app (Test-MadeName), never for
# site data, so the final mask of the main file leaves it as it is (ConvertTo-FinalLine, which reads $script:MadeLines):
# a site named "office" must not turn "PFM Office" into "PFM <SITE-NAME>".
function Add-MadeLine([string]$Kind, [string]$Name) {
  if (-not (Test-MadeName $Kind $Name)) { $lines.Add('NOTE no MADE line: a name of the kind ' + $Kind + ' is not a fixed name of 90-161.Z'); return }
  $line = 'MADE ' + $Kind + ': ' + $Name
  if (-not $script:MadeLines) { $script:MadeLines = @{} }
  $lines.Add($line); $script:MadeLines[$line] = 1
}

# A MERGE of the payload, written through CSOM: every property of the body except __metadata is set, then Update.
function Write-CsomMerge([string]$ListId, [string]$FieldName, $Body) {
  $ctx = Get-PnPContext
  $target = $ctx.Web.Lists.GetById([guid]$ListId)
  if ($FieldName) { $target = $target.Fields.GetByInternalNameOrTitle($FieldName) }
  foreach ($prop in $Body.PSObject.Properties) { if ($prop.Name -ne '__metadata') { $target.($prop.Name) = $prop.Value } }
  $target.Update()
  $ctx.ExecuteQuery()
}


# Finds a site group by its name; returns its Id, or 0 when the site has no group with that name.
function Get-GroupId([string]$Name) {
  $hit = @(Get-RestValue ('_api/web/sitegroups?$select=Id,Title&$top=5000') | Where-Object { [string]$_.Title -eq $Name })
  if ($hit.Count) { return [int]$hit[0].Id }
  return 0
}

# Finds a permission level of the site by its name, or by its kind when the name is empty; returns it, or $null.
function Get-RoleLevel([string]$Name, [int]$Kind) {
  $all = @(Get-RestValue ('_api/web/roledefinitions?$select=Id,Name,RoleTypeKind,BasePermissions&$top=500'))
  $hit = @($all | Where-Object { ($Name -and [string]$_.Name -eq $Name) -or (-not $Name -and [int]$_.RoleTypeKind -eq $Kind) })
  if ($hit.Count) { return $hit[0] }
  return $null
}

# The Ids of the permission levels a group holds on the site itself; none when it holds no level there.
function Get-WebBinding([int]$PrincipalId) {
  $uri = '_api/web/roleassignments/getbyprincipalid(' + $PrincipalId + ')/roledefinitionbindings?$select=Id'
  try { return @(Get-RestValue $uri | ForEach-Object { [int]$_.Id }) } catch { return @() }
}

# One word (High or Low) of SP.BasePermissions as a number, whatever JSON type it came in: SharePoint writes a string, and on
# Windows PowerShell 5.1 ConvertFrom-Json makes a JSON number an Int32 or an Int64 by its size. Parsed from its invariant text.
function ConvertTo-PermissionWord($Value) { return [long]::Parse(([string]$Value).Trim(), [Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture) }

# True when a level holds every permission of another level (both from Get-RoleLevel) plus the extra bits given, checked bit
# by bit in both 32-bit words.
function Test-LevelPermission($Level, $Base, [long]$Extra) {
  $have = @((ConvertTo-PermissionWord $Level.BasePermissions.Low), (ConvertTo-PermissionWord $Level.BasePermissions.High))
  $want = @(((ConvertTo-PermissionWord $Base.BasePermissions.Low) -bor $Extra), (ConvertTo-PermissionWord $Base.BasePermissions.High))
  for ($w = 0; $w -lt 2; $w++) { for ($i = 0; $i -lt 32; $i++) { $bit = [long]1 -shl $i; if (($want[$w] -band $bit) -and -not ($have[$w] -band $bit)) { return $false } } }
  return $true
}

# ==== Part 6 of 6: the RADE engine (engine/ps, in run order)
# ==== Engine part: engine/ps/01-base.ps1 (sha256 ed0e1410780e)
# RADE engine part 01, the base: finds the user's OneDrive and RADE folders, masks the DODID in text,
# moves an old app folder into OneDrive\RADE, and resolves the working folder. Used by every later part.
# Joined into every bundle by engine/rade_build.py; Windows PowerShell 5.1.

# ---------------- RADE, the Redacted Application Deployment Engine (generated; same engine in every round bundle) ----------------
# Returns the secrets to mask (the DODID, the profile folder name, the user name), each 4 or more characters, longest
# first so a longer one is masked before a shorter one inside it. Takes the DODID and the profile folder name.
function Get-Secret([string]$Id, [string]$Leaf) {
  @($Id, $Leaf, $env:USERNAME) | Where-Object { $_ -and $_.Length -ge 4 } | Sort-Object -Unique | Sort-Object Length -Descending
}
# Replaces every secret (the DODID, the profile folder name, the user name) in the text with <DODID>. Takes the text;
# gives back the masked text.
function ConvertTo-Masked([string]$Text) {
  foreach ($x in $script:secret) { $Text = $Text -replace [regex]::Escape($x), '<DODID>' }
  return $Text
}
# Gives the name of the Windows profile folder (the DODID); an empty text when there is none. Takes nothing.
function Get-ProfileLeaf { if ($env:USERPROFILE) { return (Split-Path -Leaf $env:USERPROFILE) }; return '' }
# Gives the path of the user's OneDrive folder (under $usersRoot, from the profile folder name). It only builds the
# path; takes nothing.
function Get-OneDrivePath {
  $leaf = Get-ProfileLeaf
  if (-not $leaf) { $leaf = 'no-profile-folder' }
  return (Join-Path (Join-Path $usersRoot $leaf) 'OneDrive - United States Air Force')
}
# Gives the path of the RADE folder inside OneDrive (OneDrive\RADE). Takes nothing; creates nothing.
function Get-RadePath { return (Join-Path (Get-OneDrivePath) 'RADE') }
# Gives the path of the app's old folder (OneDrive\<app>), from before RADE had its own folder. Takes nothing.
function Get-OldBasePath { return (Join-Path (Get-OneDrivePath) $appFolder) }
function Get-BasePath {
  # The real path (shown on screen, PFM 13 Nov: no placeholder). Reports and e-mails show <DODID> instead.
  # PFM 14 Nov 26: OneDrive\RADE\<app>. Until RADE has moved it (on Run), an old OneDrive\<app> folder is used.
  $new = Join-Path (Get-RadePath) $appFolder
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $new -PathType Container) -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Get-OldBasePath) -PathType Container)) { return (Get-OldBasePath) }
  return $new
}
function Get-RadeMove {
  # The one-time move of OneDrive\<app> into OneDrive\RADE (PFM 14 Nov 26). Both there: nothing moves, the RADE copy is used.
  $old = Get-OldBasePath; $new = Join-Path (Get-RadePath) $appFolder
  $o = Test-Path -LiteralPath $old -PathType Container; $n = Test-Path -LiteralPath $new -PathType Container
  return @{ Needed = ($o -and -not $n); Both = ($o -and $n); From = $old; To = $new }
}
function Move-ToRade([scriptblock]$Say) {
  # One folder move inside OneDrive (every file keeps its place). On failure the round keeps the old folder and says why.
  $m = Get-RadeMove
  if ($m.Both) { & $Say ('Note: both ' + $appFolder + ' and RADE\' + $appFolder + ' are in your OneDrive. RADE uses RADE\' + $appFolder + '; move anything you still need from the old ' + $appFolder + ' folder by hand.') }
  if (-not $m.Needed) { return (Get-BasePath) }
  try {
    $rade = Get-RadePath
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $rade -PathType Container)) { [void](New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $rade -Force) }
    [System.IO.Directory]::Move($m.From, $m.To)
    & $Say ('Moved the folder ' + $appFolder + ' into RADE (RADE\' + $appFolder + '). Every file kept its place.')
  } catch {
    & $Say ('Folder move could not run: ' + (ConvertTo-Masked $_.Exception.Message) + ' This round uses the old ' + $appFolder + ' folder; the next round tries again.')
  }
  return (Get-BasePath)
}
function Resolve-Base {
  # No DODID question (PFM 13 Nov): the Windows profile folder name is the DODID.
  $leaf = Get-ProfileLeaf
  $script:secret = Get-Secret $leaf $leaf
  if ($leaf -notmatch '^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{4,}$') { throw 'PROFILE folder name not usable (Windows profile not found). Sign in to Windows with your own account, then run again.' }
  $base = Get-BasePath
  $oneDrive = Get-OneDrivePath
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $oneDrive -PathType Container)) { throw ('FOLDER not found: ' + $oneDrive + '. OneDrive is not set up in this Windows profile.') }
  $script:dodid = $leaf
  return $base
}

# Turns seconds into text like "3m 05s". Takes the seconds (a number); gives back the text.
function Format-Duration([double]$Seconds) {
  $s = [int][math]::Round($Seconds)
  return ('{0}m {1:00}s' -f [math]::Floor($s / 60), ($s % 60))
}
# What the window calls a step to a person: its manifest "title", else its name. The log, the report, the summary, the results
# files and every key keep the name.
function Get-StepTitle($Step) { if ($Step -and [string]$Step.Title) { return [string]$Step.Title }; return [string]$Step.Name }
# Says whether Word is running. Takes nothing; gives back $true or $false.
function Test-WordOpen { return (@(Get-Process -Name WINWORD -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Count -gt 0) }
# Says whether the text is one or more e-mail addresses separated by ";". Takes the text; gives back $true or $false.
# Sends nothing.
function Test-MailTo([string]$To) {
  $one = '[^@\s;,]+@[^@\s;,]+\.[^@\s;,]+'
  return ($To -match ('^\s*' + $one + '(\s*;\s*' + $one + ')*\s*;?\s*$'))
}
# Returns the path of a file in the app's Config folder. Takes the app folder and the file name.
function Get-ConfigFile([string]$Base, [string]$Name) { return (Join-Path (Join-Path $Base 'Config') $Name) }
# Returns the path of a file in RADE's own Config folder (a test can set $script:configOver). Takes the file name.
function Get-RadeConfigFile([string]$Name) { if ($script:configOver) { return (Join-Path $script:configOver $Name) }; return (Join-Path (Join-Path (Get-RadePath) 'Config') $Name) }   # the engine's own settings (R17)
# engine-v48: $true after the last app's Uninstall moved RADE\Config to the Recycle Bin (Clear-UninstallRecord, part 17).
# Then the window place and the tour mark are not written again, so the closing window does not make RADE\Config again.
$script:radeConfigGone = $false
function Read-WindowState {
  # R28 (the Administrator, 2026-11-17): where the user last closed the window. RADE\Config\rade-window.json (a cache: when it
  # is lost or does not read, the window opens maximized on the screen with the mouse). { x, y, w, h, state, dpi, closed: { w, h, state } }
  try { $p = Get-RadeConfigFile 'rade-window.json'
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p -PathType Leaf)) { return $null }
    $j = Get-Content -LiteralPath $p -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
    foreach ($k in 'x', 'y', 'w', 'h') { if ($null -eq $j.$k -or -not ([string]$j.$k -match '^-?\d{1,5}$')) { return $null } }
    if ([int]$j.w -lt 100 -or [int]$j.h -lt 100) { return $null }
    $st = $(if ([string]$j.state -eq 'Maximized') { 'Maximized' } else { 'Normal' })
    $cl = ''; if ($j.closed -and [string]$j.closed.w -match '^\d{1,5}$' -and [string]$j.closed.h -match '^\d{1,5}$') { $cl = [string]$j.closed.w + 'x' + [string]$j.closed.h + '/' + [string]$j.closed.state -replace '[^A-Za-z0-9/x]', '' }
    return @{ X = [int]$j.x; Y = [int]$j.y; W = [int]$j.w; H = [int]$j.h; State = $st; Dpi = $(if ([string]$j.dpi -match '^\d{2,3}$') { [int]$j.dpi } else { 0 }); Closed = $cl }
  } catch { return $null }
}
function Save-WindowState([int]$X, [int]$Y, [int]$W, [int]$H, [string]$State, [int]$Dpi, [int]$ClientW, [int]$ClientH, [string]$CloseState) {
  # Numbers and two words only: no name, path or text. A write that fails is ignored (the window is closing).
  if ($script:radeConfigGone) { return }   # engine-v48: the last Uninstall took RADE\Config
  try { $o = [ordered]@{ about = 'RADE window place (a cache; delete it to open maximized again)'; x = $X; y = $Y; w = $W; h = $H; state = $State; dpi = $Dpi; closed = [ordered]@{ w = $ClientW; h = $ClientH; state = $CloseState } }
    Write-FileWhole (Get-RadeConfigFile 'rade-window.json') (($o | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4) + "`r`n") } catch { $null = $_ }
}
# L6 (the Administrator, 2026-11-19): says whether the RADE tour was shown for this Windows profile before
# (RADE\Config\rade-tour.txt is there). Takes nothing; gives back $true or $false ($true when the file cannot be looked
# for, so a problem never shows the tour each time).
function Test-TourSeen { try { return [bool](Test-Path -LiteralPath (Get-RadeConfigFile 'rade-tour.txt') -PathType Leaf) } catch { return $true } }
# Remembers that the RADE tour was shown: writes the date to RADE\Config\rade-tour.txt; a failure is ignored. Takes
# nothing; gives back nothing.
function Save-TourSeen {
  if ($script:radeConfigGone) { return }   # engine-v48: the last Uninstall took RADE\Config
  try { $p = Get-RadeConfigFile 'rade-tour.txt'; $d = Split-Path -Parent $p
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $d -PathType Container)) { [void](New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $d -Force) }
    Write-FileWhole $p ((Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd') + "`r`n") } catch { $null = $_ }   # not saved: the tour shows one more time
}
function Get-MailTo([string]$Base) {
  # RADE\Config\rade-mail-to.txt: the address the results e-mail goes to (PFM 13 Nov; RADE R17). The window box saves it.
  # Until it exists, the app's old Config\90161Z-mail-to.txt is read.
  foreach ($p in @((Get-RadeConfigFile 'rade-mail-to.txt'), (Get-ConfigFile $Base '90161Z-mail-to.txt'))) {
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p -PathType Leaf) { try { return ([string](Get-Content -LiteralPath $p -TotalCount 1)).Trim() } catch { return '' } }
  }
  return ''
}
# Writes the results e-mail address to RADE\Config\rade-mail-to.txt, creating the folder if needed. Takes the base
# folder (not used) and the address; gives back nothing.
function Save-MailTo([string]$Base, [string]$To) {
  $null = $Base
  $p = Get-RadeConfigFile 'rade-mail-to.txt'
  $dir = Split-Path -Parent $p
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir -PathType Container)) { [void](New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force) }
  [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($p, ($To.Trim() + "`r`n"), (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $true))
}
function Read-RoundHistory([string]$Base) {
  # Config\90161Z-history.csv: round, step, finish time, status, seconds (no DODID). Feeds the banner and the estimates.
  $p = Get-ConfigFile $Base '90161Z-history.csv'
  if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p -PathType Leaf) { try { return @(Import-Csv -LiteralPath $p) } catch { return @() } }
  return @()
}
# Adds one row (round, step, time, status, seconds) to the history file; a failure is ignored. Takes the base folder,
# step name, status and seconds; gives back nothing.
function Add-RoundHistory([string]$Base, [string]$Step, [string]$Status, [int]$Seconds) {
  try {
    $p = Get-ConfigFile $Base '90161Z-history.csv'
    $dir = Split-Path -Parent $p
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir -PathType Container)) { [void](New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force) }
    [pscustomobject]@{ Round = $round; Step = $Step; Finished = (Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'); Status = $Status; Seconds = $Seconds } |
      Export-Csv -LiteralPath $p -Append -NoTypeInformation
  } catch { $null = $_ }   # history is a convenience: never stop a round for it
}
function Get-NewerRound {
  # Reads go.md in the repository (the bookmark page's source; data, not code) and returns the highest round number listed in an open task
  # heading when it is newer than this one, else ''. Short timeout; any failure is silent, so it never blocks a run.
  try {
    $rq = Get-WebRequest $goUrl 4000   # engine/ps/07-checks.ps1: no Windows sign-in for the address, only for the proxy
    $rs = $rq.GetResponse()
    try { $text = (New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($rs.GetResponseStream())).ReadToEnd() } finally { $rs.Close() }
    $mine = [int]($round -replace '\D', '')
    $max = 0
    foreach ($m in [regex]::Matches($text, '(?m)^## [^\r\n]*Round R(\d{2})[^\r\n]*\(open')) { $n = [int]$m.Groups[1].Value; if ($n -gt $max) { $max = $n } }
    if ($max -gt $mine) { return ('R{0:00}' -f $max) }
  } catch { $null = $_ }
  return ''
}
# Gives the one line about the last round on this computer, or says none is recorded. Takes the history rows; gives back
# the text.
function Get-LastRoundText($Hist) {
  $r = @($Hist | Where-Object { $_.Step -eq 'ROUND' })
  if (-not $r.Count) { return 'Last round on this computer: none recorded yet.' }
  $l = $r[-1]
  $word = @{ OK = 'passed'; CHECK = 'needed review'; STOPPED = 'stopped' }[[string]$l.Status]; if (-not $word) { $word = [string]$l.Status }
  return ('Last round on this computer: ' + $l.Round + ' ' + $word + ' on ' + $l.Finished + ' (took ' + (Format-Duration ([double]$l.Seconds)) + ').')
}
# Returns the seconds of the last successful run of a step on this computer, or 0. Takes the history and the step name.
function Get-StepEstimate($Hist, [string]$Name) {
  $r = @($Hist | Where-Object { $_.Step -eq $Name -and $_.Status -eq 'OK' -and $_.Seconds })   # last good run only
  if ($r.Count) { return [int]$r[-1].Seconds }
  return 0
}

# Gives a "What to do: ..." help line for a log line that matches a known problem, once for each problem in a round;
# else an empty text. Takes the log line; marks the problem as helped.
function Get-WhatToDo([string]$Line) {
  foreach ($h in $helpRules) {
    if ($Line -match $h.Re -and -not $script:helped.ContainsKey($h.Re)) { $script:helped[$h.Re] = $true
      if ($h.Covers) { $script:helped[[string]$h.Covers] = $true }   # engine-v46: a more exact rule keeps the general one quiet
      return ('What to do: ' + $h.Text) }
  }
  return ''
}
# ==== Engine part: engine/ps/03-files.ps1 (sha256 835ff2dd232f)
# RADE engine part 03, files: the clean-up plan and the move to the Recycle Bin, the folder inventory,
# saving the bundle's files, downloading data files (checked by SHA-256), the environment a step is given and the
# shortcut icon file (engine-v42; Save-AppIcon, used by Add-DesktopIcon in part 05). Uses 01 and 02.
# Joined into every bundle by engine/rade_build.py; Windows PowerShell 5.1.

function Test-OurFile([string]$Name) {
  # Files 90-161.Z made: 90161Z-* names, sample renders, and the support scripts that keep their names.
  foreach ($pat in $ownPatterns) { if ($Name -like $pat) { return $true } }   # the app's own file names (manifest application.own)
  return ($known -contains $Name)
}
function Get-CleanupPlan([string]$Base) {
  # Finished items only (PFM 13 Nov). A file not made by 90-161.Z is never touched; its folder stays.
  $res = @{ Files = @(); Dirs = @(); Kept = 0; Lines = @() }
  foreach ($c in $cleanup) {
    if ($c.Kind -eq 'dir') {
      $p = Join-Path $Base $c.Path
      if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p -PathType Container)) { continue }
      $all = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $p -Recurse -File -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
      $ours = @($all | Where-Object { Test-OurFile $_.Name })
      $other = $all.Count - $ours.Count
      $res.Files += @($ours | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName }); $res.Dirs += $p; $res.Kept += $other
      $res.Lines += ('  Recycle   ' + $c.Path + '\  (' + $ours.Count + ' files' + $(if ($other) { '; keeps ' + $other + ' file(s) not made by 90-161.Z, and the folder' } else { '' }) + ')')
    } else {
      $dir = Join-Path $Base (Split-Path -Parent $c.Path)
      if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir -PathType Container)) { continue }
      foreach ($f in @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $dir -Filter (Split-Path -Leaf $c.Path) -File -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
        if (Test-OurFile $f.Name) { $res.Files += $f.FullName; $res.Lines += ('  Recycle   ' + (Split-Path -Parent $c.Path) + '\' + $f.Name) }
      }
    }
  }
  return $res
}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
Moves a file or a folder to the Recycle Bin (Windows: restore from there). Elsewhere (tests only): a plain delete.
.DESCRIPTION
-AskFirst (engine-v48, review MINOR 3; the Uninstall clean-up of the app folder only): Windows shows its dialogs, so an
item too large for the Recycle Bin is not deleted for good without a question; a cancel throws OperationCanceledException.
Every other caller keeps OnlyErrorDialogs.
.PARAMETER Path
The file or folder.
.PARAMETER Folder
The path is a folder.
.PARAMETER AskFirst
Windows shows all its dialogs (UIOption AllDialogs).
.OUTPUTS
None.
#>
function Move-ToRecycleBin([string]$Path, [switch]$Folder, [switch]$AskFirst) {
  if ($env:OS -eq 'Windows_NT') {
    Add-Type -AssemblyName Microsoft.VisualBasic
    $ux = $(if ($AskFirst) { 'AllDialogs' } else { 'OnlyErrorDialogs' })
    if ($Folder) { [Microsoft.VisualBasic.FileIO.FileSystem]::DeleteDirectory($Path, $ux, 'SendToRecycleBin') }
    else { [Microsoft.VisualBasic.FileIO.FileSystem]::DeleteFile($Path, $ux, 'SendToRecycleBin') }
  } else { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $Path -Force -Recurse:$Folder }
}
# Moves the files of the clean-up plan, then the folders left empty, to the Recycle Bin and says what it did. Takes the
# base folder and a Say block; gives back the summary line and sets the round to "needs review" if one move failed.
function Invoke-Cleanup([string]$Base, [scriptblock]$Say) {
  $plan = Get-CleanupPlan $Base
  $done = 0; $gone = 0; $failed = 0
  foreach ($f in @($plan.Files | Select-Object -Unique)) {   # a folder item and a file pattern can name the same file (R18: failed 1)
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f -PathType Leaf)) { continue }   # already gone: nothing to do
    try { Move-ToRecycleBin $f; $done++ } catch { $failed++; & $Say ('Clean-up could not recycle ' + (ConvertTo-Masked $f) + ': ' + (ConvertTo-Masked $_.Exception.Message)) }
  }
  foreach ($d in @($plan.Dirs | Sort-Object Length -Descending)) {
    # The folder goes only when nothing is left in it.
    if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $d -PathType Container) -and @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $d -Recurse -File -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Count -eq 0) {
      try { Move-ToRecycleBin $d -Folder; $gone++ } catch { $failed++; & $Say ('Clean-up could not recycle ' + (ConvertTo-Masked $d) + ': ' + (ConvertTo-Masked $_.Exception.Message)) }
    }
  }
  $line = 'Clean-up: moved to the Recycle Bin: ' + $done + ' files, ' + $gone + ' folders; kept (not made by 90-161.Z): ' + $plan.Kept + ' files; failed: ' + $failed + '.'
  if ($failed) { $script:roundBad = $true }
  & $Say $line
  return $line
}
function Get-FolderInventory([string]$Base) {
  # What is left, for Claude to update the next round's steps: task folders by name, counts only (no file names).
  $parts = @(); $odd = 0
  foreach ($d in @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $Base -Directory -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object Name)) {
    if ($d.Name -notmatch '^(T\d\d|Rounds|Config)$') { $odd++; continue }
    $all = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $d.FullName -Recurse -File -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
    $other = @($all | Where-Object { -not (Test-OurFile $_.Name) }).Count
    $parts += ($d.Name + ' ' + $all.Count + $(if ($other) { ' (' + $other + ' other)' } else { '' }))
  }
  return ('Files left by folder: ' + ($parts -join ', ') + $(if ($odd) { '; other folders: ' + $odd } else { '' }) + '.')
}
# Puts each shared block back into a file's text: a line "# @@SHARED <key>@@ ..." becomes the block $shared[<key>]
# (the bundle keeps a block that many files hold only once; engine/rade_build.py checks the round trip). Takes the
# text of one file; returns the text as it was in the app's repository.
function Expand-SharedBlock([string]$Text) {
  if (-not $Text.Contains('# @@SHARED ')) { return $Text }
  $out = foreach ($line in ($Text -split "`n")) { if ($line -match '^# @@SHARED (\S+)@@') { [string]$shared[$Matches[1]] } else { $line } }
  return ($out -join "`n")
}
# Saves every file of the bundle (text with CRLF and a BOM, or decoded binary) into its folder under the base folder.
# Takes the base folder and a Say block; gives back nothing.
function Write-BundleFile([string]$Base, [scriptblock]$Say) {
  $utf8Bom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $true
  & $Say 'Preparing files'
  foreach ($f in $files) {
    $dir = Join-Path $Base $f.Dir
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir -PathType Container)) { [void](New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force) }
    $path = Join-Path $dir $f.Name
    if ($f.Kind -eq 'text') { [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($path, (((Expand-SharedBlock $f.Data) -replace "`r?`n", "`r`n") + "`r`n"), $utf8Bom) }
    else { [System.IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($path, [System.Convert]::FromBase64String(($f.Data -replace '\s', ''))) }
    & $Say ('  Saved   ' + $f.Dir + '\' + $f.Name + '  (SHA-256 ' + $f.Sha + ')')
  }
  & $Say ('  ' + $files.Count + ' files saved.')
}
# Sets the TLS versions of this PowerShell's web calls (fleet v2, DEC 1): assigns TLS 1.2, and adds TLS 1.3 only when
# this .NET has that enum value (Windows PowerShell 5.1 on an older .NET throws on the name). Assigns, never ORs, so
# SSL 3, TLS 1.0 and TLS 1.1 are off. Takes nothing; returns nothing. Called before each download and web request.
function Use-TlsFloor {
  try {
    $p = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12
    if ([Enum]::GetNames([Net.SecurityProtocolType]) -contains 'Tls13') { $p = $p -bor [Net.SecurityProtocolType]'Tls13' }
    [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = $p
  } catch { $null = $_ }   # a host that refuses the setting keeps its own; the request then names the TLS in its error
}

function Save-RoundDownload([string]$Base, [scriptblock]$Say) {
  # Data files only (briefs, public color documents), never code (PFM 3A). The address never gets the Windows sign-in
  # (engine-v14, as in Get-WebRequest); only the work proxy does.
  # A repo file must match its SHA-256; a failed download leaves the link on the bookmark page as the fallback.
  $ok = 0; $bad = 0
  if (-not $fetch.Count) { return '' }
  Use-TlsFloor
  foreach ($f in $fetch) {
    $dir = Join-Path $Base $f.Dir
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir -PathType Container)) { [void](New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force) }
    $path = Join-Path $dir $f.Name
    $wc = New-Object System.Net.WebClient
    try {
      $wc.UseDefaultCredentials = $false
      try { $wc.Headers['User-Agent'] = $webAgent } catch { $null = $_ }   # R21: as in Get-WebRequest
      try { if ($wc.Proxy) { $wc.Proxy.Credentials = [System.Net.CredentialCache]::DefaultNetworkCredentials } } catch { $null = $_ }   # no proxy: nothing to sign in to
      $wc.DownloadFile($f.Url, $path)
      if ($f.Sha) {
        $sha = [System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create(); $fs = [System.IO.File]::OpenRead($path)
        try { $got = ([System.BitConverter]::ToString($sha.ComputeHash($fs)) -replace '-', '').ToLowerInvariant() } finally { $fs.Dispose(); $sha.Dispose() }   # no Get-FileHash: it is a script function of a module and was not found on Windows PowerShell 5.1 in the Windows job
        if ($got -ne $f.Sha) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $path -Force; throw 'the file changed since this round was built' }
      }
      $ok++; & $Say ('  Downloaded   ' + $f.Dir + '\' + $f.Name + '  (' + ('{0:N0}' -f (Get-Item -LiteralPath $path).Length) + ' bytes)')
    } catch {
      $bad++
      if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path -PathType Leaf) { try { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $path -Force } catch { $null = $_ } }   # no partial file left behind
      & $Say ('  Download failed   ' + $f.Dir + '\' + $f.Name + ': ' + (ConvertTo-Masked $_.Exception.Message) + $(if (Test-Deploy) { '' } else { ' (save it from the repository instead)' }))
    } finally { $wc.Dispose() }
  }
  $line = 'Downloads: ' + $ok + ' saved, ' + $bad + ' failed.'
  if ($bad) { $script:roundBad = $true }
  & $Say $line
  return $line
}
function Get-StepEnv([string]$Base, $Step) {
  # Step contract (docs/engine.md "Step contract"): what RADE tells a step, as environment variables of the child process.
  # Variables, not parameters: a script that does not know them still runs.
  $inst = ''; $last = ''
  if (Test-Deploy) {
    $e = (Read-Installed (Get-InstalledKey $script:app))
    if ($e) {
      if ($e.installed) { $inst = [string]$e.installed.version }
      $s = $e.steps[[string]$Step.Name]; if ($s -and [string]$s.version -eq [string]$script:app.Version) { $last = [string]$s.state }
    }
  }
  $o = [ordered]@{ RADE_CONTRACT = '1'; RADE_MODE = [string]$script:app.Mode; RADE_APP = [string]$script:app.Name; RADE_APP_VERSION = [string]$script:app.Version
    RADE_INSTALLED_VERSION = $inst; RADE_STEP_LAST = $last; RADE_SITE = $(if (Test-SiteUrl (Get-SiteUrl $Base)) { [string](Get-SiteUrl $Base) } else { '' }) }
  # Uninstall (engine-v40) sets RADE_MODE=uninstall and RADE_MADE for its own steps only (Invoke-Uninstall, part 17).
  if ($script:stepEnvExtra) { foreach ($k in @($script:stepEnvExtra.Keys)) { $o[[string]$k] = [string]$script:stepEnvExtra[$k] } }
  return $o
}
function ConvertTo-MadeName([string]$Name, [string]$Site) {
  # A made item's name goes into the record: no address, no ID, one line, 200 characters at most.
  # Out: any https address, the saved site address in any form (with or without https://, or only its /sites/ path),
  # and any other host/sites/ path.
  $t = (ConvertTo-Masked $Name) -replace 'https?://\S+', '<SITE>'
  if ($Site -match '^https://([^/]+)(/sites/[^/]+)') { $t = $t -replace [regex]::Escape($Matches[1] + $Matches[2]), '<SITE>' -replace [regex]::Escape($Matches[2]), '<SITE>' }
  $t = $t -replace '[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}/sites/\S*', '<SITE>' -replace '\s+', ' '
  $t = $t.Trim(); if ($t.Length -gt 200) { $t = $t.Substring(0, 200) }
  return $t
}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
Makes the bytes of an .ico file from PNG images, one entry for each image (Windows Vista and later read PNG entries).
.PARAMETER Png
The PNG images, each as a byte array.
.PARAMETER Size
The side in pixels of each image, in the same order (1 to 256).
.OUTPUTS
The bytes of the .ico file.
#>
function ConvertTo-IcoByte([object[]]$Png, [int[]]$Size) {
  $ms = New-Object System.IO.MemoryStream; $bw = New-Object System.IO.BinaryWriter($ms)
  try { $n = $Png.Count; $bw.Write([uint16]0); $bw.Write([uint16]1); $bw.Write([uint16]$n)   # header: reserved, type 1 (icon), count
    $off = 6 + 16 * $n
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $n; $i++) { $s = $Size[$i]; $b = [byte]$(if ($s -ge 256) { 0 } else { $s })   # 0 means 256
      $bw.Write($b); $bw.Write($b); $bw.Write([byte]0); $bw.Write([byte]0); $bw.Write([uint16]1); $bw.Write([uint16]32)
      $bw.Write([uint32]([byte[]]$Png[$i]).Length); $bw.Write([uint32]$off); $off += ([byte[]]$Png[$i]).Length }
    foreach ($p in $Png) { $bw.Write([byte[]]$p) }
    $bw.Flush(); return , $ms.ToArray() } finally { $bw.Dispose() }
}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
Writes the chosen app's shortcut icon as one .ico file (R44 E1).
.DESCRIPTION
The app's logo (else RADE's) at 16, 32, 48 and 256 px, centered on a clear square, each a PNG entry. Needs
System.Drawing; never an error.
.PARAMETER Path
The path of the .ico file.
.OUTPUTS
$true when the file is written, else $false.
#>
function Save-AppIcon([string]$Path) {
  try { $src = $(if ([string]$appLogoPng) { [string]$appLogoPng } else { [string]$logoPng })
    $img = New-Object System.Drawing.Bitmap((New-Object System.IO.MemoryStream(, [System.Convert]::FromBase64String($src))))
    $pngs = @(); $sizes = @(16, 32, 48, 256)
    try { foreach ($s in $sizes) { $bm = New-Object System.Drawing.Bitmap($s, $s, [System.Drawing.Imaging.PixelFormat]::Format32bppArgb); $g = [System.Drawing.Graphics]::FromImage($bm)
        try { $g.InterpolationMode = 'HighQualityBicubic'; $g.SmoothingMode = 'HighQuality'; $g.PixelOffsetMode = 'HighQuality'; $g.Clear([System.Drawing.Color]::Transparent)
          $k = [math]::Min($s / [double]$img.Width, $s / [double]$img.Height); $w = [int][math]::Round($img.Width * $k); $h = [int][math]::Round($img.Height * $k)
          $g.DrawImage($img, [int](($s - $w) / 2), [int](($s - $h) / 2), $w, $h)
          $ps = New-Object System.IO.MemoryStream; $bm.Save($ps, [System.Drawing.Imaging.ImageFormat]::Png); $pngs += , $ps.ToArray(); $ps.Dispose() }
        finally { $g.Dispose(); $bm.Dispose() } } } finally { $img.Dispose() }
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($Path, (ConvertTo-IcoByte $pngs $sizes)); return $true } catch { return $false }
}
# ==== Engine part: engine/ps/04-steps.ps1 (sha256 024b566173e2)
# RADE engine part 04, steps: runs one step as a child process, runs a hand (guide) step, builds the step
# lines, the results folder and the round plan, and makes the Outlook draft. Called by 06-round.ps1.
# Joined into every bundle by engine/rade_build.py; Windows PowerShell 5.1.

# Builds the start information of a step's child powershell.exe (pwsh when there is none): the step file with -Id and
# -NoPause, the round's fixed arguments, the person's answer as -<AskParam>, and the step's input variables.
# Takes the RADE app folder, the step and the answer; returns the ProcessStartInfo (nothing is started here).
function Get-StepStartInfo([string]$Base, $Step, [string]$Answer, [scriptblock]$Say) {
  $exe = 'powershell.exe'
  if (-not (Get-Command $exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { $exe = 'pwsh' }
  $dir = Join-Path $Base $Step.Dir
  $psi = New-Object System.Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo
  $psi.FileName = $exe
  $psi.Arguments = '-NoProfile -File "' + (Join-Path $dir $Step.File) + '" -Id "' + $script:dodid + '" -NoPause'
  if ($Step.Args) { $psi.Arguments += ' ' + $Step.Args }   # fixed arguments from the round (for example -Set T12)
  if ($Step.AskParam -and $Answer) {
    # A trailing \ before the closing quote would escape it (command-line rules): trim it, but a drive root keeps its \,
    # doubled so "D:\\" reads back as D:\ (review R08).
    $a = $Answer; if ($a.Length -gt 3) { $a = $a.TrimEnd('\') }
    if ($a.EndsWith('\')) { $a += '\' }
    $psi.Arguments += ' -' + $Step.AskParam + ' "' + $a + '"'
  }
  $psi.WorkingDirectory = $dir
  # No -ExecutionPolicy setting (fleet v2, DEC 3: Group Policy governs). A RADE started from an old shortcut hands its
  # setting down in this variable as "Bypass": take only that value out (any other value a person set stays), so a step
  # runs as the child check proved it can.
  if ($psi.EnvironmentVariables['PSExecutionPolicyPreference'] -ceq 'Bypass') { $psi.EnvironmentVariables.Remove('PSExecutionPolicyPreference') }
  $psi.UseShellExecute = $false; $psi.CreateNoWindow = $true
  $psi.RedirectStandardOutput = $true; $psi.RedirectStandardError = $true
  try { $envs = Get-StepEnv $Base $Step; foreach ($k in @($envs.Keys)) { $psi.EnvironmentVariables[[string]$k] = [string]$envs[$k] } } catch { & $Say ('    NOTE: the step inputs could not be set: ' + (ConvertTo-Masked $_.Exception.Message)) }
  return $psi
}

# Reads one output line of a running step (the step contract, docs/engine.md "Step contract"): masks it, then a
# PROGRESS line moves the step bar, a NOW line goes to the window's now-doing line, a MADE line goes to the undo list, a FALLBACK line names the fallback route, and any
# other line is logged and counted as PASS, SKIP or FAIL. Takes the line, the step, the result record $R (changed in
# place), the site address (for cleaned names) and the log callback; returns nothing.
function Add-StepLine([string]$Line, $Step, $R, [string]$Site, [scriptblock]$Say) {
  $line = ConvertTo-Masked $Line
  # "PROGRESS n/m" (or "n of m") from a step script moves the step bar and stays out of the log (PFM 14 Nov 26).
  if ($line -match '^\s*PROGRESS\s+(\d+)\s*(?:/|of)\s*(\d+)\s*$') {
    if ($script:prog -and [int]$Matches[2] -gt 0) { $script:prog.Frac = [math]::Min(1.0, [double]$Matches[1] / [double]$Matches[2]); $script:prog.FracText = $Matches[1] + ' of ' + $Matches[2] }
    return
  }
  # "NOW <text>" (L7): the step says in plain words what it does now. The window shows it under the step's bar; it stays
  # out of the log and is not a result.
  if ($line -cmatch '^\s*NOW\s+(\S.*)$') { if ($script:nowUi) { & $script:nowUi $Matches[1].Trim() }; return }
  # "MADE <kind>: <name>": something the step created (a list, a flow, a file); kept for the undo list (step contract).
  # A MADE line is never a result: it is logged with the cleaned name and not counted as PASS, FAIL or SKIP (review).
  if ($line -cmatch '^\s*MADE\s+([a-z][a-z-]{0,30}):\s+(\S.*)$') {
    $mk = $Matches[1]; $mn = ConvertTo-MadeName $Matches[2] $Site; $R.Made += @{ kind = $mk; name = $mn }
    & $Say ('    MADE ' + $mk + ': ' + $mn); return
  }
  # "FALLBACK: <route>": the step used its documented fallback route (for a user with fewer rights). Not a result line;
  # a step that passes this way reads PASSED (fallback) and counts as passed (docs/engine.md "Results").
  if ($line -cmatch '^\s*FALLBACK:\s+(\S.*)$') {
    $R.Fallback = ConvertTo-MadeName $Matches[1] $Site
    & $Say ('    FALLBACK: ' + $R.Fallback); return
  }
  # Lines that may name a unit or a file (for example seal details) never reach the report (data boundary).
  if ($Step.ScreenOnly -and $line -match $Step.ScreenOnly) { $line = ($line -replace '^(\S+).*$', '$1') + ' (detail hidden: it may hold a name; run the step script by hand to see it)' }
  if ($line -match '(^|\s)PASS(\s|$)') { $R.Pass++ }
  if ($line -cmatch '(^|\s)SKIP(\s|$)') { $R.Skip++ }   # upper case only: prose such as "skip this" is not a result
  if ($line -match '(^|\s)(FAIL|FORMAT-FAIL|RENDER-ERROR|MEASURE-ERROR|STOPPED:)(\s|$)') { $R.Fail++; if ($line -match $signInLost) { $R.SignIn = $true } }   # a failed sign-in: the CAC may be out (12-resume.ps1)
  if ($line.Trim()) { & $Say ('    ' + $line) }   # step output, indented under its step heading
  if ($script:nowUi) { $now = Get-NowText $line; if ($now) { & $script:nowUi $now } }
}
# L7 (the Administrator, 2026-11-19): turns a result line of a step script into a plain sentence for the window's
# now-doing line: the words after PASS, SKIP or FAIL (upper case), with what the result means in front. Takes the line
# (masked already); gives back the sentence, or '' when the line is not a result or has no words after the result.
function Get-NowText([string]$Line) {
  if ($Line -cnotmatch '(?:^|\s)(PASS|SKIP|FAIL)(?:\s+|:\s*)(\S.*)$') { return '' }
  $what = $Matches[2].Trim()
  return ($(if ($Matches[1] -eq 'PASS') { 'Checked: ' } elseif ($Matches[1] -eq 'SKIP') { 'Skipped: ' } else { 'Needs review: ' }) + $what)
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
Runs one step script as a child PowerShell, and once more when Windows' script policy blocked it.
.DESCRIPTION
engine-v46 (90-161.Z R45 finding 1: one step was blocked once; the same file ran a few seconds later). When the first run
printed no line and Windows did not load the script (Test-PolicyBlock), RADE logs the policy of each scope, waits 5
seconds and runs the step once more, unless the window is closing. A step blocked 2 times is named in
$script:blockedSteps for the end card.
.PARAMETER Base
The RADE app folder.
.PARAMETER Step
The step.
.PARAMETER Say
The log callback.
.PARAMETER Tick
The tick callback (moves the window's bars).
.PARAMETER Answer
The person's answer, or ''.
.OUTPUTS
What Invoke-RoundStepOnce gives, with Blocked ($true after 2 blocks).
#>
function Invoke-RoundStep([string]$Base, $Step, [scriptblock]$Say, [scriptblock]$Tick, [string]$Answer) {
  $r = Invoke-RoundStepOnce $Base $Step $Say $Tick $Answer
  if (-not (Test-PolicyBlock $r) -or $script:closing) { return $r }   # the window is closing: no second run
  & $Say ('    BLOCKED: Windows did not let this step''s script run (script policy). ' + (Get-PolicyLine) + '. RADE runs it once more in 5 seconds.')
  $until = (Get-Date).AddSeconds(5); while ((Get-Date) -lt $until -and -not $script:closing) { & $Tick; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 30 }   # the bars keep moving while RADE waits
  if ($script:closing) { return $r }   # Exit during the wait (review of PR 206): the step does not start again
  $r = Invoke-RoundStepOnce $Base $Step $Say $Tick $Answer
  if (Test-PolicyBlock $r) { $r.Blocked = $true; $script:blockedSteps += [string]$Step.Name; & $Say ('    BLOCKED again: ' + (Get-PolicyLine) + '.') }
  else { & $Say '    The second run of this step was not blocked.' }
  return $r
}
# Says whether a step result is a script policy block: the script printed no line at all (so it did no work: review of
# PR 206, a step that printed FAIL or MADE lines and then failed to load a module is not run again) and its error output
# says that Windows did not load it (running scripts is disabled, or not digitally signed). Takes the result; gives back
# $true or $false.
function Test-PolicyBlock($R) { return [bool]([int]$R.Lines -eq 0 -and [string]$R.Err -match 'running scripts is disabled|is not digitally signed|PSSecurityException') }
# Gives one line with the script policy of each scope that has one ("Get-ExecutionPolicy -List"; numbers and words only),
# for the log of a blocked step. Takes nothing.
function Get-PolicyLine {
  $all = @(); try { $all = @(Get-ExecutionPolicy -List | Where-Object { [string]$_.ExecutionPolicy -ne 'Undefined' } | ForEach-Object { [string]$_.Scope + '=' + [string]$_.ExecutionPolicy }) } catch { $null = $_ }   # no list: none set
  return ('Policy: ' + $(if ($all.Count) { $all -join ', ' } else { 'none set' }) + '; in effect: ' + [string](Get-ExecutionPolicy))
}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
Runs one step script as a child PowerShell, one time.
.DESCRIPTION
Follows the step's output line by line until it ends or passes its time limit ($stepMinutes, or the step's own
Minutes); the window's bars move every 30 ms ($Tick). Each error line is logged masked and kept in Err, so
Invoke-RoundStep can see a script policy block (engine-v46).
.PARAMETER Base
The RADE app folder.
.PARAMETER Step
The step.
.PARAMETER Say
The log callback.
.PARAMETER Tick
The tick callback (moves the window's bars).
.PARAMETER Answer
The person's answer, or ''.
.OUTPUTS
@{ Pass; Fail; Skip; Exit; Made; Fallback; SignIn; Err (the masked error output); Blocked ($false here); Lines (the
output lines read) }.
#>
function Invoke-RoundStepOnce([string]$Base, $Step, [scriptblock]$Say, [scriptblock]$Tick, [string]$Answer) {
  $psi = Get-StepStartInfo $Base $Step $Answer $Say
  $r = @{ Pass = 0; Fail = 0; Skip = 0; Exit = $null; Made = @(); Fallback = ''; SignIn = $false; Err = ''; Blocked = $false; Lines = 0 }
  $siteNow = [string](Get-SiteUrl $Base)
  $p = [System.Diagnostics.Process]::Start($psi)
  $script:child = $p
  $limit = $stepMinutes; if ($Step.Minutes) { $limit = [int]$Step.Minutes }   # a step that waits for a person sets its own limit
  $deadline = (Get-Date).AddMinutes($limit)
  $errTask = $p.StandardError.ReadToEndAsync()
  $lineTask = $p.StandardOutput.ReadLineAsync()
  while ($true) {
    while (-not $lineTask.Wait(30)) {   # 30 ms: the window's bars move smoothly (R17)
      & $Tick
      if ((Get-Date) -gt $deadline) { try { $p.Kill() } catch { $null = $_ }; $r.Fail++; & $Say ('    STOPPED: the step ran longer than ' + $limit + ' minutes and was ended.'); break }
    }
    if (-not $lineTask.IsCompleted) { break }
    $line = $lineTask.Result
    if ($null -eq $line) { break }
    $r.Lines++   # engine-v46: a step that printed any line did work (Test-PolicyBlock)
    Add-StepLine $line $Step $r $siteNow $Say
    $lineTask = $p.StandardOutput.ReadLineAsync()
  }
  $p.WaitForExit()
  $script:child = $null
  foreach ($e in @(([string]$errTask.Result) -split "`r?`n" | Where-Object { $_ })) { $r.Fail++; if ($e -match $signInLost) { $r.SignIn = $true }; $m = ConvertTo-Masked $e; $r.Err += $m + "`n"; & $Say ('    Error output: ' + $m) }
  $r.Exit = $p.ExitCode
  return $r
}
# Gives the state word for a step result: SKIPPED, INTERRUPTED, NEEDS REVIEW or PASSED. Takes the result table; gives back the word.
function Get-StepState($R) {
  if ($R.Skipped) { return 'SKIPPED' }
  if ($R.Fail -gt 0 -or $R.Exit -ne 0) { if ($R.SignIn) { return 'INTERRUPTED' }; return 'NEEDS REVIEW' }   # a failed sign-in (CAC out): resume re-runs it (the PFM, 2026-11-20)
  if ($R.Pass -eq 0 -and $R.Skip -gt 0) { return 'SKIPPED' }   # the step found nothing to do (R18: was PASSED with 0 passed)
  return 'PASSED'
}
function Get-StepLine($Step, $R, [double]$Seconds) {
  # One line per step in the summary and the e-mail: name, result, check counts, time.
  $state = Get-StepState $R
  if ($R.Skipped) { return ($Step.Name + ': SKIPPED' + $(if ($R.Why) { ' (' + $R.Why + ')' } else { ' by you' })) }
  if ($Step.Kind -eq 'guide' -and $R.FailText) { return ($Step.Name + ': FAILED (reported by you) in ' + (Format-Duration $Seconds) + ': ' + $R.FailText) }
  if ($Step.Kind -eq 'guide') { return ($Step.Name + ': ' + $state + $(if ($Step.AnswersOnly) { ' (answered by you) in ' } else { ' (confirmed by you) in ' }) + (Format-Duration $Seconds)) }
  if ($state -eq 'PASSED' -and $R.Fallback) { $state = 'PASSED (fallback: ' + $R.Fallback + ')' }
