  return ($Step.Name + ': ' + $state + ' (' + $R.Pass + ' passed, ' + $R.Fail + ' failed' + $(if ($R.Skip) { ', ' + $R.Skip + ' skipped' } else { '' }) + ', exit code ' + $R.Exit + ') in ' + (Format-Duration $Seconds))
}
# Puts the text on the clipboard, by Windows Forms or else Set-Clipboard. Takes the text; gives back $true if it worked,
# else $false.
function Copy-TextToClipboard([string]$Text) {
  try { [System.Windows.Forms.Clipboard]::SetText($Text); return $true } catch { $null = $_ }
  try { if (Get-Command Set-Clipboard -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Set-Clipboard -Value $Text; return $true } } catch { $null = $_ }
  return $false
}
function ConvertTo-UserText([string]$Text) {
  # Text a person typed (the "It failed" text, a text answer): one line, the DODID masked, no e-mail or site address.
  $t = ((ConvertTo-Masked $Text) -replace '\s+', ' ').Trim()
  $t = $t -replace '[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}', '<EMAIL>'   # e-mail first: the site rule would leave the name before @
  return ($t -replace 'https?://\S+', '<SITE>' -replace '[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.(sharepoint|sharepoint-mil|onmicrosoft)\.[A-Za-z.]+\S*', '<SITE>')   # no address reaches the e-mail
}
# Runs a hand step: shows it (in the window or as console text), waits for Done, It failed or Skip, and asks the step's
# questions (a step with "answersOnly" shows only its questions). Takes the base folder, the step and a Say block; gives
# back the result table.
function Invoke-GuideStep([string]$Base, $Step, [scriptblock]$Say) {
  $r = @{ Pass = 0; Fail = 0; Exit = 0; Skipped = $false; FailText = ''; Answers = @() }
  $script:guideAnswers = @{}; $script:guideFail = @(); $script:guideError = ''
  $dir = Join-Path $Base $Step.Dir
  $file = $(if ($Step.File) { Join-Path $dir $Step.File } else { '' })   # R18: a guide step may need no file
  $url = $Step.Url
  $urlFile = ''
  if ($Step.UrlConfig) {
    $urlFile = Get-ConfigFile $Base $Step.UrlConfig
    # A saved address is used only on the host of the step's own address (the Administrator, 2026-11-17).
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $urlFile -PathType Leaf) { try { $v = ([string](Get-Content -LiteralPath $urlFile -TotalCount 1)).Trim(); if (Test-SameHost $v $Step.Url) { $url = $v } elseif ($v -and $Step.Url) { & $Say ('    The saved address is not on ' + ([uri]$Step.Url).Host + '; the step uses its own address.') } elseif ($v) { & $Say '    The saved address is not used: this step gives no address of its own.' } } catch { $null = $_ } }
  }
  # An old marker from an earlier run would make site setup wait for a result that is not coming (review R13 #2).
  if ($Step.Marker) { $old = Join-Path $dir $Step.Marker; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $old -PathType Leaf) { try { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $old -Force } catch { $null = $_ } } }
  if ($Step.File) { & $Say ('    File ready: ' + $Step.Dir + '\' + $Step.File) }
  if ($script:textMode -and $Step.AnswersOnly) { $r.Skipped = $true; $r.Why = 'its questions need the RADE window'; & $Say ('    Skipped: ' + $r.Why + '.'); return $r }
  if ($script:textMode) {
    foreach ($l in @($Step.Guide)) { & $Say ('    ' + $l) }
    if ($url) { & $Say ('    Address: ' + $url) }   # R28 N1: a step with no address shows none
    if ($file -and (Copy-TextToClipboard $file)) { & $Say '    The full file path is on the clipboard.' }
    if ($url -and $env:OS -eq 'Windows_NT') { try { Start-Process -FilePath $url } catch { $null = $_ } }
    $res = Read-GuideChoice $Step
    if ($res -eq 'Abort') { $script:guideError = [string](Read-Host 'Paste the error message (no names or site address), then press Enter') }
  } elseif ($script:guideUi) { $res = [string](@(& $script:guideUi $Step $file $url $urlFile))[-1] }   # the window shows the step as a card and waits for the answer
  else { $res = 'Cancel' }
  # E2 (the Administrator, 2026-11-19): an answer that the manifest marks as a failure ("failOn") makes the step FAILED.
  $bad = @($script:guideFail | Where-Object { $_ })
  if ($res -eq 'Abort' -or ($res -eq 'OK' -and $bad.Count)) {
    $t = ConvertTo-UserText ([string]$script:guideError)
    if ($t.Length -gt 600) { $t = $t.Substring(0, 600) + ' ...' }
    if (-not $t) { $t = 'no error text given' }
    if ($bad.Count) { $t = 'answer ' + ($bad -join '; ') + '. Error text: ' + $t }
    $r.Fail = 1; $r.FailText = $t
    & $Say ('    Failed (reported by you): ' + $t)
  } elseif ($res -eq 'OK') {
    if ($Step.Marker) { try { Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir $Step.Marker) -Value (Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') -Encoding UTF8 } catch { $null = $_ } }
    $r.Pass = 1
    & $Say ('    ' + $(if ($Step.DoneLog) { $Step.DoneLog } elseif ($Step.AnswersOnly) { 'Answered by you.' } else { 'Confirmed by you: the flow is imported and its run has started.' }))
  } elseif ($res -eq 'None') { $r.Skipped = $true; $r.Why = 'no answer that this step offers was given'; & $Say ('    Skipped: ' + $r.Why + '.') }   # text mode: a hidden answer is never recorded as the person's
  else { $r.Skipped = $true; & $Say '    Skipped by you.' }
  # The step's questions (manifest "answers"), asked after Done: one line each for the summary, under the step's line.
  if ($res -eq 'OK') { foreach ($q in @($Step.Answers | Where-Object { $_ })) { $r.Answers += ('  Answer ' + [string]$q.Key + ': ' + (Get-GuideAnswerText $q)) } }
  return $r
}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
Text mode: asks how a hand step ended and reads the answer.
.DESCRIPTION
Only the answers the step shows are offered (manifest "hide", E1); an answer that is not offered is asked again, 3 times
at most; then the step is skipped with that reason, not as an answer of the person.
.PARAMETER Step
The step (its Hide list names the answers that are not offered: done, failed, skip).
.OUTPUTS
OK (Done), Abort (It failed), Cancel (Skip) or None (no answer that the step offers, 3 times).
#>
function Read-GuideChoice($Step) {
  $hide = @($Step.Hide)
  $ask = 'Press Enter when the flow run has started, type F and Enter if it failed, or S and Enter to skip this step'
  if ($hide.Count) {
    $ws = @(); if ($hide -notcontains 'done') { $ws += 'press Enter when you have done this step' }; if ($hide -notcontains 'failed') { $ws += 'type F and Enter if it failed' }; if ($hide -notcontains 'skip') { $ws += 'type S and Enter to skip this step' }
    $ask = ($ws -join ', or '); $ask = $ask.Substring(0, 1).ToUpperInvariant() + $ask.Substring(1)
  }
  for ($n = 0; $n -lt 3; $n++) {
    $a = [string](Read-Host $ask); $a = $(if ($a) { $a.Trim() } else { '' })   # no input (closed stdin) gives no value, not ''
    $res = $(if ($a -match '^[Ss]') { 'Cancel' } elseif ($a -match '^[Ff]') { 'Abort' } else { 'OK' })
    $name = $(if ($res -eq 'OK') { 'done' } elseif ($res -eq 'Abort') { 'failed' } else { 'skip' })
    if ($hide -notcontains $name) { return $res }
  }
  return 'None'
}
# Gives the report text of one question of a hand step: the answer, or why there is none. A text answer is masked and
# kept whole. Takes the question; reads $script:guideAnswers; gives back the text.
function Get-GuideAnswerText($Q) {
  $k = [string]$Q.Key
  if ($script:textMode) { return 'not asked (text mode)' }
  # E3: a question that depends on an earlier answer ("showIf") and did not show.
  if ($Q.ShowKey -and @($Q.ShowIn) -cnotcontains [string]$script:guideAnswers[[string]$Q.ShowKey]) { return 'not asked' }
  if (-not $script:guideAnswers.ContainsKey($k)) { return 'not answered (the window closed)' }
  if ($Q.Kind -eq 'text') { $v = ConvertTo-UserText ([string]$script:guideAnswers[$k]); if (-not $v) { $v = '(no text)' }; return $v }   # the full answer (R28: it was cut at 120 characters)
  return [string]$script:guideAnswers[$k]   # yes/no and pick: the fixed words of the buttons
}
# Adds one line to the run log, when a log exists. Takes the line; gives back nothing.
function Add-RunLog([string]$T) { if ($null -ne $script:runLog) { $script:runLog.Add($T) } }
# No scripts in results (the PFM, 2026-11-20): says whether a file is a script: a script extension ($scriptExts, from
# the build's SCRIPT_EXTS), or (engine-v34) a saved copy of a bundle under any name: its first line that is not blank is
# "# @@BUNDLE-HASH ..." (the .txt copy a person can save from a link; Test-BundleCopy). The first time a name is refused, one line goes to
# the run log. Takes the file name and, when there is one, its full path; gives back $true for a script file.
function Test-ScriptResult([string]$Name, [string]$Path = '') {
  $ext = [System.IO.Path]::GetExtension($Name).ToLowerInvariant()
  if ((@($scriptExts) -notcontains $ext) -and -not (Test-BundleCopy $Path)) { return $false }
  if ($null -eq $script:scriptsSkipped) { $script:scriptsSkipped = @{} }
  if (-not $script:scriptsSkipped.ContainsKey($Name)) { $script:scriptsSkipped[$Name] = $true; Add-RunLog ('SKIPPED script file ' + $Name + ' (scripts never go in results)') }
  return $true
}
# Says whether a file starts with the bundle hash line, so it is a copy of a bundle (a whole script) whatever its name.
# Reads to the first line that is not blank (at most 20 lines; a paste can put blank lines or spaces above it, and the
# bundle still runs); a file it cannot read counts as no copy (the extension check still holds). Takes the full path
# ('' for none); gives back $true for a bundle copy.
function Test-BundleCopy([string]$Path) {
  if (-not $Path -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path -PathType Leaf)) { return $false }
  $reader = $null
  $first = ''
  try {
    $reader = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($Path)
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt 20 -and -not $first; $i++) { $line = $reader.ReadLine(); if ($null -eq $line) { break }; $first = $line.TrimStart([char]0xFEFF).Trim() }
  } catch { return $false } finally { if ($reader) { $reader.Dispose() } }
  return $first.StartsWith('# @@BUNDLE-HASH ')
}
# Fills the results folder Rounds\<round>: a copy of each collect file (never a script file), then the report (the
# summary and the full log). Takes the RADE app folder and the summary; gives back the folder, the file count and the
# expected files that are missing.
function Export-RoundResult([string]$Base, [string[]]$Summary) {
  # One folder of plain files to attach to one e-mail (zips do not cross the boundary, PFM 13 Nov).
  $out = Join-Path (Join-Path $Base 'Rounds') $round
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $out -PathType Container)) { [void](New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $out -Force) }
  $count = 1; $missing = @()
  foreach ($c in $collect) {
    if ($c.Step -and -not ($script:ranSteps -contains $c.Step)) { continue }   # a skipped step has nothing to send
    $src = Join-Path $Base $c.Dir
    if ($c.Name -match '[*?]') {
      # A pattern (R10: any saved page counts, whatever its name); top level only, so a browser's "_files" folders stay out.
      # Several patterns may be joined with ';' ("*.mhtml;*.pdf"): missing only when none of them finds a file.
      # Windows -Filter '*.htm' also matches '.html': keep each file once. Copies carry the task prefix (T09-..., T12-...) so
      # two tasks never overwrite each other, and older copies of that task are removed first (review R10).
      $hits = @(); if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $src -PathType Container) { foreach ($pat in ($c.Name -split ';')) { $hits += @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $src -File -Filter $pat -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) } }
      $hits = @($hits | Sort-Object FullName -Unique | Where-Object { -not (Test-ScriptResult $_.Name $_.FullName) })   # a script never goes in results
      Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $out -File -Filter ($c.Dir + '-*') -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
      foreach ($h in $hits) { Copy-Item -LiteralPath $h.FullName -Destination (Join-Path $out ($c.Dir + '-' + $h.Name)) -Force; $count++ }
      if (-not $hits.Count) { $missing += ($c.Dir + '\' + $c.Name) }
      continue
    }
    $old = Join-Path $out $c.Name
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $old -PathType Leaf) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $old -Force }   # an older copy of the same name must not be sent again
    $p = Join-Path $src $c.Name
    if (Test-ScriptResult $c.Name $p) { continue }   # the build refuses such a name; this is the second guard
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p -PathType Leaf) { Copy-Item -LiteralPath $p -Destination (Join-Path $out $c.Name) -Force; $count++ } else { $missing += ($c.Dir + '\' + $c.Name) }
  }
  if ($missing.Count) { $script:roundBad = $true }
  $report = Join-Path $out ('90161Z-' + $round + '-report-r1.txt')
  $body = @($Summary) + @('', '---------------- full log ----------------') + @($script:runLog)
  [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($report, (($body -join "`r`n") + "`r`n"), (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $true))
  return @{ Dir = $out; Count = $count; Missing = $missing }
}
function Get-RoundPlan {
  # What this round writes and recycles, before it runs (PFM 13 Nov: show the impact; show the real path).
  $base = Get-BasePath
  $found = Test-Path -LiteralPath (Get-OneDrivePath) -PathType Container
  $mv = Get-RadeMove
  $shown = $(if ($mv.Needed) { $mv.To } else { $base })
  $lines = @(('Working folder: ' + $shown + $(if ($found) { '' } else { '   (NOT found: OneDrive is not set up in this Windows profile)' })), '')
  if ($mv.Needed) { $lines += @(('Folder move (runs first): OneDrive\' + $appFolder + '  ->  OneDrive\RADE\' + $appFolder), '  One move inside your OneDrive; every file keeps its place. If it cannot run, this round uses the old folder.', '') }
  $lines += 'Files this round saves:'
  foreach ($f in $files) {
    $p = Join-Path (Join-Path $base $f.Dir) $f.Name
    $lines += ($(if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p -PathType Leaf) { '  Replace   ' } else { '  New       ' }) + $f.Dir + '\' + $f.Name)
  }
  foreach ($f in $fetch) {
    $p = Join-Path (Join-Path $base $f.Dir) $f.Name
    $lines += ($(if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p -PathType Leaf) { '  Replace   ' } else { '  New       ' }) + $f.Dir + '\' + $f.Name + '  (downloaded from ' + ([uri]$f.Url).Host + $(if ($f.Sha) { ', checked' } else { '' }) + ')')
  }
  $lines += ('  Results   Rounds\' + $round + '\  (one report file and copies of the result files)')
  if ($cleanup.Count) {
    $cp = @{ Lines = @(); Kept = 0 }
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $base -PathType Container) { $cp = Get-CleanupPlan $base }
    if ($cp.Lines.Count) { $lines += ''; $lines += 'Clean-up (runs first; moves files to the Recycle Bin; clear its check box to skip):'; $lines += $cp.Lines }
    else { $lines += ''; $lines += 'Clean-up: nothing to recycle.' }
  }
  $lines += ''
  $lines += ('Settings   RADE\Config (' + $(if (Test-Deploy) { 'the installed versions' } else { 'the e-mail address' }) + ' and the saved checks) and Config\90161Z-site.txt (the site address).')
  if ((Test-Deploy) -and $script:app.Marker) {
    $lines += ''
    $lines += ('On the site   after the steps, one row in the list "' + $script:app.Marker.List + '" (row "' + $script:app.Marker.Key + '": the installed version and the date, no name).')
    if (Test-FirstInstall) { $lines += ('First install from this account. Install ' + $script:app.Name + ' once for each wing, on one site: RADE stops a second install on this site, but it cannot see an install on another site.') }
  }
  $lines += ''
  $lines += 'Missing folders are created and files of the same name are replaced. Nothing else is changed, moved or deleted.'
  return @{ Shown = $shown; Found = $found; Lines = $lines }
}
function Save-RoundDraft([string]$Dir, [string[]]$Summary, [string]$To, [string]$WindowLine) {
  # One Outlook draft with subject, body and every results file (R05, PFM 13 Nov); To from the window box (R06).
  # Never sent: this code has no Send call (tests/run.sh checks). Classic Outlook only (new Outlook has no COM): else fall back.
  if ($env:OS -ne 'Windows_NT') { return 'not Windows' }
  try {
    $ol = New-Object -ComObject Outlook.Application
    $m = $ol.CreateItem(0)
    $m.Subject = $Summary[0]
    if ($To) { $m.To = $To }
    $m.Body = ((@($Summary | Select-Object -Skip 1) + @('', $WindowLine)) -join "`r`n")
    foreach ($f in @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $Dir -File)) { if ($f.Name -ne $stateName -and -not (Test-ScriptResult $f.Name $f.FullName)) { [void]$m.Attachments.Add($f.FullName) } }   # never a script, never the resume state
    $m.Display()   # first: if it fails, nothing is left in Drafts
    $m.Save()
    return ''
  } catch { return (ConvertTo-Masked $_.Exception.Message) }
}
# Says whether the chosen app runs in deploy mode (an install) and not as a test round. Takes nothing; gives back $true
# or $false.
function Test-Deploy { return ([string]$script:app.Mode -eq 'deploy') }
# ==== Engine part: engine/ps/05-installed.ps1 (sha256 de1d26073e0a)
# RADE engine part 05, the install record: one record file for each app in RADE\Config\installed, the newer-
# version look-up, the runner copy and desktop shortcut, and the lines that tell a user what was made. Used by 04 and 06.
# Joined into every bundle by engine/rade_build.py; Windows PowerShell 5.1.

# ---- Installed versions (the Administrator, 14 Nov 26, deploy v1): RADE\Config\installed keeps, one file per app, the
# version a deploy last installed and the last deploy run. It holds no user name, path, site or DODID. A deploy run sends
# nothing: no e-mail draft, no saved address; its report stays in Rounds\<round> on this computer.
function Get-InstalledKey($A) {
  # An app that keeps an install record on the site (manifest "marker") has one record for each site: the key ends in
  # "@" and a short hash of the site address (never the address). So versions, step states and the made list of one
  # site never count on another (reviews, 14 Nov 26).
  $k = $appFolder + '/' + [string]$A.Name
  if ($A.Marker) { $h = Get-SiteMark (Get-SiteUrl (Get-BasePath)); if ($h) { $k += '@' + $h } }
  return $k
}
# Turns a saved run of a record (version, build, round, time, state) into a plain ordered table of text, fixing a date
# that PowerShell 7 reads as a date. Takes the run; gives back the table, or $null for none.
function ConvertTo-InstalledRun($V) {
  if ($null -eq $V) { return $null }
  $at = $V.at; if ($at -is [datetime]) { $at = $at.ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss', [System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture) }   # PowerShell 7 reads it as a date
  $o = [ordered]@{ version = [string]$V.version; build = [string]$V.build; round = [string]$V.round; at = [string]$at }
  if ($null -ne $V.state) { $o.state = [string]$V.state }
  return $o
}
# Shared files (docs/engine.md "Shared files"; the Administrator, 2026-11-15). Many apps, each with its own engine version,
# use RADE\Config. So: one record file for each app (RADE\Config\installed\<12 hex of the record key>.json, schema
# rade-installed/2), and an engine reads and writes only its own app's file (S1). A record with a higher schema number is
# never written, and that app is not deployed (S2). Every write goes to a temporary file first (S4). Only a file with the
# exact name is read, so a conflict copy that OneDrive makes is ignored (S5).
$installedSchema = 2
function Write-FileWhole([string]$Path, [string]$Text) {
  # The file is whole or unchanged: the text goes to a temporary file in the same folder, which then takes the place of
  # the final file in one step. A stop in the middle leaves the old file as it was.
  $dir = Split-Path -Parent $Path
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir -PathType Container)) { [void](New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force) }
  $tmp = $Path + '.tmp' + $PID
  try {
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($tmp, $Text, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false))
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path -PathType Leaf) {
      if ((Get-Item -LiteralPath $Path -Force).IsReadOnly) { throw 'the file is read-only' }
      [System.IO.File]::Replace($tmp, $Path, [NullString]::Value)   # $null would go in as an empty string, which Replace refuses
    } else { [System.IO.File]::Move($tmp, $Path) }
  } finally { if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $tmp -PathType Leaf) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $tmp -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }
}
# Gives the path of the record file of one app: RADE\Config\installed\<12 hex of the key>.json. Takes the record key;
# gives back the path.
function Get-InstalledFile([string]$Key) { return (Join-Path (Get-RadeConfigFile 'installed') ((Get-ShortHash $Key) + '.json')) }
function Read-InstalledRaw([string]$Key) {
  # State: none (no file), ok, damaged (not JSON, or no record of this schema), newer (a higher schema number: S2),
  # foreign (a whole record with another app's key: two keys gave one file name) or unreadable (the file is there but
  # cannot be read now, for example while another program holds it). Only none, ok and damaged may be written (S1).
  $p = Get-InstalledFile $Key
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p -PathType Leaf)) { return @{ State = 'none'; Path = $p } }
  $text = $null
  try { $text = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($p) } catch { return @{ State = 'unreadable'; Path = $p } }
  try {
    $j = $text | ConvertFrom-Json
    if ([string]$j.schema -notmatch '^rade-installed/(\d{1,6})$') { return @{ State = 'damaged'; Path = $p } }
    if ([int]$Matches[1] -gt $installedSchema) { return @{ State = 'newer'; Path = $p } }
    if ([int]$Matches[1] -lt $installedSchema) { return @{ State = 'damaged'; Path = $p } }
    if ([string]$j.key -cne $Key) { return @{ State = $(if ([string]$j.key) { 'foreign' } else { 'damaged' }); Path = $p } }
    return @{ State = 'ok'; Path = $p; Json = $j }
  } catch { return @{ State = 'damaged'; Path = $p } }
}
# Says whether the app's record was written by a newer RADE (a higher schema number). Takes the app; gives back $true or
# $false.
function Test-InstalledNewer($A) { return ((Read-InstalledRaw (Get-InstalledKey $A)).State -eq 'newer') }
$newerRadeText = 'a newer RADE installed this application: get the newest script from the RADE page'
function Get-InstalledBlock($A, [string]$Key = '') {
  # '' or why this app's record must not be written, so the app is not deployed (S1, S2). $Key: the record key ('' = read it now).
  switch ((Read-InstalledRaw $(if ($Key) { $Key } else { Get-InstalledKey $A })).State) {
    'newer' { return $newerRadeText }
    'foreign' { return 'the install record file of this application holds the record of another application (RADE\Config\installed). RADE did not change it: ask for help before you install' }
    'unreadable' { return 'the install record of this application could not be read (another program may be using the file). Wait a minute, then run again' }
  }
  return ''
}
function Read-Installed([string]$Key) {
  # This app's record, or $null (no file, a damaged file, or a record from a newer RADE).
  $r = Read-InstalledRaw $Key
  if ($r.State -ne 'ok') { return $null }
  try {
    $st = [ordered]@{}
    if ($r.Json.steps) { foreach ($s in @($r.Json.steps.PSObject.Properties)) {
      $at = $s.Value.at; if ($at -is [datetime]) { $at = $at.ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss', [System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture) }
      $made = @(); foreach ($m in @($s.Value.made)) { if ($null -ne $m) { $made += [ordered]@{ kind = [string]$m.kind; name = [string]$m.name } } }
      $st[$s.Name] = [ordered]@{ state = [string]$s.Value.state; version = [string]$s.Value.version; at = [string]$at; made = $made }
    } }
    return [ordered]@{ installed = (ConvertTo-InstalledRun $r.Json.installed); lastRun = (ConvertTo-InstalledRun $r.Json.lastRun); steps = $st }
  } catch { return $null }   # a damaged file reads as nothing installed
}
function Get-InstalledText($A) {
  # One short text for the Choose card and the log; '' for an app that is not a deploy.
  if ([string]$A.Mode -ne 'deploy') { return '' }
  if (Test-InstalledNewer $A) { return ('version ' + $A.Version + ' (' + $newerRadeText + ')') }
  $e = (Read-Installed (Get-InstalledKey $A))
  if ($e -and $e.installed) {
    if ($e.installed.version -eq [string]$A.Version) { return ('version ' + $A.Version + ' is installed') }
    return ('version ' + $A.Version + ' (installed now: ' + $e.installed.version + ')')
  }
  return ('version ' + $A.Version + ' (not installed yet)')
}
function Save-Installed([string]$State, [bool]$Whole, $StepRecs) {
  # Every deploy run is the app's lastRun. "installed" changes only when every step of the app ran and PASSED (none off,
  # none skipped). Clean-up is not a step: it only recycles old files, so it may be off.
  # $StepRecs: name -> @{ state; made } for the steps this run reached; a step it did not reach keeps its older record.
  # A step's "made" list adds up over runs (the undo list): an item stays until an undo removes it.
  # Returns '' or the reason the record could not be saved (the caller says it: the record is the upgrade path).
  try {
    $key = Get-InstalledKey $script:app
    $raw = Read-InstalledRaw $key
    $blk = Get-InstalledBlock $script:app; if ($blk) { return $blk }   # S1, S2: never write a record of a newer RADE or of another app, or one that cannot be read
    if ($raw.State -eq 'damaged') {
      # Keep what was there before it is replaced; an older .damaged copy is kept too.
      $keep = $raw.Path + '.damaged'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $keep) { $keep += '-' + (Get-Date).ToString('yyyyMMdd-HHmmss', [System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture) }
      Copy-Item -LiteralPath $raw.Path -Destination $keep -Force
    }
    $old = Read-Installed $key
    $run = [ordered]@{ version = [string]$script:app.Version; build = [string]$buildId; round = [string]$round; at = (Get-Date).ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss', [System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture) }
    $inst = $null; if ($old) { $inst = $old.installed }
    if ($State -eq 'PASSED' -and $Whole) { $inst = [ordered]@{ version = $run.version; build = $run.build; round = $run.round; at = $run.at } }
    $run.state = $State
    $st = [ordered]@{}; if ($old -and $old.steps) { $st = $old.steps }
    if ($StepRecs) { foreach ($n in @($StepRecs.Keys)) {
      $made = @(); $seen = @{}
      $om = @(); if ($st.Contains($n)) { $om = @($st[$n].made) }
      foreach ($m in ($om + @($StepRecs[$n].made))) { if ($null -eq $m) { continue }; $id = [string]$m.kind + '|' + [string]$m.name; if (-not $seen[$id]) { $seen[$id] = $true; $made += [ordered]@{ kind = [string]$m.kind; name = [string]$m.name } } }
      $st[$n] = [ordered]@{ state = [string]$StepRecs[$n].state; version = $run.version; at = $run.at; made = $made }
    } }
    $doc = [ordered]@{
      schema = 'rade-installed/' + $installedSchema
      about = 'What RADE installed for one app (key: folder/name; a key that ends in @ and letters is one site, as a short hash). "installed" is the last deploy in which every step ran and PASSED; "lastRun" is the last deploy run and its state; "steps" holds each step''s last state and what it made. No user, path or site address is kept here. Only the RADE that installs this app writes this file.'
      key = $key
      installed = $inst
      lastRun = $run
      steps = $st
    }
    Write-FileWhole $raw.Path ($doc | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 9)
    return ''
  } catch { return (ConvertTo-Masked $_.Exception.Message) }
}
function Test-SharedFile([string]$Dir) {
  # Test rounds only (it goes away with the test branch): runs the record functions on a scratch folder, so a round on a
  # work computer proves them on Windows PowerShell 5.1. Returns one line for each test: "PASS ..." or "FAIL ...".
  $out = @(); $keepApp = $script:app
  try {
    $script:configOver = $Dir
    $script:app = @{ Name = 'Self test'; Version = '0.0.1'; Mode = 'test'; Marker = $null }
    $key = Get-InstalledKey $script:app; $p = Get-InstalledFile $key
    $rec = @{ 'step one' = @{ state = 'PASSED'; made = @(@{ kind = 'file'; name = 'a' }) } }
    $w = Save-Installed 'PASSED' $true $rec; $e = Read-Installed $key
    $out += $(if (-not $w -and $e -and $e.installed -and $e.installed.version -eq '0.0.1' -and @($e.steps['step one'].made).Count -eq 1 -and [string]$e.steps['step one'].made[0].name -eq 'a') { 'PASS' } else { 'FAIL' }) + ' shared files: a record is written and read back'
    $w = Save-Installed 'NEEDS REVIEW' $false @{ 'step two' = @{ state = 'NEEDS REVIEW'; made = @() } }; $e = Read-Installed $key
    $left = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Split-Path -Parent $p) -Force | Where-Object { $_.Name -ne (Split-Path -Leaf $p) })
    $out += $(if (-not $w -and $e -and $e.lastRun.state -eq 'NEEDS REVIEW' -and $e.installed.version -eq '0.0.1' -and $e.steps.Count -eq 2 -and -not $left.Count) { 'PASS' } else { 'FAIL' }) + ' shared files: a second write replaces the file and leaves no temporary file'
    $newer = '{ "schema": "rade-installed/' + ($installedSchema + 1) + '", "key": "' + $key + '", "later": true }'
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($p, $newer)
    $w = Save-Installed 'PASSED' $true $rec
    $out += $(if ($w -eq $newerRadeText -and (Test-InstalledNewer $script:app) -and $null -eq (Read-Installed $key) -and [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($p) -eq $newer) { 'PASS' } else { 'FAIL' }) + ' shared files: a record of a newer RADE is not read and not written'
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($p, '{ "schema": "rade-installed/2", "key": "')
    $e0 = Read-Installed $key; $w = Save-Installed 'PASSED' $true $rec; $e = Read-Installed $key
    $out += $(if ($null -eq $e0 -and -not $w -and $e -and $e.installed -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath ($p + '.damaged') -PathType Leaf)) { 'PASS' } else { 'FAIL' }) + ' shared files: a cut record is kept as .damaged and replaced'
  } catch { $out += 'FAIL shared files: the self-test stopped (' + (ConvertTo-Masked $_.Exception.Message) + ')' }
  finally { $script:configOver = $null; $script:app = $keepApp; try { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $Dir -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch { $null = $_ } }
  return $out
}
function Get-StepPrior {
  # Deploy only: step name -> state, for the steps the record holds at the version this bundle installs.
  $res = @{}
  if (-not (Test-Deploy)) { return $res }
  $e = (Read-Installed (Get-InstalledKey $script:app))
  if ($e -and $e.steps) { foreach ($n in @($e.steps.Keys)) { if ([string]$e.steps[$n].version -eq [string]$script:app.Version) { $res[[string]$n] = [string]$e.steps[$n].state } } }
  return $res
}
function Get-StepDefault([int]$K) {
  # Safe second run (deploy v1 item 3): a step that PASSED at this version starts off, so a second run does only what is
  # left. When every step of the app has PASSED, the run is a repair: every step starts on again.
  # Optional = the manifest says "default": false. Every other step is needed: in a deploy it is on until it has PASSED
  # at this version, whatever a files-changed default says (that default is for test rounds).
  if (-not (Test-Deploy) -or [bool]$steps[$K].Optional) { return [bool]$steps[$K].Default }
  $prior = Get-StepPrior
  # Only needed steps count: an optional step that never ran must not block the repair (review).
  $all = $true; foreach ($j in $script:appSteps) { if (-not [bool]$steps[$j].Optional -and $prior[[string]$steps[$j].Name] -ne 'PASSED') { $all = $false } }
  if ($all) { return $true }
  return ($prior[[string]$steps[$K].Name] -ne 'PASSED')
}
# The RADE page (R28: the newer-version notice points here, not to the app page; the Administrator, 2026-11-17).
$radeUrl = 'https://github.com/rhope-ops/RADE'   # from apps.json "page" (fleet v2 DEC 7)
function Get-NewerVersion {
  # Reads rade-release.json in the app repository (data, not code): { "apps": { "<app name>": "<version>" } }.
  # Returns that version when it is newer than the one this bundle installs, else ''. Short timeout; any failure is silent.
  # R28: in a test round too (the Administrator, 2026-11-17): the notice shows for every application that names a version.
  if (-not [string]$script:app.Version) { return '' }   # no version: nothing to compare, no request
  try {
    $rq = Get-WebRequest $releaseUrl 4000   # engine/ps/07-checks.ps1: no Windows sign-in for the address, only for the proxy
    $rs = $rq.GetResponse()
    try { $text = (New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($rs.GetResponseStream())).ReadToEnd() } finally { $rs.Close() }
    $v = [string](($text | ConvertFrom-Json).apps.PSObject.Properties | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq [string]$script:app.Name } | ForEach-Object { $_.Value } | Select-Object -First 1)
    if ($v -match '^\d+\.\d+(\.\d+)?$' -and ([version]$v) -gt ([version][string]$script:app.Version)) { return $v }
  } catch { $null = $_ }
  return ''
}
# Gives the line that tells the user a newer version of the app is on the RADE page, or an empty text when there is
# none. Takes nothing.
function Get-NewerVersionText {
  $v = Get-NewerVersion
  if ($v) { return ('A newer version, ' + $v + ', of ' + $script:app.Name + ' is on the RADE page (' + $radeUrl + '). Use that one instead.') }
  return ''
}
function Get-StartPath {
  # R28: the app's start script (manifest app.start), inside its local install folder; '' when the app has none, the path is
  # not inside the folder, or the file is not there. Nothing is downloaded.
  $st = [string]$script:app.Start
  if (-not $st) { return '' }
  try { $base = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Get-BasePath)).TrimEnd('\', '/')
    $full = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $base ($st -replace '/', [string][System.IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar)))
    if (-not $full.StartsWith($base + [System.IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { return '' }
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $full -PathType Leaf) { return $full }
  } catch { $null = $_ }
  return ''
}
# Gives the full path of Windows PowerShell (powershell.exe), or just its name when the system folder is not known.
# Takes nothing.
function Get-PowerShellExe {
  if ($env:SystemRoot) { $x = Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $x -PathType Leaf) { return $x } }
  return 'powershell.exe'
}
# The installed runner (R28, the Administrator, 2026-11-17): RADE had none, so the desktop shortcut had nothing to open. The smallest
# one: after a deploy has passed, a copy of the pasted text is saved (the file is a whole bundle, so it carries its own engine
# and its own applications). The app's shortcut runs it. From engine-v42 each app has its own copy (Save-RunnerCopy below).
$script:selfText = ''; $script:startFile = [string]$PSCommandPath   # the file RADE runs from ('' for a paste in ISE)
try { if ($PSCommandPath -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $PSCommandPath -PathType Leaf)) { $script:selfText = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($PSCommandPath) } } catch { $null = $_ }
if (-not $script:selfText) { try { if ($psISE -and $psISE.CurrentFile) { $script:selfText = [string]$psISE.CurrentFile.Editor.Text } } catch { $null = $_ } }
# In the paste guard (engine/rade_hash.py) this code runs inside the guard's script block, so $MyInvocation is that block's:
# the guard end saves the whole text's invocation as $script:PasteOuter.
if (-not $script:selfText) { try { $inv = $(if ($script:PasteOuter) { $script:PasteOuter } else { $MyInvocation }); $script:selfText = [string]$inv.MyCommand.ScriptBlock } catch { $null = $_ } }
# R44 E3: a child that RADE started from ISE (Invoke-IseWindow) deletes its copy of the text once it has read it.
if ($env:RADE_FROM_ISE -and $PSCommandPath -and $PSCommandPath -eq $env:RADE_FROM_ISE) { try { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $PSCommandPath -Force } catch { $null = $_ } }   # a copy that stays is rewritten at the next ISE start
<#
.SYNOPSIS
Says whether RADE, started from Windows PowerShell ISE, runs its window in a child powershell.exe -STA (R44 E3).
.DESCRIPTION
90-161.Z R44 E3 (the PFM, 2026-11-25): ISE and the shortcut's host (ConsoleHost) gave the same screen two dpi paths
(R43: ISE dpiX=96 fontScale=1.5; ConsoleHost dpiX=144 fontScale=1). So from ISE, RADE runs its window in the host the
shortcut uses. It stays in ISE when the person turned it off (RADE_ISE_CHILD=0), when RADE cannot read its own text,
or when the execution policy does not run a local script file (the child is started with -File, as the shortcut is;
no -ExecutionPolicy flag, DEC 3).
.PARAMETER HostName
The name of the host ($Host.Name).
.PARAMETER Policy
The execution policy in effect (Get-ExecutionPolicy).
.OUTPUTS
@{ Go; Why }: Go is $true to start the child; Why says why not ('' when the host is not ISE).
#>
function Get-IseHandoff([string]$HostName, [string]$Policy) {
  if ($HostName -ne 'Windows PowerShell ISE Host') { return @{ Go = $false; Why = '' } }
  if ($env:RADE_ISE_CHILD -eq '0') { return @{ Go = $false; Why = 'RADE_ISE_CHILD=0' } }
  $own = ([string]$script:selfText).Contains("`$buildId = '" + $buildId + "'")   # only this bundle's text (review of PR 199)
  if (-not $own) { return @{ Go = $false; Why = 'RADE could not read its own text' } }
  if ($Policy -notin 'Unrestricted', 'RemoteSigned', 'Bypass') { return @{ Go = $false; Why = ('the execution policy is ' + $Policy) } }
  return @{ Go = $true; Why = '' }
}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
Starts RADE's window in a child powershell.exe -STA, from a copy of this text in the temp folder (R44 E3).
.DESCRIPTION
The child deletes the copy when it has read it (RADE_FROM_ISE names the copy). A child that stops at once with an
error (for example a policy that blocks the file) counts as not started: RADE then stays in ISE.
.OUTPUTS
'' when the child runs, else why it does not.
#>
function Invoke-IseWindow {
  $path = Join-Path ([System.IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ('90161Z-window-' + $buildId + '.ps1')
  try { [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($path, [string]$script:selfText, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $true))
    $env:RADE_FROM_ISE = $path
    # engine-v46 (the PFM, 2026-11-26: the PowerShell window still showed): Start-Process -WindowStyle Hidden makes Windows
    # create the console hidden, so it never flashes; engine-v44 hid it only after PowerShell had started. The console
    # still exists, so text mode can show it (Show-RadeConsole, part 11).
    try { $pr = Start-Process -FilePath (Get-PowerShellExe) -ArgumentList ('-NoProfile -STA -WindowStyle Hidden -File "' + $path + '"') -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru }
    finally { Remove-Item -LiteralPath 'Env:RADE_FROM_ISE' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }   # the child has its own copy; ISE keeps none
    if ($pr) { $null = $pr.Handle }   # Windows PowerShell 5.1 keeps the exit code only when the handle is held
    # A child that a policy blocks or that fails at once ends within a moment: RADE then stays in ISE (as StartApp does).
    if (-not $pr -or ($pr.WaitForExit(2500) -and $pr.ExitCode -ne 0)) { return ('the window process stopped at once' + $(if ($pr) { ' (exit code ' + $pr.ExitCode + ')' } else { '' })) }
    return ''
  } catch { return ('the window process could not start [' + $_.Exception.GetType().Name + ']') }
}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
The bundle's own hash check: the line to show, the short form and whether the text matches its first line.
.DESCRIPTION
Script check (docs/specs/bundle-hash.md; the Administrator, 2026-11-18): the first line of a bundle holds the SHA-256 of
all the text after it (line ends as LF, the end as one LF; engine/rade_hash.py canonical). RADE hashes its own text ($script:selfText) the
same way and shows the short form (first 12 and last 4 hex), so a person can compare it with the RADE page. It catches a
change on the way (a half copy, an old page); a changed script can print any value, so it is no security control. This
release shows the answer and stops nothing: a work-computer round must first prove that a paste keeps the text (Q5).
.OUTPUTS
A table: Line (the text to show), Short (the short form, or '' when RADE cannot read its own text) and Ok ($true only
when the hash of the text is the value on its first line).
#>
function Get-ScriptCheck {
  $res = @{ Line = 'Script check: not available (RADE could not read its own text)'; Short = ''; Ok = $false }
  try {
    $t = ([string]$script:selfText) -replace "`r`n", "`n"
    $m = [regex]::Match($t, '^\s*# @@BUNDLE-HASH ([0-9a-f]{64}) @@\n')
    if (-not $m.Success) { return $res }
    # The end of the text as the build hashes it (engine/rade_hash.py canonical): the line ends and blank lines at the end
    # count as one LF, so a paste that lost its final line end (ISE, R41) passes and a copy cut off before the end fails.
    $body = ($t.Substring($m.Length) -replace '(\n[ \t]*)+\z', '') + "`n"
    $sha = [System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()
    try { $hex = -join @($sha.ComputeHash([System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($body)) | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString('x2') }) } finally { $sha.Dispose() }
    $own = [string]$m.Groups[1].Value
    $res.Short = $hex.Substring(0, 12) + '...' + $hex.Substring(60)
    $res.Ok = ($hex -eq $own)
    if ($res.Ok) { $res.Line = 'Script check: ' + $res.Short + ' (checked)' }
    else { $res.Line = 'Script check: ' + $res.Short + ' DOES NOT MATCH the line in the script (' + $own.Substring(0, 12) + '...' + $own.Substring(60) + ')' }
  } catch { $res.Line = 'Script check: not available (' + $_.Exception.GetType().Name + ')' }
  return $res
}
$script:scriptCheck = Get-ScriptCheck
# ---- One shortcut for each app (engine-v42; 90-161.Z R44 E1; plan docs/reviews/2026-11-21-plan-intro-fulcrum.md step 7).
# RADE is never installed by itself, so the shortcut belongs to the installed app: its name is the app's word (Get-ShortcutName),
# its icon is made from the app's logo, and it opens that app's own runner copy, RADE\runners\<key>.ps1 (the app's last
# passed deploy paste; <key> = 12 hex of "<app folder>/<app name>"). A deploy of a second app does not change the first
# app's shortcut. The one shortcut "RADE" and the one runner rade-runner.ps1 of engine-v41 and before go to the Recycle Bin.

# Gives the name a person sees for the chosen app: the manifest's application.displayName, else the app name. Takes nothing.
function Get-AppDisplay { if ([string]$appDisplay) { return [string]$appDisplay }; return [string]$script:app.Name }
# Name spot L2 (engine-v45; the PFM, 2026-11-26): the word of the application row is application.productName ("Kanon"),
# else the app name. Takes nothing.
function Get-AppWord { if ([string]$appProduct) { return [string]$appProduct }; return [string]$script:app.Name }
# The line under the word: "<name> <bullet> <subtitle>" with a productName ("90-161.Z <bullet> Publications and Forms
# Management"), else the subtitle alone (L1); '' when there is nothing to show. The name is the application's own
# (manifest application.name, $appName; engine-v47: the row shows from the first screen, so a chosen round's name such as
# "90-161.Z R46" must not stand there), else the chosen app's name. Takes nothing.
function Get-AppSubtitle { $s = [string]$appSubtitle; if (-not [string]$appProduct) { return $s }
  $n = $(if ([string]$appName) { [string]$appName } else { [string]$script:app.Name })
  if ($s) { return ($n + ' ' + [string][char]0x2022 + ' ' + $s) }; return $n }
# Says whether RADE runs from an app's runner copy in RADE\runners (opened by its shortcut: no round, R44 E2). Takes nothing.
function Test-RunnerStart {
  try { return [bool]($script:startFile -and (Split-Path -Parent $script:startFile) -eq (Join-Path (Get-RadePath) 'runners')) } catch { return $false }   # no RADE folder: not a runner
}
# Gives the name of the chosen app's shortcut, without ".lnk": the app's word (application.productName, "Kanon"), else
# the app name; no version (engine-v46, the PFM, 2026-11-26; engine-v42 to v45: "<display> - <version>"). Takes nothing.
function Get-ShortcutName { return (Get-AppWord) }
# Gives the path of the chosen app's runner copy, RADE\runners\<key>.ps1 (the folder may not be there yet). Takes nothing.
function Get-RunnerPath { return (Join-Path (Join-Path (Get-RadePath) 'runners') ((Get-ShortHash ($appFolder + '/' + [string]$script:app.Name)) + '.ps1')) }
# Gives the path of the file that holds the full path of the chosen app's shortcut (RADE\runners\<key>.lnk.txt). Takes nothing.
function Get-ShortcutRecord { return ([System.IO.Path]::ChangeExtension((Get-RunnerPath), '.lnk.txt')) }
# Gives the full path of the shortcut RADE made for the chosen app, or '' when none is recorded or it is not there. Takes nothing.
function Get-AppShortcut {
  try { $r = Get-ShortcutRecord
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $r -PathType Leaf) { $v = ([string](Get-Content -LiteralPath $r -TotalCount 1)).Trim()
      if ($v -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $v -PathType Leaf)) { return $v } } } catch { $null = $_ }   # a record it cannot read: no shortcut known
  return ''
}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
Saves this paste as the chosen app's runner copy, RADE\runners\<key>.ps1, after a deploy that passed.
.DESCRIPTION
Only the text of this bundle is saved (its build id must be in it). A copy made by a higher engine release stays (an
older RADE never replaces a newer one); an equal or lower one is replaced, so the copy is the app's last passed paste.
Never an error.
.OUTPUTS
$true when the copy is saved, else $false.
#>
function Save-RunnerCopy {
  try { if (-not $script:selfText -or -not $script:selfText.Contains("`$buildId = '" + $buildId + "'")) { return $false }
    $rp = Get-RunnerPath; $rd = Split-Path -Parent $rp
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $rd -PathType Container)) { [void](New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $rd -Force) }
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $rp -PathType Leaf) {
      $m = [regex]::Match([IO.File]::ReadAllText($rp), '(?m)^\$engineRelease = (\d+)')
      if ($m.Success -and [int]$m.Groups[1].Value -gt [int]$engineRelease) { return $false } }
    Write-FileWhole $rp $script:selfText; return $true } catch { return $false }
}
# The icon of the shortcut: ConvertTo-IcoByte and Save-AppIcon, part 03 (engine/ps/03-files.ps1).
function Get-DesktopDir {
  # The user's own Desktop folder (it follows OneDrive), or '' when Windows names none that exists.
  try { $d = [Environment]::GetFolderPath('Desktop'); if ($d -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $d -PathType Container)) { return $d } } catch { $null = $_ }
  return ''
}
function Get-ShortcutDir {
  # R29 (the PFM, 17 Nov 26: "I should be asked where to install it, but have the desktop path prefilled"): the folder for the
  # RADE shortcut. RADE\Config\rade-shortcut.txt holds the folder the user chose; else the Desktop folder. '' when neither exists.
  try { $p = Get-RadeConfigFile 'rade-shortcut.txt'
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p -PathType Leaf) { $v = ([string](Get-Content -LiteralPath $p -TotalCount 1)).Trim(); if ($v -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $v -PathType Container)) { return $v } } } catch { $null = $_ }
  return (Get-DesktopDir)
}
# Saves the folder chosen for the RADE shortcut to RADE\Config\rade-shortcut.txt; a failure is ignored. Takes the
# folder; gives back nothing.
function Save-ShortcutDir([string]$Dir) {
  try { $p = Get-RadeConfigFile 'rade-shortcut.txt'; $d = Split-Path -Parent $p
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $d -PathType Container)) { [void](New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $d -Force) }
    Write-FileWhole $p ($Dir + "`r`n") } catch { $null = $_ }
}
# Says whether the chosen app has its shortcut (the one RADE made and recorded). Takes nothing; gives back $true or $false.
function Test-ShortcutMade { return [bool](Get-AppShortcut) }
# Moves the shortcut "RADE" and the runner rade-runner.ps1 of engine-v41 and before to the Recycle Bin: only a RADE.lnk
# that starts that runner, in the given folder or the saved shortcut folder. Takes the folder; gives back nothing; never an error.
function Clear-OldRadeShortcut([string]$Dir) {
  $old = Join-Path (Get-RadePath) 'rade-runner.ps1'
  foreach ($d in @(@($Dir, (Get-ShortcutDir)) | Where-Object { $_ } | Sort-Object -Unique)) {
    $l = Join-Path $d 'RADE.lnk'
    try { if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $l -PathType Leaf) -and ([string](New-Object -ComObject WScript.Shell).CreateShortcut($l).Arguments).Contains('"' + $old + '"')) {
        Move-ToRecycleBin $l } } catch { $null = $_ } }   # a shortcut it cannot read is not RADE's: it stays
  try { if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $old -PathType Leaf) { Move-ToRecycleBin $old } } catch { $null = $_ }   # an old runner that stays does no harm
}
function Add-DesktopIcon([string]$Dir) {
  # The chosen app's shortcut (Get-ShortcutName) in the folder the user chose on the install card ($Dir; R29), else
  # the folder of the app's last shortcut, else the saved shortcut folder or the Desktop; no administrator rights
  # (WScript.Shell). It is made again at each passed deploy (its icon, and a repair of old settings); the shortcut of an
  # older version of this app goes to the Recycle Bin. Returns the plain line the Done card shows, or '' when there is nothing to say.
  try { $runner = Get-RunnerPath
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $runner -PathType Leaf)) { return '' }
    $was = Get-AppShortcut; $name = Get-ShortcutName
    $desk = $(if ($Dir) { $Dir } elseif ($was) { Split-Path -Parent $was } else { Get-ShortcutDir })   # no folder given: the one chosen before (review of PR 78), else the Desktop
    $isDesk = (-not $desk -or $desk -eq (Get-DesktopDir))
    if (-not $desk -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $desk -PathType Container)) { return $(if ($isDesk) { 'RADE could not find your Desktop folder, so it made no desktop shortcut. Open RADE from the RADE page instead.' } else { 'RADE could not find the folder you chose, so it made no shortcut. Open RADE from the RADE page instead.' }) }
    Clear-OldRadeShortcut $desk
    # engine-v46 (the PFM, 2026-11-26): -WindowStyle Hidden, so the console of the shortcut's PowerShell goes away at
    # its start (a shortcut cannot start it hidden: WindowStyle 7 keeps that first moment minimized). Text mode shows it.
    $lnk = Join-Path $desk ($name + '.lnk'); $args1 = '-NoProfile -STA -WindowStyle Hidden -File "' + $runner + '"'
    $sh = New-Object -ComObject WScript.Shell
    if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $lnk) -and $lnk -ne $was -and -not ([string]$sh.CreateShortcut($lnk).Arguments).Contains('"' + $runner + '"')) {
      return ('A shortcut named "' + $name + '" that RADE did not make is in that folder, so RADE did not change it.') }   # never another program's shortcut
    $new = ($lnk -ne $was)
    $ico = [System.IO.Path]::ChangeExtension($runner, '.ico'); $hasIco = Save-AppIcon $ico
    $sc = $sh.CreateShortcut($lnk); $sc.TargetPath = (Get-PowerShellExe); $sc.Arguments = $args1
    $sc.WorkingDirectory = (Get-RadePath); $sc.Description = ('Open RADE for ' + (Get-AppDisplay)); $sc.WindowStyle = 7
    if ($hasIco) { $sc.IconLocation = $ico + ',0' }
    $sc.Save(); Write-FileWhole (Get-ShortcutRecord) ($lnk + "`r`n")
    if ($was -and $new) {   # the older version's shortcut of this app, only while it still starts this runner (review of PR 199)
      try { if (([string]$sh.CreateShortcut($was).Arguments).Contains('"' + $runner + '"')) { Move-ToRecycleBin $was } } catch { $null = $_ } }   # a shortcut it cannot read stays
    if (-not $new) { return '' }
    $where = $(if ($isDesk) { 'on your desktop' } else { 'in the folder "' + (Split-Path -Leaf $desk) + '"' })
    return ('A shortcut named "' + $name + '" is now ' + $where + '. It opens RADE for ' + (Get-AppDisplay) + '.')
  } catch { return 'RADE could not make a desktop shortcut. Open RADE from the RADE page instead.' }
}
function Get-MadeLine {
  # Deploy: what the installs of the chosen app made, from the record (deploy v1 item 4: the list a user needs to remove it by hand).
  $out = @()
  $e = (Read-Installed (Get-InstalledKey $script:app))
  if ($e -and $e.steps) { foreach ($n in @($e.steps.Keys)) { foreach ($m in @($e.steps[$n].made)) { if ($null -ne $m) { $out += ('  ' + [string]$m.kind + ': ' + [string]$m.name + '  (' + [string]$n + ')') } } } }
  if ($out.Count) { return (@('Made by this app''s installs on this computer and site (to remove the app, remove these by hand):') + $out) }
  return @()
}
# Gives the help line that names the Teams channel (a name only, no link). Takes nothing; gives back the text.
function Get-HelpLine { return ('For help, ask in the Teams channel ' + $helpChannel + '.') }
# ==== Engine part: engine/ps/06-round.ps1 (sha256 880ed23999d0)
# RADE engine part 06, the round: Invoke-Round runs clean-up, downloads and every selected step, writes the report
# and makes the draft or the install record, through the phase functions below (one run table, $run). Uses parts 01
# to 05 and the progress state of 09; called by the window and text mode.
# Joined into every bundle by engine/rade_build.py; Windows PowerShell 5.1.

# Starts the record of one run: the folder, the history, the summary lines (line 1 = the e-mail subject), the mode
# line, whether the install can be whole, and the overall progress weights. Takes the Invoke-Round inputs; returns the
# run table that the other Round functions read and change ($run).
function Initialize-RoundRun([bool]$Clean, [bool[]]$Selected, [scriptblock]$Say, [string[]]$CheckLines) {
  $script:ranSteps = @()
  $script:roundBad = $false
  $script:runLog = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
  $script:helped = @{}; $script:blockedSteps = @()   # engine-v46: the steps a script policy blocked 2 times (end card)
  $run = @{ SayRaw = $Say; Base = (Resolve-Base); Started = (Get-Date); Deploy = (Test-Deploy); Prior = (Get-StepPrior) }   # Prior is empty in a test round
  $run.Hist = Read-RoundHistory $run.Base
  # Line 1 is the e-mail subject (PFM 13 Nov); PASSED or NEEDS REVIEW is added at the end (R06; words R13).
  $run.Summary = @(('90161Z ' + $round), ('Round ' + $round + ', build ' + $buildId + ', started ' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm')))
  $run.Summary += ('Application: ' + $script:app.Name)
  # A step that is off still counts when the record says it PASSED at this version (safe second run).
  $run.Whole = $true; foreach ($k in $script:appSteps) { if (-not [bool]$steps[$k].Optional -and -not $Selected[$k] -and $run.Prior[[string]$steps[$k].Name] -ne 'PASSED') { $run.Whole = $false } }   # an optional step ("default": false) is not needed for "installed"
  $run.StepRecs = @{}; $run.RunState = @{}   # RunState: every step this run reached (the "after" check); StepRecs: what goes to the record
  $run.Done = @(); $run.Sel = $Selected; $run.Resumed = $false; $run.Kept = @{}   # Done: each finished step, for the round state (12-resume.ps1)
  $run.ModeLine = ''; if ($run.Deploy) { $run.ModeLine = 'Mode: deploy, ' + (Get-InstalledText $script:app); $run.Summary += $run.ModeLine }
  if ($CheckLines) { $run.Summary += $CheckLines }
  $run.Units = 0
  # Overall bar: each unit weighs its expected seconds (Get-StepWeight); files and clean-up weigh little.
  $script:prog = @{ Total = 5.0; Done = 0.0; Cur = 0.0; CurKnown = $false; Known = $true; Start = $null; Frac = -1.0; FracText = ''; Index = 0; Count = 0 }
  if ($Clean -and $cleanup.Count) { $run.Units++; $script:prog.Total += 10 }
  $run.Total = 0
  for ($k = 0; $k -lt $steps.Count; $k++) {
    if (-not $Selected[$k]) { continue }
    $run.Units++; $run.Total++
    $w = Get-StepWeight $run.Hist $steps[$k]; $script:prog.Total += $w.Seconds; if (-not $w.Known) { $script:prog.Known = $false }
  }
  $script:prog.Count = $run.Units
  $run.N = 0; $run.K1 = 0
  return $run
}

# Gets the computer ready before the first step: the RADE folder, the notes (mode, newer version, text mode, Word), the
# bundle's files, the downloads, the saved e-mail address and the clean-up. Throws when a deploy must not go on.
# Takes the run table, the Clean switch and the To address; changes $run.Base and $run.Summary.
function Invoke-RoundSetup($run, [bool]$Clean, [string]$To, [scriptblock]$OnStatus) {
  $speak = $run.Speak
  & $speak ('RADE, round ' + $round + ' (build ' + $buildId + '), started ' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'))
  & $speak $script:scriptCheck.Line   # in the log and the report, so a round's results show it (docs/specs/bundle-hash.md)
  $run.Base = Move-ToRade $speak
  $base = $run.Base
  & $speak ('Working folder: ' + (ConvertTo-Masked $base))
  if ($run.ModeLine) { & $speak $run.ModeLine; $nv = Get-NewerVersionText; if ($nv) { & $speak $nv; $run.Summary += $nv } }
  if ($run.Deploy) { $blk = Get-InstalledBlock $script:app; if ($blk) { throw ($blk + '. No step ran') } }   # S1, S2: before any step
  if ($script:noWindowWhy) { & $speak ('Note: no window could open, so the round runs in text mode. Reason: ' + (ConvertTo-Masked $script:noWindowWhy)) }
  if (Test-WordOpen) { & $speak 'Note: Word is open. Renders use Word: save your documents and close Word if a step stops.' }
  & $speak ''
  Write-BundleFile $base $speak
  if ($script:closing) { throw 'the window was closed (Exit) while the round ran; no step ran' }
  $fl = Save-RoundDownload $base $speak
  if ($fl) { $run.Summary += $fl }
  # A deploy needs every file: with a failed download no step runs (deploy v1 item 5).
  if ($run.Deploy -and $script:roundBad) { throw 'a file this install needs could not be downloaded, so no step ran. Check the network connection, then run again' }
  # An empty box clears the saved address (review R06 #5).
  if (-not $run.Deploy) { try { if ($To -or (Get-MailTo $base)) { Save-MailTo $base $To } } catch { & $speak ('NOTE: could not save the e-mail address: ' + (ConvertTo-Masked $_.Exception.Message)) } }
  if ($cleanup.Count) {
    if ($Clean) {
      $run.N++; $script:prog.Index = $run.N; $script:prog.Cur = 10; $script:prog.CurKnown = $false; $script:prog.Frac = -1; $script:prog.Start = Get-Date
      & $OnStatus $run.N $run.Units 'Clean-up' 0; & $speak ''; $run.Summary += (Invoke-Cleanup $base $speak)
      $script:prog.Done += 10; $script:prog.Cur = 0
    }
    elseif ($run.Resumed) { $run.Summary += 'Clean-up: not run again (the round resumed)' }   # it could recycle what the kept steps made
    else { $run.Summary += 'Clean-up: SKIPPED by you' }
  }
}

# Returns the name of the first step that step $K needs ("after" in the manifest) and that has not PASSED, in this run
# or (deploy) at this version before; '' when every needed step passed.
function Get-StepNeed($run, [int]$K) {
  foreach ($a in @($steps[$K].After)) {
    if (-not $a) { continue }
    $okA = $(if ($run.RunState.ContainsKey([string]$a)) { $run.RunState[[string]$a] -eq 'PASSED' } else { $run.Prior[[string]$a] -eq 'PASSED' })
    if (-not $okA) { return [string]$a }
  }
  return ''
}

# Runs selected step $K: its heading in the log, the step itself (a script, or a hand step of kind "guide"), its result
# line, its record (state and made list), the bars and the history. Takes the run table, the step index, the person's
# answer and the window callbacks; changes $run (Summary, Whole, RunState, StepRecs, N, K1).
function Invoke-RoundStepAt($run, [int]$K, [string]$Ans, [scriptblock]$Tick, [scriptblock]$OnStep, [scriptblock]$OnStatus) {
  $speak = $run.Speak; $step = $steps[$K]
  $est = Get-StepEstimate $run.Hist $step.Name
  $w = Get-StepWeight $run.Hist $step
  $run.N++; $run.K1++
  $script:prog.Index = $run.N; $script:prog.Cur = $w.Seconds; $script:prog.CurKnown = $w.Known; $script:prog.Frac = -1; $script:prog.FracText = ''; $script:prog.Start = Get-Date
  & $OnStatus $run.N $run.Units $step.Name $est
  & $speak ''
  & $speak ('Step ' + $run.K1 + ' of ' + $run.Total + ': ' + $step.Name)
  if ($step.Note) { & $speak ('  ' + $step.Note) }
  & $speak ('  Started ' + (Get-Date -Format 'HH:mm') + $(if ($est) { '. Last successful run took ' + (Format-Duration $est) + '.' } else { '.' }))
  $t0 = Get-Date
  # "after" (manifest): a step runs only when each step it needs PASSED, in this run or (deploy) at this version before.
  $need = Get-StepNeed $run $K
  if ($need) { $r = @{ Pass = 0; Fail = 0; Exit = 0; Skipped = $true; Why = 'it needs "' + $need + '" to pass first' }; & $speak ('    Skipped: ' + $r.Why + '.') }
  elseif ($step.Kind -eq 'guide') { $r = Invoke-GuideStep $run.Base $step $speak }
  else { $r = Invoke-RoundStep $run.Base $step $speak $Tick $Ans }
  if ((Get-StepState $r) -ne 'SKIPPED') { $script:ranSteps += $step.Name }   # a step you skip, or one that only printed SKIP, expects no result files
  $secs = ((Get-Date) - $t0).TotalSeconds
  $state = Get-StepState $r
  if ($state -eq 'NEEDS REVIEW') { $script:roundBad = $true }
  if ($state -ne 'PASSED' -and -not [bool]$step.Optional) { $run.Whole = $false }   # a skipped step is not installed (review, deploy v1); an optional step that fails makes the run NEEDS REVIEW
  $made = @($r.Made | Where-Object { $_ }); if ($state -eq 'PASSED') { foreach ($m in @($step.Makes)) { $made += @{ kind = [string]$m.kind; name = [string]$m.name } } }
  $run.RunState[[string]$step.Name] = $state
  if ($script:closing -and $state -ne 'PASSED') { $state = 'INTERRUPTED' }   # the window closed while it ran: a resume runs it again
  if (-not $need) { $run.StepRecs[[string]$step.Name] = @{ state = $(if ($state -eq 'INTERRUPTED') { 'NEEDS REVIEW' } else { $state }); made = $made } }   # the record schema has no INTERRUPTED   # a step skipped for a missing dependency keeps its older record
  $line = Get-StepLine $step $r $secs
  $lines = @($line) + @($r.Answers | Where-Object { $_ } | ForEach-Object { [string]$_ })   # a hand step's answers, under its line
  & $speak ('  Result: ' + ($line.Substring($step.Name.Length + 2)))
  if ($state -eq 'NEEDS REVIEW' -and $step.Help) { $hl = '  What to do: ' + $step.Help; & $speak $hl; $lines += $hl }   # the step's own help text (manifest "help")
  $run.Summary += $lines
  $run.Done += @{ Name = [string]$step.Name; State = $state; Lines = $lines; Made = $made }
  $script:prog.Done += $script:prog.Cur; $script:prog.Cur = 0; $script:prog.Frac = -1
  & $OnStep $K $line
  Add-RoundHistory $run.Base $step.Name $(if ($state -eq 'PASSED') { 'OK' } else { 'CHECK' }) ([int]$secs)
  Save-RoundState $run $run.Sel   # pause and resume: the state after each step that ends (12-resume.ps1)
  if ($state -eq 'INTERRUPTED' -and -not $script:closing) {   # the CAC is out: stop here; the state above lets Resume run this step again
    throw ('INTERRUPTED: the sign-in failed in step "' + (Get-StepTitle $step) + '". Insert your CAC, then select Resume') }
}

# L4 (the Administrator, 2026-11-19), test rounds only: asks the last question "Anything else about this round or the app?"
# in the window ($script:feedbackUi) and gives back its report line. The text is masked as a text answer is and kept
# whole; empty is allowed. Text mode asks nothing. Takes the log callback; gives back the line "Other feedback: ...".
function Get-RoundFeedback([scriptblock]$Say) {
  if ($script:textMode -or -not $script:feedbackUi) { $v = 'not asked (text mode)' }
  else { $v = ConvertTo-UserText ([string](@(& $script:feedbackUi))[-1]); if (-not $v) { $v = '(none)' } }
  & $Say ('Other feedback: ' + $v)
  return ('Other feedback: ' + $v)
}

# Test rounds only: runs the shared-file self-test (docs/engine.md "Shared files") on a scratch folder that is removed
# again, logs its lines and adds one summary line. Changes $run.Summary and, on a failure, the round state.
function Test-RoundSharedFile($run) {
  $speak = $run.Speak
  $sf = @(Test-SharedFile (Join-Path (Join-Path (Join-Path $run.Base 'Rounds') $round) ('selftest' + $PID)))
  foreach ($l in $sf) { & $speak ('  ' + $l) }
  $sfBad = @($sf | Where-Object { $_ -notmatch '^PASS ' }).Count
  $run.Summary += ('Shared-file self-test: ' + ($sf.Count - $sfBad) + ' passed, ' + $sfBad + ' failed')
  if ($sfBad) { $script:roundBad = $true }
  & $speak ''
}

# A run that stops midway still leaves a report to send (the summary so far and the log up to the stop); a deploy also
# records the part install, here and (when the app keeps one) on the site. Takes the run table and the error record.
function Save-StoppedRound($run, $Err) {
  $run.Summary[0] = '90161Z ' + $round + ' STOPPED'
  $run.Summary += ('STOPPED: ' + (ConvertTo-Masked ([string]$Err)))
  if ($run.Deploy) { $run.Summary += (Get-HelpLine); & $run.SayRaw (Get-HelpLine); $sv = Save-Installed 'STOPPED' $run.Whole $run.StepRecs; if ($sv) { $run.Summary += ('NOTE: the installed-version record could not be saved: ' + $sv) }
    # A stopped run that reached a step is a part install too: record it on the site (never when the own record failed).
    if ($script:app.Marker -and $run.StepRecs.Count -and -not $sv) { try { $mw = Write-SiteMarker $run.Base $false; $run.Summary += $mw; & $run.SayRaw $mw } catch { $null = $_ } } }
  [void](Export-RoundResult $run.Base $run.Summary)
  Add-RoundHistory $run.Base 'ROUND' 'STOPPED' ([int]((Get-Date) - $run.Started).TotalSeconds)
}

# Deploy v1: nothing leaves this computer. The report stays in Rounds\<round>; the version record (and, when the app
# keeps one, the row on the site) is updated, and the made list is logged. Takes the run table, the final state and
# whether a step needs review.
function Complete-DeployRun($run, [string]$State, [bool]$Bad) {
  $speak = $run.Speak
  $script:draftMade = $false
  $sv = Save-Installed $State $run.Whole $run.StepRecs
  if ($sv) { & $speak ('NOTE: the installed-version record (RADE\Config\installed) could not be saved: ' + $sv) }
  if ($Bad) { & $speak ('Note: one or more items need review (see above). The report in Rounds\' + $round + ' shows what went wrong. Nothing was sent.'); & $speak (Get-HelpLine) }
  elseif (-not $run.Whole) { & $speak ('Note: some steps were off or skipped, so version ' + $script:app.Version + ' is not recorded as installed. Run again with every step on.') }
  else {
    & $speak ('Version ' + $script:app.Version + ' of ' + $script:app.Name + ' is recorded as installed.')
  }
  # Never when the own record could not be saved: the row would then stop this account's next run.
  if ($script:app.Marker -and $run.StepRecs.Count -and -not $sv) { $mw = Write-SiteMarker $run.Base ([bool]($run.Whole -and -not $Bad)); & $speak $mw; $run.Summary += $mw }
  $ml = @(Get-MadeLine); if ($ml.Count) { foreach ($l in $ml) { & $speak $l }; $run.Summary += $ml }
  [void](Export-RoundResult $run.Base $run.Summary)   # the report also holds the deploy notes and the made list
  & $speak ('DONE in ' + (Format-Duration ((Get-Date) - $run.Started).TotalSeconds) + '. The report is in Rounds\' + $round + ' on this computer. Nothing was sent.')
}

# Test rounds (R05): an Outlook draft with the summary and every result file; if Outlook cannot make one, the results
# folder opens and the summary is on the clipboard, with the steps to make the e-mail by hand. Takes the run table, the
# results (Export-RoundResult), the To address, the window's line callback and whether a step needs review.
function Complete-TestRun($run, $Z, [string]$To, [scriptblock]$WindowLine, [bool]$Bad) {
  $speak = $run.Speak; $summary = $run.Summary
  if ($Bad) { & $speak 'Note: one or more items need review (see above). Send the results anyway; they show what went wrong.' }
  $why = Save-RoundDraft $Z.Dir $summary $To (& $WindowLine)
  $script:draftMade = (-not $why)
  if ($script:draftMade) {
    & $speak ('DONE in ' + (Format-Duration ((Get-Date) - $run.Started).TotalSeconds) + '. An Outlook draft is open with the subject "' + $summary[0] + '", the summary and all result files (' + $Z.Count + ').')
    & $speak $(if ($To) { 'Review the draft, then select Send.' } else { 'Enter the To address in the draft (or in the box here for next time), then select Send.' })
  } else {
    & $speak ('The Outlook draft could not be created (' + $why + ').')
    & $speak ('DONE. The results folder Rounds\' + $round + ' is open and the summary is on the clipboard.')
    & $speak ('Create a new e-mail: paste the summary into the body, move the first line ("' + $summary[0] + '") into the subject, and attach all files from the folder (' + $Z.Count + ').')
  }
}

# Runs one round from start to end: the preparation, each selected step in order, the shared-file self-test (test
# rounds), the results folder and then the deploy record or the e-mail draft. Every line goes to $Say (with a "what to
# do" line after a known problem). Takes the window's choices and callbacks; returns the summary lines (line 1 = the
# subject). A run that stops writes its report first, then throws again.
function Invoke-Round([bool]$Clean, [bool[]]$Selected, [string]$To, [scriptblock]$Say, [scriptblock]$Tick, [scriptblock]$OnStep, [scriptblock]$OnStatus, [scriptblock]$WindowLine, [string[]]$Answers, [string[]]$CheckLines) {
  $resume = $script:resume; $script:resume = $null   # the round state to resume from (window or text mode), once
  if ($resume) { $Clean = $false; $rsel = Get-ResumeSelection $resume   # a step whose folder was not picked now stays off
    for ($k = 0; $k -lt $steps.Count; $k++) { if ($steps[$k].AskParam -and -not $Selected[$k]) { $rsel[$k] = $false } }; $Selected = $rsel }
  $run = Initialize-RoundRun $Clean $Selected $Say $CheckLines
  if ($resume) { Initialize-RoundResume $run $resume }
  $sayRaw = $Say
  # Logs a line, then a "what to do" line when the line names a known problem. Not a closure (GetNewClosure would hide
  # the bundle's own functions): the Round functions are called from here, so they find $sayRaw in this scope.
  $run.Speak = { param($t) & $sayRaw $t; $w = Get-WhatToDo $t; if ($w) { & $sayRaw $w } }
  $speak = $run.Speak
  try {
    Invoke-RoundSetup $run $Clean $To $OnStatus
    for ($k = 0; $k -lt $steps.Count; $k++) {
      if ($script:closing) { throw 'the window was closed (Exit) while the round ran; the steps after it did not run' }
      if ($script:stopAfter) { $script:stopAfter = $false; throw 'you stopped the run after a step; the steps after it did not run' }   # the window's Cancel question (plan engine-v48 step 3)
      if (-not $Selected[$k]) { if ($script:appSteps -contains $k) { $run.Summary += ($steps[$k].Name + $(if ($run.Prior[[string]$steps[$k].Name] -eq 'PASSED') { ': already done for version ' + $script:app.Version + ', not run again' } else { ': not selected' })) }; continue }
      if ($run.Kept.ContainsKey([string]$steps[$k].Name)) { Restore-RoundStep $run $k $OnStep; continue }   # resume: a passed step stays done
      $ans = ''; if ($Answers -and $Answers.Count -gt $k) { $ans = [string]$Answers[$k] }
      Invoke-RoundStepAt $run $k $ans $Tick $OnStep $OnStatus
    }
    & $speak ''
    if (-not $run.Deploy) { $run.Summary += (Get-RoundFeedback $speak); Test-RoundSharedFile $run }
    if ($script:closing) { throw 'the window was closed (Exit) while the round ran' }
    $run.Summary += (Get-FolderInventory $run.Base)
  } catch {
    Save-StoppedRound $run $_
    throw
  }
  $z = Export-RoundResult $run.Base $run.Summary
  $run.Summary += ('Results folder: Rounds\' + $round + ', files: ' + $z.Count + $(if (@($z.Missing).Count) { '; ' + @($z.Missing).Count + ' expected files missing: ' + ($z.Missing -join ', ') } else { '; no expected file missing' }) + '.')
  & $speak $run.Summary[-1]
  $bad = $script:roundBad   # a step that needs review, a failed clean-up or download, or a missing result file
  $state = $(if ($bad) { 'NEEDS REVIEW' } else { 'PASSED' })
  $run.Summary[0] = '90161Z ' + $round + ' ' + $state
  [void](Export-RoundResult $run.Base $run.Summary)   # rewrite so the report holds the RESULTS line and the subject
  Add-RoundHistory $run.Base 'ROUND' $(if ($bad) { 'CHECK' } else { 'OK' }) ([int]((Get-Date) - $run.Started).TotalSeconds)
  $script:resultsDir = $z.Dir
  # The round ended: nothing to resume, so its state file goes.
  try { $sp = Get-RoundStatePath $run.Base; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $sp -PathType Leaf) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $sp -Force -ErrorAction Stop } }
  catch { & $speak ('NOTE: the round state could not be removed: ' + (ConvertTo-Masked $_.Exception.Message)) }
  & $speak ''
  if ($run.Deploy) { Complete-DeployRun $run $state $bad; return ,$run.Summary }
  Complete-TestRun $run $z $To $WindowLine $bad
  return ,$run.Summary
}
# ==== Engine part: engine/ps/12-resume.ps1 (sha256 e041bf7395b7)
# RADE engine part 12, pause and resume (the PFM, 2026-11-20: every app needs a pause and resume for when the user
# closes the window, removes the CAC or is stopped in any other way). After each step ends, the round state goes to
# Rounds\<round>\rade-state.json; the same round of the same build can resume from it (docs/engine.md "Pause and resume").
# Uses parts 01 to 06 (Write-FileWhole, Move-ToRecycleBin, the run table); called by 06-round.ps1, the window and text mode.
# Network: none.
# Writes: Rounds\<round>\rade-state.json only (a temporary file, then one replace); Start over moves it to the Recycle Bin.
# Credentials: none.
# Joined into every bundle by engine/rade_build.py; Windows PowerShell 5.1.

$stateName = 'rade-state.json'   # the state file in the round's results folder; never attached to the e-mail draft
$stateSchema = 'rade-state/1'
# A step line that says the sign-in failed: the CAC may be out. Such a step is INTERRUPTED, not FAILED (the PFM, 2026-11-20).
$signInLost = '(?i)smart ?card|sign-?in (failed|was cancel+ed|timed out)|authentication (failed|was cancel+ed)|user cancel+ed authentication'

# Gives the path of the round state file. Takes the RADE app folder; gives back Rounds\<round>\rade-state.json.
function Get-RoundStatePath([string]$Base) { return (Join-Path (Join-Path (Join-Path $Base 'Rounds') $round) $stateName) }

# Writes the round state after a step ends: round, build, application, time, the selected steps, each finished step
# (state, its summary lines, its record) and the log so far. A failed write never stops the round: it is one log line.
# Takes the run table and the selection; gives back nothing.
function Save-RoundState($run, [bool[]]$Selected) {
  try {
    $sel = @(); for ($k = 0; $k -lt $steps.Count; $k++) { if ($Selected[$k]) { $sel += [string]$steps[$k].Name } }
    $done = @(foreach ($d in @($run.Done)) { @{ name = [string]$d.Name; state = [string]$d.State; lines = @($d.Lines); made = @($d.Made) } })
    $doc = [ordered]@{ schema = $stateSchema; round = [string]$round; build = [string]$buildId; app = [string]$script:app.Name
      saved = (Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss'); selected = $sel; steps = $done; log = @($script:runLog) }
    Write-FileWhole (Get-RoundStatePath $run.Base) (ConvertTo-Json -InputObject $doc -Depth 6)
  } catch { Add-RunLog ('NOTE: the round state could not be saved: ' + (ConvertTo-Masked $_.Exception.Message)) }
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
Reads the round state file Rounds\<round>\rade-state.json.
.DESCRIPTION
Only a file of this round, this build and this application can resume; another build never resumes (the PFM,
2026-11-20). Next and Total give "Resume at step Next of Total": Next is the first selected step that a resume runs.
The state of another application of the same paste reads as 'none' and stays in place.
.PARAMETER Base
The RADE app folder.
.OUTPUTS
@{ State; Why; Doc; Next; Total }. State: 'none' (no file), 'ok', 'other' (another round, build or application) or
'bad' (the file cannot be read); Why says why in plain words.
#>
function Read-RoundState([string]$Base) {
  $res = @{ State = 'none'; Why = ''; Doc = $null; Next = 0; Total = 0 }
  $p = Get-RoundStatePath $Base
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p -PathType Leaf)) { return $res }
  try { $j = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($p) | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop } catch { $res.State = 'bad'; $res.Why = 'the file is not valid JSON'; return $res }
  if (-not $j -or [string]$j.schema -ne $stateSchema -or $null -eq $j.selected -or $null -eq $j.steps) {
    $res.State = 'bad'; $res.Why = 'the file is not a RADE round state'; return $res }
  if ([string]$j.app -ne [string]$script:app.Name) { return $res }   # another application of this paste: its state stays for it
  if ([string]$j.round -ne [string]$round -or [string]$j.build -ne [string]$buildId) {
    $res.State = 'other'; $res.Why = 'it was saved by build ' + [string]$j.build; return $res }
  $sel = @($j.selected | ForEach-Object { [string]$_ }); $kept = Get-ResumeKept $j
  $res.Total = $sel.Count; $res.Next = $sel.Count
  for ($i = 0; $i -lt $sel.Count; $i++) { if (-not $kept.ContainsKey($sel[$i])) { $res.Next = $i + 1; break } }
  if (-not $sel.Count) { $res.State = 'bad'; $res.Why = 'the file names no step'; return $res }
  $res.State = 'ok'; $res.Doc = $j
  return $res
}

# Gives the finished steps a resume keeps: every step that ended (passed, failed, skipped, answered), not the one that
# was INTERRUPTED (CAC out, or the window closed while it ran). Takes the state document; gives back name to saved step.
function Get-ResumeKept($Doc) {
  $kept = @{}
  foreach ($s in @($Doc.steps)) { if ($s -and [string]$s.state -and [string]$s.state -ne 'INTERRUPTED') { $kept[[string]$s.name] = $s } }
  return $kept
}

# Start over (and a state file that cannot be read, or of another build): moves the state file to the Recycle Bin.
# Takes the RADE app folder; gives back '' or why it could not be moved.
function Clear-RoundState([string]$Base) {
  $p = Get-RoundStatePath $Base
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p -PathType Leaf)) { return '' }
  try { Move-ToRecycleBin $p; return '' } catch { return (ConvertTo-Masked $_.Exception.Message) }
}

# Gives the selection a resume runs: the steps the state names. Takes the state document; gives back one bool for each step.
function Get-ResumeSelection($Doc) {
  $names = @($Doc.selected | ForEach-Object { [string]$_ })
  $sel = @(); for ($k = 0; $k -lt $steps.Count; $k++) { $sel += [bool]($script:appSteps -contains $k -and $names -contains [string]$steps[$k].Name) }
  return ,$sel
}

# Starts a resumed run: the earlier log goes back into the run log under a marker line, and the summary says where the
# run resumes. Takes the run table and the state document; changes $run.Summary and the run log.
function Initialize-RoundResume($run, $Doc) {
  $run.Resumed = $true; $run.Kept = Get-ResumeKept $Doc
  foreach ($l in @($Doc.log)) { Add-RunLog ([string]$l) }
  Add-RunLog ('---- resumed ' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm') + ' (the lines above are from the run that stopped) ----')
  $run.Summary += ('Resumed: ' + $run.Kept.Count + ' finished steps kept from the run saved at ' + ([string]$Doc.saved -replace 'T', ' ') + '.')
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
Puts a kept step back into a resumed run, as if it ran; it does not run again.
.DESCRIPTION
Adds its summary lines, its saved state (for "after"), its record and made list, the step counters and its weight on
the overall bar, logs one "kept from the earlier run" line and tells the window that the step ended.
.PARAMETER run
The run table (Invoke-Round); its Kept table holds the saved step.
.PARAMETER K
The step index.
.PARAMETER OnStep
The window's step-ended callback.
.OUTPUTS
Nothing; changes $run.
#>
function Restore-RoundStep($run, [int]$K, [scriptblock]$OnStep) {
  $step = $steps[$K]; $s = $run.Kept[[string]$step.Name]; $lines = @($s.lines | ForEach-Object { [string]$_ }); $st = [string]$s.state
  $run.N++; $run.K1++
  $made = @(foreach ($m in @($s.made)) { if ($m) { @{ kind = [string]$m.kind; name = [string]$m.name } } })
  $run.RunState[[string]$step.Name] = $st; $run.StepRecs[[string]$step.Name] = @{ state = $st; made = $made }
  if ($st -ne 'SKIPPED') { $script:ranSteps += $step.Name }; $run.Summary += $lines
  if ($st -eq 'NEEDS REVIEW') { $script:roundBad = $true }; if ($st -ne 'PASSED' -and -not [bool]$step.Optional) { $run.Whole = $false }
  $run.Done += @{ Name = [string]$step.Name; State = $st; Lines = $lines; Made = $made }
  $script:prog.Done += (Get-StepWeight $run.Hist $step).Seconds
  & $run.Speak ('Step ' + $run.K1 + ' of ' + $run.Total + ': ' + $step.Name + ': kept from the earlier run (' + $st + '), not run again.')
  & $OnStep $K $lines[0]
}
