$dot = ' ' + [char]0x00B7 + ' '   # a middle dot between facts, made at run time so the bundle stays ASCII
# ---- Environment guard (the Administrator, 15 Nov 26): RADE runs on NIPR computers only. It reads this computer's own
# full name (host name and its domain: two local values; nothing is sent and no host is contacted) and goes on only when

$niprLabel = '.area52.'
# Reads this computer's own host name and domain name (two local values; no host is contacted). Takes nothing; gives
# back "host.domain", or an empty text on an error.
function Get-OwnFqdn { try { $g = [System.Net.NetworkInformation.IPGlobalProperties]::GetIPGlobalProperties(); return [string]$g.HostName + '.' + [string]$g.DomainName } catch { return '' } }
# Says whether this computer's full name has the NIPR domain label. Takes nothing; gives back $true or $false.
function Test-NiprDevice { return ([string](Get-OwnFqdn)).Trim().ToLowerInvariant().Contains($niprLabel) }

function Get-SiteUrl([string]$Base) {
  # Config\90161Z-site.txt: the same file T16 site setup keeps (one place for the site address; never in the repo).
  $p = Get-ConfigFile $Base '90161Z-site.txt'
  if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p -PathType Leaf) { try { return ([string](Get-Content -LiteralPath $p -TotalCount 1)).Trim() } catch { return '' } }
  return ''
}
$sitePrefix = 'https://usaf.dps.mil/sites/'   # the DAF SharePoint address every site starts with; the box starts with it
# Guardrail (the Administrator, 14 Nov 26): only a site on the DAF SharePoint host is accepted, so RADE never signs in to
# or writes to another host.
function Test-SiteUrl([string]$Url) { return ($Url -match ('^' + [regex]::Escape($sitePrefix) + '[^/\\\s"]+/?$')) }
# Writes the site address to Config\<prefix>-site.txt, creating the folder if needed. Takes the base folder and the
# address; gives back nothing.
function Save-SiteUrl([string]$Base, [string]$Url) {
  $p = Get-ConfigFile $Base '90161Z-site.txt'
  $dir = Split-Path -Parent $p
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir -PathType Container)) { [void](New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force) }
  [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($p, ($Url.Trim() + "`r`n"), (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $true))
}
function Get-FlowPortal([string]$Base) {
  # The address the guide steps open (editable there, remembered in Config); the first app step that names one wins.
  # A Config address is used only when its host is the host of the app's own fixed address (the Administrator,
  # 2026-11-17: no address from a file a user can change reaches another host).
  foreach ($k in $script:appSteps) {
    $s = $steps[$k]
    if ($s.Url) {
      if ($s.UrlConfig) { $p = Get-ConfigFile $Base $s.UrlConfig; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p -PathType Leaf) { try { $v = ([string](Get-Content -LiteralPath $p -TotalCount 1)).Trim(); if ((Test-SameHost $v $s.Url)) { return @{ Url = $v; Config = $p } } elseif ($v) { return @{ Url = $s.Url; Config = $p; Refused = $true } } } catch { $null = $_ } } }
      return @{ Url = $s.Url; Config = $(if ($s.UrlConfig) { Get-ConfigFile $Base $s.UrlConfig } else { '' }) }
    }
  }
  return @{ Url = ''; Config = '' }
}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
True when both addresses are https and name the same host (any letter case) and the same port.
.DESCRIPTION
The port is part of the rule (engine-v14): an address from a file a user can change must not make RADE touch another
port of the host (AGENTS.md "No reconnaissance"). An empty or broken address gives $false.
.PARAMETER Url
The address to check.
.PARAMETER Fixed
The fixed address it must match.
.OUTPUTS
$true or $false.
#>
function Test-SameHost([string]$Url, [string]$Fixed) {
  try { $a = [uri]$Url; $b = [uri]$Fixed } catch { return $false }
  if (-not $a -or -not $b) { return $false }
  return ($a.IsAbsoluteUri -and $b.IsAbsoluteUri -and $a.Scheme -eq 'https' -and $b.Scheme -eq 'https' -and $a.Host -ieq $b.Host -and $a.Port -eq $b.Port)
}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
Makes the web request every RADE read uses: the address itself never gets the Windows sign-in.
.DESCRIPTION
One place for the request rules (engine-v14; the Administrator, 2026-11-17 and 2026-11-18): TLS 1.2 is added (Windows
PowerShell 5.1 starts with TLS 1.0, which GitHub closes), the user agent of Edge's family is sent (a request with none
can be closed by a filtering proxy), the Windows sign-in is off for the address, and only the work proxy gets it.
The request is not sent here: the caller sends it and closes the answer.
.PARAMETER Url
The address to ask.
.PARAMETER TimeoutMs
How long to wait for the answer, in milliseconds.
.OUTPUTS
The request object (System.Net.WebRequest).
#>
function Get-WebRequest([string]$Url, [int]$TimeoutMs) {
  Use-TlsFloor
  $rq = [System.Net.WebRequest]::Create($Url)
  $rq.Timeout = $TimeoutMs
  try { $rq.UserAgent = $webAgent } catch { $null = $_ }   # a file address (tests) has no user agent
  try { $rq.UseDefaultCredentials = $false } catch { $null = $_ }   # a file address (tests) has no such setting; off is also the default
  try { if ($rq.Proxy) { $rq.Proxy.Credentials = [System.Net.CredentialCache]::DefaultNetworkCredentials } } catch { $null = $_ }   # no proxy: nothing to sign in to
  return $rq
}
function Test-WebReach([string]$Url) {
  # Does the host answer? Any HTTP answer counts (401 or 403 = it answers but wants a sign-in), so the address itself
  # never gets the Windows sign-in (the Administrator, 2026-11-17); only the proxy does.
  # Returns no address and no message text (they can hold the site or tenant name): only the code or the error kind.
  try {
    $rq = Get-WebRequest $Url 6000   # TLS 1.2, user agent, no sign-in for the address (R19 to R21 findings live there)
    try { $rq.AllowAutoRedirect = $false } catch { $null = $_ }   # the answer of this address counts, not of the next one
    $rs = $rq.GetResponse()
    $code = 0; try { $code = [int]$rs.StatusCode } catch { $null = $_ }
    $rs.Close()
    return @{ Ok = $true; Code = $code }
  } catch {
    $e = $_.Exception
    while ($e -and -not ($e -is [System.Net.WebException]) -and $e.InnerException) { $e = $e.InnerException }
    if ($e -is [System.Net.WebException] -and $e.Response) {
      $code = 0; try { $code = [int]$e.Response.StatusCode } catch { $null = $_ }
      if ($code -eq 407) { return @{ Ok = $false; Why = 'Network sign-in required, code [407]' } }
      return @{ Ok = $true; Code = $code }
    }
    if ($e -is [System.Net.WebException]) {
      $why = @{ Timeout = 'no reply in time'; NameResolutionFailure = 'address not found'; ConnectFailure = 'could not connect'; ProxyNameResolutionFailure = 'network proxy not found'; TrustFailure = 'the security certificate was not trusted'; SecureChannelFailure = 'secure connection failed' }[[string]$e.Status]
      if (-not $why) { $why = 'network error' }
      $why += ' [' + [string]$e.Status + ']'
      # R21 diagnostics: the inner error kinds, a socket error code and the TLS setting (names and numbers only, no address).
      $kinds = @(); $x = $e.InnerException
      while ($x) { $k = $x.GetType().Name; if ($x -is [System.Net.Sockets.SocketException]) { $k += ' ' + [int]$x.ErrorCode } elseif ($x.HResult) { $k += ' 0x' + ('{0:X8}' -f $x.HResult) }; $kinds += $k; $x = $x.InnerException }
      $tls = ''; try { $tls = [string][Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol } catch { $null = $_ }
      if ($kinds.Count -or $tls) { $why += ' (' + (@($kinds) + @('TLS ' + $tls) -join '; ') + ')' }
      return @{ Ok = $false; Why = $why }
    }
    return @{ Ok = $false; Why = 'network error [' + $e.GetType().Name + ']' }
  }
}
# Invoke-ChildScript (runs an embedded child script; R44 E4 stage limits): part 16, engine/ps/16-site-scripts.ps1.
# The sign-in window size block, the rights check script and the install record on the site: part 16, engine/ps/16-site-scripts.ps1.
$rightWords = @{ ViewListItems = 'read items'; AddListItems = 'add items'; EditListItems = 'edit items'; ManageLists = 'manage lists'; ManageWeb = 'manage the site'; ManagePermissions = 'manage permissions' }
$rightsNeeded = @('ManageLists', 'ManageWeb', 'ManagePermissions')   # what T16 site setup and list set-up use
function Write-SiteMarker([string]$Base, [bool]$Whole) {
  # After a deploy that ran a step: a part install is recorded too (its flows may be imported already), with the word
  # "partial". Returns the one line for the log and the report.
  $m = $script:app.Marker; $site = Get-SiteUrl $Base
  $where = '"' + $m.List + '", row "' + $m.Key + '"'
  $again = ' Until it is written, another account is not stopped from a second install on this site: run this deploy again'
  if (-not (Test-SiteUrl $site)) { return ('NOTE: the install record on the site (' + $where + ') was not written: no site address.' + $again) }
  $val = [string]$script:app.Version + ' ' + (Get-Date).ToString('yyyy-MM-dd', [System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture) + $(if ($Whole) { '' } else { ' partial' })
  $r = Invoke-ChildScript $markerScript ('-Site "' + $site + '"' + (Get-MarkerArg) + ' -Value "' + $val + '"') 300 $null $signInStageSeconds
  $null = Get-SignInNote 'Install record' $r.Lines   # engine-v43 S2, S3: the sign-in lines in the run log
  $w = ''; foreach ($l in $r.Lines) { if ($l -match '^RESULT (\S+)') { $w = $Matches[1] } }
  if ($w -in 'added', 'updated') { return ('Install record on the site: ' + $where + ' now holds version ' + $script:app.Version + ' and the date' + $(if ($Whole) { '' } else { ', marked partial' }) + ' (' + $w + ').') }
  $why = $(switch ($w) { 'no-list' { 'the list was not found' } 'no-pnp' { 'the SharePoint tool is not installed' } default { $(if ($r.Stage -eq 'signin') { 'the sign-in did not finish in ' + [int]($signInStageSeconds / 60) + ' minutes, so RADE stopped it' } else { 'the sign-in or the write did not finish' }) } })   # engine-v43 S1
  return ('NOTE: the install record on the site (' + $where + ') was not written: ' + $why + '.' + $again)
}
function Split-Sentence([string]$Text) {
  # One sentence per line on screen (PFM 14 Nov 26): a break after . ! or ? when a capital, a quote or a bracket follows.
  return ($Text -replace '(?<=[.!?])\s+(?=[A-Z"\[])', "`r`n")
}
function Format-CheckResult([string]$State, [string]$Detail, [string]$Fix) {
  # Text rule (the Administrator, 2026-11-14, replaces the full-stop rule): each Details line starts with a capital and ends
  # with no full stop; one fact per line, never joined with ";". Names on the screen (buttons, menus) are in "double quotes";
  # literal values the computer reports (versions, codes, error names) are in [brackets].
  if ($Detail) { $Detail = $Detail.Substring(0, 1).ToUpper() + $Detail.Substring(1); $Detail = $Detail -replace '\.$', '' }
  if ($Fix) { $Fix = $Fix -replace '\.$', '' }
  return @{ State = $State; Detail = $Detail; Fix = $Fix }
}
# Checks of this computer itself: NIPR name, PowerShell version and language mode, OneDrive, free space, a test file,
# and a child script. Takes the check id and the tick callback (for the child script); returns a check result
# (Format-CheckResult), or $null for an id it does not handle.
function Get-ComputerCheck([string]$Id, [scriptblock]$Tick) {
  $one = $null
  switch ($Id) {
  'nipr' {
    # Reads only this computer's own full name (Test-NiprDevice); the name itself is never shown or saved.
    if (Test-NiprDevice) { $one = Format-CheckResult 'PASSED' 'Read this computer''s own full name: it is in the area52 domain' '' }
    else { $one = Format-CheckResult 'FAILED' 'This application cannot be installed in your environment.' '' }
  }
  'ps' {
    $v = $PSVersionTable.PSVersion
    if ($v -ge [version]'5.1') { $one = Format-CheckResult 'PASSED' ('version [' + $v + ']') '' }
    else { $one = Format-CheckResult 'FAILED' ('version [' + $v + ']') 'Open Windows PowerShell ISE from the Start menu, then paste the round again' }
  }
  'lang' {
    $m = [string]$ExecutionContext.SessionState.LanguageMode
    if ($m -eq 'FullLanguage') { $one = Format-CheckResult 'PASSED' 'Not restricted' '' }
    else { $one = Format-CheckResult 'FAILED' ('Restricted [' + $m + ']') 'PowerShell is restricted on this computer. Contact your ISSM and send the results e-mail as is' }
  }
  'onedrive' {
    $od = Get-OneDrivePath
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $od -PathType Container) { $one = Format-CheckResult 'PASSED' 'found' '' }
    else { $one = Format-CheckResult 'FAILED' 'not found' 'Sign in to OneDrive, wait until it is up to date, then select "Run checks again"' }
  }
  'disk' {
    $od = Get-OneDrivePath
    $root = [System.IO.Path]::GetPathRoot($od); if (-not $root) { $root = [System.IO.Path]::GetPathRoot([System.IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) }
    $free = (New-Object System.IO.DriveInfo($root)).AvailableFreeSpace
    $need = 200MB; foreach ($f in $files) { $need += 2 * $f.Data.Length }
    $mb = [math]::Floor($free / 1MB)
    if ($free -lt $need) { $one = Format-CheckResult 'FAILED' ('{0:N0} MB free, {1:N0} MB needed' -f $mb, [math]::Ceiling($need / 1MB)) 'Free up space (for example, empty the Recycle Bin), then select "Run checks again"' }
    elseif ($free -lt 1GB) { $one = Format-CheckResult 'WARNING' ('{0:N0} MB free' -f $mb) 'Enough for this deployment. Free up space soon' }
    else { $one = Format-CheckResult 'PASSED' ('{0:N0} MB free' -f $mb) '' }
  }
  'write' {
    $od = Get-OneDrivePath
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $od -PathType Container)) { $one = Format-CheckResult 'NOT RUN' 'No OneDrive folder' 'Resolve the OneDrive check first' }
    else {
      $t = Join-Path $od ('90161Z-write-test-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N').Substring(0, 8) + '.tmp')
      [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($t, 'test'); Remove-Item -LiteralPath $t -Force
      $one = Format-CheckResult 'PASSED' 'Test file saved and deleted' ''
    }
  }
  'child' {
    # Steps run as child scripts with no -ExecutionPolicy setting (DEC 3); a Group Policy can block them. The test script
    # ends with code 8 if a Bypass setting was handed down to it, so "ran" proves a step runs without one.
    $r = Invoke-ChildScript "if (`$env:PSExecutionPolicyPreference -ceq 'Bypass') { exit 8 }`r`n'child ok'`r`nexit 7`r`n" '' 60 $Tick
    # The policy of each scope that sets one: on a pass the Group Policy scopes only; on a failure every scope, for the ISSM.
    $all = @(); try { $all = @(Get-ExecutionPolicy -List | Where-Object { [string]$_.ExecutionPolicy -ne 'Undefined' } | ForEach-Object { [string]$_.Scope + '=' + [string]$_.ExecutionPolicy }) } catch { $null = $_ }   # no scope list: the detail says none set
    $pol = (@($all | Where-Object { $_ -match '^\w*Policy=' }) -join ', ')
    if ($r.Exit -eq 7) { $one = Format-CheckResult 'PASSED' ('Test script ran' + $(if ($pol) { ', policy [' + $pol + ']' } else { '' })) '' }
    else { $one = Format-CheckResult 'FAILED' ('Test script did not run, exit code [' + $r.Exit + ']' + $(if ($r.Why) { ', ' + $r.Why } else { '' }) + ', scopes [' + $(if ($all.Count) { $all -join ', ' } else { 'none set' }) + ']') 'This computer blocks RADE scripts. Contact your ISSM and send the results e-mail as is' }
  }
  }
  return $one
}

# Checks of installed programs: classic Outlook (drafts), Word (renders; it must also be closed) and PnP.PowerShell.
# Takes the check id; returns a check result, or $null for an id it does not handle.
function Get-ProgramCheck([string]$Id) {
  $one = $null
  switch ($Id) {
  'outlook' {
    if ($env:OS -ne 'Windows_NT') { $one = Format-CheckResult 'WARNING' 'Not Windows' 'RADE opens the results folder and copies the summary for your e-mail' }
    elseif ([type]::GetTypeFromProgID('Outlook.Application')) { $one = Format-CheckResult 'PASSED' 'Installed' '' }
    else { $one = Format-CheckResult 'WARNING' 'Classic Outlook not found (new Outlook cannot make drafts)' 'RADE opens the results folder and copies the summary for your e-mail' }
  }
  'word' {
    if ($env:OS -eq 'Windows_NT' -and [type]::GetTypeFromProgID('Word.Application')) {
      if (Test-WordOpen) { $one = Format-CheckResult 'FAILED' 'Installed, but open now' 'Save your work, close Word, then select "Run checks again"' }   # PFM 14 Nov 26: blocks (1B)
      else { $one = Format-CheckResult 'PASSED' 'Installed' '' }
    } else { $one = Format-CheckResult 'FAILED' 'Not found' 'This application requires Microsoft Word' }
  }
  'pnp' {
    $m = @(Get-Module -ListAvailable -Name PnP.PowerShell | Sort-Object Version -Descending)
    if (-not $m.Count) { $one = Format-CheckResult 'FAILED' 'Not installed' 'Site steps require it. Use the manual steps in the repository' }
    elseif ([string]$m[0].Version -eq '1.12.0') { $one = Format-CheckResult 'PASSED' 'version [1.12.0]' '' }
    else { $one = Format-CheckResult 'WARNING' ('Version [' + $m[0].Version + '], tested with [1.12.0]') 'Likely compatible. If a site step fails, send the results as is' }
  }
  }
  return $one
}

# Checks that a fixed address answers (the repository's go file, the site, Power Automate). Only these addresses: no
# host finding (AGENTS.md "No reconnaissance"). Takes the check id, the RADE app folder and the site address; returns
# a check result, or $null for an id it does not handle.
function Get-NetworkCheck([string]$Id, [string]$Base, [string]$Site) {
  $one = $null
  switch ($Id) {
  'net-bookmark' {
    $w = Test-WebReach $goUrl   # the file the "newer round" notice reads
    if ($w.Ok) { $one = Format-CheckResult 'PASSED' ('reached' + $(if ($w.Code) { ', code [' + $w.Code + ']' } else { '' })) '' }
    else { $one = Format-CheckResult 'WARNING' ('Not reached: ' + $w.Why) 'Optional: only the new-round notice uses it' }
  }
  'net-site' {
    if (-not (Test-SiteUrl $Site)) { $one = Format-CheckResult 'NOT RUN' 'No site address' ('Complete the "Site address" box (it starts with ' + $sitePrefix + '), then select "Run checks again"') }
    else {
      $w = Test-WebReach $Site
      if ($w.Ok) { $one = Format-CheckResult 'PASSED' ('Reached' + $(if ($w.Code -in 401, 403) { ', code [' + $w.Code + '] (sign-in required, as expected)' } elseif ($w.Code) { ', code [' + $w.Code + ']' } else { '' })) '' }
      else { $one = Format-CheckResult 'FAILED' ('Not reached: ' + $w.Why) 'Verify the address opens in Edge, then select "Run checks again"' }
    }
  }
  'net-flow' {
    $fp = Get-FlowPortal $Base
    if (-not $fp.Url) { $one = Format-CheckResult 'NOT RUN' 'No Power Automate address' '' }
    else {
      $w = Test-WebReach $fp.Url
      if ($w.Ok -and $fp.Refused) { $one = Format-CheckResult 'WARNING' ('reached the app''s own address; the saved address is not on ' + ([uri]$fp.Url).Host + ' and was not used') 'Enter an address on that host in the Power Automate step, or leave it as it is' }
      elseif ($w.Ok) { $one = Format-CheckResult 'PASSED' ('reached' + $(if ($w.Code) { ', code [' + $w.Code + ']' } else { '' })) '' }
      else { $one = Format-CheckResult 'FAILED' ('Not reached: ' + $w.Why) 'If Power Automate opens in Edge, select "Check Power Automate"' }
    }
  }
  }
  return $one
}

# The site rights check: a child script signs in with the CAC and prints only right names, True/False, the admin flag
# and the install record's version ($rightsScript). Fails on a missing right or on another account's install record.
# Takes the RADE app folder, the site address and the tick callback; returns a check result.
function Get-SiteRightsCheck([string]$Base, [string]$Site, [scriptblock]$Tick) {
  if (-not (Test-SiteUrl $Site)) { $one = Format-CheckResult 'NOT RUN' 'No site address' ('Complete the "Site address" box first (it starts with ' + $sitePrefix + ')') }
  else {
    $r = Invoke-ChildScript $rightsScript ('-Site "' + $Site + '"' + (Get-MarkerArg)) 300 $Tick $signInStageSeconds   # engine-v43 S1: a frozen sign-in stops after 3 minutes
    $have = @{}; $adm = 'unknown'; $mk = ''; $signLine = ''
    foreach ($l in $r.Lines) {
      if ($l -match '^RIGHT (\w+) (True|False)$') { $have[$Matches[1]] = ($Matches[2] -eq 'True') }
      if ($l -match '^ADMIN (True|False|unknown)$') { $adm = $Matches[1] }
      if ($l -match '^MARKER (none|unknown|found [0-9.]+)$') { $mk = $Matches[1] }
    }
    $signLine = Get-SignInNote 'Rights check' $r.Lines   # R43 E4, engine-v43 S2, S3: the sign-in time, the host, the window state
    $admText = 'Site collection administrator: ' + $(switch ($adm) { 'True' { 'yes' } 'False' { 'no' } default { 'not read' } }) + ' (shown only, not required)'
    if (-not $have.Count) {
      $why = 'Sign-in did not finish'; foreach ($l in $r.Lines) { if ($l -match '^RESULT (\S+)') { $why = $Matches[1] } }
      if ($why -eq 'not-connected') { $why = 'Sign-in did not finish' }
      if ($why -eq 'no-pnp') { $one = Format-CheckResult 'FAILED' 'SharePoint tool not installed' 'See the SharePoint tool check' }
      else { $one = Format-CheckResult 'FAILED' ($why + $(if ($r.Why) { ', ' + $r.Why } else { '' })) 'Select "Sign in and check site rights" and complete the CAC sign-in' }
    } else {
      $miss = @($rightsNeeded | Where-Object { -not $have[$_] } | ForEach-Object { $rightWords[$_] })
      $got = @($have.Keys | Sort-Object | Where-Object { $have[$_] } | ForEach-Object { $rightWords[$_] })
      if ($miss.Count) { $one = Format-CheckResult 'FAILED' ('Missing: ' + ($miss -join ', ')) 'Ask a site owner to add you to the site Owners group' }
      elseif ((Test-FirstInstall) -and $mk -like 'found *') { $one = Format-CheckResult 'FAILED' ('This site already has an install of this application [version ' + $(if ($mk -eq 'found 0') { 'not readable' } else { $mk.Substring(6) }) + '], made from another account or for another site') 'Do not install again: every flow would run twice. Ask the person who installed it to run RADE' }
      elseif ((Test-FirstInstall) -and $mk -ne 'none') { $one = Format-CheckResult 'FAILED' 'The install record on the site could not be read' 'Select "Sign in and check site rights" again' }
      else { $one = Format-CheckResult 'PASSED' ('Rights: ' + ($got -join ', ') + '. ' + $admText) '' }
    }
    if ($signLine) { $one.Detail = [string]$one.Detail + '. ' + $signLine }   # R43 E4, engine-v43: shown in Details and the report (also when the sign-in did not finish)
  }
  return $one
}

# The Power Automate check that a person answers by looking: in text mode at the prompt, in the window on a hand card
# ($script:guideUi). Takes the RADE app folder; returns a check result (NOT RUN when it is not answered).
function Get-FlowGuideCheck([string]$Base) {
  if ($script:textMode) {
    $fp = Get-FlowPortal $Base
    Write-Host ('  Open Power Automate (' + $fp.Url + '). Look at the left menu for "Solutions" (it may be under "More"), then select "My flows" and look for "Import".')
    $a = ([string](Read-Host 'Did you see both "Solutions" and "Import"? Type Y or N and press Enter')).Trim()
    if ($a -match '^[Yy]') { $one = Format-CheckResult 'PASSED' 'Confirmed by you' '' }
    else { $one = Format-CheckResult 'FAILED' '"Solutions" or "Import" not shown' 'Ask your Power Automate administrator for maker access' }
  }
  else {
    $fp = Get-FlowPortal $Base
    $g = @{ Name = 'Check Power Automate'; File = ''; Url = $fp.Url; DoneText = 'Yes: I see both'; NoText = 'No: one is missing'; SkipText = 'Not now'
      Guide = @('You look in Power Automate and answer (about 2 minutes, an estimate). Nothing is changed.',
        '1. Select Open in browser. Power Automate opens; sign in with your CAC if asked.',
        '2. Look at the left menu: it must show Solutions (it may be under More).',
        '3. Select My flows: Import must show at the top of the page.',
        '4. Come back here. Select Yes if you saw both, No if one is missing.') }
    $a = 'Cancel'; if ($script:guideUi) { $a = [string](@(& $script:guideUi $g '' $fp.Url $fp.Config))[-1] }
    if ($a -eq 'OK') { $one = Format-CheckResult 'PASSED' 'Confirmed by you' '' }
    elseif ($a -eq 'No') { $one = Format-CheckResult 'FAILED' '"Solutions" or "Import" not shown' 'Ask your Power Automate administrator for maker access' }
    else { $one = Format-CheckResult 'NOT RUN' 'Not answered' 'Select "Check Power Automate" when ready' }
  }
  return $one
}

# Runs one check (the ids of $checkDefs) and gives its result. States: PASSED, WARNING, FAILED, NOT RUN. Detail and Fix
# never hold the site address or the DODID. An error in a check is a FAILED result, and an advisory check never
# FAILS (WARNING instead). Takes the check definition, the RADE app folder, the site address and the tick callback.
function Invoke-Check($Def, [string]$Base, [string]$Site, [scriptblock]$Tick) {
  $one = $null
  try {
    switch ($Def.Id) {
      { $_ -in 'nipr', 'ps', 'lang', 'onedrive', 'disk', 'write', 'child' } { $one = Get-ComputerCheck $Def.Id $Tick; break }
      { $_ -in 'outlook', 'word', 'pnp' } { $one = Get-ProgramCheck $Def.Id; break }
      { $_ -in 'net-bookmark', 'net-site', 'net-flow' } { $one = Get-NetworkCheck $Def.Id $Base $Site; break }
      'site-rights' { $one = Get-SiteRightsCheck $Base $Site $Tick; break }
      'flow-guide' { $one = Get-FlowGuideCheck $Base; break }
      default { $one = Format-CheckResult 'NOT RUN' 'unknown check' '' }
    }
  } catch { $one = Format-CheckResult 'FAILED' ('Check stopped with an error [' + $_.Exception.GetType().Name + ']') 'Select "Run checks again". If it repeats, send the results as is' }
  if ($Def.Advisory -and $one.State -eq 'FAILED') { $one.State = 'WARNING' }
  return $one
}
function Get-CheckSummary($Results) {
  # For the summary and the e-mail: one count line, then one line for each check that did not pass.
  $c = @{ PASSED = 0; WARNING = 0; FAILED = 0; 'NOT RUN' = 0 }
  $rest = @(); $saved = 0
  foreach ($id in $script:appChecks) {
    $r = $Results[$id]; $d = Get-CheckDef $id
    if (-not $r) { $r = Format-CheckResult 'NOT RUN' 'not run' '' }
    $c[$r.State]++
    if ($r.Saved) { $saved++ }
    if ($r.State -ne 'PASSED') { $rest += ('  ' + $r.State + ': ' + $d.Name + '. ' + $r.Detail) }
  }
  $savedText = $(if ($saved) { ' (' + $saved + ' from saved results)' } else { '' })
  return @(@(('Checks. Passed: ' + $c.PASSED + $savedText + '. Warnings: ' + $c.WARNING + '. Failed: ' + $c.FAILED + '. Not run: ' + $c['NOT RUN'] + '.')) + $rest) | ForEach-Object { ConvertTo-Masked $_ }
}
function Get-CheckBlock($Results) {
  # PFM 14 Nov 26: no deploy unless every check passes (a half-done deploy is hard to undo). FAILED or NOT RUN blocks;
  # a WARNING (an advisory check, or a problem the deploy can live with) does not. No "deploy anyway".
  foreach ($id in $script:appChecks) { $r = $Results[$id]; if (-not $r -or $r.State -in 'FAILED', 'NOT RUN', 'RUNNING') { return $true } }
  return $false
}
# ==== Engine part: engine/ps/16-site-scripts.ps1 (sha256 b61c156f8c26)
# RADE engine part 16, the site scripts of the checks (moved out of engine/ps/07-checks.ps1 to keep each file at 450
# lines or fewer; fleet v2 DEC 6): the sign-in block ($signInSize, Add-SignInSize), the rights check script
# ($rightsScript), Invoke-ChildScript (moved from part 07 in engine-v42), and the install record on the site
# (Get-MarkerArg, Get-SiteMark, Test-InstalledHere, Test-FirstInstall, $markerScript). Part 07 runs them (Invoke-Check,
# Write-SiteMarker); parts 13 and 14 use Add-SignInSize when they load, so this part comes right after part 07.
# Network: none when it loads; the child scripts it holds sign in to the saved site on the DAF SharePoint host (PnP).
# Writes: none when it loads; Invoke-ChildScript writes each child script to the temp folder and deletes it at the end;
# $markerScript writes the install record (one row of the app's own list on the site).
# Credentials: the interactive CAC sign-in of PnP (-UseWebLogin), in the child scripts.
# Joined into every bundle by engine/rade_build.py, right after part 07; Windows PowerShell 5.1.

<#
.SYNOPSIS
Runs an embedded child script as a child powershell.exe, the way steps run, and gives back its exit code and output lines.
.DESCRIPTION
No -ExecutionPolicy setting (fleet v2, DEC 3: Group Policy governs). The script is written to the Windows temp folder and
deleted at the end. With StageSeconds (R44 E4), RADE reads the output while the child runs: a line "STAGE <name>" starts a
stage, a stage that runs longer than StageSeconds stops the child (Stage then names it), and "STAGE none" ends the timed
stage. Without it, the output is read at the end (the test child of the policy check).
.PARAMETER Text
The script text.
.PARAMETER ArgText
The arguments after the script path.
.PARAMETER Seconds
The time limit of the whole child.
.PARAMETER Tick
A script block called about every 30 ms while the child runs (the window stays live), or $null.
.PARAMETER StageSeconds
The time limit of one stage, or 0 for no stage limit.
.OUTPUTS
@{ Exit; Lines; Why; Stage }: Stage is the stage that was stopped, or ''.
#>
function Invoke-ChildScript([string]$Text, [string]$ArgText, [int]$Seconds, [scriptblock]$Tick, [int]$StageSeconds = 0) {
  $exe = 'powershell.exe'
  if (-not (Get-Command $exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { $exe = 'pwsh' }
  $tmp = Join-Path ([System.IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ('90161Z-check-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N').Substring(0, 8) + '.ps1')
  $res = @{ Exit = -1; Lines = @(); Why = ''; Stage = '' }
  try {
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($tmp, $Text, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $true))
    $psi = New-Object System.Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo
    $psi.FileName = $exe
    $psi.Arguments = '-NoProfile -File "' + $tmp + '"' + $(if ($ArgText) { ' ' + $ArgText } else { '' })
    $psi.UseShellExecute = $false; $psi.CreateNoWindow = $true
    $psi.RedirectStandardOutput = $true; $psi.RedirectStandardError = $true
    # A PowerShell started with -ExecutionPolicy hands that setting to its child processes in this variable (an old RADE
    # shortcut sets "Bypass"): take only that value out, as Get-StepStartInfo does, else a check would say "ran" where a
    # step cannot. Any other value a person set stays.
    if ($psi.EnvironmentVariables['PSExecutionPolicyPreference'] -ceq 'Bypass') { $psi.EnvironmentVariables.Remove('PSExecutionPolicyPreference') }
    $p = [System.Diagnostics.Process]::Start($psi)
    $script:child = $p   # Exit stops a check too (review R17)
    $errTask = $p.StandardError.ReadToEndAsync(); $got = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $outTask = $null; $rd = $null
    if ($StageSeconds -gt 0) { $rd = $p.StandardOutput.ReadLineAsync() } else { $outTask = $p.StandardOutput.ReadToEndAsync() }
    $deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds($Seconds); $stage = ''; $stageEnd = [datetime]::MaxValue
    while ($true) {
      while ($rd -and $rd.IsCompleted) {   # the lines that are there now; a STAGE line starts a stage and its time limit
        $l = $rd.Result; if ($null -eq $l) { $rd = $null; break }
        $got.Add($l); if ($l -match '^STAGE (.+)$') { $stage = $Matches[1].Trim(); $stageEnd = (Get-Date).AddSeconds($StageSeconds)
          if ($stage -eq 'none') { $stage = '' } }   # "STAGE none": no stage runs (engine-v43)
        $rd = $p.StandardOutput.ReadLineAsync() }
      if ($p.WaitForExit(30)) { break }
      if ($Tick) { & $Tick }
      if ((Get-Date) -gt $deadline) { try { $p.Kill() } catch { $null = $_ }; $res.Why = 'it ran longer than ' + $Seconds + ' seconds'; break }
      if ($stage -and (Get-Date) -gt $stageEnd) { try { $p.Kill() } catch { $null = $_ }   # it ended already
        $res.Stage = $stage; $res.Why = 'its stage "' + $stage + '" ran longer than ' + $StageSeconds + ' seconds'; break }
    }
    $p.WaitForExit()
    while ($rd) { $l = $rd.Result; if ($null -eq $l) { break }; $got.Add($l); $rd = $p.StandardOutput.ReadLineAsync() }   # the last lines after the end
    $res.Exit = $p.ExitCode
    $all = $(if ($outTask) { @(([string]$outTask.Result) -split "`r?`n") } else { @($got) })
    $res.Lines = @($all | Where-Object { $_ })
    if (-not $res.Why -and ([string]$errTask.Result).Trim()) { $res.Why = 'it wrote error output' }
  } catch { $res.Why = $_.Exception.GetType().Name }
  finally { $script:child = $null; try { if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $tmp) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $tmp -Force } } catch { $null = $_ } }
  return $res
}
# engine-v43 S1 (the PFM, 2026-11-26): the time limit of the sign-in stage of the rights, install record and Restore children
# (Back up keeps its own stage limit, $toolStageSeconds). A frozen sign-in then ends with its stage named: no force close.
$signInStageSeconds = 180
<#
.SYNOPSIS
Puts the sign-in lines of a child (SIGNIN, SIGNIN-WIN) into the run log with RADE's host, and gives the short note.
.DESCRIPTION
engine-v43 S2, S3: each line goes to the run log as "<name> <line> host=<host>" ($env:RADE_HOST: ise, child, shortcut or
console; set by part 09). The note is the SIGNIN line with the host, else (a sign-in that did not finish) the last
SIGNIN-WIN line with the host, else ''.
.PARAMETER Name
The child's name in the log (for example "Rights check").
.PARAMETER Lines
The child's output lines.
.OUTPUTS
The note, or ''.
#>
function Get-SignInNote([string]$Name, [object[]]$Lines) {
  $hostTag = ' host=' + $(if ($env:RADE_HOST) { $env:RADE_HOST } else { 'unknown' })
  $s = @($Lines | Where-Object { [string]$_ -match '^SIGNIN(-WIN)? ' })
  foreach ($l in $s) { Add-RunLog ($Name + ' ' + $l + $hostTag) }
  $done = @($s | Where-Object { [string]$_ -match '^SIGNIN seconds=' } | Select-Object -First 1)
  if ($done.Count) { return ([string]$done[0] + $hostTag) }
  if ($s.Count) { return ([string]$s[-1] + $hostTag) }
  return ''
}
# Gives the words for a stage of the Back up child ("signin", "site", "list <n>"). Takes the stage and the list titles.
function Get-StageText([string]$Stage, [object[]]$Lists) {
  if ($Stage -eq 'signin') { return 'the sign-in' }
  if ($Stage -eq 'site') { return 'the site check' }
  if ($Stage -match '^list (\d+)$' -and [int]$Matches[1] -ge 1 -and [int]$Matches[1] -le @($Lists).Count) { return ('the read of the list "' + [string]$Lists[[int]$Matches[1] - 1] + '"') }
  return ('the stage "' + $Stage + '"')
}
# E3 (R42 plan; the Owner, 2026-11-21): the one copy of the sign-in block. Each child script that signs in holds the
# line "# <RADE sign-in window size>" in its place; Add-SignInSize puts the block there. An app copies the block (from its
# start line to its end line) into its own task scripts, so both use the same code. The block, its variable and its two
# marker lines keep their names (an app's build finds the block by them), though it no longer sizes a window.
$signInSize = @'
# ---- RADE sign-in window size (start; engine/ps/07-checks.ps1 $signInSize; E3, the Owner, 2026-11-21)
# engine-v44 (the PFM, 2026-11-26): RADE never touches the CAC sign-in window of Connect-PnPOnline -UseWebLogin; it opens
# at its own size. The size watch of engine-v35 to engine-v43 (Start-SignInSize) is gone: it froze the sign-in
# (90-161.Z R44 r2, one host: watch on, 2 windows not responding at 9 s; watch off, signed in after 5 s).
# The block holds the read-only window report (Start-SignInReport, Stop-SignInReport), the DPI setting of engine-v46
# (Set-SignInDpiAware) and the one sign-in (Connect-RadeSite).
# Copy this block unchanged between its start and end lines (an app's task scripts may hold the same copy).
# Windows PowerShell 5.1, no module. When the report helper cannot be compiled (Constrained Language Mode), the sign-in
# goes on without it.
# engine-v43 S2 (the PFM, 2026-11-26: R44 r1 froze at the sign-in with no data): while Connect-PnPOnline runs, a
# background timer reads the windows of THIS process only, about every second, and prints one line at each change:
# "SIGNIN-WIN t=<seconds> windows=<visible> owned=<visible with an owner> min=<minimized> size=<largest WxH>
# hung=<not responding> front=<1 when the foreground window is one of them>". No title, no text, no other process.
# The parent reads the lines while the child runs (Invoke-ChildScript -StageSeconds), so a frozen sign-in still reports.
function Start-SignInReport {
  [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess, ConfirmImpact = 'None')]
  param()
  if (-not $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess('the windows of this process', 'Report their state')) { return }   # -WhatIf: no timer
  if ($env:OS -ne 'Windows_NT' -and $env:RADE_SIGNIN_TEST -ne '1') { return }   # Windows only (the cloud test compiles it)
  try {
    if (-not ('RadeSignIn.Report1' -as [type])) {
      Add-Type -Namespace RadeSignIn -Name Report1 -ErrorAction Stop -MemberDefinition @"
public delegate bool WinProc(System.IntPtr h, System.IntPtr l);
[System.Runtime.InteropServices.DllImport("user32.dll")] static extern bool EnumThreadWindows(uint tid, WinProc f, System.IntPtr l);
[System.Runtime.InteropServices.DllImport("user32.dll")] static extern bool IsWindowVisible(System.IntPtr h);
[System.Runtime.InteropServices.DllImport("user32.dll")] static extern bool IsIconic(System.IntPtr h);
[System.Runtime.InteropServices.DllImport("user32.dll")] static extern bool IsHungAppWindow(System.IntPtr h);
[System.Runtime.InteropServices.DllImport("user32.dll")] static extern System.IntPtr GetWindow(System.IntPtr h, uint cmd);
[System.Runtime.InteropServices.DllImport("user32.dll")] static extern System.IntPtr GetForegroundWindow();
[System.Runtime.InteropServices.DllImport("user32.dll")] static extern bool GetWindowRect(System.IntPtr h, out Rect r);
[System.Runtime.InteropServices.StructLayout(System.Runtime.InteropServices.LayoutKind.Sequential)]
public struct Rect { public int L, T, R, B; }
static System.Threading.Timer timer; static object gate = new object(); static System.DateTime t0; static string last = "";
static int n, owned, mins, hung, front, bw, bh; static long fg; static WinProc each = Each;
// Starts the report: one look now, then one every tickMs, until End. The timer starts outside the lock, so the first look runs.
public static void Begin(int tickMs) { End(false); lock (gate) { t0 = System.DateTime.Now; last = ""; }
  System.Threading.Timer tm = new System.Threading.Timer(Tick, null, System.Threading.Timeout.Infinite, System.Threading.Timeout.Infinite);
  lock (gate) { timer = tm; } tm.Change(0, tickMs); }
// Ends the report: waits until no tick runs, then, with final, prints one last line (the state at the end).
public static void End(bool final) {
  System.Threading.Timer tm; lock (gate) { tm = timer; timer = null; }
  // The event is closed only when the last tick has ended: a tick that runs past 2 s signals it later, and a closed event
  // would then end this process (review of PR 201). In that rare case the event is closed later by the garbage collector.
  if (tm != null) { System.Threading.ManualResetEvent done = new System.Threading.ManualResetEvent(false); if (!tm.Dispose(done) || done.WaitOne(2000)) { done.Dispose(); } }
  if (final) { lock (gate) { Look(true); } } }
// One timer tick: a tick that starts while another look runs is skipped; a tick after End prints nothing.
static void Tick(object state) {
  if (!System.Threading.Monitor.TryEnter(gate)) { return; }
  try { if (timer != null) { Look(false); } } finally { System.Threading.Monitor.Exit(gate); } }
// Reads the windows of this process and prints a line when the state changed since the last line, or when force is set.
// The caller holds gate.
static void Look(bool force) {
  try { n = 0; owned = 0; mins = 0; hung = 0; front = 0; bw = 0; bh = 0; fg = GetForegroundWindow().ToInt64();
    using (System.Diagnostics.Process me = System.Diagnostics.Process.GetCurrentProcess()) {
      foreach (System.Diagnostics.ProcessThread t in me.Threads) { EnumThreadWindows((uint)t.Id, each, System.IntPtr.Zero); } }
    string s = "windows=" + n + " owned=" + owned + " min=" + mins + " size=" + bw + "x" + bh + " hung=" + hung + " front=" + front;
    if (s != last || force) { last = s; System.Console.Out.WriteLine("SIGNIN-WIN t=" + (int)(System.DateTime.Now - t0).TotalSeconds + " " + s); System.Console.Out.Flush(); } }
  catch { } }
static bool Each(System.IntPtr hw, System.IntPtr l) {
  if (!IsWindowVisible(hw)) { return true; }
  n++; if (GetWindow(hw, 4) != System.IntPtr.Zero) { owned++; } if (IsIconic(hw)) { mins++; } if (IsHungAppWindow(hw)) { hung++; } if (hw.ToInt64() == fg) { front = 1; }
  Rect r; if (GetWindowRect(hw, out r) && (r.R - r.L) * (r.B - r.T) > bw * bh) { bw = r.R - r.L; bh = r.B - r.T; }
  return true; }
"@
    }
    [RadeSignIn.Report1]::Begin(1000)
  } catch { $null = $_ }   # no helper: the sign-in goes on without the report
}
function Stop-SignInReport {
  [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess, ConfirmImpact = 'None')]
  param()
  if (-not $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess('the window report of this process', 'Stop')) { return }
  try { if ('RadeSignIn.Report1' -as [type]) { [RadeSignIn.Report1]::End($true) } } catch { $null = $_ }   # no report: nothing to stop
}
# engine-v47 (the PFM, 2026-11-26, from the R46 run: "SIGNIN-DPI aware=yes", then the sign-in window opened only after
# about 90 s and 100 s; "dpiaware is clearly the culprit"): the DPI setting of engine-v46 is OFF unless
# $env:RADE_SIGNIN_DPI = '1'. The RADE window sets '0' for its children (part 09), so an app's older copy of this block,
# which turns it off only on '0', is off too. With it on, the child becomes DPI-aware (SetProcessDPIAware) before the
# sign-in, so Windows draws the PnP window at its own pixels, not stretched (90-161.Z R45 finding 2); RADE does not move,
# size or watch the window (engine-v44). Prints "SIGNIN-DPI aware=<yes|was|no|off>": yes (now aware), was (already
# aware), no (Windows did not take it, or not Windows), off (not turned on). Takes nothing.
function Set-SignInDpiAware {
  [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess, ConfirmImpact = 'None')]
  param()
  if ($env:RADE_SIGNIN_DPI -ne '1') { return 'SIGNIN-DPI aware=off' }   # engine-v47: off unless turned on
  if (-not $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess('this process', 'Make DPI-aware')) { return 'SIGNIN-DPI aware=no' }
  if ($env:OS -ne 'Windows_NT') { return 'SIGNIN-DPI aware=no' }
  try {
    if (-not ('RadeSignIn.Dpi1' -as [type])) {
      Add-Type -Namespace RadeSignIn -Name Dpi1 -ErrorAction Stop -MemberDefinition @"
[System.Runtime.InteropServices.DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool SetProcessDPIAware();
[System.Runtime.InteropServices.DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool IsProcessDPIAware();
"@
    }
    if ([RadeSignIn.Dpi1]::IsProcessDPIAware()) { return 'SIGNIN-DPI aware=was' }
    if ([RadeSignIn.Dpi1]::SetProcessDPIAware()) { return 'SIGNIN-DPI aware=yes' }
  } catch { $null = $_ }   # no helper (Constrained Language Mode): the sign-in goes on at Windows' size
  return 'SIGNIN-DPI aware=no'
}
# engine-v43 S1: the one sign-in of a child script. Prints "STAGE signin" (the parent stops a stage that runs too long),
# signs in with the CAC (PnP web login), prints "SIGNIN seconds=<n>" and "STAGE none" (no stage runs).
# Throws when the sign-in fails, as Connect-PnPOnline does. Takes the site address.
function Connect-RadeSite([string]$Site) {
  'STAGE signin'
  Set-SignInDpiAware   # engine-v47: prints aware=off unless RADE_SIGNIN_DPI=1 (the DPI sign-in of engine-v46 opened its window after about 90 s)
  $t0 = Get-Date; Start-SignInReport   # engine-v44: no size watch
  try { $null = & { Connect-PnPOnline -Url $Site -UseWebLogin -ErrorAction Stop } *>&1 }
  finally { Stop-SignInReport }   # no report after the sign-in
  'SIGNIN seconds=' + [int]((Get-Date) - $t0).TotalSeconds
  'STAGE none'
}
# ---- RADE sign-in window size (end)
'@
# Gives a child script's text with the sign-in block in place of its marker line. Takes the text; gives back the text.
function Add-SignInSize([string]$Text) { return $Text.Replace('# <RADE sign-in window size>', $signInSize.TrimEnd()) }
$rightsScript = @'
param([string]$Site, [string]$MarkerList = '', [string]$MarkerKey = '', [string]$MarkerField = '')
# <RADE sign-in window size>
# RADE check (read-only): signs in with the CAC (web login, as T16 does) and prints your rights on the site, whether your
# own account is a site collection administrator (one flag; no list of administrators) and, when the app keeps an install
# record on the site, the version in that one row. Prints only right names, True/False and a version, never the site,
# your name or an error message.
try {
  $mod = @(Get-Module -ListAvailable -Name PnP.PowerShell | Sort-Object Version -Descending)
  if (-not $mod.Count) { 'RESULT no-pnp'; exit 3 }
  $pin = @($mod | Where-Object { [string]$_.Version -eq '1.12.0' }); if ($pin.Count) { $mod = $pin }   # the tested version first (2.x needs PowerShell 7)
  $null = & { Import-Module PnP.PowerShell -RequiredVersion $mod[0].Version -DisableNameChecking } *>&1
  Connect-RadeSite $Site   # engine-v43 S1: STAGE, SIGNIN and SIGNIN-WIN lines (the block above)
  $script:web = $null
  $null = & { $script:web = Get-PnPWeb -Includes EffectiveBasePermissions -ErrorAction Stop } *>&1
  $p = $script:web.EffectiveBasePermissions
  $k = [Microsoft.SharePoint.Client.PermissionKind]
  foreach ($n in 'ViewListItems', 'AddListItems', 'EditListItems', 'ManageLists', 'ManageWeb', 'ManagePermissions') { 'RIGHT ' + $n + ' ' + $p.Has($k::$n) }
  try {
    $script:adm = $null
    $null = & { $script:adm = (Get-PnPWeb -Includes CurrentUser -ErrorAction Stop).CurrentUser.IsSiteAdmin } *>&1
    if ($script:adm -is [bool]) { 'ADMIN ' + $script:adm } else { 'ADMIN unknown' }
  } catch { 'ADMIN unknown' }
  if ($MarkerList) {
    try {
      $script:mk = 'none'
      $null = & {
        $l = Get-PnPList -Identity $MarkerList -ErrorAction Stop   # a list that does not exist gives nothing, not an error
        if ($l) {
          $q = "<View><Query><Where><Eq><FieldRef Name='Title'/><Value Type='Text'>" + $MarkerKey + "</Value></Eq></Where></Query><RowLimit>1</RowLimit></View>"
          $it = @(Get-PnPListItem -List $l -Query $q -ErrorAction Stop)
          if ($it.Count) {
            $v = ([string]$it[0][$MarkerField]).Trim()
            if ($v -match '^([0-9][0-9.]*)') { $script:mk = 'found ' + $Matches[1] } elseif ($v) { $script:mk = 'found 0' }   # any value is an install
          }
        }
      } *>&1
      'MARKER ' + $script:mk
    } catch { 'MARKER unknown' }
  }
  exit 0
} catch { 'RESULT not-connected ' + $_.Exception.GetType().Name; exit 2 }
'@
$rightsScript = Add-SignInSize $rightsScript
# ---- Install record on the site (the Administrator, 14 Nov 26: one install per site). An app with "marker" in the
# manifest keeps one row (Title = Key) in its own list: the installed version and the date, no name. The record in
# RADE\Config is per account; this row is what another account's RADE sees. A site that has the row and an account
# that did not install it: the deploy is blocked (a second import would run every flow twice).
function Get-MarkerArg {
  $m = $script:app.Marker
  if (-not $m) { return '' }
  return (' -MarkerList "' + $m.List + '" -MarkerKey "' + $m.Key + '" -MarkerField "' + $m.Field + '"')
}
# Gives a short hash that stands for a site address (so the record never holds the address). Takes the site address;
# gives back the hash, or an empty text when the address is not valid.
function Get-SiteMark([string]$Site) {
  if (-not (Test-SiteUrl $Site)) { return '' }
  return (Get-ShortHash $Site.Trim().TrimEnd('/').ToLowerInvariant())
}
function Test-InstalledHere {
  # True when this account's record for this site (Get-InstalledKey) holds a step: a deploy from this account reached
  # a step here. A run that reached no step does not count.
  if (-not (Get-SiteMark (Get-SiteUrl (Get-BasePath)))) { return $false }
  $e = (Read-Installed (Get-InstalledKey $script:app))
  return [bool]($e -and $e.steps -and $e.steps.Count)
}
# Says whether this is a deploy of an app that keeps a row on the site and this account has not installed it on that
# site yet. Takes nothing; gives back $true or $false.
function Test-FirstInstall { return ((Test-Deploy) -and [bool]$script:app.Marker -and -not (Test-InstalledHere)) }
$markerScript = @'
param([string]$Site, [string]$MarkerList, [string]$MarkerKey, [string]$MarkerField, [string]$Value)
# <RADE sign-in window size>
# RADE (one write): signs in with the CAC and sets one row of the app's own list to the installed version and the date.
# Adds the row when it is missing; changes nothing else. Prints one RESULT word, never the site, a name or an error message.
try {
  $mod = @(Get-Module -ListAvailable -Name PnP.PowerShell | Sort-Object Version -Descending)
  if (-not $mod.Count) { 'RESULT no-pnp'; exit 3 }
  $pin = @($mod | Where-Object { [string]$_.Version -eq '1.12.0' }); if ($pin.Count) { $mod = $pin }
  $null = & { Import-Module PnP.PowerShell -RequiredVersion $mod[0].Version -DisableNameChecking } *>&1
  Connect-RadeSite $Site   # engine-v43 S1: STAGE, SIGNIN and SIGNIN-WIN lines (the block above)
  $script:res = 'no-list'
  $null = & {
    $l = Get-PnPList -Identity $MarkerList -ErrorAction Stop
    if ($l) {
      $q = "<View><Query><Where><Eq><FieldRef Name='Title'/><Value Type='Text'>" + $MarkerKey + "</Value></Eq></Where></Query><RowLimit>1</RowLimit></View>"
      $it = @(Get-PnPListItem -List $l -Query $q -ErrorAction Stop)
      if ($it.Count) { $null = Set-PnPListItem -List $l -Identity $it[0].Id -Values @{ $MarkerField = $Value } -ErrorAction Stop; $script:res = 'updated' }
      else { $null = Add-PnPListItem -List $l -Values @{ Title = $MarkerKey; $MarkerField = $Value } -ErrorAction Stop; $script:res = 'added' }
    }
  } *>&1
  'RESULT ' + $script:res
  exit 0
} catch { 'RESULT failed ' + $_.Exception.GetType().Name; exit 2 }
'@
$markerScript = Add-SignInSize $markerScript
# ==== Engine part: engine/ps/08-saved-checks.ps1 (sha256 4c8dfc4d7e6d)
# RADE engine part 08, saved checks: keeps each check that passed in RADE\Config\rade-checks.json and
# decides whether a later run may skip it (age, computer, PowerShell and PnP versions, scope). Uses 07-checks.ps1.
# Joined into every bundle by engine/rade_build.py; Windows PowerShell 5.1.

# ---- Saved checks (PFM 14 Nov 26, R17): RADE\Config\rade-checks.json keeps each check that PASSED, so a later run (of
# any app on this computer) can skip it. A saved result is used only when it is at most $checkMaxDays days old, the
# PowerShell and PnP versions and the computer are the same, and its scope (the site or the Power Automate address, as a
# hash) matches. A check that did not pass is never saved. No DODID, name or address is in the file (details are masked).
$checkMaxDays = 7
# Checks whose answer can change between two runs on the same day always run (review R17 MAJOR 2: "Word is open" blocks a
# deploy, PFM 14 Nov 26 1B; free space; a test file in OneDrive).
$checkNoSave = @('nipr', 'word', 'disk', 'write')
# Fast checks that are not saved in the file either, so each run of RADE makes them once (docs/engine.md "Results": fast
# checks run fresh; from engine-v21, before it they were reused for 7 days). Their answer holds for one run of RADE, so the
# window does not make them a second time after Choose, as it does for $checkNoSave (window/06-open.ps1).
$checkEachRun = @('ps', 'lang', 'child')
# Gives the first 6 bytes (12 hex characters) of the SHA-256 of the text, lower case and without a trailing "/". Takes
# the text; gives back the hash, or an empty text for no text.
function Get-ShortHash([string]$Text) {
  if (-not $Text) { return '' }
  $sha = [System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()
  try { return (-join ($sha.ComputeHash([System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($Text.ToLowerInvariant().TrimEnd('/'))) | Select-Object -First 6 | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString('x2') })) } finally { $sha.Dispose() }
}
function Get-CheckHost {
  # What makes a saved result stale when it changes: PowerShell, the PnP module, the computer (hashed).
  if ($script:checkHost) { return $script:checkHost }
  $pnp = ''; try { $m = @(Get-Module -ListAvailable -Name PnP.PowerShell | Sort-Object Version -Descending); if ($m.Count) { $pnp = [string]$m[0].Version } } catch { $null = $_ }
  $script:checkHost = @{ powershell = [string]$PSVersionTable.PSVersion; pnp = $pnp; computer = (Get-ShortHash ([string]$env:COMPUTERNAME)) }
  return $script:checkHost
}
function Get-CheckScope([string]$Id, [string]$Base, [string]$Site) {
  # A result about one site or one address is good only for that site or address.
  if ($Id -in 'net-site', 'site-rights') { return ('site:' + (Get-ShortHash $Site)) }
  if ($Id -in 'net-flow', 'flow-guide') { return ('flow:' + (Get-ShortHash (Get-FlowPortal $Base).Url)) }
  return ''
}
# Reads the saved checks from RADE\Config\rade-checks.json. Takes nothing; gives back a table of saved results, empty
# when the file is missing or was made on another computer, PowerShell or PnP version.
function Read-CheckCache {
  $p = Get-RadeConfigFile 'rade-checks.json'
  $res = @{}
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p -PathType Leaf)) { return $res }
  try {
    $j = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($p) | ConvertFrom-Json
    $h = Get-CheckHost
    if ([string]$j.host.powershell -ne $h.powershell -or [string]$j.host.pnp -ne $h.pnp -or [string]$j.host.computer -ne $h.computer) { return $res }
    foreach ($c in @($j.checks.PSObject.Properties)) {
      $v = $c.Value
      $at = $v.at; if ($at -is [datetime]) { $at = $at.ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss', [System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture) }   # PowerShell 7 reads it as a date
      $res[$c.Name] = @{ State = [string]$v.state; Detail = [string]$v.detail; Fix = ''; At = [string]$at; Scope = [string]$v.scope }
    }
  } catch { $null = $_ }   # a damaged file is ignored: every check runs
  return $res
}
function Get-CheckAge([string]$At) {
  # Days since a saved result (fractional); -1 when the date cannot be read.
  $d = [datetime]::MinValue
  if ([datetime]::TryParseExact($At, 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss', [System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture, 'None', [ref]$d)) { return ((Get-Date) - $d).TotalDays }
  return 99999   # unreadable: too old
}
function Get-SavedCheck($Cache, [string]$Id, [string]$Scope) {
  # The saved result to use, or $null (with the reason in $script:savedWhy[$Id] when one was found but is too old).
  if (($checkNoSave + $checkEachRun) -contains $Id) { return $null }
  $c = $Cache[$Id]
  if (-not $c -or $c.State -ne 'PASSED' -or $c.Scope -ne $Scope) { return $null }
  $age = Get-CheckAge $c.At
  if ($age -lt -0.01) { $script:savedWhy[$Id] = 'Last check date is in the future (clock changed)'; return $null }
  if ($age -gt $checkMaxDays) { $script:savedWhy[$Id] = ('Last check ' + [int][math]::Floor([math]::Max(0, $age)) + ' days ago, older than ' + $checkMaxDays + ' days'); return $null }
  # Two lines (the Administrator, 2026-11-14): "Last check: 17 Nov 26", then what that check found; no full stops.
  $d0 = [datetime]::ParseExact($c.At, 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss', [System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture)
  $found = ([string]$c.Detail) -replace '\.$', ''; if ($found) { $found = $found.Substring(0, 1).ToUpperInvariant() + $found.Substring(1) }
  return @{ State = 'PASSED'; Detail = ('Last check: ' + $d0.ToString('d MMM yy', [System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture)); Fix = $found; Saved = $true; Found = $found }
}
function Save-CheckCache($Results, [string]$Base, [string]$Site) {
  # Keeps the old file's other entries (other apps' checks), replaces this run's: PASSED is saved, anything else removed.
  try {
    $p = Get-RadeConfigFile 'rade-checks.json'
    $keep = @{}
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p -PathType Leaf) {
      try { $j = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($p) | ConvertFrom-Json; foreach ($c in @($j.checks.PSObject.Properties)) { $keep[$c.Name] = $c.Value } } catch { $null = $_ }
      try { $h0 = Get-CheckHost; if ([string]$j.host.powershell -ne $h0.powershell -or [string]$j.host.pnp -ne $h0.pnp -or [string]$j.host.computer -ne $h0.computer) { $keep = @{} } } catch { $null = $_ }
    }
    foreach ($id in @($Results.Keys)) {
      $r = $Results[$id]
      if ($r.Saved) { continue }   # a saved result keeps its first date
      if (($checkNoSave + $checkEachRun) -contains $id) { if ($keep.ContainsKey($id)) { $keep.Remove($id) }; continue }
      if ($r.State -eq 'PASSED') {
        $keep[$id] = [ordered]@{ state = 'PASSED'; detail = (ConvertTo-Masked ([string]$r.Detail)); at = (Get-Date).ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss', [System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture); scope = (Get-CheckScope $id $Base $Site) }
      } elseif ($keep.ContainsKey($id) -and $r.State -ne 'RUNNING') { $keep.Remove($id) }
    }
    $sorted = [ordered]@{}; foreach ($k in @($keep.Keys | Sort-Object)) { $sorted[$k] = $keep[$k] }
    $doc = [ordered]@{
      schema = 'rade-checks/1'
      about = ('Saved RADE checks. Any app may read this file: use an entry only when its state is PASSED, its "at" is at most ' + $checkMaxDays + ' days old, "host" equals this computer (PowerShell, PnP and the hashed computer name), and "scope" matches (site: or flow: plus the first 12 hex of the SHA-256 of the lower-case address). Write only PASSED results; remove an entry when the check does not pass.')
      maxAgeDays = $checkMaxDays
      host = (Get-CheckHost)
      checks = $sorted
    }
    Write-FileWhole $p ($doc | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5)
  } catch { $null = $_ }   # saving is a convenience: never stop for it
  Save-CheckDetail $Results   # every check's detail, in a file beside the saved checks
}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
Writes each check of this run, with its result and its detail, to the file RADE\Config\rade-checks-last.txt.
.DESCRIPTION
The Administrator, 2026-11-18: a round's report and e-mail hold the check counts and only the detail of a check that did
not pass, so a detail such as the child check's policy scopes was only in the window's Record. This file holds every detail and
is not sent: it is in RADE\Config (the user's OneDrive), not in the results folder, so no e-mail draft attaches it (the detail of the child check
names an execution policy, a setting of this computer). The newest run replaces it. Never an error: it is a convenience.
.PARAMETER Results
The check results of this run, by check id.
#>
function Save-CheckDetail($Results) {
  try {
    $lines = @(('RADE checks of ' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm') + ', round ' + $round + ', build ' + $buildId + ', engine release ' + $engineRelease), 'RADE does not send this file: no e-mail draft attaches it. It is in your OneDrive folder, as all of RADE\Config. The newest run replaces it.', '')
    foreach ($id in $script:appChecks) {
      $r = $Results[$id]; if (-not $r) { continue }
      $d = Get-CheckDef $id
      $lines += ConvertTo-Masked ([string]$r.State + ': ' + $d.Name + '. ' + [string]$r.Detail + $(if ($r.Saved -and $r.Found) { ' | ' + [string]$r.Found } else { '' }))
    }
    Write-FileWhole (Get-RadeConfigFile 'rade-checks-last.txt') (($lines -join "`r`n") + "`r`n")
  } catch { $null = $_ }   # a convenience file: a run never stops for it
}
function Get-CheckToRun($Def, $Cache, [string]$Base, [string]$Site, [bool]$Force) {
  # $null = run it now; else the saved result to show.
  if ($Force) { return $null }
  if ($Def.Id -eq 'site-rights' -and (Test-FirstInstall)) { return $null }   # a first install always reads the site's install record fresh
  return (Get-SavedCheck $Cache $Def.Id (Get-CheckScope $Def.Id $Base $Site))
}
# ==== Engine part: engine/ps/13-maintenance.ps1 (sha256 b4dfe230a8a0)
# RADE engine part 13, the Maintenance tools (the Administrator, 2026-11-20; docs/engine.md "Maintenance run types").
# Diagnose: read-only; the install record, the app's local files and the app's RADE checks again; one report file.
# Back up: reads only the lists the app's manifest names ("backup") and saves each as JSON plus a CSV copy.
# Restore (engine-v31) is parts 14 and 15, engine/ps/14-restore.ps1 and 15-restore-run.ps1; it uses Invoke-Backup and Get-BackupFileName from here.
# Uninstall and its clean-up are part 17, engine/ps/17-uninstall.ps1 (engine-v48).
# Uses parts 01 to 08 (Get-BasePath, Read-Installed, Get-InstalledKey, Get-StartPath, Invoke-Check, Invoke-ChildScript).
# Network: Diagnose runs the app's own RADE checks (their fixed addresses only); Back up signs in to the saved site and
# reads only the lists the manifest names (AGENTS.md "No reconnaissance"). Neither one writes to the site.
# Writes: Diagnose: Diagnose\diagnose-<time>.txt; Back up: Backups\<time>\<list>.json and .csv (the app folder).
# Credentials: the interactive CAC sign-in of PnP (-UseWebLogin), for Back up only.
# Joined into every bundle by engine/rade_build.py; Windows PowerShell 5.1.

# Time limit of a child script that signs in and reads every named list, in seconds (Back up and the Restore dry run;
# the Administrator's lists are small, so it is generous).
$toolReadSeconds = 1800
# R44 E4 (R43: Back up stopped after a sign-in window): the time limit of one stage (sign-in, site check, one list), in seconds.
$toolStageSeconds = 300

# Gives the time stamp of a report or a backup folder (sortable, no colons). Takes nothing.
function Get-ToolStamp { return (Get-Date).ToString('yyyyMMdd-HHmmss', [System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture) }
# Makes one finding of a Maintenance tool. Takes PASS, FINDING or NOTE, the fact and what to do (or '').
function ConvertTo-ToolLine([string]$State, [string]$Text, [string]$Fix) { return @{ State = $State; Text = $Text; Fix = $Fix } }

<#
.SYNOPSIS
Diagnose, part D1: the install record and the app's local files against this paste.
.DESCRIPTION
Reads RADE's own files only: the install record (RADE\Config\installed), the start script of the app (manifest
"start") and the RADE runner copy. Each finding names its fix. Changes nothing.
.OUTPUTS
A list of ConvertTo-ToolLine tables.
#>
function Get-DiagnoseInstall {
  $e = Read-Installed (Get-InstalledKey $script:app); $out = @(); $pv = [string]$script:app.Version
  $repair = 'Select "Repair" on the Maintenance card'
  if (-not ($e -and $e.installed)) { return @(ConvertTo-ToolLine 'FINDING' ('This computer has no install record of ' + $script:app.Name + ' that ended PASSED') $repair) }
  $iv = [string]$e.installed.version; $c = 0
  try { $c = ([version]$pv).CompareTo([version]$iv) } catch { $c = [string]::CompareOrdinal($pv, $iv) }
  if ($c -eq 0) { $out += ConvertTo-ToolLine 'PASS' ('The installed version, ' + $iv + ', is the version in this paste') '' }
  elseif ($c -gt 0) { $out += ConvertTo-ToolLine 'FINDING' ('The installed version is ' + $iv + '; this paste has ' + $pv) ('Select "Update to ' + $pv + '" on the Maintenance card') }
  else { $out += ConvertTo-ToolLine 'FINDING' ('The installed version, ' + $iv + ', is newer than this paste (' + $pv + ')') ('Use the newest paste of ' + $script:app.Name) }
  $ls = $(if ($e.lastRun) { [string]$e.lastRun.state } else { '' })
  if ($ls -and $ls -ne 'PASSED') { $out += ConvertTo-ToolLine 'FINDING' ('The last install run ended ' + $ls) $repair }
  if ($e.steps) { foreach ($n in @($e.steps.Keys)) { $s = [string]$e.steps[$n].state
    if ($s -and $s -ne 'PASSED') { $out += ConvertTo-ToolLine 'FINDING' ('Step "' + $n + '" ended ' + $s + ' in its last run') $repair } } }
  $st = [string]$script:app.Start
  if ($st) { if (Get-StartPath) { $out += ConvertTo-ToolLine 'PASS' ('The start script ' + $st + ' is in the app folder') '' }
    else { $out += ConvertTo-ToolLine 'FINDING' ('The start script ' + $st + ' is missing from the app folder') ($repair + ': it puts the file back') } }
  $rp = Get-RunnerPath   # engine-v42: the app's own runner copy, RADE\runners\<key>.ps1
  if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $rp -PathType Leaf) { $out += ConvertTo-ToolLine 'PASS' 'The RADE runner copy of this app is saved' '' }
  else { $out += ConvertTo-ToolLine 'NOTE' 'The RADE runner copy of this app is not saved, so its shortcut cannot start RADE' $repair }
  return $out
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
Diagnose, part D0: the app's RADE checks again, as the Ready card runs them, with no saved result reused.
.DESCRIPTION
A check that runs on its own runs again now. A sign-in or look-and-answer check needs the user, so Diagnose shows its
saved result, or says it was not run. The checks are read-only (docs/engine.md "Checks").
.PARAMETER Base
The RADE app folder.
.PARAMETER Tick
Run while a check waits (keeps the window alive), or $null.
.OUTPUTS
A list of ConvertTo-ToolLine tables, one for each check.
#>
function Get-DiagnoseCheck([string]$Base, [scriptblock]$Tick) {
  $site = Get-SiteUrl $Base; $cache = Read-CheckCache; $out = @()
  foreach ($id in @($script:appChecks)) {
    $d = Get-CheckDef $id; $r = $null
    if ($d.Kind -eq 'auto') { $r = Invoke-Check $d $Base $site $Tick } else { $r = Get-CheckToRun $d $cache $Base $site $false }
    if (-not $r) { $out += ConvertTo-ToolLine 'NOTE' ([string]$d.Name + ': not run (it needs you)') 'Select "Repair": its checks ask for it'; continue }
    $w = $(if ($r.State -in 'PASSED', 'WARNING') { 'PASS' } else { 'FINDING' })
    $out += ConvertTo-ToolLine $w ([string]$d.Name + ': ' + $r.State + $(if ($r.Detail) { '. ' + $r.Detail } else { '' })) ([string]$r.Fix)
  }
  return $out
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
Runs Diagnose and saves its report in the app folder's Diagnose folder (never attached to the e-mail draft).
.PARAMETER Base
The RADE app folder.
.PARAMETER Tick
Run while a check waits, or $null.
.OUTPUTS
@{ Lines; Path; Findings }: the report lines (masked), the report file ('' when it could not be written) and the count
of findings.
#>
function Invoke-Diagnose([string]$Base, [scriptblock]$Tick) {
  $all = @(Get-DiagnoseInstall) + @(Get-DiagnoseCheck $Base $Tick) + @(Get-RestoreMarkNote $Base | Where-Object { $_ })   # the mark line: part 14 (engine-v33)
  $n = @($all | Where-Object { $_.State -eq 'FINDING' }).Count
  $lines = @(('Diagnose of ' + $script:app.Name + ' ' + $script:app.Version + ', ' + (Get-NowText) + '. Read-only: nothing was changed.'),
    $(if ($n) { [string]$n + ' finding(s). Each one says what to do.' } else { 'No findings.' }))
  foreach ($f in $all) { $lines += ($f.State + ': ' + $f.Text + $(if ($f.Fix) { '. What to do: ' + $f.Fix } else { '' })) }
  $lines = @($lines | ForEach-Object { ConvertTo-Masked $_ })
  $p = ''
  try { $dir = Join-Path $Base 'Diagnose'   # not Rounds\<round>: the e-mail draft attaches every file there (review of PR 143)
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir)) { $null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force }
    $p = Join-Path $dir ('diagnose-' + (Get-ToolStamp) + '.txt'); Write-FileWhole $p (($lines -join "`r`n") + "`r`n") } catch { $p = '' }
  return @{ Lines = $lines; Path = $p; Findings = $n }
}

# ---- Back up. The child script reads each named list and writes ~<n>.json and ~<n>.csv into the folder it is given.
# It prints only a list number, a row count or an error type: never the site, a name, a value or an error message.
$backupScript = @'
param([string]$Site, [string]$Folder, [string]$Lists)
# <RADE sign-in window size>
# RADE Back up (reads the site, writes this computer only): signs in with the CAC and saves each named list.
# Windows PowerShell 5.1 writes an array as {value, Count} while this type data is loaded: take it out first.
Remove-TypeData -TypeName System.Array -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
# Turns one SharePoint field value into plain text or a number: lookup and person "id;#text", link "url;#text", managed
# metadata "label|guid", place "POINT(lon lat)", several values joined with ";#", a date in ISO form (UTC). Takes the value.
function ConvertTo-PlainValue($V) {
  if ($V -is [datetime]) { return $V.ToUniversalTime().ToString('o') }
  if (($null -eq $V) -or ($V -is [string]) -or ($V -is [ValueType])) { return $V }
  $p = $V.PSObject.Properties
  if ($p['LookupId']) { return ([string]$V.LookupId + ';#' + [string]$V.LookupValue) }
  if ($p['Url']) { return ([string]$V.Url + ';#' + [string]$V.Description) }
  if ($p['TermGuid']) { return ([string]$V.Label + '|' + [string]$V.TermGuid) }
  if ($p['Latitude']) { return ('POINT(' + [string]$V.Longitude + ' ' + [string]$V.Latitude + ')') }
  if ($V -is [System.Collections.IEnumerable]) { return ((@(foreach ($x in $V) { ConvertTo-PlainValue $x }) | ForEach-Object { [string]$_ }) -join ';#') }
  return [string]$V
}
try {
  $mod = @(Get-Module -ListAvailable -Name PnP.PowerShell | Sort-Object Version -Descending)
  if (-not $mod.Count) { 'RESULT no-pnp'; exit 3 }
  $pin = @($mod | Where-Object { [string]$_.Version -eq '1.12.0' }); if ($pin.Count) { $mod = $pin }
  $null = & { Import-Module PnP.PowerShell -RequiredVersion $mod[0].Version -DisableNameChecking } *>&1
  # R44 E4: STAGE lines let RADE stop a stage that takes too long and name it (Invoke-ChildScript -StageSeconds).
  Connect-RadeSite $Site   # engine-v43 S1: STAGE signin, SIGNIN and SIGNIN-WIN lines (the block above)
  # R44 E4: the site check. The connection must be to the given site, else nothing is read (prints no address).
  'STAGE site'
  $script:web = $null
  try { $null = & { $script:web = Get-PnPWeb -ErrorAction Stop } *>&1; $u = [string]$script:web.Url } catch { 'RESULT site-unknown ' + $_.Exception.GetType().Name; exit 5 }
  if ($u.TrimEnd('/').ToLowerInvariant() -ne $Site.Trim().TrimEnd('/').ToLowerInvariant()) { 'RESULT wrong-site'; exit 4 }
  $i = 0
  foreach ($name in ($Lists -split '\|')) {
    $i++
    'STAGE list ' + $i
    try {
      $script:items = @()
      $null = & { $script:items = @(Get-PnPListItem -List $name -PageSize 500 -ErrorAction Stop) } *>&1
      $rows = @(foreach ($it in $script:items) { $o = [ordered]@{}
        foreach ($k in @($it.FieldValues.Keys)) { $o[$k] = ConvertTo-PlainValue $it.FieldValues[$k] }
        [pscustomobject]$o })
      $j = Join-Path $Folder ('~' + $i + '.json'); $c = Join-Path $Folder ('~' + $i + '.csv')   # '~': no list title has it, so no name clash
      [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($j, (ConvertTo-Json -InputObject @($rows) -Depth 4), (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $true))
      if ($rows.Count) { $rows | Export-Csv -LiteralPath $c -NoTypeInformation -Encoding UTF8 } else { [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($c, '') }
      'LIST ' + $i + ' ' + $rows.Count
    } catch { 'LIST ' + $i + ' failed ' + $_.Exception.GetType().Name }
  }
  'RESULT done'; exit 0
} catch { 'RESULT not-connected ' + $_.Exception.GetType().Name; exit 2 }
'@
$backupScript = Add-SignInSize $backupScript   # E3: the sign-in block (16-site-scripts.ps1)

# Gives the file name (no extension) of a saved list: its title with any sign a file name cannot hold made "_" (the
# build allows letters, digits, space, "_", "-", "(" and ")", so this changes nothing today). Takes the list title.
function Get-BackupFileName([string]$Name) { return ($Name -replace '[^A-Za-z0-9 _()-]', '_') }
# Makes the new folder of a backup, Backups\<time> in the app folder; a folder of that name that is there already (the
# same second, or the hour that repeats when daylight saving ends) is never reused: -2, -3 and so on follow. Takes the
# RADE app folder and the time stamp; gives back the new folder, or '' when none could be made.
function Get-NewBackupDir([string]$Base, [string]$Stamp) {
  $root = Join-Path $Base 'Backups'
  for ($k = 1; $k -le 50; $k++) { $d = Join-Path $root ($Stamp + $(if ($k -gt 1) { '-' + $k } else { '' }))
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $d) { continue }
    try { $null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $d -ErrorAction Stop; return $d } catch { if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $d)) { return '' } } }
  return '' }
# Removes the folder of a backup that saved nothing (only the new folder this run made). Takes the folder; gives back
# $true when it is gone.
function Clear-BackupDir([string]$Dir) {
  try { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $Dir -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction Stop; return $true } catch { return (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Dir)) } }
# Gives a saved list its name: ~<n>.json and ~<n>.csv become <list>.json and <list>.csv; both must be there. Takes the
# folder, the list number and the file name; gives back $true when both files have their name.
function Rename-BackupFile([string]$Dir, [int]$I, [string]$Name) {
  try { foreach ($x in '.json', '.csv') { $to = Join-Path $Dir ($Name + $x); if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $to) { return $false }   # never over another list's file
      Move-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $Dir ('~' + $I + $x)) -Destination $to -ErrorAction Stop }
    return ((Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $Dir ($Name + '.json')) -PathType Leaf) -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $Dir ($Name + '.csv')) -PathType Leaf)) } catch { return $false } }

<#
.SYNOPSIS
Runs Back up: saves each list the manifest names ("backup") as JSON plus a CSV copy in a new Backups\<time> folder.
.DESCRIPTION
An app that names no lists: Back up says so and writes nothing (the Administrator, 2026-11-20). With no valid site
address it stops before the sign-in. A list that cannot be read is reported by name, never skipped without a word. The
files are named after the list; a list file is checked after the run (it must be there). Nothing on the site changes.
.PARAMETER Base
The RADE app folder.
.PARAMETER Tick
Run while the sign-in and the reads go on (keeps the window alive), or $null.
.OUTPUTS
@{ State; Lines; Path }: State is none, no-site, done or failed; Lines are plain report lines; Path is the folder or ''.
#>
function Invoke-Backup([string]$Base, [scriptblock]$Tick) {
  $lists = @($script:app.Backup | Where-Object { $_ })
  if (-not $lists.Count) { $why = $script:app.Name + ' names no lists to back up, so Back up saved nothing.'
    return @{ State = 'none'; Path = ''; Lines = @($why, 'The app adds them in its manifest ("backup").') } }
  $site = Get-SiteUrl $Base
  if (-not (Test-SiteUrl $site)) {
    return @{ State = 'no-site'; Path = ''; Lines = @('No site address is saved, so Back up did not sign in.', 'Select "Repair": its checks ask for the site address.') } }
  $dir = Get-NewBackupDir $Base (Get-ToolStamp)   # always a new folder: a failed run removes only this one
  if (-not $dir) { return @{ State = 'failed'; Path = ''; Lines = @('Back up could not make its folder on this computer.') } }
  $r = Invoke-ChildScript $backupScript ('-Site "' + $site + '" -Folder "' + $dir + '" -Lists "' + ($lists -join '|') + '"') $toolReadSeconds $Tick $toolStageSeconds
  $got = @{}; $res = ''
  foreach ($l in $r.Lines) { if ($l -match '^LIST (\d+) (.+)$') { $got[[int]$Matches[1]] = $Matches[2] } elseif ($l -match '^RESULT (\S+)') { $res = $Matches[1] } }
  $note = Get-SignInNote 'Back up' $r.Lines   # R44 E4, engine-v43 S2, S3: the sign-in lines in the run log, with the host
  $signLine = ''; if ($note -match '^SIGNIN seconds=(\d+)') { $signLine = 'The sign-in took ' + $Matches[1] + ' seconds.' }
  if ($res -ne 'done') { $why = $(switch ($res) { 'no-pnp' { 'the SharePoint tool is not installed' } 'not-connected' { 'the sign-in did not finish' }
        'wrong-site' { 'the sign-in connected to another site than the saved site address' }
        'site-unknown' { 'RADE could not read which site the sign-in connected to' }
        default { $(if ($r.Stage) { (Get-StageText $r.Stage $lists) + ' did not finish in ' + [int]($toolStageSeconds / 60) + ' minutes, so RADE stopped it' } else { 'it stopped: ' + $r.Why }) } })
    $gone = Clear-BackupDir $dir
    $left = $(if ($gone) { 'Nothing on the site changed.' } else { 'Nothing on the site changed. Its unfinished folder stays: ' + (ConvertTo-Masked $dir) })
    return @{ State = 'failed'; Path = ''; Lines = @(@(('Back up saved nothing: ' + $why + '.'), $left, 'Select "Back up" again.') + @($signLine | Where-Object { $_ })) } }
  $lines = @(); $bad = 0
  for ($i = 1; $i -le $lists.Count; $i++) {
    $n = [string]$lists[$i - 1]; $v = [string]$got[$i]; $ok = $false
    if ($v -match '^\d+$') { $ok = Rename-BackupFile $dir $i (Get-BackupFileName $n) }
    if ($ok) { $lines += ('PASS: "' + $n + '": ' + $v + ' rows saved'); continue }
    $bad++; $ty = $(if ($v -match '^failed (\S+)') { ' (' + $Matches[1] + ')' } elseif ($v) { ' (its files could not be named)' } else { '' })
    $lines += ('FINDING: "' + $n + '" was not saved' + $ty + '. What to do: check that the list exists and that you can read it, then select "Back up" again')
  }
  $head = $(if ($bad) { [string]$bad + ' of ' + $lists.Count + ' lists were not saved.' } else { 'All ' + $lists.Count + ' lists were saved.' })
  return @{ State = $(if ($bad) { 'failed' } else { 'done' }); Path = $dir; Lines = @(@($head, 'Nothing on the site changed.') + $lines + @($signLine | Where-Object { $_ })) }
}
# ==== Engine part: engine/ps/14-restore.ps1 (sha256 a022d8e0e6d3)
# RADE engine part 14, the Maintenance tool Restore (engine-v31; the local test-site mark, engine-v32; the Administrator,
# 2026-11-20 and 2026-11-21; plan docs/reviews/2026-11-21-plan-restore-v31.md; docs/engine.md "Maintenance run types").
# Puts back the rows of a backup that are missing from their list, on a test site only: a dry run with counts first,
# then (after the user types the app name) a fresh backup, the pause switch, the Recycle Bin, then new rows with lookups
# re-pointed. A row that is on the list is never changed, and no row is made twice.
# Uses parts 01 to 08, 13 and 16 (Get-SiteUrl, Test-SiteUrl, Get-SiteMark, Invoke-ChildScript, Invoke-Backup,
# Get-BackupFileName, ConvertTo-Masked).
# Network: signs in to the saved site and reads only the lists the manifest names ("backup"), their fields and the
# site's Recycle Bin (AGENTS.md "No reconnaissance").
# Writes: site rows of the named lists (missing rows only) and the app's pause-switch row, after the typed confirm; on
# the computer, a fresh backup, Backups\~restore-map-<site hash>.json and, from the mark card,
# Config\<prefix>-restore-test-site.txt.
# Credentials: the interactive CAC sign-in of PnP (-UseWebLogin).
# The functions the window and the text mode call (Get-BackupSet to Invoke-Restore) are in part 15,
# engine/ps/15-restore-run.ps1.
# Joined into every bundle by engine/rade_build.py; Windows PowerShell 5.1.

$restoreWriteSeconds = 3600   # time limit of the Restore write, in seconds: a sign-in and every row it puts back
$backupSetMax = 10            # backups the Restore card lists, newest first (one card of rows)

# ---- Restore (engine-v31; plan docs/reviews/2026-11-21-plan-restore-v31.md). The child script runs in two modes:
# "plan" (the dry run: reads only) and "write" (after the typed confirm). It prints only list numbers, counts and error
# types: never the site, a name, an ID or a value.
$restoreScript = @'
param([string]$Site, [string]$Folder, [string]$Lists, [string]$Mode, [string]$Expect, [string]$Pause, [string]$MapFile)
# <RADE sign-in window size>
# RADE Restore: missing rows only. Mode plan reads the site and writes nothing; mode write puts the missing rows back.
# Output: PLAN, BIN, PAUSE, DONE, RESUME and RESULT lines with numbers, error types and a short hash only.
Remove-TypeData -TypeName System.Array -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue   # Windows PowerShell 5.1 writes an array as {value, Count} while it is loaded; absent elsewhere
$PageSize = 500         # rows a read asks for at once: under the SharePoint list view threshold of 5,000
$BinRowLimit = 5000     # Recycle Bin items read at most (docs/engine.md "Maintenance run types", limits)
$SigBytes = 6           # bytes of the SHA-256 kept as the dry-run hash of a list (12 hex characters)
$SkipTypes = @('Computed', 'Calculated', 'Attachments', 'ContentTypeId', 'File', 'Counter')   # field types SharePoint sets itself
$SkipNames = @('ContentType', 'Attachments')                                                   # fields SharePoint sets itself

# ---- Small helpers.
# The file name of a saved list (the same rule as Get-BackupFileName in the engine). Takes the list title.
function Get-FileName([string]$Name) { return ($Name -replace '[^A-Za-z0-9 _()-]', '_') }
