    $ui.StageViews = @{ site = 2; checking = 2; fail = 2; need = 2; ready = 2; nodrive = 2; run = 3; hand = 3; handfail = 3; answer = 3; answerfail = 3; feedback = 3
      done = 3; review = 3; stopped = 3; stepfail = 3; cancelq = 3 }
    $ui.StageWords = @('Choose', 'Check', 'Install')
    # Sets the stage now for a card. Takes the view and whether the run passed (a tick in the disc); repaints the stage.
    $ui.SetStage = { param([string]$View, [bool]$Done) $n = $(if ($ui.StageViews.ContainsKey($View)) { [int]$ui.StageViews[$View] } else { 1 })
      $ui.StageNow = @{ N = $n; Word = [string]$ui.StageWords[$n - 1]; Done = $Done }
      $ui.Stage.AccessibleName = 'Stage now: ' + $ui.StageNow.Word + ', ' + $n + ' of 3' + $(if ($Done) { ', passed' } else { '' }); & $ui.BandFit; $ui.Stage.Invalidate() }
    $ui.PaintStage = {
      <#
      .SYNOPSIS
      Draws the stage now: a disc in the band's text color with the number (a tick when the run passed), the word, and a 3 px
      underline as wide as the stage (Cards v2 mock).
      .PARAMETER P
      The stage panel.
      .PARAMETER G
      Its graphics.
      .OUTPUTS
      Nothing; a failure draws nothing (the band keeps its color).
      #>
      param($P, $G)
      try { $G.Clear($ui.C.Band); $G.SmoothingMode = 'AntiAlias'; $d = & $ui.Sc $ui.Z.Disc; $h = $P.ClientSize.Height; $y = [int](($h - $d) / 2); $u = & $ui.Sc 3
        $br = New-Object System.Drawing.SolidBrush($ui.C.BandInk); $G.FillEllipse($br, 0, $y, $d, $d); $br.Dispose()
        if ($ui.StageNow.Done) { $pt = [System.Drawing.PointF[]]@(@(0.28, 0.52), @(0.44, 0.68), @(0.74, 0.34) | ForEach-Object { New-Object System.Drawing.PointF([single]($d * $_[0]), [single]($y + $d * $_[1])) })
          $pn = New-Object System.Drawing.Pen($ui.C.Band, [single](& $ui.Sc 2)); $G.DrawLines($pn, $pt); $pn.Dispose() }   # the tick: the run passed
        else { & $ui.Word $G ([string]$ui.StageNow.N) $ui.F.SmallB $ui.C.Band 0 $y $d $d 'HorizontalCenter, VerticalCenter, NoPrefix, SingleLine' }
        & $ui.Word $G ([string]$ui.StageNow.Word) $ui.F.SmallB $ui.C.BandInk ($d + (& $ui.Sc 8)) 0 ($P.ClientSize.Width - $d - (& $ui.Sc 8)) $h 'Left, VerticalCenter, NoPrefix, SingleLine'
        $ub = New-Object System.Drawing.SolidBrush($ui.C.BandInk); $G.FillRectangle($ub, 0, ($h - $u), $P.ClientSize.Width, $u); $ub.Dispose() } catch { $null = $_ } }   # a stage that cannot be drawn: the band shows the rest
    $ui.Stage.Add_Paint({ & $ui.PaintStage $this $_.Graphics })
    $ui.BandFit = {
      <#
      .SYNOPSIS
      Places the parts of the band for the window's width: the logo and the name column at the left, the stage at the right,
      and at full size the subtitle line after the name and the version and round before the stage.
      .DESCRIPTION
      Half size (a window narrower than $ui.Z.Narrow at 100 %, plan engine-v48 step 2) hides the subtitle line and the
      version. Each text is one line, as tall as its font, and ends with "..." when its room is short.
      .OUTPUTS
      Nothing. Does nothing before the window has its scale.
      #>
      if (-not $ui.Scaled) { return }
      try { $W = [int]$ui.Band.ClientSize.Width; $H = [int]$ui.Band.ClientSize.Height; $pad = & $ui.Sc $ui.Z.G4; $gap = & $ui.Sc $ui.Z.G3
        $ui.Narrow = ([int]$ui.Form.ClientSize.Width -lt (& $ui.Sc $ui.Z.Narrow)); $lg = & $ui.Sc $ui.Z.BandLogo
        $ui.Logo.Visible = [bool]$ui.Logo.Image; $x0 = $pad; if ($ui.Logo.Visible) { $ui.Logo.Bounds = New-Object System.Drawing.Rectangle($pad, [int](($H - $lg) / 2), $lg, $lg); $x0 = $pad + $lg + $gap }
        $sw = (& $ui.Sc ($ui.Z.Disc + $ui.Z.G2)) + [int](& $ui.Meas ([string]$ui.StageNow.Word) $ui.F.SmallB 100000).Width + (& $ui.Sc $ui.Z.G1)
        $ui.Stage.Bounds = New-Object System.Drawing.Rectangle(($W - $pad - $sw), 0, $sw, $H); $rx = $W - $pad - $sw - $gap
        foreach ($l in @($ui.BandWord, $ui.BandSub, $ui.BandLine, $ui.BandVer)) { if ([string]$l.Text -cne [string]$ui.BandRaw[$l]) { $l.Text = [string]$ui.BandRaw[$l] } }   # the whole texts first
        $ui.BandVer.Visible = [bool](-not $ui.Narrow -and [string]$ui.BandVer.Text)
        if ($ui.BandVer.Visible) { $vw = [int](& $ui.Meas ([string]$ui.BandVer.Text) $ui.F.Small 100000).Width + (& $ui.Sc 4); $vh = & $ui.BandLH $ui.BandVer; $ui.BandVer.Bounds = New-Object System.Drawing.Rectangle(($rx - $vw), [int](($H - $vh) / 2), $vw, $vh); $rx -= $vw + $gap }
        $wh = & $ui.BandLH $ui.BandWord; $sh = $(if ([string]$ui.BandSub.Text) { & $ui.BandLH $ui.BandSub } else { 0 }); $ui.BandSub.Visible = [bool]$sh
        $bh = [int][math]::Max((& $ui.Sc $ui.Z.BandH), $wh + $sh); if ($bh -ne $H) { $H = $bh; $ui.Band.Height = $bh }   # 56 px at 100 %, or what the word and "in RADE" need when that is more (each fit)
        $top = [int](($H - $wh - $sh) / 2)
        $cw = [math]::Max((& $ui.Meas ([string]$ui.BandWord.Text) $ui.F.Word 100000).Width, (& $ui.Meas ([string]$ui.BandSub.Text) $ui.F.Small 100000).Width) + (& $ui.Sc 4); $cw = [int][math]::Max((& $ui.Sc 40), [math]::Min($cw, $rx - $x0))
        $ui.BandWord.Bounds = New-Object System.Drawing.Rectangle($x0, $top, $cw, $wh); if ($sh) { $ui.BandSub.Bounds = New-Object System.Drawing.Rectangle($x0, ($top + $wh), $cw, $sh) }
        foreach ($l in @($ui.BandWord, $ui.BandSub)) { & $ui.Shorten $l ([string]$ui.BandRaw[$l]) $cw }   # a word wider than its room ends with "..." (no tooltip)
        $lx = $x0 + $cw + (& $ui.Sc $ui.Z.G4); $lh = & $ui.BandLH $ui.BandLine
        $ui.BandLine.Visible = [bool](-not $ui.Narrow -and [string]$ui.BandLine.Text -and ($rx - $lx) -ge (& $ui.Sc 60))
        if ($ui.BandLine.Visible) { $ui.BandLine.Bounds = New-Object System.Drawing.Rectangle($lx, [int](($H - $lh) / 2), ($rx - $lx), $lh); & $ui.Shorten $ui.BandLine ([string]$ui.BandRaw[$ui.BandLine]) ($rx - $lx) } } catch { $null = $_ } }   # no measure yet: the next fit places them
    $ui.Band.Add_SizeChanged({ & $ui.BandFit })
    # The height a band label needs for its text, as Windows Forms measures a label (GetPreferredSize: the text with the
    # label's own padding; the self-check compares the same number), else one line of its font. Takes the label.
    $ui.BandLH = { param($L) $h = 0; try { $h = [int]$L.GetPreferredSize((New-Object System.Drawing.Size(0, 0))).Height } catch { $null = $_ }   # no measure: one line of the font
      if ($h -le 0) { $h = [int](& $ui.LineH $L.Font) }; return $h }
    # Sets the texts and the logo of the band. Takes $true once an application is chosen (its logo, word and subtitle), else
    # RADE's own (the word RADE, RADE's full name as the subtitle). An app with productName and a logo shows its own from the
    # first screen (engine-v47, the PFM, 2026-11-26: "it should be the KANON logo").
    $ui.SetBand = { param([bool]$App)
      $own = [bool]($App -or ([string]$appProduct -and $ui.AppImg)); $img = $(if ($own -and $ui.AppImg) { $ui.AppImg } else { $ui.RadeImg })
      if (-not [object]::ReferenceEquals($ui.Logo.Image, $img)) { $ui.Logo.Image = $img }; $ui.Logo.AccessibleName = $(if ($own -and $ui.AppImg) { (Get-AppWord) + ' logo' } else { 'RADE logo' })
      $ui.BandRaw[$ui.BandWord] = $(if ($own) { (Get-AppWord).ToUpperInvariant() } else { 'RADE' }); $ui.BandRaw[$ui.BandSub] = $(if ($own) { 'in RADE' } else { '' })
      $ui.BandRaw[$ui.BandLine] = $(if ($own) { [string](Get-AppSubtitle) } else { $ui.Tagline }); $r = $(if (Test-RunnerStart) { '' } else { [string]$round })
      $ui.BandRaw[$ui.BandVer] = (@($(if ($App -and [string]$script:app.Version) { [string]$script:app.Version }), $r) | Where-Object { $_ }) -join $dot
      foreach ($l in @($ui.BandWord, $ui.BandSub, $ui.BandLine, $ui.BandVer)) { $l.Text = [string]$ui.BandRaw[$l] }; & $ui.BandFit }
    # The light line under the band (plan engine-v48 step 2): 4 px in the line color when nothing is asked, 4 px green when a
    # run passed, 8 px yellow on your turn (yellow means only that), 8 px in the error color on a failure. The card's words
    # always say it too.
    $ui.Light = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Panel
    $ui.Light.Dock = 'Top'; $ui.Light.Height = $ui.Z.LineIdle; $ui.Light.BackColor = $ui.C.Hair; $ui.Light.AccessibleRole = 'StaticText'; $ui.Light.AccessibleName = 'Status light: off'
    # Sets the light line. Takes the card's Light: 'you', 'bad', 'pass' or none.
    $ui.SetLight = { param([string]$State)
      $loud = ($State -in 'you', 'bad'); $h = $(if ($loud) { $ui.Z.LineLoud } else { $ui.Z.LineIdle }); if ($ui.Scaled) { $h = & $ui.Sc $h }; if ($ui.Light.Height -ne $h) { $ui.Light.Height = $h }
      $ui.Light.BackColor = $(if ($State -eq 'you') { $ui.C.Yellow } elseif ($State -eq 'bad') { $ui.C.Red } elseif ($State -eq 'pass') { $ui.C.Green } else { $ui.C.Hair })
      $ui.Light.AccessibleName = 'Status light: ' + $(if ($State -eq 'you') { 'your turn' } elseif ($State -eq 'bad') { 'failed' } elseif ($State -eq 'pass') { 'passed' } else { 'off' }) }
    $ui.Bottom = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.TableLayoutPanel
    $ui.Bottom.Dock = 'Bottom'; $ui.Bottom.Height = 46; $ui.Bottom.AutoSize = $true; $ui.Bottom.AutoSizeMode = 'GrowAndShrink'; $ui.Bottom.MinimumSize = New-Object System.Drawing.Size(0, 46); $ui.Bottom.ColumnCount = 5; $ui.Bottom.RowCount = 1; $ui.Bottom.Padding = (& $ui.Pad ($ui.Z.Inset - $ui.Z.M) 3 $ui.Z.Inset 3); $ui.Bottom.BackColor = $ui.C.White
    foreach ($cs in @('AutoSize', 'AutoSize', 'AutoSize', 'Percent', 'AutoSize')) { [void]$ui.Bottom.ColumnStyles.Add((New-Object System.Windows.Forms.ColumnStyle($cs, 100))) }
    [void]$ui.Bottom.RowStyles.Add((New-Object System.Windows.Forms.RowStyle('AutoSize')))   # as tall as the links with their margin and focus ring, 46 at least (R24: 1 px cut at 150 %)
    $ui.RecB = & $ui.LinkBtn 'Details (F2)'; $ui.RecB.AccessibleName = 'Details: all checks, steps, files and the log (F2)'
    # UI standard v1 (B6, the Administrator, 2026-11-20): one Back pattern, a "Back (Esc)" button (40 high: one height, Cards v2) at the left end of the
    # card's action row (03-card.ps1 puts it there); Details (F2), Help (F1) and Feedback are the only links of the bottom line.
    $ui.BackB = & $ui.Btn 'action'; $ui.BackB.Text = 'Back (Esc)'; $ui.BackB.AccessibleName = 'Back (Esc)'; $ui.BackB.Visible = $false
    # Feedback (B13): the same place on every card of a test round; it opens the feedback card for the card on screen ($ui.VNote).
    $ui.FeedB = & $ui.LinkBtn 'Feedback'; $ui.FeedB.AccessibleName = 'Feedback: a comment and a picture of this window for the round'; $ui.FeedB.Visible = $false
    $ui.RightL = & $ui.Label $ui.F.Small $ui.C.Gray 0; $ui.RightL.Anchor = 'Right'; $ui.RightL.Visible = $true; $ui.RightL.TextAlign = 'MiddleRight'
    # Its widest values (the percent of a run, the count of the checks, a result word, the time a run took: $ui.FixW): one size.
    $ui.Most[$ui.RightL] = @('100 %', 'Check 999 of 999', 'Needs review', 'Stopped', '999m 59s'); $ui.RightL.Add_TextChanged({ & $ui.FixW $this })
    # L6 (the Administrator, 2026-11-19): "Help (F1)" opens the RADE tour again; shown on a card that is not busy ($ui.HelpViews).
    $ui.TourB = & $ui.LinkBtn 'Help (F1)'; $ui.TourB.AccessibleName = 'Help: the RADE tour (F1)'; $ui.TourB.Visible = $false
    foreach ($b in @($ui.RecB, $ui.TourB, $ui.FeedB)) { $b.Anchor = 'Left' }   # R32: no top anchor, so a link sits on the middle of the line, as the text at the right does (they were 3.5 px apart at 150 %)
    $ui.Bottom.Controls.Add($ui.RecB, 0, 0); $ui.Bottom.Controls.Add($ui.TourB, 1, 0); $ui.Bottom.Controls.Add($ui.FeedB, 2, 0); $ui.Bottom.Controls.Add($ui.RightL, 4, 0); & $ui.Ring $ui.Bottom
    # Bars: RADE draws them (R17). A 30 ms timer eases the fill to its value; with Windows animations off it jumps. No bar
    # moves back inside a run (all) or a step (step). The bar on the bottom edge is all steps; the short one is this step.
    $ui.DrawBar = { param($P, $G) try { $b = $ui.Bars[[string]$P.Tag]; $G.Clear($(if ($b.On) { $ui.C.Track } else { $ui.C.White })); $fw = [int][math]::Round($P.ClientSize.Width * $b.Shown); if ($b.On -and $fw -gt 0) { $br = New-Object System.Drawing.SolidBrush($b.Fill); $G.FillRectangle($br, 0, 0, $fw, $P.ClientSize.Height); $br.Dispose() } } catch { $null = $_ } }
    # Makes one thin progress bar (a panel the engine draws itself) and registers it in $ui.Bars. Takes the bar name and its
    # screen-reader label; gives back the panel.
    $ui.MkBar = { param([string]$Name, [string]$Label)
      $p = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Panel; $p.Height = 4; $p.Tag = $Name; $p.AccessibleRole = 'ProgressBar'; $p.AccessibleName = $Label; $p.AccessibleDescription = '0 %'
      try { [System.Windows.Forms.Control].GetProperty('DoubleBuffered', [System.Reflection.BindingFlags]'NonPublic, Instance').SetValue($p, $true, $null) } catch { $null = $_ }
      $ui.Bars[$Name] = @{ Panel = $p; Target = 0.0; Shown = 0.0; On = $false; Fill = $ui.C.Info }   # progress: the Info color (dark: blue, not the ember of the main button)
      $p.Add_Paint({ & $ui.DrawBar $this $_.Graphics }); $p }
    # Sets what a bar shows. Takes the bar name, the fraction (0 to 1) and whether it is on; the fill eases to it, and a
    # smaller value jumps back at once. Gives back nothing.
    $ui.SetBar = { param([string]$Name, [double]$Value, [bool]$On)
      $b = $ui.Bars[$Name]; $v = [math]::Max(0.0, [math]::Min(1.0, $Value))
      if ($v -lt $b.Target - 0.001 -or $ui.Calm) { $b.Shown = $v }   # a new step starts at 0 with no slide back
      $b.Target = $v; $b.On = $On; $b.Panel.AccessibleDescription = [string][int]($v * 100) + ' %'; $b.Panel.Invalidate() }
    $ui.Edge = & $ui.MkBar 'all' 'Progress of all steps'; $ui.Edge.Dock = 'Bottom'
    $ui.Anim = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Timer
    $ui.Anim.Interval = 30
    $ui.Anim.Add_Tick({ if ([bool]$ui.Busy -ne [bool]$ui.BusyShown) { $ui.BusyShown = [bool]$ui.Busy; try { $ui.Form.Invalidate($true) } catch { $null = $_ } }; foreach ($b in @($ui.Bars.Values)) { $d = $b.Target - $b.Shown; if ([math]::Abs($d) -gt 0.0005) { $b.Shown = $(if ($ui.Calm) { $b.Target } else { $b.Shown + $d * 0.18 }); $b.Panel.Invalidate() } } })

    # ==== Engine part: engine/ps/window/03-card.ps1 (sha256 9eb832fcf98c)
    # RADE window part 03, the card: the one block that shows a statement or a question, with its parts (line,
    # sentence, paragraphs, choices, box, hand-step text, step line, buttons) and the one-line text box helper.
    # Joined into every bundle by engine/rade_build.py; Windows PowerShell 5.1.

    # ---- The card: one block, its text column centered (76.5 % of the width, at most 680 px: engine/window.json), 40 % of the spare height above it. Top to bottom: a small
    # line in capitals (the header row), the sentence, up to four paragraphs, the choices, a box with its label, the lines of a hand step (one
    # selectable text: the numbered lines, then the unnumbered ones), the file path of a hand step, the step line (name, bar,
    # time in the step, count), the last log line, the error box, two file links, a note, the help line, the closing line of
    # a hand step, the buttons, a last gray line, and the owner's test extras. A card shows only the parts it names ($ui.SetCard).
    $ui.Card = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.TableLayoutPanel
    $ui.Card.Dock = 'Fill'; $ui.Card.ColumnCount = 3; $ui.Card.RowCount = 3; $ui.Card.BackColor = $ui.C.White
    # Three columns: a side, the text column, a side. The text column is $ui.Layout.Share % of the width and at most $ui.Layout.MaxW
    # (engine/window.json); the two sides share what is left, so the column is centered ($ui.Fit sets the sizes).
    $ui.CardCols = @(); $sd = (100 - $ui.Layout.Share) / 2
    foreach ($w in @($sd, $ui.Layout.Share, $sd)) { $cs = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.ColumnStyle('Percent', $w); $ui.CardCols += $cs; [void]$ui.Card.ColumnStyles.Add($cs) }
    # Three rows: the room above the frame (a fixed height, set by $ui.Squeeze), the frame, the rest (L1, the Administrator, 2026-11-19).
    $ui.CardRows = @((New-Object System.Windows.Forms.RowStyle('Absolute', 0)), (New-Object System.Windows.Forms.RowStyle('AutoSize')), (New-Object System.Windows.Forms.RowStyle('Percent', 100))); foreach ($rs in $ui.CardRows) { [void]$ui.Card.RowStyles.Add($rs) }
    # The card frame (L1, the Administrator, 2026-11-19): its top is fixed (40 % of the spare height above a frame of
    # $ui.Layout.FrameMin, engine/window.json), it is that tall at least and grows down to the bottom line at most. It is a
    # stack of four: the header row (the line in capitals, "Step x of n": it never scrolls and never moves), the body, a gap
    # that fills a short card up to the minimum height, and the tail, so the buttons sit at the bottom of the frame.
    # The card is a stack: the body (every part above the buttons) and the tail (the buttons, the last gray line
    # and the test extras). The body sits in a panel that scrolls only when the card is taller than the window, so the
    # buttons are always in view (the Administrator, 2026-11-15; $ui.Squeeze). No scroll at 1020 x 616 and larger.
    $ui.MkStack = { $t = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.TableLayoutPanel; $t.AutoSize = $true; $t.AutoSizeMode = 'GrowAndShrink'; $t.ColumnCount = 1; $t.Margin = (& $ui.Pad 0 0 0 0); $t.BackColor = $ui.C.White
      [void]$t.ColumnStyles.Add((New-Object System.Windows.Forms.ColumnStyle('AutoSize'))); $t }
    $ui.Stack = & $ui.MkStack; $ui.Stack.Anchor = 'Top, Left'; $ui.Body = & $ui.MkStack; $ui.Tail = & $ui.MkStack
    $ui.Scroll = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Panel
    $ui.Scroll.AutoScroll = $true; $ui.Scroll.Margin = (& $ui.Pad 0 0 0 0); $ui.Scroll.BackColor = $ui.C.White; $ui.Scroll.AccessibleName = 'Card text'

    # The YOUR TURN chip (plan engine-v48 step 3; critique change 1, the PFM, 2026-11-27): on a card where RADE waits for the
    # person (the yellow light), a yellow chip "YOUR TURN" stands before the line in capitals; the separate "Your turn" line of
    # R35 is gone. Yellow means only this (and the light line).
    $ui.Chip = & $ui.Label $ui.F.SmallB $ui.C.OnYellow 0; $ui.Chip.BackColor = $ui.C.Yellow; $ui.Chip.Text = 'YOUR TURN'; $ui.Chip.AccessibleName = 'Your turn'
    $ui.Chip.Padding = (& $ui.Pad $ui.Z.G2 $ui.Z.G1 $ui.Z.G2 $ui.Z.G1); $ui.Chip.Margin = (& $ui.Pad 0 0 $ui.Z.G3 0); $ui.Roles[$ui.Chip] = @{ ForeColor = 'OnYellow'; BackColor = 'Yellow' }   # its tokens for $ui.Recolor

    $ui.PathL = & $ui.Label $ui.F.SmallB $ui.C.Gray $ui.Z.G3; $ui.PathL.Text = 'File path'

    $ui.PctRow = & $ui.Flow $ui.Z.G3; $ui.PctRow.AccessibleName = 'Progress of the run'
    $ui.PctL = & $ui.Label $ui.F.Word $ui.C.Navy 0; $ui.PctL.Visible = $true; $ui.PctL.AccessibleName = 'Percent of the run'; $ui.Most[$ui.PctL] = @('100 %'); $ui.PctL.Add_TextChanged({ & $ui.FixW $this })
    $ui.RunBar = & $ui.MkBar 'run' 'Progress of all steps'; $ui.RunBar.Height = 6; $ui.RunBar.Margin = (& $ui.Pad 0 $ui.Z.G1 0 $ui.Z.G3)

    [void]$ui.RunHead.Controls.Add($ui.StepName); [void]$ui.RunHead.Controls.Add($ui.RunWord)
    $ui.StepSum = & $ui.Text $ui.F.Small $ui.C.Navy $ui.Z.G1 'What the step does'; $ui.StepSum.BackColor = $ui.C.Tint
    $ui.StepRow = & $ui.Flow $ui.Z.G1; $ui.StepRow.Visible = $true; $ui.StepRow.BackColor = $ui.C.Tint
    $ui.StepBar = & $ui.MkBar 'step' 'Progress of this step'; $ui.StepBar.Width = 200; $ui.StepBar.Margin = (& $ui.Pad 0 $ui.Z.BarTop $ui.Z.G2 0)
    # R28 N10: the time in this step, at the right end of its bar ("4m 12s"), every second ($ui.TimeT). The log keeps "Started".
    $ui.StepTime = & $ui.Label $ui.F.Small $ui.C.Gray 2; $ui.StepTime.Visible = $true; $ui.StepTime.AccessibleName = 'Time in this step'; $ui.StepTime.BackColor = $ui.C.Tint

    # The time ("4m 12s", "1h 04m 12s") and the count ("3 of 12") keep one size from their widest value ($ui.FixW), so the bar

    $ui.Most[$ui.StepTime] = @('9h 59m 59s'); $ui.Most[$ui.StepFrac] = @('999 of 999')

    # The now-doing line (L7, the Administrator, 2026-11-19): what the running step does now ($ui.ShowNow). It has a fixed room

    $ui.Now = & $ui.Text $ui.F.Small $ui.C.Gray $ui.Z.G1 'Now doing'; $ui.Now.BackColor = $ui.C.Tint; $ui.Now.Visible = $true

    # The WHAT TO DO box of the step-failed card (Cards v2): a 1 px edge around the label and the text.
    $ui.Todo = & $ui.Flow $ui.Z.G3; $ui.Todo.FlowDirection = 'TopDown'; $ui.Todo.Padding = (& $ui.Pad $ui.Z.G3 $ui.Z.G2 $ui.Z.G3 $ui.Z.G2); $ui.Todo.AccessibleName = 'What to do'
    $ui.TodoL = & $ui.Label $ui.F.SmallB $ui.C.Gray 0; $ui.TodoL.Text = 'WHAT TO DO'; $ui.TodoL.Visible = $true

    # A one-line box: a frame as tall as a compact button with RADE's own 1 px edge, the text box inside it with no border,
    # in the middle (a text box cannot be made taller with its text in the middle). The ring goes around the frame.
    $ui.Boxes = @()
    # Sizes and centers the text box inside its one-line frame. Takes the frame panel; does nothing before the window has
    # its scale; gives back nothing.
    # The text box is one line of its font tall, as Windows draws the text ($ui.LineH; R35: a box that sized itself was 27 high
    # where a line needs 32 at 150 %), and never taller than the frame inside its edge.
    $ui.BoxFit = { param($P) if (-not $ui.Scaled) { return }
      try { $tb = $P.Controls[0]; $in = & $ui.Sc 6; $h = [math]::Max(1, [math]::Min((& $ui.LineH $tb.Font), ($P.ClientSize.Height - (& $ui.Sc 2)))); if ($tb.Height -ne $h) { $tb.Height = $h }
        $tb.Width = [math]::Max(10, $P.ClientSize.Width - 2 * $in); $tb.Location = New-Object System.Drawing.Point($in, [int][math]::Floor(($P.ClientSize.Height - $tb.Height) / 2)) } catch { $null = $_ } }
    # Wraps a text box in a one-line frame with its own 1 px edge and a focus ring. Takes the text box and the frame width;
    # gives back the frame panel and remembers it in $ui.Boxes.
    $ui.MkBox = { param($Tb, [int]$W)

      $p.Add_Paint({ try { $pn = New-Object System.Drawing.Pen($ui.C.Edge); $_.Graphics.DrawRectangle($pn, 0, 0, ($this.ClientSize.Width - 1), ($this.ClientSize.Height - 1)); $pn.Dispose() } catch { $null = $_ } })
      $p.Add_SizeChanged({ & $ui.BoxFit $this }); $p.Add_Click({ try { [void]$this.Controls[0].Focus() } catch { $null = $_ } }); $ui.Boxes += $p; $p }
    $ui.Field = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.TextBox

    $ui.Field.Add_GotFocus({ if ($ui.BoxNoEnter) { $ui.Form.AcceptButton = $null } }); $ui.Field.Add_LostFocus({ if ($ui.BoxNoEnter) { $ui.Form.AcceptButton = $ui.AcceptOn } })
    $ui.FieldBox = & $ui.MkBox $ui.Field $ui.Z.FieldM; $ui.FieldBox.Margin = (& $ui.Pad $ui.Z.G2 $ui.Z.M $ui.Z.M $ui.Z.M)   # 8 from the label; 4 + the button's 4 = 8 to the button
    $ui.FieldB = & $ui.Btn 'compact'

    $ui.B = @(); foreach ($k in 0..($ui.NB - 1)) { $b = & $ui.Btn 'action'; $b.Tag = $k; $b.Add_Click({ $a = $ui.Acts[[int]$this.Tag]; if ($a -and (-not $ui.Busy -or $ui.Always[[int]$this.Tag]) -and (& $ui.Settled)) { & $a } }); $ui.B += $b; [void]$ui.BtnRow.Controls.Add($b) }
    $ui.Foot = & $ui.Text $ui.F.Small $ui.C.Gray ($ui.Z.G6 - $ui.Z.M) 'Last line'
    # The owner's test extras (test rounds only; they go away with the test branch): the results address, the e-mail draft

    $ui.TestRow = & $ui.Flow ($ui.Z.G6 - $ui.Z.M); $ui.TestRow.WrapContents = $true; & $ui.Ring $ui.TestRow

    # Puts controls into a table as one auto-sized row each, top to bottom. Takes the table and the list of controls; sets

    $ui.Fill = { param($T, $Parts) $row = 0; foreach ($c in @($Parts)) { [void]$T.RowStyles.Add((New-Object System.Windows.Forms.RowStyle('AutoSize'))); $T.Controls.Add($c, 0, $row); $row++ }; $T.RowCount = $row }

    # ---- What a card shows around its text (plan engine-v48 steps 2 to 4; $ui.SetCard calls these)
    # Esc (Cards v2; critique change 4, the PFM, 2026-11-27): Back only on Choose, Maintenance and the not-installed card, and
    # on the Run card Esc opens the Cancel question. Your turn and Done take no Esc; the Back of another card is a plain "Back".
    $ui.EscViews = @('choose', 'maint', 'notinst')
    $ui.Dress = {
      <#
      .SYNOPSIS
      Sets the parts of a card that are not its text: the light line, the stage now, the YOUR TURN chip, the color of the line
      in capitals and the parts of the Run and step-failed cards.
      .PARAMETER C
      The card (the hashtable of $ui.SetCard): Light ('you', 'bad' or 'pass'), KickColor (a token name), StepRow, Todo.
      .OUTPUTS
      Nothing.
      #>
      param($C)
      & $ui.SetLight ([string]$C.Light); & $ui.SetStage ([string]$C.View) ([string]$C.Light -eq 'pass')
      $ui.Chip.Visible = ([string]$C.Light -eq 'you'); $ui.Kick.ForeColor = $(if ($C.KickColor) { $ui.C[[string]$C.KickColor] } else { $ui.C.Gray })
      if ($ui.Scaled) { & $ui.SetWrap $ui.Kick ([int]$ui.ContentW - $(if ($ui.Chip.Visible) { [int]$ui.Chip.PreferredSize.Width + (& $ui.Sc $ui.Z.G3) } else { 0 })) }   # the line in capitals beside the chip
      foreach ($x in @($ui.PctRow, $ui.RunBar, $ui.RunRow)) { $x.Visible = [bool]$C.StepRow }
      if (-not $C.StepRow) { $ui.RunA.Visible = $false; $ui.RunB.Visible = $false }
      $ui.Todo.Visible = [bool]$C.Todo; $ui.TodoT.Text = [string]$C.Todo
      $om = & $ui.Sc $(if (@($C.Options | Where-Object { $_ -and $_.Inline }).Count) { $ui.Z.G4 } else { $ui.Z.G6 }); $m = $ui.Opts.Margin   # one-line rows (Maintenance): 16 above the list
      if ($m.Top -ne $om) { $ui.Opts.Margin = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Padding($m.Left, $om, $m.Right, $m.Bottom) }
      $ui.P[0].Font = $(if ($C.Strong) { $ui.F.Turn } else { $ui.F.Body }) }   # the Done card's summary line is strong
    # Says whether a button text fits the widest button (B1: 240 x 40) with the button's padding, as $ui.BtnSize measures it. A
    # main button whose text with " (Enter)" does not fit keeps its text alone (Enter still selects it). Takes the text.
    $ui.KeyFits = { param([string]$T) try { return ([int][System.Windows.Forms.TextRenderer]::MeasureText($T, $ui.F.SmallB).Width + (& $ui.Sc (2 * $ui.Z.G2)) -le (& $ui.Sc $ui.Z.WideW)) } catch { return $true } }   # no measure: the key shows
    $ui.SetButtons = {
      <#
      .SYNOPSIS
      Fills the action row of a card: the primary button last (B3, B4) with its key in its text ("Done (Enter)"), Back at the
      left end ("Back (Esc)" where Esc does Back), and Enter on the primary unless the card says NoAccept.
      .PARAMETER C
      The card: Buttons (Text, Kind, Act, Always; up to $ui.NB), Back, NoAccept.
      .OUTPUTS
      Nothing. Sets $ui.Acts, $ui.BOn, $ui.BMain, $ui.Always, $ui.Back, $ui.BackOn, $ui.First, $ui.Accept and the AcceptButton.
      #>
      param($C)
      $bs = @(@($C.Buttons | Where-Object { $_ -and [string]$_.Kind -ne 'primary' }) + @($C.Buttons | Where-Object { $_ -and [string]$_.Kind -eq 'primary' }))
      $ui.Acts = @(); $ui.First = $null; $ui.Accept = $null; $ui.BOn = @($false) * $ui.NB; $ui.BMain = @($false) * $ui.NB; $ui.Always = @($false) * $ui.NB
      $ui.Back = $C.Back; $ui.BackOn = ([bool]$C.Back -and -not $ui.RecOn); $ui.BackB.Visible = $ui.BackOn   # B6: Back at the left end of the action row
      $ui.BackB.Text = $(if ($ui.EscViews -contains [string]$C.View) { 'Back (Esc)' } else { 'Back' }); $ui.BackB.AccessibleName = $ui.BackB.Text   # "(Esc)" only where Esc works
      $ui.BoxNoEnter = [bool]$C.BoxNoEnter   # Enter in a box of this card answers nothing (the hand card's address box)
      for ($k = 0; $k -lt $ui.NB; $k++) {
        $b = $ui.B[$k]
        if ($k -ge $bs.Count) { $b.Visible = $false; $ui.Acts += $null; continue }
        $main = ([string]$bs[$k].Kind -eq 'primary'); $key = $(if ($main -and -not $C.NoAccept -and (& $ui.KeyFits ([string]$bs[$k].Text + ' (Enter)'))) { ' (Enter)' } else { '' })
        $b.Text = [string]$bs[$k].Text + $key; & $ui.Style $b ([string]$bs[$k].Kind); $b.Visible = $true; $ui.Acts += $bs[$k].Act; $ui.BOn[$k] = $true; $ui.BMain[$k] = $main; $ui.Always[$k] = [bool]$bs[$k].Always
        if ($b.Enabled -and -not $ui.First) { $ui.First = $b }; if ($b.Enabled -and -not $ui.Accept -and $main) { $ui.Accept = $b } }
      & $ui.Apart
      $ui.BtnRow.Visible = [bool]($bs.Count -or $ui.BackOn)
      $ui.Form.AcceptButton = $(if ($C.NoAccept) { $null } else { $ui.Accept }); $ui.AcceptOn = $ui.Form.AcceptButton }   # Enter = the primary button ("(Enter)" in its text)
    # ==== Engine part: engine/ps/window/04-record-parts.ps1 (sha256 c05dec9b4998)
    # RADE window part 04, the hand-step text and the Record's first parts: builds the rich text of the numbered
    # lines of a hand step and fits its box. Builds on 03-card.ps1 (the Guide box).
    # Joined into every bundle by engine/rade_build.py; Windows PowerShell 5.1.

    # ---- The Record (F2): all checks by group with their result, the steps with a box each (they can be changed only
    # before the run), and one text box with the files (New, Replace, Recycle), what the installs made, and the log.
    $ui.Rec = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.TableLayoutPanel
    $ui.Rec.Dock = 'Fill'; $ui.Rec.ColumnCount = 3; $ui.Rec.RowCount = 2; $ui.Rec.Padding = (& $ui.Pad ($ui.Z.Inset + $ui.Z.M) 0 ($ui.Z.Inset + $ui.Z.M) $ui.Z.G2); $ui.Rec.BackColor = $ui.C.White; $ui.Rec.Visible = $false
    foreach ($w in @(36, 30, 34)) { [void]$ui.Rec.ColumnStyles.Add((New-Object System.Windows.Forms.ColumnStyle('Percent', $w))) }
    [void]$ui.Rec.RowStyles.Add((New-Object System.Windows.Forms.RowStyle('AutoSize'))); [void]$ui.Rec.RowStyles.Add((New-Object System.Windows.Forms.RowStyle('Percent', 100)))
    $ui.RecHead = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.FlowLayoutPanel

    $ui.RecClose = & $ui.Btn 'compact'; $ui.RecClose.Text = 'Back (Esc)'; $ui.RecClose.AccessibleName = 'Close Details (Esc)'
    $ui.RecTitle = & $ui.Label $ui.F.Body $ui.C.Navy 9; $ui.RecTitle.Margin = (& $ui.Pad 10 9 0 0); $ui.RecTitle.Text = 'Details'; $ui.RecTitle.Visible = $true
    # R33 (the PFM, 19 Nov 26): the check list and the step list are drawn, so they cannot be selected; Copy all puts the whole
    # Record (the checks with each detail, the steps, the files and the log) on the clipboard as plain text ($ui.RecAll).
    $ui.RecCopy = & $ui.Btn 'compact'; $ui.RecCopy.Text = 'Copy all'; $ui.RecCopy.AccessibleName = 'Copy all of Details as text'
    [void]$ui.RecHead.Controls.Add($ui.RecClose); [void]$ui.RecHead.Controls.Add($ui.RecCopy); [void]$ui.RecHead.Controls.Add($ui.RecTitle)
    $ui.RecChecks = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Panel
    $ui.RecChecks.Dock = 'Top'; $ui.RecChecks.BackColor = $ui.C.White; $ui.RecChecks.AccessibleRole = 'StaticText'; $ui.RecChecks.AccessibleName = 'Checks'
    try { [System.Windows.Forms.Control].GetProperty('DoubleBuffered', [System.Reflection.BindingFlags]'NonPublic, Instance').SetValue($ui.RecChecks, $true, $null) } catch { $null = $_ }
    $ui.RecSteps = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.FlowLayoutPanel
    $ui.RecSteps.Dock = 'Fill'; $ui.RecSteps.FlowDirection = 'TopDown'; $ui.RecSteps.WrapContents = $false; $ui.RecSteps.AutoScroll = $true; $ui.RecSteps.BackColor = $ui.C.White; $ui.RecSteps.Margin = (& $ui.Pad 0 0 16 0); $ui.RecSteps.AccessibleName = 'Steps'
    $ui.RecText = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.TextBox
    $ui.RecText.Dock = 'Fill'; $ui.RecText.Multiline = $true; $ui.RecText.ReadOnly = $true; $ui.RecText.ScrollBars = 'Vertical'; $ui.RecText.WordWrap = $true; $ui.RecText.Font = $ui.F.Mono; $ui.RecText.BackColor = $ui.C.White; $ui.RecText.ForeColor = $ui.C.Ink; $ui.RecText.BorderStyle = 'FixedSingle'; $ui.RecText.Margin = (& $ui.Pad 4 4 4 4); $ui.RecText.AccessibleName = 'Files, made list and log'
    $ui.Rec.Controls.Add($ui.RecHead, 0, 0); $ui.Rec.SetColumnSpan($ui.RecHead, 3)

    $ui.RecScroll = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Panel

    $ui.RecScroll.Controls.Add($ui.RecChecks)
    $ui.Rec.Controls.Add($ui.RecScroll, 0, 1); $ui.Rec.Controls.Add($ui.RecSteps, 1, 1); $ui.Rec.Controls.Add($ui.RecText, 2, 1)
    # The Fill parts go in first: they dock last, inside the light, the logo line, the bottom line and the edge bar.
    foreach ($c in @($ui.Card, $ui.Rec, $ui.Bottom, $ui.Edge, $ui.Light, $ui.Band)) { $ui.Form.Controls.Add($c) }   # the band on top, the light line under it
    $ui.Form.ResumeLayout($false); $ui.Form.PerformLayout()

    # The lines of a hand step (the Administrator, 2026-11-17; R28 N4): a guide line that starts with "<digits>. " is numbered:
    # its number right-aligned in the left column, its text wrapped in the right column; any other line follows the list,
    # small and gray. All of it is ONE rich text box ($ui.Guide), so a person can select across lines. The plain parts stay in
    # $ui.GuideNums, $ui.GuideTexts and $ui.GuideRest (the tests read them). RTF: figure spaces right-align the numbers, a tab
    # and a hanging indent start the text column; sizes in twips from the pixels the box draws at.
    $ui.SetSteps = { param($Guide)
      $ui.GuideNums = @(); $ui.GuideTexts = @(); $ui.GuideRest = @()
      foreach ($g in @($Guide)) { $g = [string]$g
        if ($g -match '^(\d+)\.\s+(\S.*)$') { $ui.GuideNums += ($Matches[1] + '.'); $ui.GuideTexts += $Matches[2] } elseif ($g.Trim()) { $ui.GuideRest += $g.Trim() } }
      $on = [bool](@($ui.GuideNums).Count -or @($ui.GuideRest).Count); $ui.Guide.Visible = $on
      if (-not $on) { try { $ui.Guide.Clear() } catch { $null = $_ }; return }
      & $ui.GuideBuild; & $ui.FitSteps }
    # Escapes text for rich text (RTF): backslash and braces, and characters above 126 as \u codes. Takes the text; gives
    # back the escaped text.
    $ui.RtfEsc = { param([string]$T) $sb = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder
      foreach ($ch in $T.ToCharArray()) { $n = [int]$ch; if ($ch -eq [char]92 -or $ch -eq '{' -or $ch -eq '}') { [void]$sb.Append([char]92).Append($ch) } elseif ($n -gt 126) { [void]$sb.Append('\u' + $(if ($n -gt 32767) { $n - 65536 } else { $n }) + '?') } elseif ($n -lt 32) { [void]$sb.Append(' ') } else { [void]$sb.Append($ch) } }
      return $sb.ToString() }
    # Builds the rich text of the hand-step box from $ui.GuideNums, $ui.GuideTexts and $ui.GuideRest (numbers right-aligned
    # in a column, then the small gray lines) and sets it into the box. Takes nothing; sets $ui.Guide.Rtf, $ui.GuideInkAt
    # and the box's screen-reader text.
    $ui.GuideBuild = {
      $g = $null; try { $g = $ui.Guide.CreateGraphics() } catch { $null = $_ }
      $dpi = 96.0; try { if ($g -and [double]$g.DpiX -gt 0) { $dpi = [double]$g.DpiX } } catch { $null = $_ }
      # Turns screen pixels into twips (1/1440 inch) at the box's dpi. Takes the pixels; gives back a whole number.
      $tw = { param([double]$Px) [int][math]::Round($Px * 1440.0 / $dpi) }
      $nw = 0; foreach ($n in @($ui.GuideNums)) { $w = 0; try { $w = [int][System.Windows.Forms.TextRenderer]::MeasureText($g, $n, $ui.F.Body, (New-Object System.Drawing.Size(100000, 0)), [System.Windows.Forms.TextFormatFlags]'NoPadding, SingleLine').Width } catch { $w = [int][System.Windows.Forms.TextRenderer]::MeasureText($n, $ui.F.Body).Width }; $nw = [math]::Max($nw, $w) }
      try { if ($g) { $g.Dispose() } } catch { $null = $_ }
      $cT = & $tw ($nw + (& $ui.Sc 8)); $g1 = & $tw (& $ui.Sc $ui.Z.G1); $g3 = & $tw (& $ui.Sc $ui.Z.G3)
      # Writes a color as the RTF color text (red, green, blue). Takes the color; gives back the text.
      $col = { param($C) '\red' + $C.R + '\green' + $C.G + '\blue' + $C.B + ';' }
      $fb = [int][math]::Round([double]$ui.F.Body.SizeInPoints * 2); $fs = [int][math]::Round([double]$ui.F.Small.SizeInPoints * 2)
      $paras = @(); $plain = 0; $wide = ''; $ui.GuideInkAt = 0
      # A shorter number gets figure spaces (as wide as a digit) in front: the numbers end on one line, and every line starts at
      # the left indent, so the first letter's place never depends on a tab (R28 job: a right tab was laid out late).
      $ml = 0; foreach ($n in @($ui.GuideNums)) { $ml = [math]::Max($ml, ([string]$n).Length) }
      for ($i = 0; $i -lt @($ui.GuideNums).Count; $i++) {
        $n = [string]$ui.GuideNums[$i]; $t = [string]$ui.GuideTexts[$i]; $pad = ([string][char]0x2007) * ($ml - $n.Length)
        if ($n.Length -eq $ml -and -not $wide) { $wide = $n; $ui.GuideInkAt = $plain }   # a widest number: its first letter is on the card edge
        $paras += ('\pard\li' + $cT + '\fi-' + $cT + '\tx' + $cT + '\sb' + $(if ($i) { $g1 } else { 0 }) + '\cf1\fs' + $fb + ' ' + (& $ui.RtfEsc ($pad + $n)) + '\tab ' + (& $ui.RtfEsc $t))
        $plain += 2 + $pad.Length + $n.Length + $t.Length }   # padding, number, tab, text, and the line break
      for ($i = 0; $i -lt @($ui.GuideRest).Count; $i++) {
        $paras += ('\pard\li0\fi0\sb' + $(if ($i -or @($ui.GuideNums).Count) { $(if ($i) { 0 } else { $g3 }) } else { 0 }) + '\cf2\fs' + $fs + ' ' + (& $ui.RtfEsc ([string]$ui.GuideRest[$i]))) }
      if (-not @($ui.GuideNums).Count) { $ui.GuideInkAt = 0 }
      $rtf = '{\rtf1\ansi\ansicpg1252\deff0\uc1{\fonttbl{\f0\fnil ' + (& $ui.RtfEsc ([string]$ui.F.Body.Name)) + ';}}{\colortbl ;' + (& $col $ui.C.Navy) + (& $col $ui.C.Gray) + '}\f0 ' + ($paras -join "\par`r`n") + '}'
      if ([int]$ui.ContentW -gt 0 -and $ui.Guide.Width -ne [int]$ui.ContentW) { $ui.Guide.Width = [int]$ui.ContentW }   # its final width first: a text laid out at the default 100 px kept a wrong place for its first letter (R28 job)
      $ui.GuideH = 0; $ui.Guide.Rtf = $rtf
      $ui.Guide.AccessibleDescription = ((@(for ($i = 0; $i -lt @($ui.GuideNums).Count; $i++) { [string]$ui.GuideNums[$i] + ' ' + [string]$ui.GuideTexts[$i] }) + @($ui.GuideRest)) -join ' ') }
    # How tall the text is: the rich text box says it (ContentsResized), or the place of its last letter plus one line.
    $ui.GuideNeed = { $h = [int]$ui.GuideH
      try { $n = [int]$ui.Guide.TextLength; if ($n -gt 0) { $pt = $ui.Guide.GetPositionFromCharIndex($n - 1); $lf = $(if (@($ui.GuideRest).Count) { $ui.F.Small } else { $ui.F.Body }); $h = [math]::Max($h, [int]$pt.Y + [int][System.Windows.Forms.TextRenderer]::MeasureText('Ag', $lf).Height) } } catch { $null = $_ }
      return $h }
    # Sets the hand-step box to its width and the height its text needs. Takes nothing; changes the box size and does
    # nothing while it is already fitting.
    $ui.GuideFit = { if ($ui.InGuideFit) { return }; $ui.InGuideFit = $true
      try { if ($ui.Guide.Visible) { $w = [int]$ui.ContentW; $h = [math]::Max(1, (& $ui.GuideNeed) + (& $ui.Sc 2)); if ($ui.Guide.Width -ne $w) { $ui.GuideH = 0; $ui.Guide.Width = $w; $h = [math]::Max(1, (& $ui.GuideNeed) + (& $ui.Sc 2)) }; if ($ui.Guide.Height -ne $h) { $ui.Guide.Height = $h } } } catch { $null = $_ } finally { $ui.InGuideFit = $false } }
    # Where the ink of the guide's first number starts in the box: the place of the letter (as the box lays it out) plus the
    # letter's own left side (drawn once into a bitmap). A rich text box cannot be drawn into a bitmap, so $ui.Ink cannot measure it.
    $ui.Bearing = { param([string]$Ch, $F)
      $k = 'bearing|' + $F.Name + '|' + $F.SizeInPoints + '|' + $Ch; if ($ui.Inks.ContainsKey($k)) { return [int]$ui.Inks[$k] }; $v = 0
      try { $bm = New-Object System.Drawing.Bitmap(160, 160); try { $gb = [System.Drawing.Graphics]::FromImage($bm); $gb.Clear([System.Drawing.Color]::White)
          [System.Windows.Forms.TextRenderer]::DrawText($gb, $Ch, $F, (New-Object System.Drawing.Point(0, 0)), [System.Drawing.Color]::Black, [System.Windows.Forms.TextFormatFlags]'NoPadding'); $gb.Dispose(); $hit = -1
          for ($x = 0; $x -lt 80 -and $hit -lt 0; $x++) { for ($y = 0; $y -lt 160; $y++) { $px = $bm.GetPixel($x, $y); if ($px.R + $px.G + $px.B -lt 600) { $hit = $x; break } } }
          if ($hit -ge 0) { $v = $hit; $ui.Inks[$k] = $v } } finally { $bm.Dispose() } } catch { $null = $_ }
      return $v }
    # Gives the x place where the ink of the first number starts in the hand-step box (the letter's place plus its side
    # bearing); 0 when it cannot be read. Takes nothing.
    $ui.GuideInk = { try { $i = [int]$ui.GuideInkAt; $t = [string]$ui.Guide.Text; if ($i -ge $t.Length) { $i = 0 }; if (-not $t) { return 0 }
        $f = $(if (@($ui.GuideNums).Count) { $ui.F.Body } else { $ui.F.Small }); return ([int]$ui.Guide.GetPositionFromCharIndex($i).X + (& $ui.Bearing ([string]$t[$i]) $f)) } catch { return 0 } }
    # Fits the hand-step box after its text or the window width changed. Takes nothing; calls $ui.GuideFit.
    $ui.FitSteps = { & $ui.GuideFit }
    # Lays the card out again for the window's size: text widths, the choices, the step boxes and the buttons.
    $ui.Fit = {
      if (-not $ui.Scaled) { return }   # R1 review: a size set while Windows Forms scales the form would be scaled again
      # Text wraps at the card's width; the choices are as wide as the card.
      # The text column: $ui.Layout.Share % of the card's width, at most $ui.Layout.MaxW (engine/window.json; the Administrator,
      # 2026-11-18), centered between the two sides. Below the cap the sides are (100 - share) / 2 % each, as before.
      $W = [int]$ui.Card.ClientSize.Width; $col = [math]::Min([int]($W * $ui.Layout.Share / 100), [int](& $ui.Sc $ui.Layout.MaxW)); $side = [math]::Max(0, [int](($W - $col) / 2))
      try { if (@($ui.CardCols).Count -eq 3 -and ([int]$ui.CardCols[0].Width -ne $side -or [int]$ui.CardCols[1].Width -ne $col)) {
          $ui.CardCols[0].SizeType = 'Absolute'; $ui.CardCols[0].Width = $side; $ui.CardCols[1].SizeType = 'Absolute'; $ui.CardCols[1].Width = $col
          $ui.CardCols[2].SizeType = 'Percent'; $ui.CardCols[2].Width = 100 } } catch { $null = $_ }   # stand-in types or a form being closed: the card keeps its last columns
      $cw = [math]::Max((& $ui.Sc 240), $col - (& $ui.Sc 4)); $ui.ContentW = $cw
      foreach ($l in @($ui.P[0], $ui.P[1], $ui.P[2], $ui.P[3], $ui.PathT, $ui.Note, $ui.Help, $ui.Foot, $ui.Close)) { & $ui.SetWrap $l $cw }
      & $ui.SetWrap $ui.Kick ($cw - $(if ($ui.Chip.Visible) { [int]$ui.Chip.PreferredSize.Width + (& $ui.Sc $ui.Z.G3) } else { 0 }))   # the line in capitals beside the YOUR TURN chip
      & $ui.SetWrap $ui.Sent ($cw - (& $ui.Sc 44))
      # Rows wrap at the card's width (a button or a box is never cut), and no box is wider than the card.
      $mm = & $ui.Sc $ui.Z.M
      foreach ($r in @($ui.BtnRow, $ui.LinkRow, $ui.TestRow, $ui.FieldRow)) { $r.MaximumSize = New-Object System.Drawing.Size(($cw + 2 * $mm), 0) }
      $ui.BtnRow.MinimumSize = New-Object System.Drawing.Size(($cw + 2 * $mm), 0)   # B3: the action row is as wide as the column, so the primary can stand at its right end (an auto-sized row wraps at its own width)
      $ui.ErrBox.Width = [math]::Min((& $ui.Sc $ui.Z.FieldL), ($cw - 2 * $mm))
      & $ui.BandFit   # the band: full size or half size for this width (02-fixed-parts.ps1)
      try { $lh = [math]::Max([int][System.Windows.Forms.TextRenderer]::MeasureText('Ag', $ui.Kick.Font).Height + (& $ui.Sc 2), [int]$ui.Chip.PreferredSize.Height); if ($ui.Head.MinimumSize.Height -ne $lh) { $ui.Head.MinimumSize = New-Object System.Drawing.Size(0, $lh) } } catch { $null = $_ }   # L1: the header row keeps its height on a card with no line or no chip
      foreach ($l in @($ui.RightL, $ui.StepTime, $ui.StepFrac, $ui.PctL)) { & $ui.FixW $l }   # labels of changing values: one size from their widest value
      & $ui.FitRow; & $ui.Apart; & $ui.FitSent; & $ui.FitSteps; & $ui.FitEdges; & $ui.FitBar; & $ui.AlignRows
      foreach ($o in @($ui.Opts.Controls)) { $o.Width = $cw; try { $o.Height = (& $ui.OptPlan $o.Tag $cw).H } catch { $null = $_ } }
      if ($ui.View -eq 'run' -and $ui.Running) { & $ui.PlaceRuns }   # the step lists take the room this size has
      & $ui.Squeeze }
    # ==== Engine part: engine/ps/window/05-alignment.ps1 (sha256 76c490274d7c)
    # RADE window part 05, alignment and layout: centers a row of controls, breaks and fits long text, keeps the
    # card inside the window (Squeeze) and runs the layout self-check. Builds on 03-card.ps1.
    # Joined into every bundle by engine/rade_build.py; Windows PowerShell 5.1.

    # ---- Alignment (the Administrator, 2026-11-15, after the R24 pictures; docs/window-design.md "Sizes"). An aligned row:
    # its parts share one vertical midpoint (each part's top margin is set from the tallest part). One left edge per card:
    # a label draws its text after a padding that grows with its font (Windows text padding: about 1/6 of the line), so a
    # 22 pt headline started about 3 px right of a 9 pt line and of the buttons. Each part moves by its own padding.
    # Where a part's ink starts, measured: the part drawn into a bitmap by Windows (DrawToBitmap: the same drawing as on
    # screen, with its own flags, padding and the first glyph's side bearing), the first column that differs from its back
    # color. A button with an edge starts at its edge. Without a bitmap (the test stand-ins), the text padding Windows adds
    # (1/6 em, rounded up). R24 job: a formula and a with/without-NoPadding measure both missed by 3 to 6 px.
    # One edge per card at $ui.Sc 10 from the card's column: room for the largest text inset (a 22 pt headline: about 7)
    # and for a button's 4 px margin, because a negative margin is taken as 0 in a table cell (R24 job).
    $ui.FitEdges = {
      <#
      .SYNOPSIS
      Puts the ink of each part of the card on one edge, $ui.Sc 10 into the card's column (the help above).
      .DESCRIPTION
      Texts by their measured ink; the buttons by their own 4 px margin; a list or a box (the Run card's lists and bar, the
      WHAT TO DO box) by its own edge; the YOUR TURN chip by its yellow box, else the line in capitals by its ink.
      .OUTPUTS
      Nothing. Changes left margins; a part that cannot be measured keeps its margin until the next fit.
      #>
      try {
        $mm = & $ui.Sc $ui.Z.M; $x = & $ui.Sc 10; $ui.EdgeX = $x
        foreach ($l in @($ui.P[0], $ui.P[1], $ui.P[2], $ui.P[3], $ui.PathL, $ui.PathT, $ui.Note, $ui.Help, $ui.Foot, $ui.Close, $ui.FieldL, $ui.TestL)) { & $ui.SetLeft $l ($x - (& $ui.Ink $l)) }
        & $ui.SetLeft $ui.TickP 0; & $ui.SetLeft $ui.SentRow ($x - $(if ($ui.TickP.Visible) { & $ui.Ink $ui.TickP } else { & $ui.Ink $ui.Sent }))
        & $ui.SetLeft $ui.PctRow ($x - (& $ui.Ink $ui.PctL)); foreach ($b in @($ui.RunBar, $ui.RunA, $ui.RunRow, $ui.RunB, $ui.Todo)) { & $ui.SetLeft $b $x }   # a list or a box: its edge on the card edge
        & $ui.SetLeft $ui.ErrRow ($x - $ui.ErrBox.Margin.Left)
        & $ui.SetLeft $ui.BtnRow ($x - $mm)   # a button's own 4 px margin (room for the ring)
        $l1 = @($ui.LinkRow.Controls | Where-Object { $_.Visible })[0]; if ($l1) { & $ui.SetLeft $ui.LinkRow ($x - $mm - (& $ui.Ink $l1)) }   # a link's text is in the middle of its box
        if ($ui.Guide.Visible) { & $ui.SetLeft $ui.Guide ($x - (& $ui.GuideInk)) }   # the widest number sits on the edge; shorter ones are right-aligned to it
        & $ui.SetLeft $ui.Opts $x
        # The header row: the chip's box starts on the edge (its yellow is the part a person sees), else the kicker's ink does.
        if ($ui.Chip.Visible) { & $ui.SetLeft $ui.Chip $x; & $ui.SetLeft $ui.Kick 0 } else { & $ui.SetLeft $ui.Kick ($x - (& $ui.Ink $ui.Kick)) } } catch { $null = $_ } }
    # The x of a control inside one of its parents (the sum of the lefts on the way up). Takes the control and the parent;
    # gives back the pixels.
    $ui.LeftIn = { param($C, $P) $x = 0; $c = $C; while ($c -and -not [object]::ReferenceEquals($c, $P)) { $x += [int]$c.Left; $c = $c.Parent }; $x }
    # The step bar's own top margin, scaled ($ui.Z.BarTop at 100 %). Takes nothing; gives back the pixels.
    $ui.BarTop = { & $ui.Sc $ui.Z.BarTop }
    # The height a label has with a text in it. An empty label asks for less (31 against 33 px at 150 %; R32), so a row aligned
    # before its first text was 1.5 px off the bar afterwards. Takes the label; gives back the pixels.
    $ui.LabelH = { param($L) try { if (-not [string]$L.Text) { $ui.Probe.Font = $L.Font; $ui.Probe.Text = '0'; return [int]$ui.Probe.PreferredSize.Height } } catch { $null = $_ }; return [int]$L.PreferredSize.Height }   # no probe: the label's own answer
    # R29b N3: the time in this step and its count sit on the vertical midpoint of the step's bar (the same flow line: each
    # part's top is the line's top plus its top margin). A text taller than the bar's place moves the bar down; that lift is
    # worked out from $ui.BarTop each time, so it never adds up. Takes nothing; changes the top margins of $ui.StepBar,
    # $ui.StepTime and $ui.StepFrac.
    $ui.AlignTick = { try {
        $b0 = [int](& $ui.BarTop)
        $h = [int](& $ui.LabelH $ui.StepTime); $lift = [int][math]::Max(0, [math]::Ceiling($h / 2.0 - ($b0 + [double]$ui.StepBar.Height / 2.0)))   # a text taller than the bar's place: the bar moves down
        $m = $ui.StepBar.Margin; if ($m.Top -ne $b0 + $lift) { $ui.StepBar.Margin = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Padding($m.Left, ($b0 + $lift), $m.Right, $m.Bottom) }
        $bm = [double]$ui.StepBar.Margin.Top + [double]$ui.StepBar.Height / 2.0
        foreach ($l in @($ui.StepTime, $ui.StepFrac)) { $hl = [int](& $ui.LabelH $l); $t = [int][math]::Max(0, [math]::Round($bm - $hl / 2.0, [System.MidpointRounding]::AwayFromZero)); $m = $l.Margin
          if ($m.Top -ne $t) { $l.Margin = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Padding($m.Left, $t, $m.Right, $m.Bottom) } } } catch { $null = $_ } }   # no bar yet: the next fit aligns the row
    $ui.FitBar = {
      <#
      .SYNOPSIS
      Sizes the Run card's parts for the card's width (Cards v2): the bar of the whole run and the step lists as wide as the
      card's text; in the running step's row the name with RUNNING at the right end, the summary and the now-doing line
      wrapped to the row, and the step bar as wide as the room beside the time and the count (R47: it starts where the name does).
      .OUTPUTS
      Nothing. Changes widths, wrap widths and margins; a size that cannot be read waits for the next fit.
      #>
      try { $cw = [int]$ui.ContentW; if ($cw -le 0) { return }; $pad = & $ui.Sc $ui.Z.G2; $in = $cw - 2 * $pad
        $ui.RunBar.Width = $cw; foreach ($r in @($ui.RunA, $ui.RunB)) { $r.Width = $cw; & $ui.SizeRuns $r }
        foreach ($r in @($ui.RunRow, $ui.Todo)) { $r.MinimumSize = New-Object System.Drawing.Size($cw, 0); $r.MaximumSize = New-Object System.Drawing.Size($cw, 0) }
        $ww = [int]$ui.RunWord.PreferredSize.Width; & $ui.SetWrap $ui.StepName ($in - $ww - (& $ui.Sc $ui.Z.G3)); & $ui.SetWrap $ui.StepSum $in; & $ui.SetWrap $ui.Now $in; & $ui.SetWrap $ui.TodoT ($cw - 2 * (& $ui.Sc $ui.Z.G3))
        $m = $ui.StepName.Margin; $gr = [int][math]::Max(0, $in - [int]$ui.StepName.Width - $ww); if ($m.Right -ne $gr) { $ui.StepName.Margin = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Padding(0, $m.Top, $gr, $m.Bottom) }   # RUNNING at the right end
        $ui.StepRow.MaximumSize = New-Object System.Drawing.Size($in, 0); $bm = $ui.StepBar.Margin
        $w = $in - $bm.Left - $bm.Right - [int]$ui.StepTime.Width - [int]$ui.StepFrac.Width - $ui.StepFrac.Margin.Left - (& $ui.Sc 2)   # the time and the count keep one size ($ui.FixW): the bar keeps its width
        $w = [int][math]::Max((& $ui.Sc 60), $w); if ($ui.StepBar.Width -ne $w) { $ui.StepBar.Width = $w } } catch { $null = $_ } }   # no measure yet: the next fit sets it
    # Centers a row of controls up and down by changing their top and bottom margins. Takes the controls and the top margin
    # of the row; gives back nothing.
    $ui.AlignRow = { param($Parts, [int]$Base)
      try { $hs = @($Parts | ForEach-Object { if ($_.AutoSize) { [int]$_.PreferredSize.Height } else { [int]$_.Height } }); $hh = [int]($hs | Measure-Object -Maximum).Maximum
        for ($i = 0; $i -lt $Parts.Count; $i++) { $m = $Parts[$i].Margin; $t = $Base + [int][math]::Floor(($hh - $hs[$i]) / 2); $b = $Base + $hh - $hs[$i] - ($t - $Base)
          if ($m.Top -ne $t -or $m.Bottom -ne $b) { $Parts[$i].Margin = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Padding($m.Left, $t, $m.Right, $b) } } } catch { $null = $_ } }
    # Returns the controls of one aligned row (Top, FieldRow, ...). Takes the row name.
    $ui.RowParts = { param([string]$Row) switch ($Row) { 'Head' { @(@($ui.Chip, $ui.Kick) | Where-Object { $_.Visible }) } 'FieldRow' { @($ui.FieldL, $ui.FieldBox) + @($(if ($ui.FieldBOn) { $ui.FieldB })) } 'TestRow' { @($ui.TestL, $ui.ToBoxF, $ui.DraftB, $ui.OkBox) } } }
    # Lines up every fixed row: box heights, the text box in its frame, then each row on one center line.
    $ui.AlignRows = { try { $bh = [int]$ui.FieldB.Height; if ($bh -gt 0) { foreach ($p in $ui.Boxes) { if ($p.Height -ne $bh) { $p.Height = $bh } } } } catch { $null = $_ }   # a box is as tall as the compact button, measured
      foreach ($p in $ui.Boxes) { & $ui.BoxFit $p }   # the text box fills its frame (R24 job: a frame whose size never changed kept a 100 px text box at its top)
      & $ui.AlignRow (& $ui.RowParts 'Head') 0   # the chip and the line in capitals on one midpoint
      $mm = & $ui.Sc $ui.Z.M; & $ui.AlignRow (& $ui.RowParts 'TestRow') $mm; & $ui.AlignTick
      # L3 (the Administrator, 2026-11-19): a label above its box (a text answer). The box is on the next line, on the card's edge, 4 px under the label.
      if ($ui.FieldAbove) { $ui.FieldL.Margin = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Padding($ui.FieldL.Margin.Left, $mm, 0, 0); $ui.FieldBox.Margin = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Padding([int]$ui.EdgeX, (& $ui.Sc $ui.Z.G1), $mm, $mm) }
      else { $bx = $ui.FieldBox.Margin; $g2 = & $ui.Sc $ui.Z.G2; if ($bx.Left -ne $g2) { $ui.FieldBox.Margin = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Padding($g2, $bx.Top, $mm, $bx.Bottom) }; & $ui.AlignRow (& $ui.RowParts 'FieldRow') $mm } }
    # The question headline (the prompt's first sentence, manifest "answers") shrinks to fit one line: from the headline size
    # in 0.5 pt steps to 60 % of it (never under the body size); only at that size does it wrap. Other cards keep the headline size.
    $ui.SentFonts = @{}
    # Every text the window puts into a wrapping label of the card: a word wider than the line is broken (M3 review). A
    # label's text set elsewhere since the last break (for example a note) is taken as its new text.
    $ui.Raw = @{}
    # Re-breaks the long words of every card text so each line fits its width. Takes nothing; changes the label texts (the
    # raw text is kept in $ui.Raw).
    $ui.BreakAll = { foreach ($l in @($ui.Kick, $ui.P[0], $ui.P[1], $ui.P[2], $ui.P[3], $ui.PathT, $ui.StepName, $ui.Note, $ui.Help, $ui.Foot, $ui.Close)) {
        try { $w = [int](& $ui.GetWrap $l); if ($w -le 0 -or -not $l.Text) { continue }
          $e = $ui.Raw[$l]; $raw = $(if ($e -and [string]$l.Text -ceq [string]$e.Out) { [string]$e.Raw } else { [string]$l.Text })
          $b = & $ui.BreakLong $raw $l.Font $w; $ui.Raw[$l] = @{ Raw = $raw; Out = $b }; if ([string]$l.Text -cne $b) { $l.Text = $b } } catch { $null = $_ } }
      & $ui.CutNow }   # the now-doing line is cut again from its whole text at the new width (review of PR 121)
    # Fits the headline: on an answer card the font shrinks, not below the body size, until the text fits one line; then it
    # breaks long words and calls $ui.BreakAll. Takes nothing; changes $ui.Sent.
    $ui.FitSent = { try {
        $f = $ui.F.Sent; $w = [int](& $ui.GetWrap $ui.Sent); $t = [string]$ui.SentRaw
        if ($ui.View -eq 'answer') { $pt = [double]$ui.F.Sent.SizeInPoints / $ui.FontK; $floor = [math]::Max($pt * 0.6, [double]$ui.F.Body.SizeInPoints / $ui.FontK)
          while ($w -gt 0 -and $pt -gt $floor -and [System.Windows.Forms.TextRenderer]::MeasureText($t, $f).Width -gt $w) {
            $pt = [math]::Max($floor, $pt - 0.5); $k = [string]$pt; if (-not $ui.SentFonts.ContainsKey($k)) { $ui.SentFonts[$k] = & $ui.Font ([string]$ui.F.Sent.Name) $pt $null }; $f = $ui.SentFonts[$k] }
        }
        if (-not [object]::ReferenceEquals($ui.Sent.Font, $f)) { $ui.Sent.Font = $f }
        $b = & $ui.BreakLong $t $f $w; if ($ui.Sent.Text -ne $b) { $ui.Sent.Text = $b } } catch { $null = $_ }
      & $ui.BreakAll }
    $ui.FitRow = {
      # The box of a box row takes the width that is left beside its label and its button (at most 420). A box under its
      # label (L3) is as wide as the card's text: from the card's edge to the end of the text column.
      try { $cw = $ui.ContentW
        if ($ui.FieldAbove) { $ui.FieldBox.Width = [math]::Max((& $ui.Sc 160), ($cw - (& $ui.Sc 10))); return }
        $left = $cw - $ui.FieldL.PreferredSize.Width - (& $ui.Sc 20)
        if ($ui.FieldBOn) { $left -= ($ui.FieldB.Width + (& $ui.Sc 8)) }
        $ui.FieldBox.Width = [math]::Max((& $ui.Sc 160), [math]::Min((& $ui.Sc $ui.Z.FieldM), [int]$left)) } catch { $null = $_ } }
    $ui.Apart = {
      # UI standard v1 (B3, the Administrator, 2026-11-20): the primary button is the last one and stands alone at the right
      # end of the action row ("Back (Esc)" at the left end, the others after it), 24 px at least after the others (Cards v2).
      # When the row is too narrow for that, the primary button starts its own row. A narrow window stacks them ($ui.StackBtns).
      try { $mm = & $ui.Sc $ui.Z.M; $n = -1; $prev = -1; $used = 0
        for ($k = 0; $k -lt $ui.NB; $k++) { $ui.BtnRow.SetFlowBreak($ui.B[$k], $false); $ui.B[$k].Margin = (& $ui.Pad $mm $mm $mm $mm); if ($ui.BOn[$k] -and $ui.BMain[$k]) { $n = $k } }   # every button: a hidden one keeps no old margin
        $bt = $mm + $(if (@($ui.BOn | Where-Object { $_ }).Count) { [int][math]::Floor(((& $ui.Sc $ui.Z.ActionH) - $ui.BackB.Height) / 2) } else { 0 })   # Back (Esc) on the midpoint of the 40 px buttons
        $ui.BackB.Margin = (& $ui.Pad $mm $bt $mm $mm); $ui.BtnRow.SetFlowBreak($ui.BackB, $false)
        & $ui.BtnOrder ([bool]$ui.Narrow) $n; if ($ui.Narrow) { & $ui.StackBtns $n; return }
        foreach ($b in @(@($ui.B) + @($ui.BackB))) { if ($ui.Wide[$b]) { $ui.Wide.Remove($b); & $ui.FitBtn $b } }   # a row: each button at the size its text needs   # D4: under about 700 px, a stack at the right edge
        if ($n -lt 0) { try { $ui.BtnRow.PerformLayout() } catch { $null = $_ }; return }   # no layout yet: the card's layout does it
        if ($ui.BackOn) { $prev = -2; $used += $ui.BackB.Width + 2 * $mm }   # a flag, not .Visible: the row can still be hidden from the card before
        for ($k = 0; $k -lt $n; $k++) { if ($ui.BOn[$k]) { $prev = $k; $used += $ui.B[$k].Width + 2 * $mm } }
        if ($prev -eq -1) { $used = 0 }
        $room = $(if ($ui.BtnRow.MaximumSize.Width -gt 0) { [int]$ui.BtnRow.MaximumSize.Width } else { $ui.ContentW + 2 * $mm }) - (& $ui.Sc 2)   # the width the row really wraps at, 2 px slack
        $left = $room - $used - $ui.B[$n].Width - $mm
        if ($left -lt (& $ui.Sc $ui.Z.G6)) { if ($prev -ge 0) { $ui.BtnRow.SetFlowBreak($ui.B[$prev], $true) } elseif ($prev -eq -2) { $ui.BtnRow.SetFlowBreak($ui.BackB, $true) }; $left = $room - $ui.B[$n].Width - $mm }   # too narrow: its own row
        $ui.B[$n].Margin = (& $ui.Pad ([int][math]::Max($mm, $left)) $mm $mm $mm); $ui.BtnRow.PerformLayout()
        $f = $(if ($ui.BackOn) { $ui.BackB } else { @(for ($k = 0; $k -lt $n; $k++) { if ($ui.BOn[$k]) { $ui.B[$k] } })[0] })   # the row still wrapped: the primary at the right end of its own row
        if ($f -and -not [object]::ReferenceEquals($f, $ui.B[$n]) -and $ui.B[$n].Top -gt $f.Top + $f.Height) { $ui.B[$n].Margin = (& $ui.Pad ([int][math]::Max($mm, $room - $ui.B[$n].Width - $mm)) $mm $mm $mm) }
        $ui.BtnRow.PerformLayout()   # the row's height is right before the frame is placed ($ui.Squeeze)
      } catch { $null = $_ } }
    # The order of the action row's buttons (D4, the PFM, 2026-11-27): in a row Back first and the primary last; in the stack
    # of a narrow window the primary first and Back last. Tab follows the order. Takes whether it is the stack and the index
    # of the primary (-1: none); a host that cannot reorder keeps the row order.
    $ui.BtnOrder = { param([bool]$Stack, [int]$N) try { $all = @($ui.B | ForEach-Object { $_ })
        $o = $(if ($Stack -and $N -ge 0) { @($ui.B[$N]) + @($all | Where-Object { -not [object]::ReferenceEquals($_, $ui.B[$N]) }) + @($ui.BackB) } elseif ($Stack) { $all + @($ui.BackB) } else { @($ui.BackB) + $all })
        for ($i = 0; $i -lt $o.Count; $i++) { $ui.BtnRow.Controls.SetChildIndex($o[$i], $i); $o[$i].TabIndex = $i } } catch { $null = $_ } }   # the stand-ins cannot reorder: the row keeps its order
    # Stacks the action row at the right edge of the card's text (D4; Cards v2): each button 240 px wide, one under the
    # other, the primary on top and 16 px under it the others, 8 apart. Takes the index of the primary (-1: none).
    $ui.StackBtns = { param([int]$N) $mm = & $ui.Sc $ui.Z.M; foreach ($b in @(@($ui.B) + @($ui.BackB))) { $ui.Wide[$b] = $true; & $ui.FitBtn $b } $room = $(if ($ui.BtnRow.MaximumSize.Width -gt 0) { [int]$ui.BtnRow.MaximumSize.Width } else { $ui.ContentW + 2 * $mm }) - (& $ui.Sc 2)
      foreach ($b in @(@($ui.B) + @($ui.BackB))) { $x = [int][math]::Max($mm, $room - $b.Width - $mm); $low = $(if ($N -ge 0 -and [object]::ReferenceEquals($b, $ui.B[$N])) { (& $ui.Sc $ui.Z.G4) - $mm } else { $mm })
        $b.Margin = (& $ui.Pad $x $mm $mm $low); try { $ui.BtnRow.SetFlowBreak($b, $true) } catch { $null = $_ } }   # the stand-ins have no flow breaks
      try { $ui.BtnRow.PerformLayout() } catch { $null = $_ } }   # no layout yet: the card's layout does it
    # Places the card frame (L1) and lets the card's text scroll when the card is taller than the window (the help below).
    $ui.Squeeze = {
      <#
      .SYNOPSIS
      Places the card frame (L1) and lets the card's text scroll when the card is taller than the window, so the buttons stay in view.
      .DESCRIPTION
      The frame's top is fixed for a window size; a card too tall for the room under it moves up before it scrolls. A short
      card gets a gap above its buttons, so the frame is its minimum height.
      .OUTPUTS
      Nothing. Sets the card's top row, the size of $ui.Scroll and $ui.Gap, $ui.Scrolls and $ui.Frame (what the self-check compares).
      #>
      if (-not $ui.Scaled) { return }
      if ($ui.InSqueeze) { return }; $ui.InSqueeze = $true
      try { $bh = [int]$ui.Body.Height; $bw = [int]$ui.Body.Width; $H = [int]$ui.Card.ClientSize.Height; $hh = [int]$ui.Head.Height; $th = [int]$ui.Tail.Height
        $min = [math]::Min((& $ui.Sc $ui.Layout.FrameMin), $H); $want = [int][math]::Floor(($H - $min) * 0.4); $top = $want
        $need = $hh + $bh + $th; if ($need -gt $H - $top) { $top = [math]::Max(0, $H - $need) }   # a tall card moves up before it gets a scroll bar
        $avail = $H - $top - $hh - $th; $sh = $bh; $bar = 0
        if ($bh -gt $avail) { $sh = [math]::Max((& $ui.Sc 80), $avail); $bar = [System.Windows.Forms.SystemInformation]::VerticalScrollBarWidth + (& $ui.Sc 4) }
        $ui.Scrolls = [bool]$bar; $gap = $(if ($ui.Narrow) { 0 } else { [math]::Max(0, $min - $hh - $sh - $th) })   # D4: in a narrow window the buttons stand right under the text
        $ui.Frame = @{ WantTop = $want; MinH = $(if ($ui.Narrow) { 0 } else { $min }); Moved = ($top -ne $want) }
        if ($ui.Scroll.Width -ne ($bw + $bar) -or $ui.Scroll.Height -ne $sh) { $ui.Scroll.Size = New-Object System.Drawing.Size(($bw + $bar), $sh) }
        if ($ui.Gap.Height -ne $gap) { $ui.Gap.Height = $gap }; if ($ui.Gap.Visible -ne [bool]$gap) { $ui.Gap.Visible = [bool]$gap }
        try { if ([int]$ui.CardRows[0].Height -ne $top) { $ui.CardRows[0].Height = $top } } catch { $null = $_ }   # stand-in types: no row styles
      } catch { $null = $_ } finally { $ui.InSqueeze = $false } }   # a size that cannot be read: the next fit places the frame
    $ui.Body.Add_SizeChanged({ & $ui.Squeeze }); $ui.Tail.Add_SizeChanged({ & $ui.Squeeze }); $ui.Head.Add_SizeChanged({ & $ui.Squeeze })
    $ui.Card.Add_SizeChanged({ try { & $ui.Fit } catch { $null = $_ } })
    # Counts how many lines a text takes at a width, at least 1 and at most a limit (0 for no text). Takes the text, font,
    # width, one line's height and the limit; gives back the number.
    $ui.Rows = { param([string]$Text, $Font, [int]$W, [int]$LineH, [int]$Most) if (-not $Text) { return 0 }; [math]::Min($Most, [math]::Max(1, [int][math]::Round((& $ui.Meas $Text $Font $W).Height / [math]::Max(1, $LineH)))) }
    $ui.OptPlan = { param($o, [int]$w)
      # Where the parts of one choice go, and how tall it is. The name gets its width first. The two facts stay on the
      # right when the name and they fit on one line and the summary needs 2 lines or fewer beside them; else they go on one
      # line under the summary, also when they leave the summary less than 60 % of the row. The summary wraps to 4 lines, the notice to 3 (engine-v47, the PFM, 2026-11-26: the summary was cut at full
      # and at half width; 2 lines before), a blocked application's reason and its "What to do" to 2 lines each; then "...".
      $pad = & $ui.Sc 16; $x = $pad + (& $ui.Sc 38); $inner = $w - $x - $pad; $gap = & $ui.Sc 12
      $h1 = [System.Windows.Forms.TextRenderer]::MeasureText('Ag', $ui.F.Body).Height; $h2 = [System.Windows.Forms.TextRenderer]::MeasureText('Ag', $ui.F.Small).Height
      $vw = 0; if ($o.Ver) { $vw = [System.Windows.Forms.TextRenderer]::MeasureText([string]$o.Ver, $ui.F.Small).Width }
      $nw = [System.Windows.Forms.TextRenderer]::MeasureText([string]$o.Name, $ui.F.Body).Width
      $rw = 0; foreach ($r in @($o.R1, $o.R2)) { if ($r) { $rw = [math]::Max($rw, [System.Windows.Forms.TextRenderer]::MeasureText([string]$r, $ui.F.SmallB).Width) } }
      $under = [bool]($rw -and -not $o.Off -and ($nw + $vw + $gap + $rw) -gt $inner)
      $tw = $inner; if ($rw -and -not $under) { $tw = $inner - $rw - $gap }
      # Inline rows (engine-v47, the Maintenance card, mock option A): the name in a column as wide as the widest name of the
      # list ($o.Names), the text beside it (2 lines at most), the fact on the right, so 5 rows fit without a scroll
      # (Windows job of PR 209: the card scrolled at 1020 x 616 with rows of the Choose height). Too narrow: the Choose layout.
      if ($o.Inline -and $rw) { foreach ($fc in @($o.Facts)) { if ($fc) { $rw = [math]::Max($rw, [System.Windows.Forms.TextRenderer]::MeasureText([string]$fc, $ui.F.SmallB).Width) } }   # the list's widest fact: one layout for all rows
        $nc = $gap; foreach ($nm in @($o.Names)) { $nc = [math]::Max($nc, [System.Windows.Forms.TextRenderer]::MeasureText([string]$nm, $ui.F.Body).Width + $gap) }
        $sw = $inner - $rw - $gap - $nc
        $fits = ($sw -ge (& $ui.Sc 120)); if ($fits) { foreach ($sb in @($o.Subs)) { if ($sb -and (& $ui.Rows ([string]$sb) $ui.F.Small $sw $h2 3) -gt 2) { $fits = $false; break } } }   # every text of the list in 2 lines, else the whole list takes the Choose layout (review of PR 209: a long app name or version)
        if ($fits) { $sl = & $ui.Rows ([string]$o.Sub) $ui.F.Small $sw $h2 2; $ni = [math]::Max($h1, $sl * $h2); $hi = [math]::Max((& $ui.Sc 40), ($ni + (& $ui.Sc 16)))
          return @{ Inline = $true; H = [int]$hi; Pad = $pad; X = $x; Tw = [int]($inner - $rw - $gap); Rw = $rw; Under = $false; S1 = $sl; S2 = 0; NL = 0; H1 = $h1; H2 = $h2; Vw = 0; Nw = $nw; Nc = [int]$nc; Sw = [int]$sw; Y = 0 } } }
      if ($o.Inline -and $rw) { $under = $true; $tw = $inner }   # the fallback of an inline list: every row puts its fact under its text, which takes the whole width (review of PR 209)
      $sf = $(if ($o.Off) { $ui.F.SmallB } else { $ui.F.Small }); $s1 = & $ui.Rows ([string]$o.Sub) $sf $tw $h2 4
      if ($rw -and -not $under -and -not $o.Off -and -not $o.Inline -and ($s1 -gt 2 -or $tw -lt [int]($inner * 0.6))) { $under = $true; $tw = $inner; $s1 = & $ui.Rows ([string]$o.Sub) $sf $tw $h2 4 }   # the summary takes the whole width when the facts leave it a narrow column (Windows job of PR 209: 2 short lines and a cut notice)
      $s2 = & $ui.Rows ([string]$o.Sub2) $ui.F.Small $tw $h2 2; $nl = & $ui.Rows ([string]$o.Note) $ui.F.SmallB $tw $h2 3
      $need = $h1 + ($s1 + $s2 + $nl + [int]$under) * $h2
      $hh = [math]::Max((& $ui.Sc $(if ($o.Off -and -not ($o.Sub -or $o.Sub2 -or $o.Note)) { 40 } else { 66 })), ($need + (& $ui.Sc 20)))   # a row that is off and has no text under its name: one line
      return @{ H = [int]$hh; Pad = $pad; X = $x; Tw = [int]$tw; Rw = $rw; Under = $under; S1 = $s1; S2 = $s2; NL = $nl; H1 = $h1; H2 = $h2; Vw = $vw; Nw = $nw; Y = [int](($hh - $need) / 2) } }
    $ui.PaintOpt = { param($P, $G)
      # One choice: a key (1 to 9), the name and version, the summary, an optional notice, and two facts. An application
      # that cannot run here is not a button: a red cross, the reason, what to do, and the word FAILED. A Danger row (the
      # one destructive action, Uninstall on the Maintenance card; engine-v47) has a dark red edge, name and right text.
      try {
        $o = $P.Tag; $w = $P.ClientSize.Width; $h = $P.ClientSize.Height; $G.Clear($ui.C.White)
        $pl = & $ui.OptPlan $o $w; $pad = $pl.Pad; $x = $pl.X; $y = $pl.Y; $h1 = $pl.H1; $h2 = $pl.H2; $tw = $pl.Tw; $rw = $pl.Rw
        $one = 'Left, Top, NoPrefix, SingleLine, EndEllipsis'; $wrap = 'Left, Top, NoPrefix, WordBreak, EndEllipsis, TextBoxControl'
        if ($o.Off) {
          $pn = New-Object System.Drawing.Pen($ui.C.Hair); $G.DrawLine($pn, 0, 0, $w, 0); $pn.Dispose()
          $cp = New-Object System.Drawing.Pen($(if ($o.Soon) { $ui.C.Gray } else { $ui.C.Red }), [single](& $ui.Sc 2)); $d = & $ui.Sc 12; $cx = $pad + (& $ui.Sc 6); $cy = [int](($h - $d) / 2)
          if ($o.Soon) { $G.DrawLine($cp, $cx, ($cy + [int]($d / 2)), ($cx + $d), ($cy + [int]($d / 2))) }   # not built yet: a gray dash, no failure
          else { $G.DrawLine($cp, $cx, $cy, ($cx + $d), ($cy + $d)); $G.DrawLine($cp, ($cx + $d), $cy, $cx, ($cy + $d)) }; $cp.Dispose()
        } else {
          $foc = [bool]$P.Focused; $t = $(if ($foc) { & $ui.Sc 2 } else { 1 })
          $pn = New-Object System.Drawing.Pen($(if ($foc) { $ui.C.Navy } elseif ($o.Danger) { $ui.C.Red } else { $ui.C.Edge }), [single]$t); $i = [int]($t / 2); $G.DrawRectangle($pn, $i, $i, ($w - 1 - 2 * $i), ($h - 1 - 2 * $i)); $pn.Dispose()
          $k = & $ui.Sc 24; $ky = [int](($h - $k) / 2); $kp = New-Object System.Drawing.Pen($ui.C.Edge); $G.DrawRectangle($kp, $pad, $ky, $k, $k); $kp.Dispose()
          & $ui.Word $G ([string]$o.Key) $ui.F.SmallB $ui.C.Gray $pad $ky $k $k 'HorizontalCenter, VerticalCenter, NoPrefix, SingleLine'
        }
        if ($pl.Inline) {   # one line: name, text, fact (the Maintenance card)
          & $ui.Word $G ([string]$o.Name) $ui.F.Body $(if ($o.Off) { $ui.C.Gray } elseif ($o.Danger) { $ui.C.Red } else { $ui.C.Navy }) $x ([int](($h - $h1) / 2)) ($pl.Nc - (& $ui.Sc 4)) $h1 $one
          $sh = $pl.S1 * $h2; & $ui.Word $G ([string]$o.Sub) $ui.F.Small $ui.C.Gray ($x + $pl.Nc) ([int](($h - $sh) / 2)) $pl.Sw $sh $wrap
          & $ui.Word $G ([string]$o.R1) $ui.F.Small $(if ($o.Soon) { $ui.C.Gray } elseif ($o.Off -or $o.Danger) { $ui.C.Red } else { $ui.C.Navy }) ($w - $pad - $rw) ([int](($h - $h2) / 2)) $rw $h2 'Right, Top, NoPrefix, SingleLine'
          return }
        $nw = [math]::Max((& $ui.Sc 40), [math]::Min($pl.Nw, ($tw - $pl.Vw)))   # the name first; the version keeps its place after it
        & $ui.Word $G ([string]$o.Name) $ui.F.Body $(if ($o.Off) { $ui.C.Gray } elseif ($o.Danger) { $ui.C.Red } else { $ui.C.Navy }) $x $y $nw $h1 $one
        if ($o.Ver) { & $ui.Word $G ([string]$o.Ver) $ui.F.Small $ui.C.Gray ($x + $nw) $y ([math]::Max(1, ($tw - $nw))) $h1 $one }
        $yy = $y + $h1
        if ($o.Sub) { & $ui.Word $G ([string]$o.Sub) $(if ($o.Off) { $ui.F.SmallB } else { $ui.F.Small }) $(if ($o.Off -and -not $o.Soon) { $ui.C.Navy } else { $ui.C.Gray }) $x $yy $tw ($pl.S1 * $h2) $wrap; $yy += $pl.S1 * $h2 }
        if ($o.Sub2) { & $ui.Word $G ([string]$o.Sub2) $ui.F.Small $ui.C.Navy $x $yy $tw ($pl.S2 * $h2) $wrap; $yy += $pl.S2 * $h2 }
        if ($pl.Under) { & $ui.Word $G ((@($o.R1, $o.R2) | Where-Object { $_ }) -join $dot) $ui.F.Small $(if ($o.Soon) { $ui.C.Gray } elseif ($o.Danger) { $ui.C.Red } else { $ui.C.Navy }) $x $yy $tw $h2 $one; $yy += $h2 }   # the row's own color: gray when not set up, dark red for Uninstall (review of PR 209)
        if ($o.Note) { & $ui.Word $G ([string]$o.Note) $ui.F.SmallB $ui.C.Navy $x $yy $tw ($pl.NL * $h2) $wrap }
        if ($rw -and -not $pl.Under) {
          $rx = $w - $pad - $rw
          if ($o.R1) { & $ui.Word $G ([string]$o.R1) $(if ($o.Off) { $ui.F.SmallB } else { $ui.F.Small }) $(if ($o.Soon) { $ui.C.Gray } elseif ($o.Off -or $o.Danger) { $ui.C.Red } else { $ui.C.Navy }) $rx ($y + (& $ui.Sc 2)) $rw $h2 'Right, Top, NoPrefix, SingleLine' }
          if ($o.R2) { & $ui.Word $G ([string]$o.R2) $ui.F.Small $ui.C.Gray $rx ($y + $h1) $rw $h2 'Right, Top, NoPrefix, SingleLine' }
        }
      } catch { $null = $_ } }
    # Fills the choice list with one button for each item (the old ones are kept to dispose after the window closes).
    # Takes the list of items (name, version, notes).
    $ui.FillOpts = { param($List)
      $ui.Trash = @($ui.Trash) + @($ui.Opts.Controls); $ui.Opts.Controls.Clear()   # old choices are disposed after the window has closed: a button is never disposed inside its own Click
      $n = 0
      foreach ($o in @($List | Where-Object { $_ })) {
        $said = (@($o.Name, $o.Ver, $o.Sub, $o.Sub2, $o.Note, $o.R1, $o.R2) | Where-Object { $_ }) -join '. '
        if ($o.Off) { $c = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Panel; $c.AccessibleRole = 'StaticText'; $c.AccessibleName = $said }
        else {
          $n++; $o.Key = $n
          $c = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Button; $c.FlatStyle = 'Flat'; $c.FlatAppearance.BorderSize = 0; $c.UseVisualStyleBackColor = $false; $c.Text = ''; $c.AccessibleName = ('Choice ' + $n + ': ' + $said)
          $c.Add_Click({ if ($ui.OnOpt -and -not $ui.Busy -and (& $ui.Settled)) { & $ui.OnOpt ([int]$this.Tag.Index) } }); $c.Add_GotFocus({ $this.Invalidate() }); $c.Add_LostFocus({ $this.Invalidate() })
        }
        $c.Tag = $o; $c.BackColor = $ui.C.White; $c.Margin = (& $ui.Pad 0 0 0 (& $ui.Sc $(if ($o.Inline) { $ui.Z.G1 } else { $ui.Z.G2 })))   # one-line rows (Maintenance) 4 apart: 6 rows fit (Windows job of PR 211)
        $hh = & $ui.Sc $(if ($o.Note -or $o.Sub2) { 86 } else { 66 }); try { $hh = (& $ui.OptPlan $o $ui.ContentW).H } catch { $null = $_ }   # as tall as its lines, 66 at least
        $c.Size = New-Object System.Drawing.Size($ui.ContentW, $hh)
        $c.Add_Paint({ & $ui.PaintOpt $this $_.Graphics })
        [void]$ui.Opts.Controls.Add($c)
      } }
    $ui.Measure = { param([string]$Card)
      # The numbers for RowBad and EdgeBad, from the real layout (screen pixels).
      $out = @(); $sr = { param($C) $C.RectangleToScreen($C.ClientRectangle) }
      foreach ($row in 'Head', 'FieldRow', 'TestRow') {
        $ps = @(& $ui.RowParts $row); if ($ps.Count -lt 2 -or -not $ps[0].Parent.Visible) { continue }   # the parts AlignRow aligns (R5 review: one rule for both)
        $out += & $ui.RowBad $Card $row @($ps | ForEach-Object { $rr = & $sr $_; @{ N = (& $ui.NameOf $_); Top = $rr.Top; H = $rr.Height; Line = $rr.Top - $_.Margin.Top; Kind = $(if ($ui.Boxes -contains $_) { 'box' } elseif ($_ -is [System.Windows.Forms.Button] -and $_.FlatAppearance.BorderSize -gt 0) { 'button' } else { 'other' }) } })
      }
      # R32: the bottom line's link and its text at the right share one midpoint.
      if ($ui.RecB.Visible -and $ui.RightL.Visible -and [string]$ui.RightL.Text) { $out += & $ui.RowBad $Card 'Bottom' @(@($ui.RecB, $ui.RightL) | ForEach-Object { $rr = & $sr $_; @{ N = (& $ui.NameOf $_); Top = $rr.Top; H = $rr.Height; Line = 0; Kind = 'other' } }) }
      # Returns where a control's ink starts (its left edge plus the measured ink offset: text, edge or drawing). Takes the control.
      $tx = { param($C) (& $sr $C).Left + (& $ui.Ink $C) }
      if ($ui.FieldRow.Visible -and $ui.FieldAbove -and -not $ui.RecOn) { $rl = & $sr $ui.FieldL; $rb = & $sr $ui.FieldBox   # L3: the label above its box
        $out += & $ui.AboveBad $Card @{ LabelBottom = $rl.Bottom; BoxTop = $rb.Top; BoxLeft = $rb.Left; BoxW = $rb.Width; Edge = (& $tx $ui.FieldL); TextW = ($ui.ContentW - (& $ui.Sc 10)) } }
      if ($ui.Frame -and -not $ui.RecOn) { $rh = & $sr $ui.Head; $rt = & $sr $ui.Tail; $rc = & $sr $ui.Card   # L1: the header row at the fixed top, the frame at its minimum height at least
        $out += & $ui.FrameBad $Card @{ Top = $rh.Top - $rc.Top; WantTop = $ui.Frame.WantTop; H = $rt.Bottom - $rh.Top; MinH = $ui.Frame.MinH; Moved = $ui.Frame.Moved } }
      if ($ui.StepRow.Visible -and -not $ui.RecOn) { $rb = & $sr $ui.StepBar
        foreach ($l in @($ui.StepTime, $ui.StepFrac)) { $rl = & $sr $l; if (($rl.Top - $l.Margin.Top) -eq ($rb.Top - $ui.StepBar.Margin.Top) -and $rl.Left -gt $rb.Left) { $out += & $ui.TickBad $Card @{ Top = $rb.Top; H = $rb.Height } @{ N = (& $ui.NameOf $l); Top = $rl.Top; H = $rl.Height } } } }
      if (-not $ui.RecOn) {
        $es = @()   # the card column: where each part's ink starts ($tx above)
        if ($ui.Chip.Visible) { $es += @{ N = 'Chip'; X = (& $sr $ui.Chip).Left } } elseif ($ui.Kick.Visible -and $ui.Kick.Text) { $es += @{ N = 'Kick'; X = (& $tx $ui.Kick) } }   # the chip's box is its edge
        if ($ui.TickP.Visible) { $es += @{ N = 'TickP'; X = (& $tx $ui.TickP) } } elseif ($ui.Sent.Visible -and $ui.Sent.Text) { $es += @{ N = 'Sent'; X = (& $tx $ui.Sent) } }
        foreach ($l in @(@($ui.P) + @($ui.PathL, $ui.PathT, $ui.Close, $ui.PctL, $ui.FieldL, $ui.Note, $ui.Help, $ui.Foot, $ui.TestL))) { if ($l.Visible -and $l.Text -and $l.Parent.Visible) { $es += @{ N = (& $ui.NameOf $l); X = (& $tx $l) } } }
        foreach ($b in @($ui.RunBar, $ui.RunA, $ui.RunRow, $ui.RunB, $ui.Todo)) { if ($b.Visible) { $es += @{ N = (& $ui.NameOf $b); X = (& $sr $b).Left } } }   # Cards v2: a list or a box starts on the edge; the texts inside it are indented
        if ($ui.Guide.Visible) { $es += @{ N = 'Guide'; X = (& $sr $ui.Guide).Left + (& $ui.GuideInk) } }   # the widest number of the numbered list
        if ($ui.ErrBox.Visible) { $es += @{ N = 'ErrBox'; X = (& $sr $ui.ErrBox).Left } }
        $k1 = @($ui.LinkRow.Controls | Where-Object { $_.Visible })[0]; if ($k1) { $es += @{ N = (& $ui.NameOf $k1); X = (& $tx $k1); D = ('link ink ' + (& $ui.Ink $k1) + ', width ' + $k1.Width + ', margin ' + $k1.Margin.Left + ', row margin ' + $ui.LinkRow.Margin.Left) } }
        $o1 = @($ui.Opts.Controls | Where-Object { $_.Visible })[0]; if ($o1) { $es += @{ N = 'choice 1'; X = (& $sr $o1).Left } }
        $b1 = @(@($ui.BackB) + @($ui.B | Where-Object { [string]$ui.Kinds[$_] -ne 'primary' }) | Where-Object { $_.Visible })[0]; if ($b1 -and -not $ui.Narrow) { $es += @{ N = (& $ui.NameOf $b1); X = (& $tx $b1) } }   # B3: the primary stands at the right end
        $out += & $ui.EdgeBad $Card $es
      }
      return $out }
    $ui.Scale = {
      # The scaling facts, numbers only (R24: the screen dpi said 100 % while every size was 1.5 x). DeviceDpi exists from .NET 4.7.
      try { $f = $ui.Form; $dd = 'n/a'; try { $pp = $f.GetType().GetProperty('DeviceDpi'); if ($pp) { $dd = [string]$pp.GetValue($f, $null) } } catch { $null = $_ }
        $as = $f.CurrentAutoScaleDimensions; $sn = [System.Windows.Forms.Screen]::FromControl($f)
        # The process dpi awareness, read from Windows Forms itself (its internal DpiHelper, .NET 4.7+); no native call: that
        # would need C# compiled on the work computer. PerMonitorV2 with dpiX 96 and autoScale 144 is the R24 case.
