        $aw = 'n/a'; try { $dh = $f.GetType().Assembly.GetType('System.Windows.Forms.DpiHelper'); if ($dh) { $bf = [System.Reflection.BindingFlags]'NonPublic, Public, Static'; $pm = $dh.GetProperty('IsPerMonitorV2Awareness', $bf)
            if ($pm) { $aw = $(if ([bool]$pm.GetValue($null, $null)) { 'PerMonitorV2' } else { 'not-PerMonitorV2' }) } } } catch { $null = $_ }
        $sd = $f.AutoScaleDimensions; $rd = 'n/a'; try { if ($script:native -and $f.IsHandleCreated) { $rd = [string][Rade.Native]::GetDpiForWindow($f.Handle) } } catch { $null = $_ }
        $lg = $(if ($ui.Logo) { [string]$ui.Logo.Width + 'x' + $ui.Logo.Height } else { 'n/a' }); $b1 = @($ui.B | Where-Object { $_.Visible })[0]; $bt = $(if ($b1) { [string]$b1.Width + 'x' + $b1.Height } else { 'n/a' })
        $l = ('SCALE dpiX=' + [int]$ui.ScreenDpi + ' deviceDpi=' + $dd + ' mode=' + [string]$f.AutoScaleMode + ' asd=' + [int]$sd.Width + 'x' + [int]$sd.Height + ' autoScale=' + [int]$as.Width + 'x' + [int]$as.Height + ' font=' + [int]$f.Font.Height + ' fontPt=' + $f.Font.SizeInPoints + ' fontScale=' + $ui.FontK + ' ctlScale=' + [math]::Round($ui.Dpi / 96.0, 2) + ' realDpi=' + $rd + ' aware=' + $aw + ' screen=' + $sn.Bounds.Width + 'x' + $sn.Bounds.Height +
          ' work=' + $sn.WorkingArea.Width + 'x' + $sn.WorkingArea.Height + ' client=' + $f.ClientSize.Width + 'x' + $f.ClientSize.Height + ' state=' + [string]$f.WindowState + ' logo=' + $lg + ' btn=' + $bt + ' shown=' + $(if ($ui.ShownAt) { $ui.ShownAt } else { 'n/a' }) + ' placed=' + $ui.Placed + ' lastClose=' + $(if ($ui.LastClose) { $ui.LastClose } else { 'n/a' }))
        $sy = 'n/a'; try { $sy = [string][Rade.Dpi]::GetDpiForSystem() } catch { $null = $_ }   # no Rade.Dpi (not Windows, before 1607): n/a
        return ($l + ' thread=' + $script:dpiThread + ' sysDpi=' + $sy)   # R34: the window thread's dpi awareness (01-setup.ps1) and the system dpi
      } catch { return ('SCALE could not be read: ' + (ConvertTo-Masked ([string]$_.Exception.Message))) } }
    $ui.ScaleKeep = 20   # the SCALE lines rade-window-scale.txt keeps (E4)
    # E4 (R42 plan; the Administrator, 2026-11-21): each RADE window writes its SCALE line, with the time, its own host name and
    # its own process name (no other process is read), to RADE\Config\rade-window-scale.txt when it is shown, so a round's
    # results hold the line of every RADE window, also one opened from the RADE shortcut in another process. The file keeps
    # the last $ui.ScaleKeep lines. Numbers and names of programs only: no path, user or site. A failure is ignored. Takes nothing.
    $ui.LogScale = {
      try { $p = Get-RadeConfigFile 'rade-window-scale.txt'; $d = Split-Path -Parent $p
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $d -PathType Container)) { [void](New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $d -Force) }
        $exe = 'n/a'; try { $exe = [System.Diagnostics.Process]::GetCurrentProcess().ProcessName } catch { $null = $_ }   # no name: the line says n/a
        $line = (Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss') + ' host=' + ([string]$Host.Name -replace '\s', '') + ' exe=' + $exe + ' rade=' + [string]$env:RADE_HOST + ' taskbar=' + [string]$script:taskbarId + ' build=' + $buildId + ' ' + (& $ui.Scale)   # engine-v46: the start (child, shortcut) and the taskbar identity of this window
        $old = @(); if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p -PathType Leaf) { $old = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $p | Where-Object { $_ }) }
        Write-FileWhole $p ((@(@($old) + @($line)) | Select-Object -Last $ui.ScaleKeep) -join "`r`n") } catch { $null = $_ } }   # not written: the round has no line of this window
    # The SCALE lines of the RADE windows shown since this window opened ($ui.OpenedAt), this one included, for the round's
    # results (E4). Takes nothing; gives back the lines (none when the file cannot be read).
    $ui.ScaleLines = {
      try { $p = Get-RadeConfigFile 'rade-window-scale.txt'; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p -PathType Leaf)) { return @() }
        $since = $ui.OpenedAt.ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss')
        return @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $p | Where-Object { $_ -match '^(\d{4}-\d\d-\d\dT\d\d:\d\d:\d\d) ' -and [string]::CompareOrdinal($Matches[1], $since) -ge 0 } | ForEach-Object { 'WINDOW ' + $_ }) } catch { return @() } }
    # Gives the result of the layout self-check: its pass line, or the defects found, with the window size and scale. Takes
    # nothing; gives back the text.
    $ui.LayLine = {
      & $ui.Check
      $pct = [int][math]::Round($ui.Dpi / 96.0 * 100); $sp = [int][math]::Round($ui.ScreenDpi / 96.0 * 100)   # the form's scale (the one source); the screen dpi beside it when it differs
      $size = [string]$ui.Form.ClientSize.Width + ' x ' + $ui.Form.ClientSize.Height + ' at ' + [string]$pct + ' %' + $(if ($sp -ne $pct) { ' (the form auto-scale; the screen dpi says ' + $sp + ' %)' } else { '' })
      $sc = $(if ($ui.LayScroll.Count) { '; the text scrolls on: ' + ((@($ui.LayScroll.Keys) | Sort-Object) -join ', ') } else { '' })
      if ($ui.LayBad.Count) { return ('Layout self-check: ' + $ui.LayBad.Count + ' defects in ' + $ui.LayCards.Count + ' cards (' + $size + ')' + $sc + "`r`n" + (& $ui.Scale) + "`r`n" + (@($ui.LayBad) -join "`r`n")) }
      return ('Layout self-check: PASS layout, ' + $ui.LayCards.Count + ' cards (' + $size + ')' + $sc + "`r`n" + (& $ui.Scale)) }
    # Sets a label's text and shows it only when the text is not empty. Takes the label and the text; gives back nothing.
    $ui.Show = { param($C, [string]$Text) $C.Text = $Text; $C.Visible = [bool]$Text }
    # A script whose hash does not match its own hash line (the Administrator, 2026-11-19; docs/specs/bundle-hash.md R3): on the
    # boot, choose and ready cards the last line says so in dark red, in place of the card's own last line, with the full
    # "Script check:" line under it (E1, R42 plan, the Owner, 2026-11-21: the values to compare, before Run). The Ready card
    # (the card with Run) always shows the full "Script check:" line under its own last line: checked, does not match, or not
    # available. A match and a hash that cannot be read show nothing on the boot and choose cards. Takes the card; changes the
    # color and text of $ui.Foot.
    $ui.ScriptWarn = { param($c)
      $bad = [bool]($script:scriptCheck.Short -and -not $script:scriptCheck.Ok); $line = [string]$script:scriptCheck.Line
      if ($bad -and [string]$c.View -in 'boot', 'choose', 'ready') { & $ui.Show $ui.Foot ('This script does not match its hash. Do not run it.' + $(if ($line) { "`r`n" + $line } else { '' })); $ui.Foot.ForeColor = $ui.C.Red }
      else { $ui.Foot.ForeColor = $ui.C.Gray
        if ([string]$c.View -eq 'ready' -and $line) { & $ui.Show $ui.Foot (@(@([string]$c.Foot, $line) | Where-Object { $_ }) -join "`r`n") } } }
    # Sets what each card text box with changing values can show on the card that comes ($ui.Range): the card's Range names
    # them (Kick, P0, StepName: lists of texts); a part the card does not name has no range. Takes the card's Range (or $null).
    $ui.SetRange = { param($R) foreach ($k in 'Kick', 'P0', 'StepName') { $box = $(if ($k -eq 'P0') { $ui.P[0] } else { $ui[$k] })
        $v = $(if ($R -and $R[$k]) { @($R[$k] | ForEach-Object { [string]$_ }) } else { $null }); if ($v) { $ui.Range[$box] = $v } else { $ui.Range.Remove($box) }; & $ui.Reflow $box } }
    $ui.SetCard = { param($c)
      # Shows one card. $c names the parts: View, Light ('you' = yellow and YOUR TURN, 'bad' = the error color, 'pass' = green), KickColor, Strong, Todo, Range ($ui.SetRange), Kicker, Sentence, Tick, P (up to 4
      # paragraphs), Options + OnOption, Lines (guide lines, in order: numbered ones first, others after them; one selectable text), Path (a file path), StepRow, Field (Label, Text, Name, Button, Do, Max, Above), Err, Links, Note, Help, Close (the hand card's closing line),
      # Buttons (Text, Kind, Do, Apart; up to $ui.NB), Foot, Test, Right, Back, NoAccept, Focus ('field', 'fieldbutton', 'err' or 'text').
      & $ui.Check   # the card that goes away (test rounds only)
      $ui.Hot = $null; $ui.Down = $null   # no hover or pressed state is carried over (R4 review)
      if ($ui.RecOn -and ($c.Light -or $c.View -eq 'done')) { $ui.RecOn = $false; $ui.Rec.Visible = $false; $ui.Card.Visible = $true; $ui.RecB.Visible = $true }   # a card that needs you closes the Record
      $ui.View = [string]$c.View; $ui.Card.SuspendLayout()
      & $ui.Dress $c   # the light line, the stage now, the YOUR TURN chip, the Run card's parts (03-card.ps1)
      & $ui.SetRange $c.Range; $ui.Kick.Text = ([string]$c.Kicker).ToUpperInvariant()   # the line in capitals keeps its line also when empty
      $ui.SentRaw = [string]$c.Sentence; $ui.Sent.Text = $ui.SentRaw; $ui.TickP.Visible = [bool]$c.Tick
      $ps = @($c.P | Where-Object { $_ }); for ($k = 0; $k -lt 4; $k++) { & $ui.Show $ui.P[$k] $(if ($k -lt $ps.Count) { [string]$ps[$k] } else { '' }) }
      $ui.OnOpt = $c.OnOption; & $ui.FillOpts $c.Options; $ui.Opts.Visible = [bool]$ui.Opts.Controls.Count
      & $ui.SetSteps $c.Lines
      $ui.PathL.Visible = [bool]$c.Path; & $ui.Show $ui.PathT ([string]$c.Path)
      $ui.NowRaw = ''; $ui.Now.Text = ''; if ($c.StepRow) { $ui.StepTime.Text = '' }   # the run card keeps the now-doing room, empty until a text comes
      $ui.FieldRow.Visible = [bool]$c.Field; $ui.FieldDo = $null
      $ui.FieldAbove = [bool]($c.Field -and $c.Field.Above); try { $ui.FieldRow.SetFlowBreak($ui.FieldL, $ui.FieldAbove) } catch { $null = $_ }   # L3: the box goes under its label
      if ($c.Field) { $ui.FieldL.Text = [string]$c.Field.Label; $ui.Field.Text = [string]$c.Field.Text; $ui.Field.AccessibleName = [string]$c.Field.Name; $ui.FieldB.Visible = [bool]$c.Field.Button; $ui.FieldBOn = [bool]$c.Field.Button; $ui.FieldB.Text = [string]$c.Field.Button; $ui.FieldDo = $c.Field.Act; $ui.Field.MaxLength = $(if ($c.Field.Max) { [int]$c.Field.Max } else { 32767 }); & $ui.FitRow }
      $ui.ErrRow.Visible = [bool]$c.Err; if ($c.Err) { $ui.ErrBox.Text = '' }
      $ui.LinkRow.Visible = [bool]($c.Links -or $c.PageLink); $ui.CopyPathB.Visible = [bool]$c.Links; $ui.ShowFileB.Visible = [bool]$c.Links; $ui.PageB.Visible = [bool]$c.PageLink
      & $ui.Show $ui.Note ([string]$c.Note); & $ui.Show $ui.Help ([string]$c.Help); & $ui.Show $ui.Foot ([string]$c.Foot); & $ui.Show $ui.Close ([string]$c.Close)
      & $ui.ScriptWarn $c   # the script's hash does not match: a red last line on the boot, Choose and Ready cards
      $bm = & $ui.Sc $(if ($c.Close) { $ui.Z.G2 - $ui.Z.M } else { $ui.Z.G4 - $ui.Z.M }); $bn = $ui.BtnRow.Margin; if ($bn.Top -ne $bm) { $ui.BtnRow.Margin = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Padding($bn.Left, $bm, $bn.Right, $bn.Bottom) }   # 8 under the closing line, else 16
      & $ui.SetButtons $c   # the action row: the primary last with its key, Back, Enter (03-card.ps1)
      $ui.TestRow.Visible = [bool]$c.Test
      $ui.CardNow = $c; $ui.TourB.Visible = ($ui.HelpViews -contains [string]$c.View -and -not $ui.RecOn)   # L6: Help on a card that can be shown again
      $ui.FeedB.Visible = [bool]((& $ui.NoteOn) -and -not $ui.RecOn -and [string]$c.View -notin $ui.NoNoteViews); $ui.RightL.Text = $(if ($c.Right) { [string]$c.Right } else { '' })   # R-top-bar (2026-11-19): no state words; only the percent, the time or a result word
      & $ui.FitSent; & $ui.FitEdges; & $ui.FitBar; & $ui.AlignRows   # the step bar's width for this card's step row before it is drawn (R35 job: the first Run card wrapped the time under the title)
      $ui.Card.ResumeLayout(); try { $ui.Card.PerformLayout() } catch { $null = $_ }
      if ($ui.Guide.Visible) { try { $ui.Guide.Refresh() } catch { $null = $_ }; & $ui.GuideFit; & $ui.FitEdges }   # the rich text box finishes its layout when it paints: paint it (no message pump), then measure its edge again (R28 job: 4 to 13 px off on the first hand card)
      try { $ui.Scroll.AutoScrollPosition = New-Object System.Drawing.Point(0, 0) } catch { $null = $_ }; & $ui.Squeeze   # a new card starts at its top
      $f = $null
      if ($c.Focus -eq 'field') { $f = $ui.Field } elseif ($c.Focus -eq 'fieldbutton') { $f = $ui.FieldB } elseif ($c.Focus -eq 'err') { $f = $ui.ErrBox } elseif ($c.Focus -eq 'text') { $f = $(if ($ui.Guide.Visible) { $ui.Guide } else { $ui.Sent }) }   # a card with no box: the focus on its text, so Enter answers nothing
      elseif ($c.Focus -eq 'button' -and $ui.Accept) { $f = $ui.Accept }   # engine-v47: the Maintenance card, Enter = Start (review of PR 209)
      elseif ($c.Focus -eq 'main') { $f = $(if ($ui.Accept) { $ui.Accept } elseif ($ui.Guide.Visible) { $ui.Guide } else { $ui.Sent }) }   # the hand card: Done, else its text (Enter never falls to Skip or It failed)
      elseif ($ui.Opts.Controls.Count) { foreach ($o in @($ui.Opts.Controls)) { if (-not $o.Tag.Off) { $f = $o; break } } }
      if (-not $f) { $f = $ui.Accept }; if (-not $f) { $f = $ui.First }; if (-not $f) { $f = $ui.RecB }
      if (-not $ui.RecOn) { try { [void]$f.Focus() } catch { $null = $_ } }
      # Focus on the card's own text (a hand step with no address) must not scroll it: Windows scrolls a focused control into
      # view, so the card started scrolled to its end (R35 job: deploy-tour-small 08-noaddress-hand, 11 px). It starts at its top.
      if ([object]::ReferenceEquals($f, $ui.Guide) -or [object]::ReferenceEquals($f, $ui.Sent)) { try { $ui.Scroll.AutoScrollPosition = New-Object System.Drawing.Point(0, 0) } catch { $null = $_ } }   # no scroll position yet: the card is at its top
      # The guard counts from here, when the card is built and the person can see it (M2 review): a click that waited in the
      # queue while the card was built comes in during this DoEvents, inside the guard, and is dropped.
      $ui.CardAt = $ui.Clock.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds
      [System.Windows.Forms.Application]::DoEvents() }
    # Brings the window to the front (restores it when minimized) without keeping it on top.
    $ui.ToFront = { try { if ([string]$ui.Form.WindowState -eq 'Minimized') { $ui.Form.WindowState = 'Normal' }; $ui.Form.TopMost = $true; $ui.Form.Activate(); $ui.Form.TopMost = $false } catch { $null = $_ } }
    # Shows one gray line under the card's box or buttons, or hides it for empty text. Takes the text.
    $ui.Say1 = { param([string]$Text) $ui.Note.Text = $Text; $ui.Note.Visible = [bool]$Text }   # one gray line under the card's box or buttons

    # ==== Engine part: engine/ps/window/06-open.ps1 (sha256 55353da0b520)
    # RADE window part 06, the opening views: boot, Choose (pick an application), the site address card, and the
    # check cards (needs you, failed). Uses the card of 03-card.ps1 and the engine checks.
    # Joined into every bundle by engine/rade_build.py; Windows PowerShell 5.1.

    # ---- When the window opens: the Local checks of every application in the paste run once (base checks before Choose).
    # An application with a FAILED one cannot be chosen. A newer version on the RADE page is read here too (test and deploy).
    $ui.RunBase = {
      $ui.BaseIds = @(); foreach ($a in $apps) { foreach ($id in @($a.Checks)) { $d = Get-CheckDef $id; if ($d -and $d.Group -eq 'Local' -and $d.Kind -eq 'auto' -and $ui.BaseIds -notcontains $id) { $ui.BaseIds += $id } } }
      $cache = Read-CheckCache; $bp = Get-BasePath; $site = Get-SiteUrl $bp; $i = 0; $ui.Busy = $true; $ui.BaseRes = @{}
      try {
        foreach ($id in $ui.BaseIds) {
          if ($ui.Form.IsDisposed -or $script:closing) { return }
          $i++; $d = Get-CheckDef $id; $ui.RightL.Text = 'Check ' + $i + ' of ' + $ui.BaseIds.Count
          $r = Get-CheckToRun $d $cache $bp $site $false
          if (-not $r) { $r = Invoke-Check $d $bp $site { [System.Windows.Forms.Application]::DoEvents() } }
          $ui.BaseRes[$id] = $r; & $ui.RecRefresh   # an open Record shows the new result
        }
        # One read per application (4 s at most each); after one slow read the others are not tried.
        $slow = $false
        for ($j = 0; $j -lt $apps.Count; $j++) {
          if ($slow -or $ui.Newer.ContainsKey($j)) { continue }
          $t0 = Get-Date; $script:app = $apps[$j]; $ui.Newer[$j] = [string](Get-NewerVersion); if (((Get-Date) - $t0).TotalSeconds -gt 3) { $slow = $true }
        }
        if (-not $ui.ContainsKey('NewRound')) { $ui.NewRound = [string](Get-NewerRound) }
      } finally { $ui.Busy = $false; Select-App 0 } }
    $ui.VNoApps = {
      # R28: a paste that lists no application (a manifest or build fault): say so, with what to do, instead of an empty list.
      & $ui.SetCard @{ View = 'noapps'; Light = 'bad'; Kicker = 'Nothing to choose'; Sentence = 'No application is listed in this paste.'
        P = @('This paste has nothing that RADE can install or run.', 'What to do: close this window and copy the paste again from the RADE page. If it is still empty, ask in the Teams channel.'); Help = (Get-HelpLine)
        Buttons = @(@{ Text = 'Close'; Kind = 'primary'; Act = { $ui.Form.Close() } }) } }
    $ui.VBootErr = { param([string]$Why)
      # R28: the checks that run when the window opens stopped with an error: a card, not a blank window.
      & $ui.SetCard @{ View = 'booterr'; Light = 'bad'; Kicker = 'Stopped'; Sentence = 'RADE could not check this computer.'
        P = @($Why, 'Nothing was changed.', 'What to do: select "Try again". If it stops again, ask in the Teams channel.'); Help = (Get-HelpLine)
        Buttons = @(@{ Text = 'Try again'; Kind = 'primary'; Act = { & $ui.Boot } }, @{ Text = 'Close'; Act = { $ui.Form.Close() } }) }
      & $ui.ToFront }
    # engine-v47 (the PFM, 2026-11-26): for an app with application.productName every choice is a version of one product, so a
    # choice reads "<word> <version>" ("Kanon 0.1.0") or, for a round, "<word> <round>" ("Kanon R46"), and the headline asks for
    # the version. Without a productName: the choice's name and its version, as before. Takes the choice; gives @{ Name; Ver }.
    $ui.ChoiceName = { param($A)
      if (-not [string]$appProduct) { return @{ Name = [string]$A.Name; Ver = $(if ($A.Version) { ' ' + $A.Version } else { '' }) } }
      $n = [string]$A.Name; $tail = $(if ([string]$A.Version) { [string]$A.Version } elseif ([string]$appName -and $n.StartsWith([string]$appName + ' ')) { $n.Substring(([string]$appName).Length + 1) } else { [string]$round })
      return @{ Name = ([string]$appProduct + ' ' + $tail); Ver = '' } }   # "90-161.Z R46" gives "Kanon R46"; another name gives the round
    # The Choose headline. Takes whether a choice installs (deploy); gives the sentence.
    $ui.ChooseSentence = { param([bool]$Dep)
      $verb = $(if ($Dep) { 'install' } else { 'run' })
      if ([string]$appProduct) { return ('What version of ' + [string]$appProduct + ' do you want to ' + $verb + '?') }
      return ('Which application do you want to ' + $verb + '?') }
    # Shows the Choose card: one option for each application, off when one of its checks failed. Takes nothing; selects the
    # first application and sets the card.
    $ui.VChoose = {
      if (@($apps).Count -eq 0) { & $ui.VNoApps; return }
      Select-App 0; $ui.Picked = $false; $ui.Plan = $null; $ui.StartAfter = $false; & $ui.SetBand $false; $ui.Form.Text = & $ui.TitleText $null; $list = @(); $dep = $false; $ui.Blocked = @{}; $ui.BlockedFix = @{}
      for ($j = 0; $j -lt $apps.Count; $j++) { foreach ($id in @($apps[$j].Checks)) { $r = $ui.BaseRes[$id]; if ($r -and $r.State -eq 'FAILED') { $ui.Blocked[$j] = ((Get-CheckDef $id).Name + ': ' + $r.Detail); $ui.BlockedFix[$j] = $(if ($r.Fix) { 'What to do: ' + $r.Fix } else { '' }); break } } }
      for ($j = 0; $j -lt $apps.Count; $j++) {
        $a = $apps[$j]; if ([string]$a.Mode -eq 'deploy') { $dep = $true }
        if ($ui.Blocked.ContainsKey($j)) { $nv = & $ui.ChoiceName $a; $list += @{ Off = $true; Index = $j; Name = $nv.Name; Ver = $nv.Ver; Sub = [string]$ui.Blocked[$j]; Sub2 = [string]$ui.BlockedFix[$j]; R1 = 'FAILED' }; continue }
        $f = Get-AppFact $a $ui.Hist; $nv = & $ui.ChoiceName $a
        $list += @{ Index = $j; Name = $nv.Name; Ver = $nv.Ver; Sub = [string]$a.Summary; R1 = $f.Steps; R2 = $f.Installed
          Note = $(if ($ui.Newer[$j]) { 'Version ' + $ui.Newer[$j] + ' is on the RADE page. This paste installs ' + $a.Version + '.' } else { '' }) }
      }
      $nr = [string]$ui.NewRound
      & $ui.SetCard @{ View = 'choose'; Sentence = (& $ui.ChooseSentence $dep)
        P = @($(if ($nr) { 'A newer round, ' + $nr + ', is in the repository. Close this window and run ' + $nr + ' instead.' } else { '' })); Options = $list; OnOption = { param($j) & $ui.Pick $j }
        PageLink = [bool](@($ui.Newer.Values | Where-Object { $_ }).Count)
        Buttons = @($(if ($ui.Blocked.Count) { @{ Text = 'Check this computer again'; Kind = 'primary'; Act = { & $ui.Boot } } } else { $null }))   # no "Remove RADE" (engine-v48; the PFM, 2026-11-26): the last app's Uninstall clears RADE's shared folder
        Foot = $(if ($dep) { '' } else { Get-LastRoundText $ui.Hist }) } }
    # Shows "Checking this computer", runs the base checks and then shows Choose; shows the error card when they stop. Takes
    # nothing.
    $ui.Boot = {
      & $ui.SetBand $false   # the band from the first card: RADE's (or the app's, for an app with productName and a logo)
      & $ui.SetCard @{ View = 'boot'; Sentence = 'Checking this computer.'; P = @('This takes a few seconds. Nothing is changed.') }
      try { & $ui.RunBase } catch { if (-not ($ui.Form.IsDisposed -or $script:closing)) { & $ui.VBootErr (ConvertTo-Masked ([string]$_.Exception.Message)) }; return }
      if ($ui.Form.IsDisposed -or $script:closing) { return }
      if (Test-TourSeen) { & $ui.VChoose } else { $ui.TourFrom = $null; & $ui.VTour 0 } }   # L6: the tour comes one time, before the first Choose
    # L6 (the Administrator, 2026-11-19): the RADE tour, 5 cards: what RADE does, your turn and RADE's turn, what Done,
    # It failed and Skip mean, where the results go, and the Record. Shown one time for a Windows profile, before the first
    # Choose (RADE\Config\rade-tour.txt), and again from "Help (F1)". S = the headline of a card, P = its paragraphs.
    $ui.TourCards = @(
      @{ S = 'RADE installs and tests applications on this computer.'; P = @('You choose an application. RADE checks this computer, then does the work as a list of steps.', 'A test of an application is called a round.') },
      @{ S = 'RADE does most steps. Some steps are yours.'; P = @('When RADE does a step, the card shows its progress. Keep the window open.', 'A yellow line at the top: RADE waits for you. The card says what to do.') },
      @{ S = 'A step that you do has up to three answers.'; P = @('"Done": you did the step and it worked.', '"It failed": the step did not work. RADE then asks what the error said.', '"Skip": you did not do the step. A card shows only the answers that fit its step.') },
      @{ S = 'The results stay on this computer.'; P = @('RADE writes a report into its results folder. RADE sends nothing.', 'After a test round RADE makes an e-mail draft with the results. You read it, and you send it.') },
      @{ S = 'Details shows everything.'; P = @('Select "Details" or press F2 to see all checks, steps, files and the log.', 'Select "Help" or press F1 to see this tour again.') })
    # The cards that "Help (F1)" can leave and show again: no step or check runs on them, and none waits inside the engine.
    $ui.HelpViews = @('choose', 'maint', 'notinst', 'stepfail', 'toolres', 'restmark', 'restpick', 'restconfirm', 'site', 'fail', 'need', 'ready', 'nodrive', 'done', 'review', 'stopped', 'noapps', 'booterr')
    # Shows card $I of the tour (0 = the first). "Next" and "Back" move; "Skip the tour" and the last card's button end it.
    # Takes the card number.
    $ui.VTour = { param([int]$I)
      $n = $ui.TourCards.Count; $ui.TourI = [math]::Max(0, [math]::Min($n - 1, $I)); $tc = $ui.TourCards[$ui.TourI]; $last = ($ui.TourI -eq $n - 1)
      & $ui.SetCard @{ View = 'tour'; Kicker = ('RADE tour' + $dot + ($ui.TourI + 1) + ' of ' + $n); Sentence = [string]$tc.S; P = @($tc.P)
        Buttons = @(@{ Text = $(if ($last) { 'Close the tour' } else { 'Next' }); Kind = 'primary'; Act = { if ($ui.TourI -ge $ui.TourCards.Count - 1) { & $ui.EndTour } else { & $ui.VTour ($ui.TourI + 1) } } },
          $(if ($last) { $null } else { @{ Text = 'Skip the tour'; Act = { & $ui.EndTour } } }))
        Back = $(if ($ui.TourI) { { & $ui.VTour ($ui.TourI - 1) } } else { $null }) } }   # B6: the one Back pattern
    # Ends the tour: remembers that it was shown (Save-TourSeen) and shows the card it came from (Choose on the first run).
    # Takes nothing.
    $ui.EndTour = { Save-TourSeen; $from = $ui.TourFrom; $ui.TourFrom = $null; if ($from) { & $ui.SetCard $from } else { & $ui.VChoose } }
    # "Help (F1)": opens the tour from a card of $ui.HelpViews while nothing runs; the tour's end shows that card again
    # (a box on it has its first text again). Takes nothing.
    $ui.OpenTour = {
      if ($ui.Busy -or $ui.Running -or $ui.RecOn -or $ui.HelpViews -notcontains [string]$ui.View) { return }
      $ui.TourFrom = $ui.CardNow; & $ui.VTour 0 }
    $ui.TourB.Add_Click({ & $ui.OpenTour })
    # Resets what the user chose: each step to its default, clean-up on, no step states. Takes nothing.
    $ui.InitSel = { $ui.Sel = @{}; foreach ($k in $script:appSteps) { $ui.Sel[[int]$k] = [bool](Get-StepDefault $k) }; $ui.Clean = $true; $ui.StepState = @{} }
    # Takes the application the user chose: selects it, reuses base check results that can be reused, and shows Maintenance
    # (already installed) or the checks. Takes the application number.
    $ui.Pick = { param([int]$J)
      Select-App $J; $ui.Picked = $true
      # The base checks are not run twice, except the ones whose answer can change at any time ($checkNoSave: Word open, disk, write).
      foreach ($id in $script:appChecks) { if ($ui.BaseRes.ContainsKey($id) -and $checkNoSave -notcontains $id -and $ui.BaseRes[$id].State -in 'PASSED', 'WARNING') { $script:checkResults[$id] = $ui.BaseRes[$id] } }
      & $ui.SetBand $true   # the band: the app's logo, its word in capitals ("KANON"), "in RADE", its subtitle, version and round
      $ui.Form.Text = & $ui.TitleText $script:app   # engine-v47: "Kanon - 0.1.0" or "Kanon - R46"
      & $ui.InitSel
      $e = $null; if (Test-Deploy) { $e = (Read-Installed (Get-InstalledKey $script:app)) }
      if ($e -and $e.installed) { & $ui.VMaint $e.installed } elseif (Test-Deploy) { & $ui.VNotInst } else { & $ui.Checks $false } }
    # The Maintenance card of an app that is not installed (plan engine-v48 D8, the PFM, 2026-11-27; Cards v2): one Install
    # button; the other options come only after an install. Install runs the checks, then the Ready card. Takes nothing.
    $ui.VNotInst = { $w = Get-AppWord; $v = [string]$script:app.Version
      & $ui.SetCard @{ View = 'notinst'; Kicker = ($w + ' ' + $v); Sentence = ($w + ' is not installed.')
        P = @(('Install puts ' + $w + ' on this computer' + $(if (& $ui.NeedSite) { ' and on your site' } else { '' }) + '. RADE runs the checks first.'))
        Note = 'Repair, Diagnose, Back up, Restore and Uninstall are available after the install.'
        Buttons = @(@{ Text = ('Install ' + $v); Kind = 'primary'; Act = { & $ui.Checks $false } }); Back = { & $ui.VChoose } } }
    # The name of the row that installs this paste's version (D1): "Install <v>" when nothing is installed, "Update to <v>"
    # when an older version is, "Repair" when this one is. Takes the install record's installed part (or $null); gives the name.
    $ui.RowVerb = { param($Inst) $v = [string]$script:app.Version; if (-not $Inst) { return ('Install ' + $v) }
      try { $c = ([version]$v).CompareTo([version][string]$Inst.version); if ($c -gt 0) { return ('Update to ' + $v) } elseif ($c -eq 0) { return 'Repair' } } catch { $null = $_ }   # a version that is not a number: Install
      return ('Install ' + $v) }
    # Shows the Maintenance card of an installed application. Takes its install record (version and date).
    $ui.VMaint = { param($Inst)
      $ui.MaintInst = $Inst   # Back from a tool's cards shows this card again
      # Maintenance (the Administrator, 2026-11-14; docs/engine.md "Maintenance run types"). engine-v47, option A of the mock
      # (the PFM, 2026-11-26: "put all options that are maintenance actions directly on that screen, in the list, with uninstall
      # last, including repair in it"): one card, one list: Update or Repair, Diagnose, Back up, Restore, then Uninstall in dark
      # red; "Start <word>" is the action button. The second screen "Maintenance" (view tools, engine-v30 to v46) is gone.
      $verb = & $ui.RowVerb $Inst
      # Start (R28 fix: the PFM found no Start button): the installed application with a start script can be started from here.
      # It runs the checks first (Start comes only after they pass: AGENTS.md "RADE and the app"), then starts the application.
      # Primary when the installed version is this paste's version; else the Update row is the main action.
      $ui.StartAfter = $false; $startB = $null
      if ([string]$script:app.Start -and (Get-StartPath)) { $startB = @{ Text = 'Start ' + (Get-AppWord); Kind = $(if ([string]$Inst.version -eq [string]$script:app.Version) { 'primary' } else { '' }); Act = { $ui.StartAfter = $true; & $ui.Checks $false } } }
      $ui.MaintVerb = $verb   # read when a row is clicked (a scriptblock does not keep this card's local variables)
      # D1 (the PFM, 2026-11-27): row 1 "Install <version>" stays, gray and off; row 2 Repair or Update, then the tools.
      $off = @{ Off = $true; Soon = $true; Index = 0; Name = ('Install ' + $script:app.Version); Ver = ''; Sub = ''; R1 = '' }
      $fix = @{ Index = 10; Name = $verb; Ver = ''; Sub = $(if ($verb -eq 'Repair') { 'Adds what is missing. Keeps your data.' } else { 'Installs ' + $script:app.Version + ' and keeps your data.' }); R1 = 'Runs the checks' }
      # Uninstall (engine-v40): dark red and on for an app with Uninstall steps, else not available (answer 4A of the PFM, 2026-11-25).
      # The texts do not name the app (a long name made the row 3 lines and the card scroll: Windows job of PR 209, 624 x 682).
      $un = $(if (@($script:app.Uninstall).Count) { @{ Index = 20; Name = 'Uninstall'; Ver = ''; Danger = $true; Sub = 'Makes a backup, then removes the app.'; R1 = 'Changes the site' } }
        else { @{ Off = $true; Soon = $true; Index = 20; Name = 'Uninstall'; Ver = ''; Sub = 'This app has no Uninstall steps.'; R1 = 'Not set up' } })
      & $ui.SetCard @{ View = 'maint'; Kicker = ((Get-AppWord) + ' ' + [string][char]0x2022 + ' ' + $Inst.version); Sentence = ((Get-AppWord) + ' ' + $Inst.version + ' is installed.')
        Options = (& $ui.InlineRows (@($off, $fix) + @(& $ui.ToolRows) + @($un))); OnOption = { param($j) & $ui.MaintPick $j }
        Buttons = @($startB); Focus = 'button'; Back = { & $ui.VChoose } } }   # Focus: Start when it is the primary, else the first row
    # Marks the rows of a list as inline rows (one line each: name, text, fact; $ui.OptPlan) and gives each the names of the
    # list and their facts, so the name and fact columns are as wide as the widest of the list (every row takes the same
    # layout). Takes the rows; gives them back.
    $ui.InlineRows = { param($Rows) $r = @($Rows | Where-Object { $_ }); $names = @($r | ForEach-Object { [string]$_.Name }); $facts = @($r | ForEach-Object { [string]$_.R1 }); $subs = @($r | ForEach-Object { [string]$_.Sub })
      foreach ($o in $r) { $o.Inline = $true; $o.Names = $names; $o.Facts = $facts; $o.Subs = $subs }; return , $r }   # one name and one fact column for the whole list
    # A click on a row of the Maintenance card: 10 = Update or Repair (the checks, then the install run), 20 = Uninstall (its
    # confirm card, part 11), else a tool row (Diagnose, Back up, Restore: $ui.RunTool, part 11). Takes the row's index.
    $ui.MaintPick = { param([int]$J)
      if ($J -eq 10) { & $ui.Checks $false } elseif ($J -eq 20) { & $ui.VUninstall } else { & $ui.RunTool $J } }
    # The Back target of the tool cards: the Maintenance card. Takes nothing.
    $ui.ToolsBack = { & $ui.VMaint $ui.MaintInst }
    # Says whether the chosen application has a check that needs the site address. Takes nothing; gives back $true or
    # $false.
    $ui.NeedSite = { [bool](@($script:appChecks | Where-Object { $_ -in 'net-site', 'site-rights' }).Count) }
    # Shows the card that asks for the site address (filled with the saved one, or the DAF SharePoint start).
    $ui.VSite = {
      $v = Get-SiteUrl (Get-BasePath); if (-not $v) { $v = $sitePrefix }   # PFM 14 Nov 26: the box starts with the DAF SharePoint address
      & $ui.SetCard @{ View = 'site'; Sentence = 'Which site does the application go to?'; P = @('RADE writes to this SharePoint site. The address is saved for next time.')
        Field = @{ Label = 'Site address'; Text = $v; Name = 'Site address, starts with https://' }; Focus = 'field'
        Buttons = @(@{ Text = 'Continue'; Kind = 'primary'; Act = { & $ui.SaveSite } }); Back = { & $ui.VChoose } }
      try { $ui.Field.SelectionStart = $ui.Field.Text.Length; $ui.Field.SelectionLength = 0 } catch { $null = $_ } }
    # Saves the address in the box when it is a valid site address, drops the site checks' old results and runs the checks
    # again; else says what is wrong. Takes nothing.
    $ui.SaveSite = {
      $v = $ui.Field.Text.Trim()
      if (-not (Test-SiteUrl $v)) { & $ui.Say1 ('The address must look like ' + $sitePrefix + 'name'); return }
      try { $null = Save-SiteUrl (Get-BasePath) $v } catch { $null = $_ }
      foreach ($id in 'net-site', 'site-rights') { if ($script:checkResults.ContainsKey($id)) { $script:checkResults.Remove($id) } }
      & $ui.Checks $false }
    $ui.Checks = { param([bool]$Force)
      # The chosen application's checks that run on their own. A check with a result from this window is kept unless $Force
      # ("Run checks again"); a saved result (RADE\Config\rade-checks.json) is reused as before.
      $bp = Get-BasePath; $site = Get-SiteUrl $bp
      if ((& $ui.NeedSite) -and -not (Test-SiteUrl $site)) { & $ui.VSite; return }
      $ids = @($script:appChecks); $cache = Read-CheckCache; $script:savedWhy = @{}
      $ui.Cancel = $false
      & $ui.SetCard @{ View = 'checking'; Sentence = 'Checking this computer and your access.'; P = @('Read-only. Nothing is changed.'); Range = @{ P0 = @($ids | ForEach-Object { [string](Get-CheckDef $_).Name }) }; Buttons = @(@{ Text = 'Cancel'; Always = $true; Act = { & $ui.CancelChecks } }) }
      & $ui.SetBar 'all' 0 $true; $ui.Bars['all'].Fill = $ui.C.Info; $ui.Busy = $true
      try {
        for ($i = 0; $i -lt $ids.Count; $i++) {
          if ($ui.Form.IsDisposed -or $script:closing) { return }
          if ($ui.Cancel) { break }
          $id = $ids[$i]; $d = Get-CheckDef $id; $have = $script:checkResults[$id]
          if ($d.Kind -ne 'auto') { if (-not $have) { $sv = Get-CheckToRun $d $cache $bp $site $false; if ($sv) { $script:checkResults[$id] = $sv } }; continue }   # a sign-in or look check: its saved result, else it asks later
          if ($have -and -not $Force) { continue }
          $sv = Get-CheckToRun $d $cache $bp $site $Force
          if ($sv) { $script:checkResults[$id] = $sv; & $ui.RecRefresh; continue }
          $ui.P[0].Text = [string]$d.Name; $ui.RightL.Text = 'Check ' + ($i + 1) + ' of ' + $ids.Count; & $ui.SetBar 'all' ($i / [math]::Max(1, $ids.Count)) $true
          [System.Windows.Forms.Application]::DoEvents()
          $script:checkResults[$id] = Invoke-Check $d $bp $site { [System.Windows.Forms.Application]::DoEvents() }
          if ($ui.BaseRes.ContainsKey($id)) { $ui.BaseRes[$id] = $script:checkResults[$id] }   # Choose shows the newest result of a base check
          & $ui.RecRefresh   # an open Record shows the new result
        }
      } finally { $null = Save-CheckCache $script:checkResults $bp $site; $ui.Busy = $false; & $ui.SetBar 'all' 0 $false }
      if ($ui.Cancel) { $ui.Cancel = $false; & $ui.VChoose; return }   # Cancel: back to Choose, nothing changed (a check that ran is kept)
      & $ui.Next }
    $ui.CancelChecks = {
      # The check that is running ends first (a sign-in window cannot be closed from here); then RADE goes back to Choose.
      $ui.Cancel = $true; & $ui.Say1 'RADE stops after the check that is running.' }
    $ui.Next = {
      # One question at a time: the first FAILED check, else the first check that waits for you, else the plan.
      if ($ui.Form.IsDisposed -or $script:closing) { return }
      $ids = @($script:appChecks); $fails = @(); $needs = @()
      for ($i = 0; $i -lt $ids.Count; $i++) { $r = $script:checkResults[$ids[$i]]; if (-not $r -or $r.State -in 'NOT RUN', 'RUNNING') { $needs += $i } elseif ($r.State -eq 'FAILED') { $fails += $i } }
      if ($fails.Count) { & $ui.VFail $fails[0] $fails.Count; return }
      if ($needs.Count) { & $ui.VNeed $needs[0]; return }
      & $ui.VReady }
    # Shows the card of a failed check with what to do and a button to run it again. Takes the check number and the count of
    # failed checks.
    $ui.VFail = { param([int]$I, [int]$Count)
      $ids = @($script:appChecks); $ui.CurId = [string]$ids[$I]; $d = Get-CheckDef $ids[$I]; $r = $script:checkResults[$ids[$I]]
      # A check that runs on its own: "Run checks again". A sign-in or look-and-answer check: its own button, as on the card that asks for it.
      $again = $(if ($d.Kind -eq 'signin') { @{ Text = 'Sign in and check site rights'; Kind = 'primary'; Act = { & $ui.One } } } elseif ($d.Kind -eq 'guide') { @{ Text = 'Check Power Automate'; Kind = 'primary'; Act = { & $ui.One } } } else { @{ Text = 'Run checks again'; Kind = 'primary'; Act = { & $ui.Checks $true } } })
      $ok = @($ids | Where-Object { $script:checkResults[$_] -and $script:checkResults[$_].State -in 'PASSED', 'WARNING' }).Count
      & $ui.SetCard @{ View = 'fail'; Light = 'bad'; Kicker = ('Check ' + ($I + 1) + ' of ' + $ids.Count + $dot + 'FAILED'); Sentence = $(if ($Count -eq 1) { 'One check failed.' } else { [string]$Count + ' checks failed. This is the first.' })
        P = @([string]$d.Name, [string]$r.Detail, $(if ($r.Fix) { 'What to do: ' + $r.Fix } else { '' }))
        Buttons = @($again, $(if (& $ui.NeedSite) { @{ Text = 'Change the site address'; Act = { & $ui.VSite } } } else { $null }))
        Foot = ([string]$ok + ' of ' + (& $ui.Counted $ids.Count 'check') + ' passed. RADE changes nothing until every check passes.'); Back = { & $ui.VChoose } }
      & $ui.ToFront }
    # Shows the card of a check that needs the user (a sign-in, a look-and-answer, or not run yet). Takes the check number.
    $ui.VNeed = { param([int]$I)
      $ids = @($script:appChecks); $ui.CurId = [string]$ids[$I]; $d = Get-CheckDef $ui.CurId; $r = $script:checkResults[$ui.CurId]
      $how = $(if ($d.Kind -eq 'signin') { 'CAC sign-in, read-only' } elseif ($d.Kind -eq 'guide') { 'You look and answer, read-only' } else { 'Not run yet' })
      $text = $(if ($d.Kind -eq 'signin') { 'Sign in and check site rights' } elseif ($d.Kind -eq 'guide') { 'Check Power Automate' } else { 'Run checks again' })
      & $ui.SetCard @{ View = 'need'; Light = 'you'; Kicker = ('Check ' + ($I + 1) + ' of ' + $ids.Count); Sentence = 'One check needs you.'
        P = @([string]$d.Name, $(if ($r -and $r.Detail) { [string]$r.Detail } elseif ($script:savedWhy[$ui.CurId]) { [string]$script:savedWhy[$ui.CurId] } else { $how }), $(if ($r -and $r.Fix) { 'What to do: ' + $r.Fix } else { '' }))
        Buttons = @(@{ Text = $text; Kind = 'primary'; Act = $(if ($d.Kind -eq 'auto') { { & $ui.Checks $true } } else { { & $ui.One } }) }); Back = { & $ui.VChoose } } }
    $ui.One = {
      # A check that needs you: the CAC sign-in opens its own window; the look-and-answer check shows a hand card.
      $d = Get-CheckDef $ui.CurId; $bp = Get-BasePath; $site = Get-SiteUrl $bp
      $ui.Cancel = $false
      & $ui.SetCard @{ View = 'checking'; Light = 'you'; Sentence = $(if ($d.Kind -eq 'signin') { 'Waiting for your sign-in.' } else { 'Checking.' }); P = @([string]$d.Name); Buttons = @(@{ Text = 'Cancel'; Always = $true; Act = { & $ui.CancelChecks } }) }
      $ui.Busy = $true
      try { $script:checkResults[$ui.CurId] = Invoke-Check $d $bp $site { [System.Windows.Forms.Application]::DoEvents() } }
      finally { $null = Save-CheckCache $script:checkResults $bp $site; $ui.Busy = $false; & $ui.RecRefresh }
      & $ui.ToFront; if ($ui.Cancel) { $ui.Cancel = $false; & $ui.VChoose; return }; & $ui.Next }
    $ui.VReady = {
      # The plan in three lines; the detail (each file, each step's box) is in the Record.
      if ($ui.Form.IsDisposed -or $script:closing) { return }
      $plan = Get-RoundPlan; $ui.Plan = $plan; $dep = Test-Deploy
      if (-not $plan.Found) {
        & $ui.SetCard @{ View = 'nodrive'; Light = 'bad'; Sentence = 'Your OneDrive folder was not found.'; P = @('RADE saves its files in your OneDrive folder.', 'What to do: open OneDrive from the Start menu and sign in. Then select "Look again".')
          Buttons = @(@{ Text = 'Look again'; Kind = 'primary'; Act = { & $ui.VReady } }); Back = { & $ui.VChoose } }
        return }
      $new = @($plan.Lines | Where-Object { $_ -match '^  New ' }).Count; $rep = @($plan.Lines | Where-Object { $_ -match '^  Replace ' }).Count
      $rec = 0; $in = $false; foreach ($l in $plan.Lines) { if ($l -match '^Clean-up \(runs first') { $in = $true } elseif ($in) { if ($l) { $rec++ } else { $in = $false } } }
      $n = [int][bool]($cleanup.Count -and $ui.Clean); $est = 0; $you = ''; $done = 0   # Clean-up counts as a step, as in the run's "Step k of n"
      foreach ($k in $script:appSteps) {
        if (-not $ui.Sel[[int]$k]) { if ($dep -and -not [bool]$steps[$k].Optional -and -not (Get-StepDefault $k)) { $done++ }; continue }
        $n++; $est += (Get-StepWeight $ui.Hist $steps[$k]).Seconds; if (-not $you -and $steps[$k].Kind -eq 'guide') { $you = 'Step ' + $n + ' needs you.' }
      }
      $ids = @($script:appChecks); $warn = @($ids | Where-Object { $script:checkResults[$_].State -eq 'WARNING' })
      $w1 = ''; if ($warn.Count) { $w1 = 'Warning: ' + (Get-CheckDef $warn[0]).Name + '. ' + $script:checkResults[$warn[0]].Detail + $(if ($warn.Count -gt 1) { ' (and ' + ($warn.Count - 1) + ' more in Details)' } else { '' }) }
      # The saved site, by name, before anything is written (the Administrator, 2026-11-15): the steps use it with no
      # question, so a wrong site must show here. On the card only: a card's text never enters the log or the report.
      $siteName = ''; if ((& $ui.NeedSite) -and (Test-SiteUrl (Get-SiteUrl (Get-BasePath)))) { $siteName = ([string](Get-SiteUrl (Get-BasePath))).TrimEnd('/') -replace '^.*/', '' }
      # Start (R28, the Administrator, 2026-11-17): for an application that is installed and has a start script in its local folder, after the
      # checks pass. It is the main button when the installed version is this paste's version; when this paste is newer, Install stays
      # the main button.
      $startB = $null; $startPrimary = $false
      # Pause and resume (the PFM, 2026-11-20): a saved state of this round and build offers "Resume at step N of M" (main
      # button) and "Start over". A state that cannot be read, or of another build, goes to the Recycle Bin with a plain line.
      $rs = Read-RoundState (Get-BasePath); $rsNote = ''
      if ($rs.State -eq 'bad') { $null = Clear-RoundState (Get-BasePath); $rsNote = 'The saved progress of this round could not be read (' + $rs.Why + '), so the round starts over.' }
      elseif ($rs.State -eq 'other') { $null = Clear-RoundState (Get-BasePath); $rsNote = 'Saved progress of another build of this round was not used. The round starts over.' }
      $resB = $(if ($rs.State -eq 'ok') { @{ Text = 'Resume at step ' + $rs.Next + ' of ' + $rs.Total; Kind = 'primary'; Act = { & $ui.ResumeRun } } } else { $null })
      if ($dep -and [string]$script:app.Start) {
        $inst = Read-Installed (Get-InstalledKey $script:app)
        if ($inst -and $inst.installed -and (Get-StartPath)) { $startPrimary = ([string]$inst.installed.version -eq [string]$script:app.Version); $startB = @{ Text = 'Start ' + (Get-AppWord); Kind = $(if ($startPrimary) { 'primary' } else { '' }); Act = { & $ui.StartApp } } }
      }
      if ($resB -and $startB) { $startB.Kind = '' }   # Resume is the one main button (B4, UI standard v1: one primary)
      $hasWork = [bool]($n -or ($cleanup.Count -and $ui.Clean))
      $runB = @{ Text = $(if ($dep) { 'Install' } else { 'Run' }); Kind = $(if ($hasWork -and -not $startPrimary) { 'primary' } elseif ($hasWork) { '' } else { 'off' }); Act = { & $ui.Run } }
      if ($resB) { $runB = @{ Text = 'Start over'; Act = { & $ui.StartOver } } }   # in the place of Install or Run
      & $ui.SetCard @{ View = 'ready'
        Kicker = $(if ($warn.Count) { (& $ui.Counted ($ids.Count - $warn.Count) 'check') + ' passed' + $dot + (& $ui.Counted $warn.Count 'warning') } elseif ($ids.Count -eq 1) { 'The check passed' } else { 'All ' + $ids.Count + ' checks passed' })
        Sentence = $(if ($dep) { 'Ready to install ' + $script:app.Name + ' ' + $script:app.Version + '.' } else { 'Ready to run round ' + $round + '.' })
        P = @(('Writes to ' + $plan.Shown + ': ' + $new + ' new files, ' + $rep + ' replaced, ' + $rec + ' moved to the Recycle Bin.'),
          ([string]$n + $(if ($n -eq 1) { ' step' } else { ' steps' }) + ', about ' + [math]::Max(1, [int][math]::Round($est / 60)) + ' min. ' + $you + $(if ($done) { ' ' + $done + ' already done for this version and off.' } else { '' })),
          $(if (Test-WordOpen) { 'Word is open. Save your documents and close Word before you start.' } else { '' }), $w1, $rsNote)
        Buttons = @($resB, $startB, $runB,   # B7: Details is the link "Details (F2)"; B4: one primary (Resume when it shows)
          $(if ($siteName) { @{ Text = 'Change the site address'; Act = { & $ui.VSite } } } else { $null }))
        Foot = $(if ($siteName) { 'Site: ' + $siteName } else { '' })
        Field = $(if ($dep -and -not (Test-ShortcutMade)) { @{ Label = 'Shortcut in'; Text = (Get-ShortcutDir); Name = 'Folder for the shortcut'; Button = 'Browse'; Act = { & $ui.BrowseDir } } } else { $null })
        Back = { & $ui.VChoose } }
      if ($ui.StartAfter) { $ui.StartAfter = $false; if ($startB) { & $ui.StartApp } else { & $ui.Say1 ('The checks passed, but ' + $script:app.Name + ' cannot be started: it is not recorded as installed, or its start file was not found. Select "Install" to install it again.') } } }   # Start on Maintenance: the checks passed, so the application starts
    # R29 N8 (the PFM, 17 Nov 26): the install asks where the app's shortcut goes (engine-v42: one for each app); the box starts with the Desktop folder.
    $ui.BrowseDir = {
      $pick = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.FolderBrowserDialog
      try { $pick.Description = 'Choose the folder for the shortcut.'; $pick.ShowNewFolderButton = $true; $v = $ui.Field.Text.Trim(); if ($v -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $v -PathType Container)) { $pick.SelectedPath = $v }
        if ([string]$pick.ShowDialog($ui.Form) -eq 'OK') { $ui.Field.Text = [string]$pick.SelectedPath } } catch { & $ui.Say1 'The folder window could not open. Type the folder in the box.' } finally { $pick.Dispose() } }

    # ==== Engine part: engine/ps/window/07-run.ps1 (sha256 3585a12dc8d5)
    # RADE window part 07, the run: the callbacks Invoke-Round uses (log line, tick, step state), the Run button,
    # and the Done, Needs review and Stopped cards. Uses the card parts and Invoke-Round.
    # Joined into every bundle by engine/rade_build.py; Windows PowerShell 5.1.

    # ---- The run. Invoke-Round calls back: a log line ($ui.Say), a tick ($ui.Tick), a step that starts ($ui.OnStatus) and
    # a step that ends ($ui.OnStep). A step you do by hand comes in through $script:guideUi, what a step does now through
    # $script:nowUi, and the last question of a test round through $script:feedbackUi.
    $ui.Say = { param($t) Add-RunLog $t; $ui.Log.Add([string]$t); if ($ui.RecOn) { try { $ui.RecText.AppendText([string]$t + "`r`n") } catch { $null = $_ } }; try { [System.Windows.Forms.Application]::DoEvents() } catch { $null = $_ } }
    # L7 (the Administrator, 2026-11-19): the now-doing line under the step's bar. The engine calls this ($script:nowUi) with a
    # plain sentence for each item a step script reports (Get-NowText) and for a NOW line. Cards v2 (plan engine-v48 step 5):
    # the text as written, with no "..." added; it wraps to $ui.NowLines lines and the line keeps its room. Takes the text.
    $ui.ShowNow = { param([string]$Text) try { if ($ui.View -eq 'run') { $ui.NowRaw = $Text.Trim(); & $ui.CutNow; $ui.Now.Visible = $true } } catch { $null = $_ } }   # a line that cannot show never stops a step
    # Shows the whole now-doing text ($ui.NowRaw) in $ui.NowLines lines at the line's wrap width (a text longer than that, over
    # the manifest's 80 characters, is cut at the end of the last line); runs again after a resize ($ui.BreakAll). Takes nothing.
    $ui.CutNow = { try { $w = [int](& $ui.GetWrap $ui.Now); $x = [string]$ui.NowRaw; if ($x) { $x = & $ui.FitLines (& $ui.BreakLong $x $ui.Now.Font $w) $ui.Now.Font $w $ui.NowLines }; if ([string]$ui.Now.Text -cne $x) { $ui.Now.Text = $x } } catch { $null = $_ } }   # a line that cannot show never stops a step
    # The engine's callback for the now-doing line (Add-StepLine): shows the text and emits nothing. Takes the text.
    $script:nowUi = { param($t) $null = & $ui.ShowNow ([string]$t) }
    # L8 (the Administrator, 2026-11-19): a step stays on the Run card for $ui.Layout.StepMs (engine/window.json) at least, so a
    # run of fast steps does not flicker. Waits out the rest of that time since the step showed. Takes nothing.
    $ui.HoldStep = {
      while ($ui.View -eq 'run' -and $null -ne $ui.StepAt -and -not $script:closing -and -not $ui.Form.IsDisposed -and ($ui.Clock.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds - [double]$ui.StepAt) -lt [double]$ui.Layout.StepMs) { [System.Windows.Forms.Application]::DoEvents(); Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15 } }
    # Draws the progress: both bars, the time in the step, the step fraction and the overall percent (the Administrator, 2026-11-19:
    # the percent only). Takes nothing; does nothing when no step runs.
    $ui.Paint = {
      if (-not $script:prog -or -not $script:stepStart) { return }
      $g = Get-Progress
      $all = [math]::Max($g.All, $ui.Bars['all'].Target); & $ui.SetBar 'all' $all $true; & $ui.SetBar 'run' $all $true; & $ui.SetBar 'step' ([math]::Max($g.StepShown, $ui.Bars['step'].Target)) $true
      if ($ui.View -ne 'run') { return }
      & $ui.ShowTime
      $fr = $(if ($script:prog.Frac -ge 0) { [string]$script:prog.FracText } else { '' }); if ($ui.StepFrac.Text -ne $fr) { $ui.StepFrac.Text = $fr }   # one size ($ui.FixW): the bar keeps its width
      # Cards v2: one percent for the whole run, on the card beside its bar (the bottom line has none).
      $rt = [string][int]($g.All * 100) + ' %'; if ($ui.PctL.Text -ne $rt) { $ui.PctL.Text = $rt } }
    # The time in this step (R28 N10): "4m 12s"; with hours "1h 04m 12s".
    $ui.Elapsed = { param([double]$Sec) $q = [int][math]::Floor([math]::Max(0, $Sec)); $h = [int][math]::Floor($q / 3600); $m = [int][math]::Floor(($q % 3600) / 60); $x = $q % 60
      if ($h) { return ('{0}h {1:00}m {2:00}s' -f $h, $m, $x) }; return ('{0}m {1:00}s' -f $m, $x) }
    # Shows the time in this step on the step line, once for each second. The time keeps one size from its widest value
    # ($ui.FixW), so the bar beside it never changes its width. Takes nothing; a failure is ignored.
    $ui.ShowTime = { try { if ($ui.View -eq 'run' -and $script:stepStart) { $t = & $ui.Elapsed ((Get-Date) - $script:stepStart).TotalSeconds; if ($ui.StepTime.Text -ne $t) { $ui.StepTime.Text = $t } } } catch { $null = $_ } }
    $ui.TimeT = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Timer; $ui.TimeT.Interval = 1000; $ui.TimeT.Add_Tick({ & $ui.ShowTime })
    # The tick callback of a running step: repaints the bars and lets the window handle its events. Emits nothing.
    $ui.Tick = { $null = & $ui.Paint; [System.Windows.Forms.Application]::DoEvents() }   # a callback must emit nothing: its output would join the engine function's return value
    # Returns the title the window shows for a step (its manifest title, else its name). Takes the step name.
    $ui.TitleOf = { param([string]$Name) foreach ($s in @($steps)) { if ([string]$s.Name -ceq $Name) { return (Get-StepTitle $s) } }; return $Name }   # the title of the step with this name
    # ---- The step list of the Run card (plan engine-v48 step 3, Cards v2). $ui.RunList has one row for each step of this
    # run (Clean-up first when it runs): @{ Key (the step name, or 'Clean-up'); Title; Sub (the second line); State }. The
    # running row is the tinted $ui.RunRow; the row before it and the rows after it are drawn in $ui.RunA and $ui.RunB.
    $ui.RunList = @()
    # The status of a row: its word and the token of its color. Takes the state word; gives back @(word, token).
    $ui.RunMark = { param([string]$S) switch ($S) { 'PASSED' { @('PASSED', 'GreenInk') } 'DONE' { @('DONE', 'GreenInk') } 'SKIPPED' { @('SKIPPED', 'Gray') }
        'FAILED' { @('FAILED', 'Red') } 'NEEDS REVIEW' { @('NEEDS REVIEW', 'Red') } 'INTERRUPTED' { @('STOPPED', 'Red') } default { @('WAITING', 'Gray') } } }
    # Makes the rows of this run from the steps that are on. Takes the selection (one flag for each step); sets $ui.RunList.
    $ui.MakeRunList = { param($Sel)
      $ui.RunList = @(); if ($cleanup.Count -and $ui.Clean -and -not $script:resume) {   # a resume runs no clean-up (Invoke-Round)
      $ui.RunList += @{ Key = 'Clean-up'; Title = 'Clean-up'; Sub = ''; State = '' } }
      for ($k = 0; $k -lt $steps.Count; $k++) { if ($Sel[$k]) { $ui.RunList += @{ Key = [string]$steps[$k].Name; Title = (Get-StepTitle $steps[$k]); Sub = [string]$steps[$k].Doing; State = '' } } } }
    # The room the Run card has for drawn rows: the card's height less its header, its body without the lists and its
    # buttons (each as tall as its parts ask for), so the card never scrolls for its lists (the Windows job of PR 211: fixed
    # thresholds made the Run card scroll at 1004 x 577 with long texts). Takes nothing; gives back pixels (0 at least).
    $ui.RunRoom = { $ph = { param($C) $h = 0; try { $h = [int]$C.GetPreferredSize((New-Object System.Drawing.Size(0, 0))).Height } catch { $null = $_ }; [math]::Max($h, [int]$C.Height) }   # no measure: its height
      return [int][math]::Max(0, [int]$ui.Card.ClientSize.Height - (& $ph $ui.Head) - (& $ph $ui.Body) - (& $ph $ui.Tail) - (& $ui.Sc $ui.Z.G2)) }
    $ui.RunMost = 4   # at most 4 drawn rows beside the running one (the Cards v2 mock: 5 rows in all)
    # The width of a drawn row's texts (the row less the status column and the side room). Takes the row width.
    $ui.RunTextW = { param([int]$W) [int][math]::Max(1, $W - (& $ui.Sc 120) - 2 * (& $ui.Sc $ui.Z.G2)) }
    # The height of one drawn row slot (R35, the Administrator, 2026-11-19: values do not move anything): the tallest row this
    # run can have, from the longest name of all its steps (2 lines at most) and a second line of 2 lines, 44 px at least.
    # Takes the width; gives back pixels.
    $ui.RunSlotOf = { param([int]$W)
      $h1 = & $ui.LineH $ui.F.SmallB; $h2 = & $ui.LineH $ui.F.Small; $tw = & $ui.RunTextW $W; $n1 = 1
      foreach ($x in @($ui.RunList)) { $n1 = [math]::Max($n1, (& $ui.Rows ([string]$x.Title) $ui.F.SmallB $tw $h1 2)) }
      return [int][math]::Max((& $ui.Sc 44), $n1 * $h1 + 2 * $h2 + (& $ui.Sc $ui.Z.G3)) }
    $ui.RunCap = @{}; $ui.RunSlotH = 0; $ui.RunN = 0; $ui.RunKey = ''   # the slots of each list, the slot height, the slots in all, the size they are for
    # Sizes one drawn list to its slots (not to its rows: a list keeps its height from step to step). Takes the panel.
    $ui.SizeRuns = { param($P) $P.Height = [math]::Max(1, [int]$ui.RunCap[$P] * [int]$ui.RunSlotH)
      $P.AccessibleDescription = (@($P.Tag) | ForEach-Object { [string]$_.Title + ': ' + (& $ui.RunMark ([string]$_.State))[0] }) -join '; ' }
    # The number of row slots the Run card has room for at this window size (R35: once for a size, again only after a
    # resize, so the parts never move from step to step). Takes nothing; sets $ui.RunN, $ui.RunSlotH and $ui.RunKey.
    $ui.RunFit = { $key = [string]$ui.Card.ClientSize.Width + 'x' + $ui.Card.ClientSize.Height; if ($ui.RunKey -eq $key) { return }
      foreach ($p in @($ui.RunA, $ui.RunB)) { $ui.RunCap[$p] = 0; $p.Visible = $false }   # first the card with no list: its room ($ui.RunRoom)
      try { $ui.Card.PerformLayout() } catch { $null = $_ }; $ui.RunSlotH = & $ui.RunSlotOf ([int]$ui.RunA.Width)
      $ui.RunN = [int][math]::Min($ui.RunMost, [math]::Floor((& $ui.RunRoom) / [math]::Max(1, $ui.RunSlotH))); $ui.RunKey = $key }
    # Puts the rows around the running step into the lists: one slot for the step before it (empty on the first step), the
    # other slots for the steps after it. The slots keep their heights from step to step. Takes nothing.
    $ui.PlaceRuns = {
      $all = @($ui.RunList); $r = -1; for ($i = 0; $i -lt $all.Count; $i++) { if ($all[$i].State -eq 'RUNNING') { $r = $i } }
      $ui.StepSum.Text = $(if ($r -ge 0) { [string]$all[$r].Sub } else { '' }); $ui.StepSum.Visible = $true   # its room is the longest summary ($ui.Range)
      & $ui.RunFit; $na = [int][bool]$ui.RunN; $a = @(); if ($na -and $r -gt 0) { $a = @($all[$r - 1]) }
      $b = @(); for ($i = $r + 1; $i -lt $all.Count -and $b.Count -lt ($ui.RunN - $na); $i++) { $b += $all[$i] }
      $ui.RunA.Tag = $a; $ui.RunB.Tag = $b; $ui.RunCap[$ui.RunA] = $na; $ui.RunCap[$ui.RunB] = $ui.RunN - $na
      foreach ($p in @($ui.RunA, $ui.RunB)) { & $ui.SizeRuns $p; $p.Visible = [bool]$ui.RunCap[$p] }   # only the Run card shows them ($ui.Dress hides them)
      $ui.RunA.Invalidate(); $ui.RunB.Invalidate(); & $ui.Squeeze }
    # Marks the step that starts as running, and a row that was running and has no result as done. Takes the step name.
    $ui.RunStart = { param([string]$Name) foreach ($x in @($ui.RunList)) { if ($x.State -eq 'RUNNING') { $x.State = 'DONE' } }
      foreach ($x in @($ui.RunList)) { if ([string]$x.Key -ceq $Name) { $x.State = 'RUNNING'; break } } }
    # Keeps the result of a step that ended in its row: the state word and the rest of its result line as its second line.
    # Takes the step name, the state word and the rest of the line.
    $ui.RunEnd = { param([string]$Name, [string]$State, [string]$Rest)
      foreach ($x in @($ui.RunList)) { if ([string]$x.Key -ceq $Name) { $x.State = $State; $t = ($Rest.Substring([math]::Min($Rest.Length, $State.Length)) -replace '^[\s:(]+', '' -replace '\)$', '').Trim(); if ($t) { $x.Sub = $t } } } }
    $ui.PaintRuns = {
      <#
      .SYNOPSIS
      Draws the rows of one step list: a thin line under each row, the name and the second line (2 lines each at most), and at the
      right the status as an icon and a word (PASSED with a tick, WAITING with a ring, FAILED with a cross).
      .PARAMETER P
      The list panel (its Tag holds the rows).
      .PARAMETER G
      Its graphics.
      .OUTPUTS
      Nothing; a failure draws nothing more.
      #>
      param($P, $G)
      try { $G.Clear($ui.C.White); $G.SmoothingMode = 'AntiAlias'; $w = $P.ClientSize.Width; $y = 0; $pad = & $ui.Sc $ui.Z.G2; $mw = & $ui.Sc 120; $h1 = & $ui.LineH $ui.F.SmallB; $h2 = & $ui.LineH $ui.F.Small
        $wrap = 'Left, Top, NoPrefix, WordBreak, EndEllipsis, TextBoxControl'; $ln = New-Object System.Drawing.Pen($ui.C.Hair)
        foreach ($r in @($P.Tag)) { $h = [int]$ui.RunSlotH; $m = & $ui.RunMark ([string]$r.State); $col = $ui.C[[string]$m[1]]
          $tw = & $ui.RunTextW $w; $n1 = & $ui.Rows ([string]$r.Title) $ui.F.SmallB $tw $h1 2   # the name and the second line wrap to 2 lines each (Cards v2)
          & $ui.Word $G ([string]$r.Title) $ui.F.SmallB $ui.C.Navy $pad ($y + (& $ui.Sc 6)) $tw ($n1 * $h1) $wrap
          & $ui.Word $G ([string]$r.Sub) $ui.F.Small $ui.C.Gray $pad ($y + (& $ui.Sc 6) + $n1 * $h1) $tw (2 * $h2) $wrap
          & $ui.Word $G ([string]$m[0]) $ui.F.SmallB $col ($w - $mw) $y ($mw - $pad) $h 'Right, VerticalCenter, NoPrefix, SingleLine'
          $ww = [int](& $ui.Meas ([string]$m[0]) $ui.F.SmallB 100000).Width; & $ui.RunIcon $G ([string]$m[0]) $col ($w - $pad - $ww - (& $ui.Sc 16)) ($y + [int]($h / 2))
          $y += $h; $G.DrawLine($ln, 0, ($y - 1), $w, ($y - 1)) }
        $ln.Dispose() } catch { $null = $_ } }   # a list that cannot be drawn: the running row and the percent still show
    # Draws the icon of a status, 10 px, centered on a point: a tick, a cross, a ring (WAITING) or a dash. Takes the graphics,
    # the word, the color and the point.
    $ui.RunIcon = { param($G, [string]$Word, $Color, [int]$X, [int]$Y) $d = & $ui.Sc 10; $t = $Y - [int]($d / 2); $pn = New-Object System.Drawing.Pen($Color, [single](& $ui.Sc 2))
      if ($Word -in 'PASSED', 'DONE') { $G.DrawLines($pn, [System.Drawing.Point[]]@((New-Object System.Drawing.Point($X, ($t + [int]($d / 2)))), (New-Object System.Drawing.Point(($X + [int]($d / 3)), ($t + $d))), (New-Object System.Drawing.Point(($X + $d), $t)))) }
      elseif ($Word -in 'FAILED', 'NEEDS REVIEW', 'STOPPED') { $G.DrawLine($pn, $X, $t, ($X + $d), ($t + $d)); $G.DrawLine($pn, ($X + $d), $t, $X, ($t + $d)) }
      elseif ($Word -eq 'WAITING') { $G.DrawEllipse($pn, $X, $t, $d, $d) } else { $G.DrawLine($pn, $X, $Y, ($X + $d), $Y) }
      $pn.Dispose() }
    # The installed part of this app's install record, or $null (the row the person sees next on Maintenance: $ui.RowVerb).
    $ui.InstNow = { $e = $null; try { $e = Read-Installed (Get-InstalledKey $script:app) } catch { $null = $_ }; if ($e -and $e.installed) { return $e.installed }; return $null }   # no record: not installed
    # A count with its noun, singular for 1 ("1 step", "3 checks"). Takes the number and the noun.
    $ui.Counted = { param([int]$N, [string]$One) [string]$N + ' ' + $One + $(if ($N -ne 1) { 's' } else { '' }) }
    # The Cancel question (Cards v2; critique change 10): Cancel or Esc on the Run card asks first. "Stop the install" lets the
    # step that runs now finish and then stops the run ($script:stopAfter, engine/ps/06-round.ps1); "Keep installing" shows the
    # Run card again. The run goes on while the question shows; during the setup, before the first step, it says so. Takes nothing.
    $ui.VCancelQ = {
      if (-not $ui.Running -or $ui.View -ne 'run') { return }
      $t = & $ui.TitleOf $ui.StepNow; $dep = Test-Deploy; $verb = $(if ($dep) { 'install' } else { 'round' })
      & $ui.SetCard @{ View = 'cancelq'; Light = 'you'; Kicker = $ui.Kick.Text; Sentence = ('Stop the ' + $verb + '?')
        P = @($(if ($ui.StepI -and $t) { 'RADE stops after "' + $t + '". The steps that passed stay done.' } else { 'RADE stops before the first step.' }), $(if ($dep) { 'To finish the install later, select "' + (& $ui.RowVerb (& $ui.InstNow)) + '" again.' } else { '' }))
        Buttons = @(@{ Text = ('Stop the ' + $verb); Kind = 'dangerline'; Always = $true; Act = { $script:stopAfter = $true; & $ui.ShowRun; & $ui.Say1 'RADE stops after the step that runs now.' } },
          @{ Text = $(if ($dep) { 'Keep installing' } else { 'Keep running' }); Kind = 'primary'; Always = $true; Act = { & $ui.ShowRun } }) } }
    # Shows the run card: step k of n, the step name, the bars, Cancel and the next step that needs you.
    $ui.ShowRun = {
      & $ui.SetCard @{ View = 'run'; Kicker = $(if ($ui.StepI) { 'Step ' + $ui.StepI + ' of ' + $ui.StepN } else { 'Starting' }); Sentence = $(if (Test-Deploy) { 'Installing ' + (Get-AppWord) + ' ' + $script:app.Version + '.' } else { 'Running round ' + $round + '.' })
        StepRow = $true; Buttons = @(@{ Text = 'Cancel (Esc)'; Always = $true; Act = { & $ui.VCancelQ } })   # Cards v2: the Cancel question first (the window's X still asks with a message)
        Range = @{ Kick = @('STARTING', 'STEP 00 OF 00'); StepName = @(@($steps | ForEach-Object { Get-StepTitle $_ }) + @('Clean-up')) }   # every step title: the step row keeps its place
        Foot = $(if (@($ui.Guides).Count) { 'RADE needs you next at "' + (& $ui.TitleOf $ui.Guides[0]) + '". Until then, keep this window open.' } elseif (-not (Test-Deploy) -and -not $ui.Asked) { 'RADE asks you one last question at the end. Until then, keep this window open.' } else { 'Nothing is needed from you. Keep this window open.' }) }
      $ui.Range[$ui.StepSum] = @($ui.RunList | ForEach-Object { [string]$_.Sub } | Where-Object { $_ }); & $ui.Reflow $ui.StepSum   # one height for every summary (R35)
      $ui.StepName.Text = (& $ui.TitleOf $ui.StepNow); $ui.PctL.Text = [string][int]($ui.Bars['all'].Target * 100) + ' %'; $null = & $ui.PlaceRuns; $null = & $ui.FitEdges; $null = & $ui.FitBar; $null = & $ui.ShowTime }   # the edge follows the ink of the new text's first letter (titles start with any letter)
    # Shows a new step on the Run card that is shown: its number in the line in capitals and its title. Both keep their size
    # ($ui.Range of the card), and the edges are fitted for the title's first letter. Takes the step number, the count and the name.
    $ui.ShowStep = { param([int]$I, [int]$N, [string]$Name) $ui.Kick.Text = ('Step ' + $I + ' of ' + $N).ToUpperInvariant(); $ui.StepName.Text = (& $ui.TitleOf $Name); $null = & $ui.FitEdges; $null = & $ui.FitBar }
    # Invoke-Round calls this when a step starts: keeps its name, start and estimate, and moves the run card on.
    # Takes the step index, the step count, the name and the estimate.
    $ui.OnStatus = { param($i, $count, $name, $estimate)
      $null = & $ui.HoldStep
      $script:statusBase = $name; $script:stepStart = Get-Date; $script:stepEst = $estimate
      if ($i -le 1) { $null = & $ui.SetBar 'all' 0 $true }
      $ui.StepI = [int]$i; $ui.StepN = [int]$count; $ui.StepNow = [string]$name
      $null = & $ui.RunStart ([string]$name)
      if ($ui.View -eq 'cancelq') { $ui.Kick.Text = ('Step ' + $i + ' of ' + $count).ToUpperInvariant() } elseif ($ui.View -ne 'run') { $null = & $ui.ShowRun } else { $null = & $ui.ShowStep $i $count $name; $null = & $ui.PlaceRuns }   # the Cancel question stays
      $null = & $ui.SetBar 'step' 0 $true; $ui.StepFrac.Text = ''; $null = & $ui.FitBar; $null = & $ui.ShowTime
      $null = & $ui.ShowNow ''; $ui.StepAt = $ui.Clock.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds   # Cards v2: the step's doing text is its summary line ($ui.PlaceRuns); the now-doing line waits for its first item
      $null = & $ui.Paint; [System.Windows.Forms.Application]::DoEvents() }
    # Called when a step ends: keeps its state word (DONE, PASSED, SKIPPED, ...) from the result line and redraws. Takes the
    # step number and its result line.
    $ui.OnStep = { param($k, $line)
      $nm = [string]$steps[$k].Name + ': '; $rest = [string]$line; if ($rest.StartsWith($nm, [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal)) { $rest = $rest.Substring($nm.Length) }
      $st = 'DONE'; foreach ($w in 'NEEDS REVIEW', 'INTERRUPTED', 'FAILED', 'SKIPPED', 'PASSED') { if ($rest.StartsWith($w, [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal)) { $st = $w; break } }
      $ui.StepState[[int]$k] = $st; $null = & $ui.RunEnd ([string]$steps[$k].Name) $st $rest; $null = & $ui.Paint }
    # Gives the "Window: OK" or "Window: NOT OK" line for the report, with the layout self-check when it is on. Takes
    # nothing; gives back the text.
    $ui.WindowLine = { $w = $(if ($ui.OkBox.Checked) { 'Window: OK' } else { 'Window: NOT OK - write here what overlapped or was cut off' }); if ($ui.LayOn -and ($env:RADE_LAYOUT -eq '1' -or -not (Test-Deploy))) { $w += "`r`n" + (& $ui.LayLine) }
      @(@($w) + @(& $ui.ScaleLines)) -join "`r`n" }   # E4: the SCALE line of each RADE window shown since this one opened
    $ui.StartApp = {
      # The installed app opens from its local copy in its own powershell.exe process; then RADE closes.
      $p = Get-StartPath; if (-not $p) { & $ui.Say1 'The start file of this application was not found. Select "Install" to put it back.'; return }
      # No -ExecutionPolicy setting (DEC 3): drop only a "Bypass" handed down by an old RADE shortcut (RADE closes after this)
      if ($env:PSExecutionPolicyPreference -ceq 'Bypass') { Remove-Item -LiteralPath 'Env:PSExecutionPolicyPreference' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
      try { $pr = Start-Process -FilePath (Get-PowerShellExe) -ArgumentList ('-NoProfile -STA -File "' + $p + '"') -WorkingDirectory (Split-Path -Parent $p) -PassThru
        if ($pr) { $null = $pr.Handle }   # Windows PowerShell 5.1 keeps the exit code only when the handle is held
        # A start script that a policy blocks or that fails at once ends within a moment: say so and keep RADE open.
        if ($pr -and $pr.WaitForExit(2500) -and $pr.ExitCode -ne 0) { & $ui.Say1 ('The application stopped as soon as it started (exit code ' + $pr.ExitCode + '). Ask in the Teams channel.'); return }
        $ui.Started = $true; $ui.Form.Close() } catch { & $ui.Say1 'The application could not be started. Select "Start" again, or ask in the Teams channel.' } }
    # Starts the run: saves the shortcut folder, asks for the folder some steps need, then calls Invoke-Round with the
    # window callbacks and shows Done, Needs review or Stopped. Takes nothing.
    $ui.Run = {
      $ui.LinkDir = ''; $ui.FieldAsked = $false
      if ($ui.View -eq 'ready' -and $ui.FieldRow.Visible -and $ui.FieldL.Text -eq 'Shortcut in') {   # R29 N8: the folder for the app's shortcut (the label is the key: 06-open.ps1)
        $d = $ui.Field.Text.Trim().Trim('"')
        if ($d -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $d -PathType Container)) { & $ui.Say1 'That folder was not found. Select "Browse" to choose a folder, or empty the box for no shortcut.'; $script:resume = $null; return }
        $ui.LinkDir = $d; $ui.FieldAsked = $true; if ($d) { Save-ShortcutDir $d } }
      $dep = Test-Deploy; $ui.Running = $true; $ui.Asked = $false; $ui.StepAt = $null; $ui.Summary = @(); $ui.Log.Clear(); $ui.StepState = @{}; $ui.StepI = 0; $ui.StepNow = ''; $ui.Edit = $false
      $to = ''; if (-not $dep) { $to = [string](Get-MailTo (Get-BasePath)); $ui.ToBox.Text = $to }
      $sel = @(); $ui.Guides = @()
      for ($k = 0; $k -lt $steps.Count; $k++) { $on = [bool]($script:appSteps -contains $k -and $ui.Sel[[int]$k]); $sel += $on; if ($on -and $steps[$k].Kind -eq 'guide') { $ui.Guides += [string]$steps[$k].Name } }
      # A step that needs a folder asks for it now (a Windows dialog); Cancel skips that step. A resume does not ask again
      # for a step it keeps.
      $kept = $(if ($script:resume) { Get-ResumeKept $script:resume } else { @{} })
      $answers = @()
      for ($k = 0; $k -lt $steps.Count; $k++) {
        $a = ''
        if ($sel[$k] -and $steps[$k].AskParam -and -not $kept.ContainsKey([string]$steps[$k].Name)) {
          $pick = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.FolderBrowserDialog
          $pick.Description = $steps[$k].AskPrompt; $pick.ShowNewFolderButton = $false
          if ([string]$pick.ShowDialog($ui.Form) -eq 'OK') { $a = [string]$pick.SelectedPath } else { $sel[$k] = $false; $ui.Guides = @($ui.Guides | Where-Object { $_ -ne [string]$steps[$k].Name }); $ui.Log.Add($steps[$k].Name + ': skipped (no folder picked)') }
          $pick.Dispose()
        }
        $answers += $a
      }
      $ui.Bars['all'].Fill = $ui.C.Info; $ui.Bars['run'].Fill = $ui.C.Info; $ui.Bars['step'].Fill = $ui.C.Info; & $ui.SetBar 'all' 0 $true; & $ui.SetBar 'run' 0 $true; & $ui.SetBar 'step' 0 $true
      $script:stopAfter = $false; & $ui.MakeRunList $sel; $ui.RunKey = ''; & $ui.ShowRun; $ui.TimeT.Start()
      $checkLines = Get-CheckSummary $script:checkResults
      $script:roundStart = Get-Date
      try {
        $ui.Summary = Invoke-Round ([bool]($cleanup.Count -and $ui.Clean)) $sel $to $ui.Say $ui.Tick $ui.OnStep $ui.OnStatus $ui.WindowLine $answers $checkLines
        & $ui.HoldStep; $script:stepStart = $null; $ui.Running = $false
        if (-not ($script:closing -or $ui.Form.IsDisposed)) { & $ui.VDone }   # closed in the last moments of the run: no clipboard, no folder
      } catch {
        $script:stepStart = $null; $ui.Running = $false
        if ($script:closing -or $ui.Form.IsDisposed) { return }   # Exit during a step: the report on disk says STOPPED
        $msg = 'STOPPED: ' + (ConvertTo-Masked ([string]$_)); & $ui.Say $msg
        $what = [string](Get-WhatToDo $msg); if ($what) { & $ui.Say $what }
        & $ui.VStopped $msg.Substring(9) $what
      } finally { $script:resume = $null; $ui.Running = $false; try { $ui.TimeT.Stop() } catch { $null = $_ }; $sv = $ui.StepState; & $ui.InitSel; $ui.StepState = $sv } }
    # Pause and resume (the PFM, 2026-11-20; docs/engine.md "Pause and resume"): runs the round again from its saved state.
    # The steps that passed stay done; the step that was running and the steps after it run. Takes nothing.
    $ui.ResumeRun = {
      $st = Read-RoundState (Get-BasePath)
      if ($st.State -ne 'ok') { $null = Clear-RoundState (Get-BasePath); & $ui.VReady; & $ui.Say1 'The saved progress could not be read, so the round starts over. Select the main button to start.'; return }
      $sel = Get-ResumeSelection $st.Doc; for ($k = 0; $k -lt $steps.Count; $k++) { if ($script:appSteps -contains $k) { $ui.Sel[[int]$k] = [bool]$sel[$k] } }
      $script:resume = $st.Doc; & $ui.Run }
    # Start over: the saved state goes to the Recycle Bin, then the round runs from its first step. Takes nothing.
    $ui.StartOver = { $why = Clear-RoundState (Get-BasePath); if ($why) { & $ui.Say1 ('The saved progress could not be moved to the Recycle Bin (' + $why + ').'); return }; $script:resume = $null; & $ui.Run }
    $ui.MadeText = {
      # Deploy: how many things the installs of this application made, by kind (the list is in the Record).
      $c = [ordered]@{}; $e = (Read-Installed (Get-InstalledKey $script:app))
      if ($e -and $e.steps) { foreach ($n in @($e.steps.Keys)) { foreach ($m in @($e.steps[$n].made)) { if ($null -ne $m) { $k = [string]$m.kind; if ($c.Contains($k)) { $c[$k] = [int]$c[$k] + 1 } else { $c[$k] = 1 } } } } }
      if (-not $c.Count) { return '' }
      $parts = @(); foreach ($k in @($c.Keys)) { $parts += ([string]$c[$k] + ' ' + $k + $(if ($c[$k] -ne 1) { 's' } else { '' })) }
      return ('The installs of this application made: ' + ($parts -join ', ') + '.') }
    # Copies the summary (else the log) to the clipboard and says "Copied.". Takes nothing.
    $ui.Copy = {
      $t = $(if (@($ui.Summary).Count) { @($ui.Summary) } else { @($ui.Log) }) -join "`r`n"
      try { [System.Windows.Forms.Clipboard]::SetText($t); & $ui.Say1 'Copied.' } catch { & $ui.Say1 'The clipboard is busy. Select the button again.' } }
    # Opens the results folder in Explorer, when there is one. Takes nothing.
    $ui.Open = { if ($script:resultsDir) { Start-Process -FilePath 'explorer.exe' -ArgumentList ('"' + $script:resultsDir + '"') } }
    # engine-v46 (the PFM, 2026-11-26: "I got no notification that a script was blocked"): the end card names each step
    # whose script Windows blocked 2 times (Invoke-RoundStep), also when it is not the first problem. Takes nothing; gives
    # back the paragraph, or '' when no step was blocked.
    $ui.BlockedText = { $b = @($script:blockedSteps | Where-Object { $_ })
      if (-not $b.Count) { return '' }
      return ('Windows blocked the script of ' + $(if ($b.Count -eq 1) { 'the step "' + $b[0] + '"' } else { [string]$b.Count + ' steps: "' + ($b -join '", "') + '"' }) + ' 2 times. Details shows the policy line.') }
    # Shows the card at the end of a run: Done when every step passed ($ui.VPassed), else the step-failed card for the first
    # step that failed ($ui.VStepFail), or Needs review. Copies the summary and opens the folder in a test round. Takes nothing.
    $ui.VDone = {
      $sum = @($ui.Summary); $dep = Test-Deploy; $bad = ([string]$sum[0] -match 'NEEDS REVIEW')
      $ui.Took = Format-Duration ((Get-Date) - $script:roundStart).TotalSeconds
      $ui.Bars['all'].Fill = $(if ($bad) { $ui.C.Red } else { $ui.C.Green }); & $ui.SetBar 'all' $(if ($bad) { $ui.Bars['all'].Target } else { 1 }) $true
      $ui.Mail = $(if ($script:draftMade) { 'An Outlook draft is open with the summary and all result files. Review it, then select Send.' } else { 'The results folder is open and the summary is on the clipboard. Paste it into an e-mail and attach the files.' })
      if (-not $bad) { & $ui.VPassed } else {
        # The first step that failed or needs review, with its help line from the manifest; the rest is in Details.
        $one = ''; $what = ''; $more = 0
        for ($k = 0; $k -lt $sum.Count; $k++) { if ([string]$sum[$k] -match ': (NEEDS REVIEW|FAILED) ') { if ($one) { $more++ } else { $one = [string]$sum[$k]; if ($k + 1 -lt $sum.Count -and [string]$sum[$k + 1] -match '^\s+What to do: ') { $what = ([string]$sum[$k + 1]).Trim() } } } }
        $row = $null; $ri = 0; for ($i = 0; $i -lt @($ui.RunList).Count; $i++) { if ($one.StartsWith([string]$ui.RunList[$i].Key + ': ', [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal)) { $row = $ui.RunList[$i]; $ri = $i + 1; break } }
        if ($row) { & $ui.VStepFail $row $ri $one $what $more } else {
          if (-not $one) { $one = 'A file, the clean-up or a result file needs review. Details shows which.' }
          & $ui.SetCard @{ View = 'review'; Light = 'bad'; Kicker = 'Needs review'; Right = 'Needs review'; Sentence = $(if ($dep) { 'The install is not complete.' } else { 'The round needs review.' })
            P = @(($one + $(if ($more) { ' (and ' + $more + ' more in Details)' } else { '' })), $what, (& $ui.BlockedText), $(if ($dep) { 'Steps that passed stay done. If you paste the block again, RADE runs only what is left.' } else { $ui.Mail }))
            Help = $(if ($dep) { Get-HelpLine } else { '' }); Note = $(if ($dep) { '"Copy summary" puts the report on the clipboard. Paste it in the channel. Nothing was sent.' } else { '' })
            Buttons = @(@{ Text = 'Copy summary'; Kind = 'primary'; Act = { & $ui.Copy } }, @{ Text = 'Open results folder'; Act = { & $ui.Open } }, @{ Text = 'Close'; Act = { $ui.Form.Close() } })
            Test = (-not $dep); Back = { & $ui.VReady } } } }
      if (-not $dep) { & $ui.Copy; if (-not $script:draftMade) { & $ui.Open } }   # a test round: the summary is on the clipboard, and with no draft the folder opens
      & $ui.ToFront }
    $ui.VPassed = {
      <#
      .SYNOPSIS
      Shows the Done card of a run that passed (Cards v2): the green light line, the kicker "ALL n STEPS PASSED" in the
      PASSED color, the tick and the headline, the strong summary line "<n> steps and <m> checks passed in <time>.", what
      was sent (nothing), the main button "Start <word> (Enter)" when it can start, and no Back.
      .OUTPUTS
      Nothing.
      #>
      $dep = Test-Deploy; $made = ''; if ($dep) { $made = [string](& $ui.MadeText) }
      $all = @($ui.RunList).Count; $n = @($ui.RunList | Where-Object { [string]$_.State -in 'PASSED', 'DONE' }).Count   # counted from the states: a skipped step did not pass
      $m = @($script:appChecks | Where-Object { $script:checkResults[$_] -and [string]$script:checkResults[$_].State -like 'PASSED*' }).Count   # a warning did not pass
