      $iconNote = ''; if ($dep) { $saved = Save-RunnerCopy   # a copy that stays (a higher engine) keeps its shortcut (review of PR 199)
        $noBox = 'The shortcut folder box was empty, so RADE made no shortcut. Open RADE from the RADE page instead.'   # R28: the runner copy and the shortcut (a deploy that passed)
        $iconNote = $(if (-not $saved) { '' } elseif ($ui.FieldAsked -and -not $ui.LinkDir -and (Get-DesktopDir)) { $noBox } else { [string](Add-DesktopIcon ([string]$ui.LinkDir)) }) }
      $inst = ($dep -and (Get-InstalledText $script:app) -match 'is installed$'); $w = Get-AppWord
      # Start (R28 fix: after a first install the Done card had no Start button): the checks passed before the install.
      $startB = $(if ($inst -and [string]$script:app.Start -and (Get-StartPath)) { @{ Text = 'Start ' + $w; Kind = 'primary'; Act = { & $ui.StartApp } } } else { $null })
      & $ui.SetCard @{ View = 'done'; Light = 'pass'; Tick = $true; KickColor = 'GreenInk'; Strong = $true
        Kicker = $(if (($dep -and -not $inst) -or $n -ne $all) { 'Passed' } else { $(if ($n -eq 1) { 'The step passed' } else { 'All ' + $n + ' steps passed' }) })
        Sentence = $(if (-not $dep) { 'Round ' + $round + ' is done.' } elseif ($inst) { $w + ' ' + $script:app.Version + ' is installed.' } else { 'The run passed, but version ' + $script:app.Version + ' is not recorded as installed.' })
        P = @(((& $ui.Counted $n 'step') + ' and ' + (& $ui.Counted $m 'check') + ' passed in ' + $ui.Took + '.'), $(if ($dep -and -not $inst) { 'Some steps were off or skipped. Run again with every step on.' } else { '' }), $(if ($dep) { 'Nothing was sent. The report stays on this computer.' } else { $ui.Mail }), $made, $iconNote)
        Buttons = @(@{ Text = 'Open results folder'; Act = { & $ui.Open } }, @{ Text = 'Copy summary'; Act = { & $ui.Copy } }, @{ Text = 'Close'; Kind = $(if ($startB) { '' } else { 'primary' }); Act = { $ui.Form.Close() } }, $startB)
        Test = (-not $dep) } }
    $ui.VStepFail = {
      <#
      .SYNOPSIS
      Shows the step-failed card (Cards v2): the kicker "STEP k OF n FAILED" with a cross, both in the error color; the
      headline "A step failed: <step title>."; what happened; the boxed WHAT TO DO line; the help line; "Try again (Enter)"
      (the Ready card, which offers Resume), "Copy summary" and "Close".
      .PARAMETER Row
      The row of the step in $ui.RunList.
      .PARAMETER K
      Its number in the run.
      .PARAMETER Line
      Its result line from the summary.
      .PARAMETER What
      Its "What to do:" line ('' when it has none).
      .PARAMETER More
      How many more steps failed or need review.
      .OUTPUTS
      Nothing.
      #>
      param($Row, [int]$K, [string]$Line, [string]$What, [int]$More)
      $dep = Test-Deploy; $said = $Line.Substring([math]::Min($Line.Length, ([string]$Row.Key).Length + 2))
      $what = ($said -replace '^(FAILED|NEEDS REVIEW)[^:]*:\s*', '').Trim(); if ($what) { $said = $what }   # what happened, without the state word and the time (Cards v2)
      & $ui.SetCard @{ View = 'stepfail'; Light = 'bad'; KickColor = 'Red'; Kicker = ([string][char]0x00D7 + ' Step ' + $K + ' of ' + @($ui.RunList).Count + ' failed')
        Sentence = ('A step failed: ' + [string]$Row.Title + '.'); Todo = ($What -replace '^What to do:\s*', '')
        P = @(($said + $(if ($More) { ' (and ' + $More + ' more in Details)' } else { '' })), (& $ui.BlockedText), $(if ($dep) { '' } else { $ui.Mail })); Help = (Get-HelpLine)
        Buttons = @(@{ Text = 'Copy summary'; Act = { & $ui.Copy } }, @{ Text = 'Close'; Act = { $ui.Form.Close() } }, @{ Text = 'Try again'; Kind = 'primary'; Act = { & $ui.VReady } })
        Test = (-not $dep) } }
    # Shows the Paused card (the PFM, 2026-11-20): the sign-in failed in a step (the CAC is out), so the round paused at that
    # step; Resume runs it again. Takes the reason ("INTERRUPTED: ..."); does nothing when the window is closing.
    $ui.VPaused = { param([string]$Why)
      if ($script:closing -or $ui.Form.IsDisposed) { return }
      $p1 = (($Why.Substring(13) -replace '\. Insert your CAC, then select Resume$', '') -replace '^t', 'T') + '.'
      & $ui.SetCard @{ View = 'stopped'; Kicker = 'Paused'; Right = 'Paused'; Sentence = 'Insert your CAC, then select Resume.'
        P = @($p1, 'The steps that passed stay done. Resume runs this step again.'); Back = { & $ui.VReady }
        Buttons = @(@{ Text = 'Resume'; Kind = 'primary'; Act = { & $ui.ResumeRun } }, @{ Text = 'Copy the log'; Act = { & $ui.Copy } }, @{ Text = 'Close'; Act = { $ui.Form.Close() } }) }
      & $ui.ToFront }
    # Shows the Stopped card with why the run stopped and what to do. Takes the reason and the help text; does nothing when
    # the window is closing.
    $ui.VStopped = { param([string]$Why, [string]$What)
      if ($script:closing -or $ui.Form.IsDisposed) { return }
      $dep = Test-Deploy
      if ($Why -match '^INTERRUPTED: ') { & $ui.VPaused $Why; return }   # the sign-in failed (CAC out): Paused, not Stopped
      & $ui.SetCard @{ View = 'stopped'; Light = 'bad'; Kicker = 'Stopped'; Right = 'Stopped'; Sentence = $(if ($dep) { 'The install stopped.' } else { 'The round stopped.' })
        P = @(($Why.Substring(0, 1).ToUpperInvariant() + $Why.Substring(1)), $What, 'The report in the results folder says STOPPED.'); Help = $(if ($dep) { Get-HelpLine } else { '' })
        Buttons = @(@{ Text = 'Copy the log'; Kind = 'primary'; Act = { & $ui.Copy } }, @{ Text = 'Try again'; Act = { & $ui.VReady } }, @{ Text = 'Close'; Act = { $ui.Form.Close() } }); Back = { & $ui.VReady } }
      & $ui.ToFront }
    $ui.OkBox.Add_CheckedChanged({ if (-not $ui.OkBox.Checked) { & $ui.Say1 'Select "Make e-mail draft" to make a draft that says "Window: NOT OK".' } elseif ($ui.Note.Text -match '^Select "Make e-mail draft"') { & $ui.Say1 '' } })   # ticking again removes only this note
    $ui.DraftB.Add_Click({
      $to = $ui.ToBox.Text.Trim()
      if ($to -and -not (Test-MailTo $to)) { & $ui.Say1 'The e-mail address does not look right.'; return }
      try { $null = Save-MailTo (Get-BasePath) $to } catch { $null = $_ }
      $why = Save-RoundDraft $script:resultsDir $ui.Summary $to (& $ui.WindowLine)
      & $ui.Say1 $(if ($why) { 'The Outlook draft could not be created (' + $why + ').' } else { 'The Outlook draft is open.' }) })

    # ==== Engine part: engine/ps/window/08-hand-step.ps1 (sha256 82dcc1edc2c6)
    # RADE window part 08, a hand step: the cards for a step the user does by hand (It failed, questions,
    # open the address) and $script:guideUi, which the engine waits in until the user answers.
    # Joined into every bundle by engine/rade_build.py; Windows PowerShell 5.1.

    # ---- A step you do by hand, or a check you answer by looking (R13, R14, R18): the card holds the numbered lines, the
    # address (it can be changed; it is remembered in Config), the file path on the clipboard, and the answers. The engine
    # waits in $script:guideUi until an answer is set: OK = Done or Yes, No, Abort = It failed (with the error text),
    # Cancel = Skip, Not now, or the window closed. Enter = Done (plan engine-v48 step 4; before: a click only).
    $ui.VHand = {
      $st = $ui.G.Step; $file = [string]$ui.G.File; $hide = @($st.Hide)
      $clip = $(if (-not $file) { '' } elseif (Copy-TextToClipboard $file) { 'The path of ' + $st.File + ' is on the clipboard.' } else { 'Select "Copy file path" to put the path of ' + $st.File + ' on the clipboard.' })
      $two = $(if ($st.NoText) { @{ Text = [string]$st.NoText; Act = { $ui.Answer = 'No' } } } else { @{ Text = 'It failed'; Act = { & $ui.VHandFail } } })
      # R28 N1: the address row only when the step has an address (or a saved one it can take); N6: the file's full path on the card.
      $addr = [bool]($ui.GUrl -or $st.UrlConfig); $dw = $(if ($st.DoneText) { [string]$st.DoneText } else { 'Done' })
      # E1 (the Administrator, 2026-11-19): the step's "hide" takes buttons off the card; one button always stays (the build checks it).
      $one = @{ Text = $dw; Kind = 'primary'; Act = { $ui.Answer = 'OK' } }; $three = @{ Text = $(if ($st.SkipText) { [string]$st.SkipText } else { 'Skip' }); Act = { $ui.Answer = 'Cancel' } }
      $bs = @($(if ($hide -notcontains 'done') { $one }), $(if ($hide -notcontains 'skip') { $three }), $(if ($hide -notcontains 'failed') { $two }))   # Cards v2: Done, then Skip and It failed
      $close = $(if ($hide -contains 'done') { '' } elseif ($addr) { 'When you finish in the browser, come back to this window and select "' + $dw + '".' } else { 'When you finish, select "' + $dw + '".' })
      & $ui.SetCard @{ View = 'hand'; Light = 'you'; Kicker = $(if ($ui.Running -and $ui.StepI) { 'Step ' + $ui.StepI + ' of ' + $ui.StepN } else { '' }); Sentence = (Get-StepTitle $st)
        P = @([string]$st.Note); Lines = @($st.Guide); Close = $close
        Field = $(if ($addr) { @{ Label = 'Address'; Text = $ui.GUrl; Name = 'Address to open'; Button = 'Open in browser'; Act = { & $ui.OpenUrl } } } else { $null }); Path = $file; Links = [bool]$file; Note = $clip
        Buttons = $bs; BoxNoEnter = $true; Focus = $(if ($addr) { 'main' } else { 'text' }) } }   # Cards v2 (critique change 3): Enter = Done ("Done (Enter)"): the focus is on Done (a focused button takes Enter itself)
    # Shows the card where the user pastes the error of a hand step that failed; its button sets the answer to Abort. Takes
    # nothing.
    $ui.VHandFail = {
      & $ui.SetCard @{ View = 'handfail'; Light = 'you'; Kicker = 'It failed'; Sentence = 'What did the error say?'; P = @('Paste the error message here. Do not include names or a site address.'); Err = $true
        Buttons = @(@{ Text = 'Report the failure'; Kind = 'primary'; Act = { $script:guideError = [string]$ui.ErrBox.Text; $ui.Answer = 'Abort' } }); Back = { & $ui.VHand }; NoAccept = $true; Focus = 'err' } }
    # A question of a hand step (manifest "answers"), after Done: the prompt is the sentence; yes/no and pick answer with
    # one button per word, a text with one line (10,000 characters at most; empty is allowed; R28: kept whole) and "Continue". No Back.
    $ui.ReplyActs = @({ $ui.Reply = [string]$ui.B[0].Text }, { $ui.Reply = [string]$ui.B[1].Text }, { $ui.Reply = [string]$ui.B[2].Text }, { $ui.Reply = [string]$ui.B[3].Text })
    $ui.VAnswer = {
      <#
      .SYNOPSIS
      Shows one question of a hand step (text, yes or no, or a pick). The first sentence of the prompt is the headline.
      .DESCRIPTION
      Yes / no and a pick answer with one plain button per choice. When a choice does not fit the widest button (E5, R42
      plan; $ui.AnswerFits), each choice is a full-width choice row instead, so no answer text is cut. A text question has
      the box "Your answer" and "Continue". No Back.
      .PARAMETER Q
      The question (Kind, Prompt, Choices).
      .PARAMETER I
      Its number.
      .PARAMETER N
      The count of questions.
      .OUTPUTS
      None; the answer is set in $ui.Reply.
      #>
      param($Q, [int]$I, [int]$N)
      $ui.Reply = $null
      $c = @{ View = 'answer'; Light = 'you'; Kicker = ($(if ($ui.Running -and $ui.StepI) { 'Step ' + $ui.StepI + ' of ' + $ui.StepN + $dot } else { '' }) + 'Question ' + $I + ' of ' + $N); Sentence = [string]$Q.Prompt }
      # The prompt's first sentence (up to the first "?", "." or ":" followed by a space or the end) is the headline; the rest
      # is a body line under it (the Administrator, 2026-11-15, rework B). A first sentence too long for one line shrinks ($ui.FitSent).
      if ([string]$Q.Prompt -match '^(.+?[?.:])(?:\s+(\S.*))?$') { $c.Sentence = $Matches[1]; if ($Matches[2]) { $c.P = @($Matches[2].Trim()) } }
      if ($Q.Kind -eq 'text') { $c.Field = @{ Label = 'Your answer'; Text = ''; Name = [string]$Q.Prompt; Max = 10000; Above = $true }
        $c.Focus = 'field'; $c.Buttons = @(@{ Text = 'Continue'; Kind = 'primary'; Act = { $ui.Reply = [string]$ui.Field.Text } }) }
      else { $ws = @($(if ($Q.Kind -eq 'yesno') { 'Yes', 'No' } else { $Q.Choices })); $ui.AnswerWords = @($ws | ForEach-Object { [string]$_ })
        if (& $ui.AnswerFits $ws) { $c.Buttons = @(for ($k = 0; $k -lt $ws.Count; $k++) { @{ Text = [string]$ws[$k]; Act = $ui.ReplyActs[$k] } }) }
        else {   # E5 (R41: "needs 416 has 360"): a choice too long for the widest button; each choice is a full-width row, no text is cut
          $c.Options = @(for ($k = 0; $k -lt $ws.Count; $k++) { @{ Index = $k; Name = [string]$ws[$k]; Ver = '' } })
          # A click on choice row j answers with that choice's own text. Takes the row's index.
          $c.OnOption = { param($j) $ui.Reply = [string]$ui.AnswerWords[$j] }
          $c.P = @(@($c.P) + @('You cannot change the answer after the click. Click the row with your answer. You then see the next card.') | Where-Object { $_ }) } }
      & $ui.SetCard $c }
    # Says whether every answer choice fits the widest action button (UI standard v1, B1: 240 x 40), measured in the button
    # font with the button's padding, as $ui.BtnSize measures it. Takes the choices; gives back $true or $false.
    $ui.AnswerFits = { param($Words)
      $max = & $ui.Sc $ui.Z.WideW; $pad = & $ui.Sc (2 * $ui.Z.G2)
      foreach ($w in @($Words)) { try { if ([int][System.Windows.Forms.TextRenderer]::MeasureText([string]$w, $ui.F.SmallB).Width + $pad -gt $max) { return $false } } catch { $null = $_ } }   # no measure: buttons, as before
      return $true }
    # E2 (the Administrator, 2026-11-19): after an answer that the manifest marks as a failure ("failOn"), the card where the
    # user pastes the error text. Its button keeps the text in $script:guideError and sets $ui.Reply. No Back. Takes nothing.
    $ui.VAnswerFail = {
      $ui.Reply = $null
      & $ui.SetCard @{ View = 'answerfail'; Light = 'you'; Kicker = ($(if ($ui.Running -and $ui.StepI) { 'Step ' + $ui.StepI + ' of ' + $ui.StepN + $dot } else { '' }) + 'It failed'); Sentence = 'What did the error say?'
        P = @('Paste the error message here. Do not include names or a site address. If there is no message, leave the box empty.'); Err = $true
        Buttons = @(@{ Text = 'Continue'; Kind = 'primary'; Act = { $script:guideError = [string]$ui.ErrBox.Text; $ui.Reply = 'ok' } }); NoAccept = $true; Focus = 'err' } }
    # Waits until the user answers the card that is shown ($ui.Reply is set) or the window closes. Takes nothing.
    $ui.WaitReply = { while ($null -eq $ui.Reply -and -not $script:closing -and -not $ui.Form.IsDisposed) { [System.Windows.Forms.Application]::DoEvents(); Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 25 } }
    # Asks the questions of a hand step, one card each, in order; a question with "showIf" shows only after one of its
    # answers to the earlier question (E3). Keeps the answers in $script:guideAnswers and the answers that mean a failure
    # in $script:guideFail; after the first of those it asks for the error text. Takes the step; gives back nothing.
    $ui.AskAnswers = { param($Step)
      $qs = @($Step.Answers | Where-Object { $_ })
      for ($i = 0; $i -lt $qs.Count -and -not $script:closing -and -not $ui.Form.IsDisposed; $i++) {
        $q = $qs[$i]; if ($q.ShowKey -and @($q.ShowIn) -cnotcontains [string]$script:guideAnswers[[string]$q.ShowKey]) { continue }
        $null = & $ui.VAnswer $q ($i + 1) $qs.Count; $null = & $ui.WaitReply
        if ($null -eq $ui.Reply) { return }
        $v = [string]$ui.Reply; $script:guideAnswers[[string]$q.Key] = $v
        if (@($q.FailOn) -ccontains $v) { $script:guideFail += ([string]$q.Key + ': ' + $v); if (@($script:guideFail).Count -eq 1) { $null = & $ui.VAnswerFail; $null = & $ui.WaitReply } }
      } }
    # Opens the address in the box in the browser and remembers it (also in its file). Takes nothing; says so when the
    # address does not start with https://, or is not on the host of the step's own address (the Administrator, 2026-11-17).
    $ui.OpenUrl = {
      $u = $ui.Field.Text.Trim()
      if ($u -notmatch '^https://') { & $ui.Say1 'The address must start with https://'; return }
      $fixed = [string]$ui.G.Step.Url
      if (-not $fixed) { & $ui.Say1 'This step gives no address of its own, so RADE cannot open one from here.'; return }
      if (-not (Test-SameHost $u $fixed)) { & $ui.Say1 ('The address must be on ' + ([uri]$fixed).Host + ', like the address this step gives.'); return }
      $ui.GUrl = $u; try { if ($ui.G.UrlFile) { Set-Content -LiteralPath $ui.G.UrlFile -Value $u -Encoding UTF8 } } catch { $null = $_ }
      try { Start-Process -FilePath $u; & $ui.Say1 'Opened in your browser. Do the steps on this card, then come back to this window.' } catch { & $ui.Say1 ('The browser could not be opened: ' + $_.Exception.Message) } }
    $ui.CopyPathB.Add_Click({ & $ui.Say1 $(if (Copy-TextToClipboard ([string]$ui.G.File)) { 'File path copied. Press Ctrl+V in the "File name" box' } else { 'The clipboard is busy. Select "Copy file path" again.' }) })
    $ui.PageB.Add_Click({ try { Start-Process -FilePath $radeUrl } catch { & $ui.Say1 'The browser could not be opened. Open the RADE page from your bookmarks.' } })
    $ui.ShowFileB.Add_Click({ if ($ui.G.File) { Start-Process -FilePath 'explorer.exe' -ArgumentList ('/select,"' + $ui.G.File + '"') } })
    # Shows a hand step and waits until the user answers, then asks the step's questions; a step with "answersOnly" shows its
    # questions at once (E2). Takes the step, the file path, the address and the address file; gives back OK, Abort or Cancel.
    $script:guideUi = { param($Step, [string]$File, [string]$Url, [string]$UrlFile)
      $ui.G = @{ Step = $Step; File = $File; UrlFile = $UrlFile }; $ui.GUrl = $Url; $script:guideError = ''; $ui.Answer = ''; $was = $ui.Busy; $ui.Busy = $false
      $script:guideAnswers = @{}; $script:guideFail = @()
      if ($Step.AnswersOnly) { $ui.Answer = 'OK'; $null = & $ui.ToFront }
      else { $null = & $ui.VHand; $null = & $ui.ToFront
        while (-not $ui.Answer -and -not $script:closing -and -not $ui.Form.IsDisposed) { [System.Windows.Forms.Application]::DoEvents(); Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 25 } }
      # After Done (not after "It failed" or Skip): the step's questions, one card each, in order. Their time is the step's time.
      if ($ui.Answer -eq 'OK') { $null = & $ui.AskAnswers $Step }
      $ui.Busy = $was; $res = [string]$ui.Answer; if (-not $res) { $res = 'Cancel' }
      if ($Step.AnswersOnly -and ($script:closing -or $ui.Form.IsDisposed)) { $res = 'Cancel' }   # the window closed before the last answer
      $ui.Guides = @($ui.Guides | Where-Object { $_ -ne [string]$Step.Name })
      if ($ui.Running -and -not $script:closing) { $null = & $ui.ShowRun }
      return $res }
    # L4 (the Administrator, 2026-11-19): the last card of a test round, "Anything else about this round or the app?". The
    # text is optional and takes up to 10,000 characters, like every text answer (R34, R7); a pasted block becomes one line ($ui.PasteLine); the engine puts it into the report under the line "Other feedback:" (Get-RoundFeedback). Takes
    # nothing; waits for Continue; gives back the text ('' when the window closed).
    $script:feedbackUi = {
      $null = & $ui.HoldStep   # L8: the last step stays on the Run card for its minimum time first
      $was = $ui.Busy; $ui.Busy = $false; $ui.Reply = $null; $ui.Asked = $true
      $null = & $ui.SetCard @{ View = 'feedback'; Light = 'you'; Kicker = 'Last question'; Sentence = 'Anything else about this round or the app?'
        P = @('This is optional. Do not type names or addresses.'); Field = @{ Label = 'Your answer'; Text = ''; Name = 'Anything else about this round or the app?'; Max = 10000; Above = $true }; Focus = 'field'
        Buttons = @(@{ Text = 'Continue'; Kind = 'primary'; Act = { $ui.Reply = [string]$ui.Field.Text } }) }
      $null = & $ui.ToFront; $null = & $ui.WaitReply
      $ui.Busy = $was; $text = [string]$ui.Reply
      if ($ui.Running -and -not $script:closing) { $null = & $ui.ShowRun }
      return $text }
    # ---- Feedback on every card (UI standard v1, B13; the Administrator, 2026-11-20). In a test round the bottom line has the
    # link "Feedback" ($ui.FeedB) on every card. It takes a picture of the window as it is (Control.DrawToBitmap of the form),
    # then shows a card with a comment box; Save writes the comment (masked as a text answer is) and the picture as
    # feedback-NN.txt and feedback-NN.png into Rounds\<round>\Feedback, then shows the card it came from again. Feedback is a
    # subfolder of the round's results folder: the e-mail draft attaches only the files at the top of the results folder, and
    # the picture shows the real profile path (DoD365 boundary, AGENTS.md "Project rules"), so it stays on this computer.
    # Gives back $true when the bundle's chosen (or only) application is a test one: the link shows then. Takes nothing.
    $ui.NoteOn = { try { if ($ui.Picked) { return [bool](-not (Test-Deploy)) }; return [bool](@($apps | Where-Object { [string]$_.Mode -ne 'deploy' }).Count) } catch { return $false } }   # no answer: no link
    $ui.NoNoteViews = @('note')
    $ui.VNote = {
      <#
      .SYNOPSIS
      Shows the feedback card for the card on screen, with a picture of the window taken first.
      .DESCRIPTION
      Does nothing while RADE is busy or a run is on (the Run card keeps updating), in the Record and on the feedback card
      itself. The picture is kept in $ui.NoteShot until Save or Back; no picture (a host that cannot draw the form) is allowed.
      .OUTPUTS
      Nothing.
      #>
      if ($ui.Busy -or $ui.Running -or $ui.RecOn -or -not $ui.CardNow -or [string]$ui.View -in $ui.NoNoteViews) { return }
      try { if ($ui.NoteShot) { $ui.NoteShot.Dispose() } } catch { $null = $_ }   # an old picture (the card was left by F1, F2 or Close)
      $ui.NoteFor = $ui.CardNow; $ui.NoteShot = $null; $ui.NoteKeep = @{ Field = [string]$ui.Field.Text; Err = [string]$ui.ErrBox.Text }   # typed text comes back
      try { $w = [int]$ui.Form.Width; $h = [int]$ui.Form.Height; $bm = New-Object System.Drawing.Bitmap($w, $h)
        $ui.Form.DrawToBitmap($bm, (New-Object System.Drawing.Rectangle(0, 0, $w, $h))); $ui.NoteShot = $bm } catch { $null = $_ }   # no picture: the comment alone
      & $ui.SetCard @{ View = 'note'; Kicker = 'Feedback'; Sentence = 'What do you want to tell us about this card?'
        P = @('RADE saves your comment and a picture of the window in the Feedback folder of this round. They stay on this computer and are not attached to the results e-mail.', 'Do not type names or addresses.'); Err = $true
        Buttons = @(@{ Text = 'Save'; Kind = 'primary'; Act = { & $ui.Say1 (& $ui.SaveNote ([string]$ui.ErrBox.Text)); & $ui.NoteBack $false } }); Back = { & $ui.NoteBack $true }; NoAccept = $true; Focus = 'err' } }
    $ui.SaveNote = {
      <#
      .SYNOPSIS
      Writes one feedback comment and the picture of $ui.NoteShot into Rounds\<round>\Feedback (UI standard v1, B13).
      .DESCRIPTION
      The files are feedback-NN.txt (the card, the time, the window size and scale, then the comment, masked as a text answer
      is) and feedback-NN.png; NN is the first number not yet used. A picture that cannot be saved leaves the comment saved.
      .PARAMETER Text
      The comment as typed.
      .OUTPUTS
      The line the card shows: what was saved, or why nothing could be saved (masked).
      #>
      param([string]$Text)
      try { $dir = Join-Path (Join-Path (Join-Path (Get-BasePath) 'Rounds') $round) 'Feedback'
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir -PathType Container)) { $null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force -ErrorAction Stop }
        $n = 1; while (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir ('feedback-{0:D2}.txt' -f $n))) { $n++ }; $stem = 'feedback-{0:D2}' -f $n
        $win = [string]$ui.Form.ClientSize.Width + ' x ' + $ui.Form.ClientSize.Height + ' at ' + [int][math]::Round($ui.Dpi / 96.0 * 100) + ' %' + $(if ($ui.High) { ', contrast theme' } else { '' })
        $lines = @(('Card: ' + [string]$ui.NoteFor.View), ('Time: ' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm')), ('Window: ' + $win), '', (ConvertTo-UserText $Text))
        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $dir ($stem + '.txt')), (($lines -join "`r`n") + "`r`n"), (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($true)))
        $pic = ''; $png = ('System.Drawing.Imaging.ImageFormat' -as [type])
        if ($ui.NoteShot) { try { $ui.NoteShot.Save((Join-Path $dir ($stem + '.png')), $png::Png); $pic = ' and its picture' } catch { $null = $_ } }   # no picture file: the comment is saved
        return ('Feedback saved: ' + $stem + $pic + ' in the Feedback folder of round ' + $round + '.')
      } catch { return ('The feedback could not be saved: ' + (ConvertTo-Masked ([string]$_.Exception.Message))) } }
    # Shows the card the feedback came from again and lets the picture go. Takes $true when Back was selected (the note line
    # is cleared then).
    $ui.NoteBack = { param([bool]$Cancel)
      $say = [string]$ui.Note.Text; try { if ($ui.NoteShot) { $ui.NoteShot.Dispose() } } catch { $null = $_ }; $ui.NoteShot = $null   # a picture that is gone: nothing to free
      if ($ui.NoteFor) { & $ui.SetCard $ui.NoteFor; if ($ui.NoteKeep) { $ui.Field.Text = $ui.NoteKeep.Field; $ui.ErrBox.Text = $ui.NoteKeep.Err }; if (-not $Cancel) { & $ui.Say1 $say } } }
    # ==== Engine part: engine/ps/window/09-record.ps1 (sha256 54ca62fdd112)
    # RADE window part 09, the Record (F2): lists the checks, the steps and the log, and closes it again.
    # Builds on the Record parts in 04-record-parts.ps1.
    # Joined into every bundle by engine/rade_build.py; Windows PowerShell 5.1.

    # ---- The Record
    # Returns the text color of a state in the Record (green PASSED, red FAILED or NEEDS REVIEW, ...). Takes the state.
    $ui.StateInk = { param([string]$St) $(if ($St -eq 'PASSED') { $ui.C.GreenInk } elseif ($St -in 'FAILED', 'NEEDS REVIEW') { $ui.C.Red } elseif ($St -in 'WARNING', 'RUNNING') { $ui.C.Navy } else { $ui.C.Gray }) }   # the word is always shown: never color alone
    $ui.RecRows = {
      # The checks to list: the chosen application's, or (before a choice) the base checks. Group, name, state, and the rows under it.
      $ids = $(if ($ui.Picked) { @($script:appChecks) } else { @($ui.BaseIds) }); $rows = @(); $g0 = ''
      foreach ($id in $ids) {
        $d = Get-CheckDef $id; $r = $(if ($ui.Picked) { $script:checkResults[$id] } else { $ui.BaseRes[$id] }); if (-not $r) { $r = @{ State = 'NOT RUN'; Detail = ''; Fix = '' } }
        if ([string]$d.Group -ne $g0) { $g0 = [string]$d.Group; $rows += @{ Head = $g0.ToUpperInvariant() } }
        $nm = [string]$d.Short; if (-not $nm) { $nm = [string]$d.Name }
        $rows += @{ Name = $nm; State = [string]$r.State; More = $(if ($r.State -ne 'PASSED' -or $r.Saved) { @(@($r.Detail, $r.Fix) | Where-Object { $_ }) } else { @(@($r.Detail) | Where-Object { $_ }) }) }   # not passed: what was found, then what to do; reused (Get-SavedCheck): "Last check: 17 Nov 26", then what it found; passed (R33): what it found
      }
      return $rows }
    $ui.RecPlan = { param([int]$w)
      # Where each row of the check list goes. The result word has its own column (as wide as the widest plain result
      # word): no name and no detail enters it. A qualifier ("fallback") goes under the word in gray. A name and each
      # detail wrap to 2 lines at most.
      $h0 = [System.Windows.Forms.TextRenderer]::MeasureText('Ag', $ui.F.Small).Height; $hc = [System.Windows.Forms.TextRenderer]::MeasureText('Ag', $ui.F.SmallB).Height; $v = & $ui.Sc 3
      $sw = 0; foreach ($t in 'NOT RUN', 'WARNING', 'RUNNING', 'PASSED', 'FAILED', 'fallback') { $sw = [math]::Max($sw, [System.Windows.Forms.TextRenderer]::MeasureText($t, $ui.F.SmallB).Width) }
      $sw += & $ui.Sc 4; $lw = [math]::Max((& $ui.Sc 60), ($w - $sw - (& $ui.Sc 8))); $in = & $ui.Sc 12; $y = 0; $rows = @()
      foreach ($r in @($ui.RecData)) {
        if ($r.Head) { $y += & $ui.Sc 8; $rows += @{ R = $r; Y = $y; H = ($h0 + $v) }; $y += $h0 + $v; continue }
        $word = [string]$r.State; $qual = ''; if ($word -match '^(.+?) \((.+)\)$') { $word = $Matches[1]; $qual = $Matches[2] }
        $nh = (& $ui.Rows ([string]$r.Name) $ui.F.Small $lw $h0 2) * $h0 + $v; if ($qual) { $nh = [math]::Max($nh, (2 * $hc + $v)) }
        $more = @(); $my = $y + $nh
        foreach ($m in @($r.More)) { $mh = (& $ui.Rows ([string]$m) $ui.F.Small ($lw - $in) $h0 2) * $h0 + $v; $more += @{ T = [string]$m; Y = $my; H = $mh }; $my += $mh }
        $rows += @{ R = $r; Y = $y; H = $nh; Word = $word; Qual = $qual; More = $more }; $y = $my
      }
      return @{ Rows = $rows; Tall = $y; Sw = $sw; Lw = $lw; In = $in; H0 = $h0; Hc = $hc } }
    $ui.RecChecks.Add_Paint({
      try {
        $g = $_.Graphics; $g.Clear($ui.C.White); $w = $this.ClientSize.Width; $pl = & $ui.RecPlan $w; $sw = $pl.Sw; $lw = $pl.Lw
        $wrap = 'Left, Top, NoPrefix, WordBreak, EndEllipsis, TextBoxControl'
        foreach ($q in @($pl.Rows)) {
          $r = $q.R
          if ($r.Head) { & $ui.Word $g ([string]$r.Head) $ui.F.SmallB $ui.C.Gray 0 $q.Y $w $q.H 'Left, VerticalCenter, NoPrefix, SingleLine'; continue }
          & $ui.Word $g ([string]$r.Name) $ui.F.Small $ui.C.Navy 0 ($q.Y + (& $ui.Sc 1)) $lw ($q.H - (& $ui.Sc 1)) $wrap
          & $ui.Word $g ([string]$q.Word) $ui.F.SmallB (& $ui.StateInk ([string]$q.Word)) ($w - $sw) ($q.Y + (& $ui.Sc 2)) $sw $pl.Hc 'Right, Top, NoPrefix, SingleLine'
          if ($q.Qual) { & $ui.Word $g ([string]$q.Qual) $ui.F.Small $ui.C.Gray ($w - $sw) ($q.Y + (& $ui.Sc 2) + $pl.Hc) $sw $pl.Hc 'Right, Top, NoPrefix, SingleLine' }
          foreach ($m in @($q.More)) { & $ui.Word $g $m.T $ui.F.Small $ui.C.Gray $pl.In ($m.Y + (& $ui.Sc 1)) ($lw - $pl.In) ($m.H - (& $ui.Sc 1)) $wrap }   # what was found, then what to do
        }
      } catch { $null = $_ } })
    # Reads the check results again while the Record is open (R33: a check that ended after F2 still showed NOT RUN). Takes
    # nothing; does nothing when the Record is closed. Called after each check result of the window's check runs.
    $ui.RecRefresh = { if (-not $ui.RecOn) { return }
      try { $ui.RecData = @(& $ui.RecRows); & $ui.RecTall; & $ui.RecName; $ui.RecChecks.Invalidate() } catch { $null = $_ } }   # a form being closed: nothing to redraw
    # Sets the screen-reader text of the check list from $ui.RecData. Takes nothing.
    $ui.RecName = { $ui.RecChecks.AccessibleName = 'Checks. ' + ((@($ui.RecData) | ForEach-Object { if ($_.Head) { $_.Head + ':' } else { $_.Name + ' ' + $_.State + $(if (@($_.More).Count) { ', ' + (@($_.More) -join ', ') } else { '' }) } }) -join '. ') }
    # The whole Record as plain text, for Copy all (R33): the title, each check with its result and its detail lines, each step
    # box with its state, then the text box (files, made list, log). Takes nothing; gives back the text with Windows line ends.
    $ui.RecAll = {
      $t = @([string]$ui.RecTitle.Text, '', 'CHECKS')
      foreach ($r in @($ui.RecData)) { if ($r.Head) { $t += ('  ' + $r.Head) } else { $t += ('    ' + $r.State + ': ' + $r.Name); foreach ($m in @($r.More)) { $t += ('      ' + [string]$m) } } }
      $t += @('', 'STEPS')
      foreach ($c in @($ui.RecSteps.Controls)) {
        if ($c -is [System.Windows.Forms.CheckBox]) { $fu = $ui.Full[$c]; $t += ('  [' + $(if ($c.Checked) { 'x' } else { ' ' }) + '] ' + $(if ($null -ne $fu) { [string]$fu } else { [string]$c.Text })) }
        elseif ([string]$c.Text -and [string]$c.Text -ne 'STEPS') { $t += ('      ' + [string]$c.Text) } }
      $t += ''; $t += @(([string]$ui.RecText.Text) -split "`r?`n")
      return ((@($t) -join "`r`n").TrimEnd() + "`r`n") }
    # Copy all: puts $ui.RecAll on the clipboard and says so on the button until the Record opens again. Takes nothing.
    $ui.RecCopyAll = { try { [System.Windows.Forms.Clipboard]::SetText((& $ui.RecAll)); $ui.RecCopy.Text = 'Copied' } catch { $ui.RecCopy.Text = 'Not copied' } }
    # Sets the height of the check list to the height of its rows. Takes nothing; does nothing before the window has its
    # scale.
    $ui.RecTall = { if (-not $ui.Scaled) { return }; try { $t = (& $ui.RecPlan $ui.RecChecks.ClientSize.Width).Tall + (& $ui.Sc 4); if ($ui.RecChecks.Height -ne $t) { $ui.RecChecks.Height = $t } } catch { $null = $_ } }
    $ui.RecChecks.Add_Resize({ if ($ui.RecOn -and [int]$ui.RecW -ne [int]$this.ClientSize.Width) { $ui.RecW = [int]$this.ClientSize.Width; & $ui.RecTall }; $this.Invalidate() })
    # The step list: a label or a long step name wraps at the column's width, also after the window changes its size.
    $ui.RecFit = { if (-not $ui.Scaled) { return }; try { $mw = [math]::Max((& $ui.Sc 120), ($ui.RecSteps.ClientSize.Width - (& $ui.Sc 28))); foreach ($l in @($ui.RecSteps.Controls)) { if ($l -is [System.Windows.Forms.CheckBox]) { $fu = $ui.Full[$l]; if ($null -ne $fu) { & $ui.Shorten $l ([string]$fu) $mw }; $l.Size = New-Object System.Drawing.Size($mw, $l.PreferredSize.Height) } else { $l.MaximumSize = New-Object System.Drawing.Size($mw, 0) } } } catch { $null = $_ } }   # a step box is one line, as wide as the column, and ends with "..." when its text is longer
    $ui.RecSteps.Add_SizeChanged({ & $ui.RecFit })
    & $ui.Ring $ui.RecSteps; & $ui.Ring $ui.Rec; & $ui.Cue $ui.RecText   # focus is always visible: the step boxes and the text box too
    # Opens the Record (F2): every check, the step boxes, the files, the made list and the log, sized to its rows.
    $ui.VRecord = {
      & $ui.Check
      if ($ui.View -eq 'ready' -and -not $ui.Running) { $ui.Edit = $true }   # B7 (UI standard v1): the Record is a link only; opened from Ready, its boxes can change
      $ui.RecOn = $true; $ui.RecData = @(& $ui.RecRows)
      $ui.RecW = 0; & $ui.RecTall   # as tall as its rows (the same plan as the Paint handler)
      & $ui.RecName; $ui.RecCopy.Text = 'Copy all'
      $old = @($ui.RecSteps.Controls); $ui.RecSteps.Controls.Clear(); foreach ($o in $old) { $o.Dispose() }; $ui.Full = @{}
      # Adds one label to the Steps part of the Record. Takes the text, the font and the color; gives back nothing.
      $mk = { param([string]$Text, $Font, $Color) $l = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Label; $l.AutoSize = $true; $l.UseMnemonic = $false; $l.MaximumSize = New-Object System.Drawing.Size(([math]::Max((& $ui.Sc 120), $ui.RecSteps.ClientSize.Width - (& $ui.Sc 24))), 0); $l.Text = $Text; $l.Font = $Font; $l.ForeColor = $Color; $l.Margin = (& $ui.Pad (& $ui.Sc 5) 0 0 (& $ui.Sc 6)); [void]$ui.RecSteps.Controls.Add($l) }
      & $mk 'STEPS' $ui.F.SmallB $ui.C.Gray
      if (-not $ui.Picked) { & $mk 'Choose an application first.' $ui.F.Small $ui.C.Gray }
      else {
        if (-not $ui.Edit) { & $mk $(if ($ui.Running) { 'The run has started: the boxes are locked.' } else { 'To change the boxes, go to "Ready" and select "Details (F2)".' }) $ui.F.Small $ui.C.Gray }
        $list = @(); if ($cleanup.Count) { $list += -1 }; $list += @($script:appSteps); $n = 0
        foreach ($k in $list) {
          $cb = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.CheckBox
          $cb.AutoSize = $false; $cb.UseMnemonic = $false; $cb.Margin = (& $ui.Pad (& $ui.Sc 5) (& $ui.Sc 4) (& $ui.Sc 4) (& $ui.Sc 4)); & $ui.Cue $cb; $cb.Enabled = [bool]$ui.Edit; $cb.Tag = [int]$k; $cb.Font = $ui.F.SmallB; $cb.ForeColor = $ui.C.Navy
          if ($k -lt 0) { $cb.Text = 'Clean-up'; $cb.Checked = [bool]$ui.Clean; $more = 'Moves finished files to the Recycle Bin' }
          else {
            $n++; $s1 = $steps[$k]; $cb.Checked = [bool]$ui.Sel[[int]$k]
            $cb.Text = [string]$n + '  ' + (Get-StepTitle $s1) + $(if ($s1.AskParam) { '  (asks for a folder)' } elseif ($s1.Kind -eq 'guide') { '  (needs you)' } else { '' })
            $more = $(if ($ui.StepState[[int]$k]) { [string]$ui.StepState[[int]$k] } elseif ((Test-Deploy) -and -not [bool]$s1.Optional -and -not (Get-StepDefault $k)) { 'Already done for version ' + $script:app.Version + '. Tick the box to run it again' } else { [string]$s1.Note })
          }
          $cb.AccessibleName = $cb.Text + $(if ($more) { '. ' + $more } else { '' }); $ui.Full[$cb] = [string]$cb.Text   # the full name; the box may show it shortened ($ui.RecFit)
          $cb.Add_CheckedChanged({ if ([int]$this.Tag -lt 0) { $ui.Clean = [bool]$this.Checked } else { $ui.Sel[[int]$this.Tag] = [bool]$this.Checked } })
          [void]$ui.RecSteps.Controls.Add($cb)
          if ($more) { & $mk $more $ui.F.Small (& $ui.StateInk $more) }
        }
      }
      $t = @()
      if ($ui.Picked) {
        if (-not $ui.Plan) { $ui.Plan = Get-RoundPlan }
        $t += $ui.Plan.Lines
        if (Test-Deploy) { $ml = @(Get-MadeLine); if ($ml.Count) { $t += ''; $t += $ml } else { $t += @('', 'The installs of this application have made nothing yet.') } }
      }
      if ($ui.Log.Count -or $ui.Running) { $t += @('', 'LOG'); $t += @($ui.Log) }
      $ui.RecText.Text = ($t -join "`r`n") + "`r`n"   # ends with a line break: a live log line is added below
      $ui.RecTitle.Text = 'Details' + $(if ($ui.Picked) { $dot + $script:app.Name } else { '' })
      & $ui.RecFit
      $ui.Card.Visible = $false; $ui.Rec.Visible = $true; & $ui.RecTall; $ui.RecChecks.Invalidate(); $ui.RecB.Visible = $false; $ui.TourB.Visible = $false; $ui.BackB.Visible = $false; $ui.FeedB.Visible = $false
      try { [void]$ui.RecClose.Focus() } catch { $null = $_ } }
    # Closes the Record and shows the card again; redraws the ready card when a step box was changed. Takes nothing.
    $ui.CloseRecord = {
      & $ui.Check
      $ui.RecOn = $false; $ui.Rec.Visible = $false; $ui.Card.Visible = $true; $ui.RecB.Visible = $true; $ui.TourB.Visible = ($ui.HelpViews -contains [string]$ui.View); $ui.BackOn = [bool]$ui.Back; $ui.BackB.Visible = $ui.BackOn; $ui.BtnRow.Visible = [bool](@($ui.BOn | Where-Object { $_ }).Count -or $ui.BackOn); & $ui.Apart; $ui.FeedB.Visible = [bool]((& $ui.NoteOn) -and [string]$ui.View -notin $ui.NoNoteViews)
      if ($ui.Edit) { $ui.Edit = $false; if ($ui.View -eq 'ready') { & $ui.VReady } }   # the plan line follows the boxes
      try { [void]$ui.RecB.Focus() } catch { $null = $_ } }
    $ui.RecB.Add_Click({ & $ui.VRecord })
    $ui.FeedB.Add_Click({ if (& $ui.Settled) { & $ui.VNote } })   # B13: the feedback card for the card on screen
    $ui.RecClose.Add_Click({ & $ui.CloseRecord })
    $ui.RecCopy.Add_Click({ & $ui.RecCopyAll })
    $ui.BackB.Add_Click({ if ((& $ui.Settled) -and $ui.Back -and -not $ui.RecOn -and -not $ui.Busy -and -not $ui.Running) { & $ui.Back } })

    # ==== Engine part: engine/ps/window/11-tools.ps1 (sha256 49d6b7bcf9dd)
    # RADE window part 11, the Maintenance tools on the Maintenance card (the Administrator, 2026-11-20; one card from engine-v47): a click on the
    # Diagnose or the Back up row runs it (engine/ps/13-maintenance.ps1), with a card while it runs and a card with its result.
    # Restore (engine-v31, the Administrator, 2026-11-21): pick a backup, the dry-run card with its counts, the typed app
    # name, then the write and its result card. The local test-site mark (engine-v32, the Administrator, 2026-11-21): for an
    # app with "testSites": "local", a card where the person types the site name marks the saved site as a test site; the
    # backup card has "Remove test-site mark" (engine-v33).
    # Listed before 10-keys.ps1 in engine/rade_build.py (that part shows the form).
    # Network: none here (parts 13 and 14 name what each tool reaches).
    # Writes: the mark file, from the mark card, and its removal (Save-RestoreMark, Clear-RestoreMark, engine/ps/15-restore-run.ps1).
    # Credentials: none.
    # Joined into every bundle by engine/rade_build.py; Windows PowerShell 5.1.

    # The line on a card while a child may show the CAC sign-in window (R44 E4: in R43 no sign-in window showed in front).
    $ui.SignInHint = 'A sign-in window may open. If you do not see it, press Alt+Tab.'

    # The tool rows of the Maintenance card (indexes 0 to 2). Diagnose and Back up (engine-v30); Restore (engine-v31) for an app that names it.
    $ui.ToolRows = {
      $n = @($script:app.Backup).Count; $lists = $(if ($n -eq 1) { '1 list' } elseif ($n) { [string]$n + ' lists' } else { 'No lists named' })
      # Short texts and facts (engine-v47, review of PR 209): each row is one line on the Maintenance card, with 2 lines at most
      # for its text, also at 150 % and in a narrow window (the PFM, 2026-11-26: no cut text).
      @(@{ Index = 0; Name = 'Diagnose'; Ver = ''; Sub = 'Checks the install. Changes nothing.'; R1 = 'Writes a report' },
        @{ Index = 1; Name = 'Back up'; Ver = ''; Sub = 'Saves the lists to this computer.'; R1 = $lists },
        $(if ($script:app.Restore) { @{ Index = 2; Name = 'Restore'; Ver = ''; Sub = 'Puts missing rows back. Test sites only.'; R1 = 'Changes the site' } }
          else { @{ Off = $true; Index = 2; Name = 'Restore'; Ver = ''; Sub = 'Puts missing rows back from a backup.'; R1 = 'Not set up'; Soon = $true } })) }

    $ui.RunTool = {
      <#
      .SYNOPSIS
      Runs one Maintenance tool from its row: a card while it runs, then the result card.
      .PARAMETER J
      The row: 0 Diagnose, 1 Back up, 2 Restore (its first card: $ui.VRestorePick).
      #>
      param([int]$J)
      if ($J -eq 2 -and -not $ui.Busy) { & $ui.VRestorePick; return }
      if ($J -notin 0, 1 -or $ui.Busy) { return }
      $name = $(if ($J -eq 0) { 'Diagnose' } else { 'Back up' })
      $what = $(if ($J -eq 0) { 'Read-only. Nothing is changed.' } else { 'Reads the lists and saves them on this computer. Nothing on the site changes. ' + $ui.SignInHint })
      & $ui.SetCard @{ View = 'toolrun'; Kicker = [string]$ui.Kick.Text; Sentence = ($name + ' is running.'); P = @($what) }
      $ui.Busy = $true; [System.Windows.Forms.Application]::DoEvents(); $res = $null
      try { $bp = Get-BasePath
        if ($J -eq 0) { $res = Invoke-Diagnose $bp { [System.Windows.Forms.Application]::DoEvents() } } else { $res = Invoke-Backup $bp { [System.Windows.Forms.Application]::DoEvents() } } }
      catch { $res = @{ State = 'failed'; Findings = 1; Path = ''; Lines = @(($name + ' stopped with an error [' + $_.Exception.GetType().Name + '].'), 'Nothing was changed. Select it again.') } }
      finally { $ui.Busy = $false }
      if ($ui.Form.IsDisposed -or $script:closing) { return }
      & $ui.ToolResult $name $res }

    $ui.ToolResult = {
      <#
      .SYNOPSIS
      Shows the result card of a Maintenance tool: what it found, saved or put back, and the file or folder it wrote.
      .PARAMETER Name
      The tool: Diagnose, Back up or Restore.
      .PARAMETER Res
      Its result: Invoke-Diagnose (Lines, Path, Findings), Invoke-Backup or Invoke-Restore (State, Lines, Path).
      #>
      param([string]$Name, $Res)
      $diag = ($Name -eq 'Diagnose'); $bad = $(if ($diag) { [int]$Res.Findings -gt 0 } else { [string]$Res.State -in 'failed', 'refused', 'changed', 'unmark-failed', 'no-backup', 'review' })
      $st = [string]$Res.State
      $sent = $(if ($diag -and $bad) { 'Diagnose found ' + $Res.Findings + ' thing(s) to fix.' } elseif ($diag) { 'Diagnose found nothing to fix.' }
        elseif ($Name -eq 'Restore') { $(switch ($st) { 'done' { 'Restore put the missing rows back.' } 'refused' { 'Restore cannot run here.' } 'none' { 'Restore has no backup to use.' }
            'changed' { 'Restore wrote nothing: the site changed after the dry run.' } default { 'Restore did not finish.' } }) }
        elseif ($Name -eq 'Uninstall') { $(switch ($st) { 'done' { $script:app.Name + ' is uninstalled.' } 'refused' { 'Uninstall cannot run here.' } 'no-backup' { 'Uninstall removed nothing.' }
            'review' { 'Uninstall did not finish.' } default { 'Uninstall stopped with an error.' } }) }
        elseif ($st -eq 'done') { 'Back up saved the lists.' } elseif ($st -eq 'none') { 'Back up has no lists to save.' }
        elseif ($st -eq 'no-site') { 'Back up saved nothing.' } else { 'Back up did not save everything.' })
      if ($Name -eq 'Restore' -and $st -eq 'unmarked') { $sent = 'The test-site mark is removed.' }
      if ($Name -eq 'Restore' -and $st -eq 'unmark-failed') { $sent = 'The test-site mark was not removed.' }
      $lines = @($Res.Lines); $path = $(if ($Res.Path) { [string]$Res.Path } else { $null })
      $buttons = @(@{ Text = 'Done'; Kind = 'primary'; Act = $ui.ToolsBack })
      # Uninstall (engine-v40): after a whole Uninstall the app is not installed, so Done goes to Choose; else to the Maintenance card.
      if ($Name -eq 'Uninstall') { $buttons = @(@{ Text = 'Done'; Kind = 'primary'; Act = $(if ($st -eq 'done') { { & $ui.VChoose } } else { { & $ui.VMaint $ui.MaintInst } }) }) }
      if ($Res.Unmark) { $buttons = @(& $ui.UnmarkButton) + $buttons }   # a marked site with no backup (engine-v33)
      & $ui.SetCard @{ View = 'toolres'; Light = $(if ($bad) { 'bad' } else { '' }); Kicker = [string]$ui.Kick.Text; Sentence = $sent
        P = @($lines | Select-Object -First 2); Lines = @($lines | Select-Object -Skip 2); Path = $path
        Buttons = $buttons; Back = $(if ($Name -eq 'Uninstall') { $buttons[0].Act } else { $ui.ToolsBack }) }
      & $ui.ToFront }

    $ui.VRestorePick = {
      <#
      .SYNOPSIS
      Restore, card 1 (view restpick): the backups on this computer, newest first, one row each.
      .DESCRIPTION
      A site that only lacks the local test-site mark (engine-v32) goes to the mark card ($ui.VRestoreMark); a site that is
      not a test site, or no backup, goes straight to the result card. Keeps the site name for the "Test site:" line of the
      dry-run and confirm cards ($ui.RestoreSite). Takes no parameter.
      #>
      $appPath = Get-BasePath; $siteCheck = Test-RestoreSite $appPath
      if ($siteCheck.NeedMark) { $ui.MarkNext = $ui.VRestorePick; $ui.MarkBack = $ui.ToolsBack; & $ui.VRestoreMark; return }
      if (-not $siteCheck.Ok) { & $ui.ToolResult 'Restore' @{ State = 'refused'; Path = ''; Lines = $siteCheck.Lines }; return }
      $ui.RestoreSite = [string]$siteCheck.Name; $marked = [bool]$script:app.Restore.Local   # Ok with "local": the site is marked
      $ui.RestoreSets = @(Get-BackupSet $appPath)
      $noSet = @('There is no backup of this app on this computer.', 'Select "Back up" first.')
      if (-not $ui.RestoreSets.Count) { & $ui.ToolResult 'Restore' @{ State = 'none'; Path = ''; Unmark = $marked; Lines = $noSet }; return }
      $buttons = $(if ($marked) { @(& $ui.UnmarkButton) } else { $null })   # the focus is on the newest backup row (SetCard), never on this button
      $rows = @(for ($k = 0; $k -lt $ui.RestoreSets.Count; $k++) { $set = $ui.RestoreSets[$k]
          @{ Index = $k; Name = $set.Name; Ver = ''; Sub = ([string]$set.Lists + ' of ' + @($script:app.Backup).Count + ' lists'); R1 = $(if ($k -eq 0) { 'Newest' } else { '' }) } })
      & $ui.SetCard @{ View = 'restpick'; Kicker = [string]$ui.Kick.Text; Sentence = 'Which backup does Restore use?'
        P = @('Restore first runs a dry run on the site and shows what it would put back. Nothing is written before you confirm.')
        Options = $rows; OnOption = { param($j) & $ui.RestorePlan $j }; Buttons = $buttons; Back = $ui.ToolsBack } }


    # The "Remove test-site mark" button (engine-v33; the Administrator, 2026-11-21): a secondary button on the backup card
    # and on the no-backup result card of a marked site. Takes nothing; gives back the button table.
    $ui.UnmarkButton = { return @{ Text = 'Remove test-site mark'; Kind = ''; Act = { & $ui.RestoreUnmark } } }

    # Removes the mark, then shows the result card. No typed confirm: it makes Restore stricter. Takes nothing.
    $ui.RestoreUnmark = {
      if ($ui.Busy) { return }
      $res = @{ State = 'unmarked'; Path = ''; Lines = @('The saved site is no longer marked as a test site on this computer.', 'Restore asks for the site name again before it runs.') }
      try { Clear-RestoreMark (Get-BasePath) }
      catch { $res = @{ State = 'unmark-failed'; Path = ''; Lines = @(('The mark could not be removed [' + $_.Exception.GetType().Name + '].'), 'Nothing was changed.') } }
      & $ui.ToolResult 'Restore' $res }

    $ui.VRestoreMark = {
      <#
      .SYNOPSIS
      Restore, the mark card (view restmark): the person types the saved site's name to mark it as a test site on this
      computer.
      .DESCRIPTION
      The Administrator, 2026-11-21: for an app whose manifest gives "testSites": "local" (its public repo names no site).
      The card does not show the name: the person types it, so the mark says they know which site this is. The mark is
      stored only on this computer, next to the site address (Config). Takes no parameter.
      #>
      $where = "The mark stays on this computer only, in the app's Config folder. Restore and Uninstall refuse every site without it."
      & $ui.SetCard @{ View = 'restmark'; Light = 'you'; Kicker = [string]$ui.Kick.Text; Sentence = 'Is the saved site a test site?'
        P = @('Restore and Uninstall change only a test site. To mark the saved site as one, type its name: the part of its address after the last /.', $where)
        Field = @{ Label = 'Site name'; Text = ''; Name = 'The site name, to mark the saved site as a test site'; Max = 200 }; Focus = 'field'
        Buttons = @(@{ Text = 'Mark as test site'; Kind = 'primary'; Act = { & $ui.RestoreMarkGo } }); Back = $(if ($ui.MarkBack) { $ui.MarkBack } else { $ui.ToolsBack }) } }

    # Restore, the mark card's button: checks the typed name against the saved site (without case; a pasted full address
    # counts too), saves the mark, then shows card 1. Takes nothing.
    $ui.RestoreMarkGo = {
      if ($ui.Busy) { return }
      $appPath = Get-BasePath; $siteCheck = Test-RestoreSite $appPath; $typed = $ui.Field.Text.Trim().TrimEnd('/')
      if ($typed.StartsWith($sitePrefix, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { $typed = $typed.Substring($sitePrefix.Length) }
      if (-not $siteCheck.Name -or $typed -ne $siteCheck.Name) { & $ui.Say1 'That is not the name of the saved site. Type the part of its address after the last /.'; return }
      try { Save-RestoreMark $appPath $siteCheck.Name }
      catch { & $ui.Say1 ('The mark could not be saved [' + $_.Exception.GetType().Name + ']. Nothing was changed.'); return }
      if ($ui.MarkNext) { & $ui.MarkNext } else { & $ui.VRestorePick } }   # Restore's backup card, or Uninstall's confirm card

    $ui.RestorePlan = {
      <#
      .SYNOPSIS
      Restore, card 2: runs the dry run of the backup picked (reads the site only), then shows the confirm card.
      .PARAMETER Row
      The backup's row number on the restpick card.
      #>
      param([int]$Row)
      if ($ui.Busy -or $Row -ge @($ui.RestoreSets).Count) { return }
      $ui.RestoreDir = [string]$ui.RestoreSets[$Row].Path
      $siteLine = 'Test site: ' + $ui.RestoreSite
      & $ui.SetCard @{ View = 'toolrun'; Kicker = [string]$ui.Kick.Text; Sentence = 'The Restore dry run is running.'; P = @($siteLine, 'Reads the site. Nothing is written. ' + $ui.SignInHint) }
      $ui.Busy = $true; [System.Windows.Forms.Application]::DoEvents(); $dry = $null
      try { $dry = Invoke-RestorePlan (Get-BasePath) $ui.RestoreDir { [System.Windows.Forms.Application]::DoEvents() } }
      catch { $dry = @{ State = 'failed'; Lines = @(('The dry run stopped with an error [' + $_.Exception.GetType().Name + '].'), 'Nothing was changed.') } }
      finally { $ui.Busy = $false }
      if ($ui.Form.IsDisposed -or $script:closing) { return }
      if ($dry.State -ne 'plan') { & $ui.ToolResult 'Restore' $dry; return }
      $ui.RestoreDry = $dry; & $ui.VRestoreConfirm }

    $ui.VRestoreConfirm = {
      <#
      .SYNOPSIS
      Restore, card 3 (view restconfirm): the dry run's counts for each list and, when rows would come back, the box for
      the app name.
      .DESCRIPTION
      The Administrator, 2026-11-21: the user types the app name, then RADE saves a fresh backup, then writes. With nothing
      to put back the card has Done only. Reads $ui.RestoreDry (Invoke-RestorePlan); takes no parameter.
      #>
      $dry = $ui.RestoreDry; $lines = @($dry.Lines); $siteLine = 'Test site: ' + $ui.RestoreSite
      if (-not $dry.Missing) { & $ui.SetCard @{ View = 'restconfirm'; Kicker = [string]$ui.Kick.Text; Sentence = 'Nothing to restore.'
          P = @($siteLine, $lines[0]); Lines = @($lines | Select-Object -Skip 1)
          Buttons = @(@{ Text = 'Done'; Kind = 'primary'; Act = $ui.ToolsBack }); Back = { & $ui.VRestorePick } }; return }
      $pauseDef = $script:app.Restore.Pause
      $flow = $(if ($pauseDef) { "RADE turns the app's pause switch on while it writes, then puts it back." } else { 'This app names no pause switch: its flows keep running while rows come back.' })
      # One operator (the Administrator, 2026-11-21): the record of re-made rows is in this RADE folder only.
      $oneOperator = 'Only one person runs Restore for this site, from this RADE folder.'
      & $ui.SetCard @{ View = 'restconfirm'; Light = 'you'; Kicker = [string]$ui.Kick.Text; Sentence = ('Put back ' + $dry.Missing + ' rows on the site?')
        P = @($siteLine, $lines[0], ('RADE first saves a fresh backup. Rows on the lists now are not changed. ' + $flow + ' ' + $oneOperator)); Lines = @($lines | Select-Object -Skip 1)
        Field = @{ Label = ('Type ' + $script:app.Name + ' to confirm'); Text = ''; Name = 'The app name, to confirm Restore' }; Focus = 'field'
        Buttons = @(@{ Text = 'Restore'; Kind = 'primary'; Act = { & $ui.RestoreGo } }); Back = { & $ui.VRestorePick } } }

    # Restore, card 4: checks the typed name, then runs the write (Invoke-Restore) and shows its result. Takes nothing.
    $ui.RestoreGo = {
      if ($ui.Busy) { return }
      if ($ui.Field.Text.Trim() -cne [string]$script:app.Name) { & $ui.Say1 ('Type the app name as shown: ' + $script:app.Name); return }
      & $ui.SetCard @{ View = 'toolrun'; Kicker = [string]$ui.Kick.Text; Sentence = 'Restore is running.'; P = @('It saves a fresh backup, then puts the missing rows back. Do not close RADE.') }
      $ui.Busy = $true; [System.Windows.Forms.Application]::DoEvents(); $res = $null
      try { $res = Invoke-Restore (Get-BasePath) $ui.RestoreDir $ui.RestoreDry { [System.Windows.Forms.Application]::DoEvents() } }
      catch { $res = @{ State = 'failed'; Path = ''; Lines = @(('Restore stopped with an error [' + $_.Exception.GetType().Name + '].'), 'Run Restore again: it puts back only what is still missing.') } }
      finally { $ui.Busy = $false; $ui.RestoreDry = $null }
      if ($ui.Form.IsDisposed -or $script:closing) { return }
      & $ui.ToolResult 'Restore' $res }

    $ui.VUninstall = {
      <#
      .SYNOPSIS
      Uninstall, the first card: the test-site gate, then the Backups card (view unbackups; engine-v48, the orchestrator's
      choice of 2026-11-27 for DECISIONS 2026-11-26: keep the Backups folder, or remove it too).
      .DESCRIPTION
      Test sites only (the Restore gate: a site that only lacks the local mark goes to the mark card first, then back here).
      The Backups card asks one question with two buttons: "Keep the Backups folder" (the main button, Enter) and "Remove
      the Backups folder too"; each one goes to the confirm card ($ui.VUninstallConfirm). Back (Esc) goes to Maintenance.
      Takes no parameter.
      #>
      if ($ui.Busy) { return }
      $siteCheck = Test-UninstallSite (Get-BasePath)
      # The mark card goes on to this card, and its Back returns to the Maintenance card.
      if ($siteCheck.NeedMark) { $ui.MarkNext = $ui.VUninstall; $ui.MarkBack = $ui.ToolsBack; & $ui.VRestoreMark; return }
      if (-not $siteCheck.Ok) { & $ui.ToolResult 'Uninstall' @{ State = 'refused'; Path = ''; Lines = @($siteCheck.Lines) }; return }
      $ui.UninstallSite = [string]$siteCheck.Name
      & $ui.SetCard @{ View = 'unbackups'; Light = 'you'; Kicker = [string]$ui.Kick.Text; Sentence = 'Keep the Backups folder?'
        P = @(('The Backups folder holds the backups of ' + (Get-AppWord) + '. Restore needs them.'))
        Buttons = @(@{ Text = 'Remove the Backups folder too'; Kind = ''; Act = { $ui.UninstallKeep = $false; & $ui.VUninstallConfirm } },
          @{ Text = 'Keep the Backups folder'; Kind = 'primary'; Act = { $ui.UninstallKeep = $true; & $ui.VUninstallConfirm } }); Back = { & $ui.VMaint $ui.MaintInst } } }

    $ui.VUninstallConfirm = {
      <#
      .SYNOPSIS
      Uninstall, the confirm card (view unconfirm; engine-v40, 90-161.Z R43 E3, the PFM, 2026-11-25).
      .DESCRIPTION
      The card names the test site, the backup, the app's Uninstall steps (a hand step says so), what goes to the Recycle
      Bin after them and the Backups choice of the card before ($ui.UninstallKeep; engine-v48); the person types the app
      name, then "Uninstall" (dark red: the one destructive action) runs it. Back goes to the Backups card. Takes no parameter.
      #>
      if ($ui.Busy) { return }
      $all = @($script:app.Uninstall); $n = @($script:app.Backup).Count
      $rows = @(for ($i = 0; $i -lt $all.Count; $i++) { $st = $steps[[int]$all[$i]]
          ([string]($i + 1) + '. ' + (Get-StepTitle $st) + $(if ($st.Kind -eq 'guide') { ' (you do this step)' } else { '' })) })
      $what = 'RADE first backs up ' + $n + ' list(s). Then it runs ' + $(if ($all.Count -eq 1) { 'this step' } else { 'these ' + $all.Count + ' steps' }) + ' of ' + $script:app.Name + '.'
      $what += ' They remove what the install made on the site.'
      # engine-v48 (DECISIONS 2026-11-26): after the steps, the clean-up (Invoke-Uninstall, part 17); the last app's also takes RADE's shared files.
      $clean = $(if ($ui.UninstallKeep) { 'After the steps, RADE moves the app files, the runner copy, the shortcut and the install record to the Recycle Bin. Your choice: keep the Backups folder.' }
        else { 'After the steps, RADE moves the app folder, the runner copy, the shortcut and the install record to the Recycle Bin. Your choice: remove the Backups folder too.' })
      if (-not @(Get-OtherRecordKey (Get-InstalledKey $script:app)).Count) { $clean += ' No other app has an install record on this computer, so RADE\Config and RADE\runners go to the Recycle Bin too.' }
      & $ui.SetCard @{ View = 'unconfirm'; Light = 'you'; Kicker = [string]$ui.Kick.Text; Sentence = ('Uninstall ' + $script:app.Name + ' from the test site?')
        P = @(('Test site: ' + $ui.UninstallSite), $what, $clean); Lines = $rows
        Field = @{ Label = ('Type ' + $script:app.Name + ' to confirm'); Text = ''; Name = 'The app name, to confirm Uninstall' }; Focus = 'field'
        Buttons = @(@{ Text = 'Uninstall'; Kind = 'danger'; Act = { & $ui.UninstallGo } }); Back = { & $ui.VUninstall } } }

    $ui.UninstallGo = {
      <#
      .SYNOPSIS
      Uninstall, the run: checks the typed app name, runs Invoke-Uninstall (part 17) with the Backups choice, then shows the result card.
      .DESCRIPTION
      The name must match exactly, capitals too. The run card names each step; a hand step shows its own card. Takes no
      parameter.
      #>
      if ($ui.Busy) { return }
      if ($ui.Field.Text.Trim() -cne [string]$script:app.Name) { & $ui.Say1 ('Type the app name as shown: ' + $script:app.Name); return }
      $siteLine = 'Test site: ' + $ui.UninstallSite
      # The run card with one sentence: what Uninstall does now. Takes the sentence.
      $card = { param($Text) & $ui.SetCard @{ View = 'toolrun'; Kicker = [string]$ui.Kick.Text; Sentence = $Text; P = @($siteLine, 'Do not close RADE. ' + $ui.SignInHint) } }
      & $card 'Uninstall is saving a backup.'
      $ui.Busy = $true; [System.Windows.Forms.Application]::DoEvents(); $res = $null
      # Before each step: the run card names it. Takes the step, its number and the count.
      $onStep = { param($St, $I, $N) & $card ('Uninstall step ' + $I + ' of ' + $N + ': ' + (Get-StepTitle $St)); [System.Windows.Forms.Application]::DoEvents() }
      try { $res = Invoke-Uninstall (Get-BasePath) { [System.Windows.Forms.Application]::DoEvents() } $onStep ([bool]$ui.UninstallKeep) }   # the Backups card's choice
      catch { $why = 'Uninstall stopped with an error [' + $_.Exception.GetType().Name + '].'
        $res = @{ State = 'failed'; Path = ''; Lines = @($why, 'Select "Uninstall" again: its steps remove only what is still there.') } }
      finally { $ui.Busy = $false }
      if ($ui.Form.IsDisposed -or $script:closing) { return }
      & $ui.ToolResult 'Uninstall' $res }
    # ==== Engine part: engine/ps/window/10-keys.ps1 (sha256 e019997dc19d)
    # RADE window part 10, keys and form events: the key handlers (F2, Esc, Enter, Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V in the answer box), the window place
    # saved and restored, and the call that shows the form. It is the last window part.
    # Joined into every bundle by engine/rade_build.py; Windows PowerShell 5.1.

    # ---- Keys: F1 = Help (the RADE tour); F2 = the Record (Page Down and Page Up move its check list, and on a card that is taller than the window its text); Esc = close the Record, else Back where $ui.EscViews says, the Cancel question on Run, and on Choose (no Back) it exits; Enter = the main button; 1 to 9 = a choice.
    $ui.Form.Add_KeyDown({
      $k = [string]$_.KeyCode
      if ($_.Control -and $k -eq 'C' -and (& $ui.CopyText $ui.Form.ActiveControl)) { $_.SuppressKeyPress = $true }   # Ctrl+C copies the selected card text
      elseif ((($_.Control -and $k -eq 'V') -or ($_.Shift -and $k -eq 'Insert')) -and [object]::ReferenceEquals($ui.Form.ActiveControl, $ui.Field) -and (& $ui.PasteLine $ui.Field)) { $_.SuppressKeyPress = $true }   # R34: a pasted block goes into the one-line answer box whole
      elseif ($k -eq 'F1') { $_.SuppressKeyPress = $true; & $ui.OpenTour }   # L6: Help = the RADE tour
      elseif ($k -eq 'F2') { $_.SuppressKeyPress = $true; if ($ui.RecOn) { & $ui.CloseRecord } else { & $ui.VRecord } }
      elseif ($ui.RecOn -and $k -in 'PageDown', 'Next', 'PageUp', 'Prior' -and -not (& $ui.InField)) {   # the check list by keyboard when it is taller than the window; Windows names these keys Next and Prior; in the log box they page the log
        $_.SuppressKeyPress = $true; try { $y = [math]::Abs($ui.RecScroll.AutoScrollPosition.Y) + $(if ($k -in 'PageDown', 'Next') { 1 } else { -1 }) * [math]::Max((& $ui.Sc 40), $ui.RecScroll.ClientSize.Height - (& $ui.Sc 40)); $ui.RecScroll.AutoScrollPosition = New-Object System.Drawing.Point(0, [math]::Max(0, $y)) } catch { $null = $_ } }
      elseif (-not $ui.RecOn -and $ui.Scrolls -and $k -in 'PageDown', 'Next', 'PageUp', 'Prior' -and -not (& $ui.InField)) {   # the text of a card that is taller than the window, by keyboard
        $_.SuppressKeyPress = $true; try { $y = [math]::Abs($ui.Scroll.AutoScrollPosition.Y) + $(if ($k -in 'PageDown', 'Next') { 1 } else { -1 }) * [math]::Max((& $ui.Sc 40), $ui.Scroll.ClientSize.Height - (& $ui.Sc 40)); $ui.Scroll.AutoScrollPosition = New-Object System.Drawing.Point(0, [math]::Max(0, $y)) } catch { $null = $_ } }
      elseif ($k -eq 'Escape') { $_.SuppressKeyPress = $true   # Cards v2: Back only where it is safe ($ui.EscViews); on the Run card the Cancel question; else nothing
        if ($ui.RecOn) { & $ui.CloseRecord } elseif ($ui.View -eq 'run' -and $ui.Running) { & $ui.VCancelQ } elseif ($ui.Back -and $ui.EscViews -contains $ui.View -and -not $ui.Busy -and -not $ui.Running) { & $ui.Back } elseif ($ui.View -eq 'choose' -and -not $ui.Busy) { $ui.Form.Close() } }
      elseif ($k -in 'Return', 'Enter' -and -not $ui.RecOn -and $ui.Form.AcceptButton -and -not ($ui.BoxNoEnter -and (& $ui.InField)) -and -not (($ui.Form.ActiveControl -is [System.Windows.Forms.TextBoxBase]) -and -not $ui.Form.ActiveControl.ReadOnly -and $ui.Form.ActiveControl.Multiline)) {
        $_.SuppressKeyPress = $true; $ui.Form.AcceptButton.PerformClick() }   # Enter = the main button also when the card's text has the focus (a box that takes several lines keeps its Enter)
      elseif ($k -match '^(D|NumPad)([1-9])$' -and -not $ui.RecOn -and -not $ui.Busy -and $ui.Opts.Visible -and -not (& $ui.InField)) {
        $n = [int]$Matches[2]; foreach ($o in @($ui.Opts.Controls)) { if (-not $o.Tag.Off -and [int]$o.Tag.Key -eq $n) { $_.SuppressKeyPress = $true; $o.PerformClick(); break } } } })
    # Window size and place (R28, the Administrator, 2026-11-17): the window opens where the user last closed it (RADE\Config\rade-window.json;
    # bounds that are off every current screen are ignored); the first time it is maximized on the screen that shows the mouse. The
    # minimum size is engine/window.json minSize (640 x 480 at 100 %, so Windows Snap can offer its zones; the Administrator, 2026-11-18;
    # 1280 x 720 before), cut to the work area of a small screen. The size and the state at Shown and at close are
    # recorded, and the layout self-check runs again after each resize (debounced: 400 ms after the last size change).
    $ui.Place = {
      $f = $ui.Form; $saved = Read-WindowState; $ui.Placed = 'first run'; $ui.LastClose = $(if ($saved) { [string]$saved.Closed } else { '' })
      try {
        $use = $null; $wa = $null
        if ($saved) { $r = New-Object System.Drawing.Rectangle($saved.X, $saved.Y, $saved.W, $saved.H)
          foreach ($sc in @([System.Windows.Forms.Screen]::AllScreens)) { $i = [System.Drawing.Rectangle]::Intersect($sc.WorkingArea, $r); if ($i.Width -ge (& $ui.Sc 120) -and $i.Height -ge (& $ui.Sc 60)) { $use = $r; $wa = $sc.WorkingArea; break } } }
        if ($use) {
          $w = $use.Width; $h = $use.Height
          if ($saved.Dpi -gt 0 -and [int]$ui.Dpi -ne $saved.Dpi) { $w = [int]($w * $ui.Dpi / $saved.Dpi); $h = [int]($h * $ui.Dpi / $saved.Dpi) }   # the screen scale changed since: the size follows
          $w = [math]::Min($w, $wa.Width); $h = [math]::Min($h, $wa.Height)
          $x = [math]::Max($wa.Left, [math]::Min($use.X, $wa.Right - $w)); $y = [math]::Max($wa.Top, [math]::Min($use.Y, $wa.Bottom - $h))
          $f.Bounds = New-Object System.Drawing.Rectangle($x, $y, $w, $h); $ui.Placed = 'saved'
          if ($saved.State -eq 'Maximized') { $f.WindowState = 'Maximized' }
        } else {
          $sc = [System.Windows.Forms.Screen]::FromPoint([System.Windows.Forms.Cursor]::Position); $wa = $sc.WorkingArea
          $f.Width = [int]($wa.Width * 0.95); $f.Height = [int]($wa.Height * 0.95); $f.Left = $wa.Left + [int](($wa.Width - $f.Width) / 2); $f.Top = $wa.Top + [int](($wa.Height - $f.Height) / 2)   # where Restore goes
          $f.WindowState = 'Maximized'
        }
        $f.MinimumSize = New-Object System.Drawing.Size([math]::Min((& $ui.Sc $ui.Layout.MinW), $wa.Width), [math]::Min((& $ui.Sc $ui.Layout.MinH), $wa.Height))
      } catch { $null = $_ } }
    # Gives the form's client size and window state as text like "1020x760/Normal". Takes nothing.
    $ui.WinNow = { $f = $ui.Form; $s = [string]$f.WindowState; if ($s -notin 'Normal', 'Maximized', 'Minimized') { $s = 'Normal' }; return ([string]$f.ClientSize.Width + 'x' + $f.ClientSize.Height + '/' + $s) }
    $ui.ResizeT = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Timer; $ui.ResizeT.Interval = 400
    $ui.ResizeT.Add_Tick({ $ui.ResizeT.Stop(); try { if ($ui.Scaled -and [string]$ui.Form.WindowState -ne 'Minimized') { & $ui.Fit; & $ui.Check } } catch { $null = $_ } })
    $ui.Form.Add_Resize({ try { if ($ui.Scaled) { $ui.ResizeT.Stop(); $ui.ResizeT.Start() } } catch { $null = $_ } })
    # The mouse wheel (R32, the Administrator, 2026-11-18: "scroll works only when hovering the scroll bar"). Windows sends the
    # wheel to the control that has the focus, and a text of the card or a button does not pass it on. So every control of the
    # window hands the wheel to $ui.Wheel: it moves the Record's list when the Record is open, else the card's text, 3 lines for
    # each notch, when that area has more than it shows. A box that scrolls its own text (the log) keeps the wheel.
    # Takes the control that got the wheel and the event; marks the event as handled when it moved an area.
    $ui.Wheel = { param($S, $E)
      try {
        if (($S -is [System.Windows.Forms.TextBoxBase]) -and $S.Multiline -and [string]$S.ScrollBars -ne 'None') { return }
        if ($S -is [System.Windows.Forms.ScrollableControl] -and $S.AutoScroll -and $S.VerticalScroll.Visible) { return }   # an area that scrolls moves itself
        $a = $(if ($ui.RecOn) { $ui.RecScroll } else { $ui.Scroll }); if (-not $a -or -not $a.VerticalScroll.Visible) { return }
        $y = [math]::Abs($a.AutoScrollPosition.Y) - [int][math]::Round($E.Delta / 120.0 * 3 * $ui.F.Body.Height)
        $a.AutoScrollPosition = New-Object System.Drawing.Point(0, ([int][math]::Max(0, $y)))
        if ($E -is [System.Windows.Forms.HandledMouseEventArgs]) { $E.Handled = $true }
      } catch { $null = $_ } }   # the wheel never stops the window
    # Hooks the wheel on a control and on every control inside it (a control added later hands the wheel to its parent, which
    # has the hook). Takes the control.
    $ui.WheelOn = { param($C) try { $C.Add_MouseWheel({ & $ui.Wheel $this $_ }) } catch { $null = $_ }; foreach ($k in @($C.Controls)) { & $ui.WheelOn $k } }   # a control with no wheel event: skipped
    $ui.Form.Add_Shown({
      & $ui.WheelOn $ui.Form
      $ui.Opened = $true; & $ui.FormDpi; $ui.Scaled = $true   # the form has its scale now: from here the size handlers work (each runs once below or on the first card)
      foreach ($b in @($ui.BtnKind.Keys)) { & $ui.FitBtn $b }   # UI standard v1: every button at its fixed size for this scale
      & $ui.Place
      & $ui.Fit; $ui.ShownAt = & $ui.WinNow; & $ui.LogScale; $ui.Anim.Start()   # E4: this window's SCALE line for the round's results
      & $ui.Boot })
    $ui.Form.Add_SystemColorsChanged({ & $ui.Recolor $false })   # a contrast theme came on or went off (UI standard v1, B11): the window's own thread
    $ui.Form.Add_FormClosing({
      # The window's X (there is no Exit button): ask first only while a step runs, because closing stops it (R17).
      if ($ui.Running -and -not $script:closing) {
        $a = [System.Windows.Forms.MessageBox]::Show($ui.Form, 'A step is running. If you exit now, RADE stops it and the round ends as STOPPED (the report in the results folder says so). Exit now?', 'RADE - Exit', [System.Windows.Forms.MessageBoxButtons]::YesNo, [System.Windows.Forms.MessageBoxIcon]::Warning, [System.Windows.Forms.MessageBoxDefaultButton]::Button2)
        if ([string]$a -ne 'Yes') { $_.Cancel = $true; return }
      }
      $script:closing = $true; try { $ui.Anim.Stop(); $ui.ResizeT.Stop(); $ui.TimeT.Stop() } catch { $null = $_ }
      try { $f = $ui.Form; $ui.CloseAt = & $ui.WinNow; $st = [string]$f.WindowState; if ($st -eq 'Minimized') { $st = 'Normal' }
        $b = $(if ([string]$f.WindowState -eq 'Normal') { $f.Bounds } else { $f.RestoreBounds }); $cp = ($ui.CloseAt -split '/'); $cs = ([string]$cp[0] -split 'x')   # split on / first: "Maximized" holds an x
        Save-WindowState $b.X $b.Y $b.Width $b.Height $st ([int]$ui.Dpi) ([int]$cs[0]) ([int]$cs[1]) ([string]$cp[1])
        Write-Host ('RADE window at close: client ' + ($ui.CloseAt -replace '/', ', ') + '.') } catch { $null = $_ }
      if ($script:child -and -not $script:child.HasExited) { try { $script:child.Kill() } catch { $null = $_ } } })
    # The window is the main form of this thread, with no owner (R24: shown with ShowDialog from PowerShell ISE, ISE owned
    # it, so it had no taskbar button and could not be restored after it was minimized). When a message loop already runs
    # on this thread, Application.Run cannot start one: then ShowDialog, as before. Run disposes the form when it closes.
    $ui.Opened = $false
    try { [System.Windows.Forms.Application]::Run($ui.Form) }
    catch {
      $ex = $_.Exception; while ($ex -and -not ($ex -is [System.InvalidOperationException])) { $ex = $ex.InnerException }
      if (-not $ex -or $ui.Opened -or $ui.Form.IsDisposed) { throw }   # only a loop that could not start: the window never showed
      [void]$ui.Form.ShowDialog()
    }
    foreach ($o in @($ui.Trash)) { try { $o.Dispose() } catch { $null = $_ } }   # after the window has closed: no handler is running
    return
  } catch {
    $gui = $false; $script:noWindowWhy = [string]$_.Exception.Message
    if ($_.InvocationInfo) { $script:noWindowWhy += ' (line ' + $_.InvocationInfo.ScriptLineNumber + ')' }
    $shown = $script:noWindowWhy
    if ($env:USERPROFILE) { $shown = $shown -replace [regex]::Escape([string]$env:USERPROFILE), 'C:\Users\<DODID>' }
    Write-Host ('No window could open (' + (ConvertTo-Masked $shown) + '). The round runs in text mode.')
  } finally {
    # R34 (review of PR 124): the thread's own dpi awareness comes back also when the window failed (window part 01 changed it).
    if ($script:dpiOld -ne [IntPtr]::Zero) {
      try { $null = [Rade.Dpi]::SetThreadDpiAwarenessContext($script:dpiOld) } catch { $null = $_ }   # a failure leaves the closed window's setting
      $script:dpiOld = [IntPtr]::Zero }
  }
}
# ==== Engine part: engine/ps/11-text-mode.ps1 (sha256 300b8c9bc270)
# RADE engine part 11, text mode: runs the whole round in the console (checks, plan, the Enter prompt,
# the round and the summary) when no window is open. Uses the parts before it.
# Joined into every bundle by engine/rade_build.py; Windows PowerShell 5.1.

<#
.SYNOPSIS
Shows this process's console window again (engine-v44, review of the hidden ISE child).
.DESCRIPTION
The ISE child (Invoke-IseWindow, part 05) and, from engine-v46, the app's shortcut start with -WindowStyle Hidden, so
no blank console shows while the RADE window is open. When the window cannot open there, text mode runs in that console: it must show, or its questions wait
where nobody can see them. Only the console of this process is shown; nothing else is read or changed. Windows only;
a failure (no console, Constrained Language Mode) changes nothing.
.OUTPUTS
None.
#>
function Show-RadeConsole {
  if ($env:OS -ne 'Windows_NT') { return }
  try {
    if (-not ('RadeConsole.Show1' -as [type])) {
      Add-Type -Namespace RadeConsole -Name Show1 -ErrorAction Stop -MemberDefinition @"
[System.Runtime.InteropServices.DllImport("kernel32.dll")] public static extern System.IntPtr GetConsoleWindow();
[System.Runtime.InteropServices.DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool ShowWindow(System.IntPtr h, int cmd);
"@
    }
    $cw = [RadeConsole.Show1]::GetConsoleWindow()
    if ($cw -ne [IntPtr]::Zero) { $null = [RadeConsole.Show1]::ShowWindow($cw, 9) }   # 9 = SW_RESTORE: shown and not minimized
  } catch { $null = $_ }   # no console to show: text mode writes as before
}

try {
  if ($env:RADE_HOST -in 'child', 'shortcut') { Show-RadeConsole }   # a hidden console (ISE child, shortcut): it shows for text mode
  $script:textMode = $true
  # Writes a line to the run log and the console. Takes the line; gives back nothing.
  $say = { param($t) Add-RunLog $t; Write-Host $t }
  Write-Host ('RADE - ' + $round + ' - build ' + $buildId)
  Write-Host $script:scriptCheck.Line   # the bundle hash, to compare with the RADE page (docs/specs/bundle-hash.md)
  Write-Host (Get-LastRoundText (Read-RoundHistory (Get-BasePath)))
  $newer = Get-NewerRound
  if ($newer) { Write-Host ('A newer round, ' + $newer + ', is in the repository. Type N and press Enter to stop, then run ' + $newer + '.') }
  if ($apps.Count -gt 1) {
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $apps.Count; $i++) { Write-Host ('  ' + ($i + 1) + '. ' + $apps[$i].Name) }
    $pick = ([string](Read-Host ('Type the number of the application to deploy (1 to ' + $apps.Count + ') and press Enter'))).Trim()
    $pi = 0; if ([int]::TryParse($pick, [ref]$pi) -and $pi -ge 1 -and $pi -le $apps.Count) { Select-App ($pi - 1) }
  }
  Write-Host ('Application: ' + $script:app.Name)
  # All checks run here too: the sign-in check opens its own sign-in window; the Power Automate check asks in the console.
  $site0 = Get-SiteUrl (Get-BasePath)
  if (-not (Test-SiteUrl $site0) -and @($script:appChecks | Where-Object { $_ -in 'net-site', 'site-rights' }).Count) {
    $v = ([string](Read-Host 'Type the site address (it starts with https://usaf.dps.mil/sites/), then press Enter')).Trim()
    if (Test-SiteUrl $v) { $site0 = $v; try { Save-SiteUrl (Get-BasePath) $v } catch { $null = $_ } }   # saved as the window does: the record and the steps read it
  }
  $script:secret = Get-Secret (Get-ProfileLeaf) (Get-ProfileLeaf)
  $cache = Read-CheckCache
  foreach ($id in $script:appChecks) {
    $d = Get-CheckDef $id
    $r = Get-CheckToRun $d $cache (Get-BasePath) $site0 $false
    if (-not $r) { $r = Invoke-Check $d (Get-BasePath) $site0 $null }
    $script:checkResults[$id] = $r
    Write-Host ('  ' + $r.State + ': ' + $d.Name + '. ' + $r.Detail + $(if ($r.Fix -and ($r.State -ne 'PASSED' -or $r.Saved)) { ' | ' + $r.Fix } else { '' }))
  }
  Save-CheckCache $script:checkResults (Get-BasePath) $site0
  if ($checkGate -and (Get-CheckBlock $script:checkResults)) {
    # PFM 14 Nov 26: no deploy unless every check passes. Nothing has been written.
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host 'You cannot deploy yet: a check is FAILED or NOT RUN (see above). Only the saved checks (RADE\Config\rade-checks.json) were written.'
    Write-Host 'Fix each one, then paste the round again.'
    return
  }
  # Pause and resume (the PFM, 2026-11-20; docs/engine.md "Pause and resume"): R (or Enter) resumes, S starts over.
  $rs = Read-RoundState (Get-BasePath)
  if ($rs.State -eq 'bad') { $null = Clear-RoundState (Get-BasePath); Write-Host ('The saved progress of this round could not be read (' + $rs.Why + '), so the round starts over.') }
  elseif ($rs.State -eq 'other') { $null = Clear-RoundState (Get-BasePath); Write-Host 'Saved progress of another build of this round was not used. The round starts over.' }
  elseif ($rs.State -eq 'ok') {
    $ra = ([string](Read-Host ('Type R and press Enter to resume at step ' + $rs.Next + ' of ' + $rs.Total + ', or type S and press Enter to start over'))).Trim()
    if ($ra -match '^[Ss]') { $why = Clear-RoundState (Get-BasePath); Write-Host $(if ($why) { 'The saved progress could not be moved to the Recycle Bin (' + $why + ').' } else { 'Start over: the saved progress is in the Recycle Bin.' }) }
    else { $script:resume = $rs.Doc; Write-Host ('Resume at step ' + $rs.Next + ' of ' + $rs.Total + '.') }
  }
  foreach ($l in (Get-RoundPlan).Lines) { Write-Host $l }
  if (Test-WordOpen) { Write-Host 'Word is open. Save your documents and close Word before you run (renders use Word).' }
  $to = $(if (Test-Deploy) { '' } else { Get-MailTo (Get-BasePath) })
  # The plan above shows first; Enter starts the run (PFM 13 Nov), N stops before anything is written.
  $go = ([string](Read-Host 'Press Enter to start the round, or type N and press Enter to stop with no changes')).Trim()
  if ($go -match '^[Nn]') { Write-Host 'Stopped. Only the saved checks (RADE\Config\rade-checks.json) were written.'; return }
  $sel = @(); for ($k = 0; $k -lt $steps.Count; $k++) { $sel += ($script:appSteps -contains $k -and (Get-StepDefault $k) -and -not $steps[$k].AskParam) }   # text mode: steps that need a folder are skipped
  # Text mode: prints the overall line when a step starts (step i of count and the percent). Takes the Invoke-Round values.
  $onStatusText = { param($i, $count, $name, $estimate) $null = $name; $null = $estimate; $g = Get-Progress; Write-Host ('  Overall: step ' + $i + ' of ' + $count + ', ' + [int]($g.All * 100) + ' % done, about ' + (Format-Duration $g.Left) + ' left (a guess)') }
  $checkLines = Get-CheckSummary $script:checkResults
  $sum = Invoke-Round $true $sel $to $say { } { } $onStatusText { 'Window: text mode (no window opened)' } @() $checkLines
  if (Test-Deploy) { return }   # a deploy sends nothing: no folder pop-up, no clipboard
  if ($script:resultsDir -and $env:OS -eq 'Windows_NT' -and -not $script:draftMade) { Start-Process -FilePath 'explorer.exe' -ArgumentList ('"' + $script:resultsDir + '"') }
  if (Get-Command Set-Clipboard -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { try { Set-Clipboard -Value ($sum -join "`r`n"); Write-Host 'Summary copied to the clipboard.' } catch { Write-Host 'The clipboard is not available.' } }
} catch {
  Write-Host ''
  $m = 'STOPPED: ' + (ConvertTo-Masked ([string]$_))
  Write-Host $m
  $w = Get-WhatToDo $m; if ($w) { Write-Host $w }
  if ($m -match '^STOPPED: INTERRUPTED: ') { Write-Host 'In text mode: insert your CAC, run RADE again and type R to resume at that step.' }
}
}
# ==== Paste guard, end (GENERATED): the script block above runs only from here, so a cut paste runs nothing.
$script:PasteOuter = $MyInvocation   # the whole text (engine/ps/05-installed.ps1 reads it when no file or ISE pane holds it)
. $script:PasteBody
